(91)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ (mi (91)0632 khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud/ 3brgyad pa/ khro bo gshin rje'i gshed kyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo rim par phye ba/ 3dgu pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi khro bo'i cho ga zhib mo phyi ma rim par phye ba/ 23bcu pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi cho ga zhib mo phyi ma'i yang phyi ma rim par phye ba/ 31bcu gcig pa/ gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa'i yig 'bru gcig pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa rim par phye ba/ 34bcu gnyis pa/ gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa'i yi ge gcig pa'i ri mo dang mchod pa dang bzlas pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba/ 37bcu gsum pa/ gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa'i yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i brtul zhugs rim par phye ba/ 39bcu bzhi pa/ khro bo gshin rje'i gshed kyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo bsdus pa

rim par phye ba/ 41bcwa lnga pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed zhal drug r+ghaṃ zhes bya ba las byung ba'i cho ga zhib mo rim par phye ba/ 42bcu drug pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed rim par phye ba/ 45bcu bdun pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi gsal shing khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i cho ga zhib mo phyi ma'i yang phyi ma gsang ba gsal shing rgyud rim par phye ba/ 48bcwa brgyad pa/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyal po rtog pa phyi ma'i yang phyi ma gsang ba rim par phye ba/ 54gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa ste dang po/ 61gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa ste gnyis pa/ 62gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa ste gsum pa/ 67gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa ste bzhi pa/ 71nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa lnga pa ste bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po la rjes su yi rang ba rim par phye ba/ 76bsdur mchan/(84) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(105)0633 'phags pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs zhes bya ba/ 106rnal 'byor gyi dbang rgyug chen po don yod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bsgyur/bod kyi ban+de skyo 'od 'byung la gnang /bsdur mchan/(109) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(110)0634 'phags pa be con chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 1112

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(117) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(119)0635 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 120pa'i ta su red dra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(124) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(126)0636 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 127rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye // sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchan/(130) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(131)0637 'phags pa thams cad la mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 132rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/3

bsdur mchan/(136) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(137)0638 'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ 138rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes ldes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(143) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(145)0639 tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 146bsdur mchan/(147) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(148)0640 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 1gorgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(153) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(155)0641 'phags pa lha mo skul byed ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 156bsdur mchan/(158) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(159)0642 'phags pa sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 160

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na 'i la dang / sku chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(173) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(177)0643 'phags pa bu mang po rton pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 178rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(180) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(181)༷644 'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 182rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shu sirnya dang /ban+de ye shes snying po'i sdes bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bca ka ra sirta dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(182) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(194)0645 'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 195rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(201) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(201)5

0646 'phags pa mdangs phyir 'phrog pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 202bsdur mchan/(204) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(205)0647 'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ 206bsdur mchan/(210) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(211)0648 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ 212bsdur mchan/(213) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(214)06go 'phags pa gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ 215rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / nu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(218) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(219)0650 'phags pa nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 220bsdur mchan/(222) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(222)0651 'phags pa nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 223

bsdur mchan/(224) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(224)0652 rims nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ 225bsdur mchan/(226) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(226)0653 'phags pa rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 227rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ṭī spras sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchad/(229) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(230)0654 'brum bu'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 231bsdur mchan/(232) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(232)0655 mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa/ 233bsdur mchan/(234) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(234)0656 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ 230paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo rnyi dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(245) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(247)7

0657 'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 248bsdur mchan/(250) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(251)0658 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/ 252bsdur mchan/(254) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(254)0659 'phags pa mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 255le'u dang po/ 255le'u gnyis pa/ 260le'u gsum pa/ 264le'u bzhi pa/ 266le'u lnga pa/ 270le'u drug pa/ 274le'u bdun pa/ 278le'u brgyad pa/ 282le'u dgu pa/ 285rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī mi tra dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(289) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(301)8

0660 'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud/ 302dang po lhag par gnas pa'i don yongs su bkod pa'i le'u/ 302gnyis pa de bzhin nyid kyi le'u/ 209gsum pa sngags dang phyag rgya'i le'u/ 312bzhi pa bris sku'i le'u/ 320lnga pa lha 'byung ba'i le'u/ 324drug pa skye bo gzung ba'i thabs kyi le'u/ 327bdun pa rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 335brgyad pa sbyor ba phran tshegs kyi le'u/ 338dgu pa sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 344bcu pa mngon par dga' ba'i le'u/ 350bsdur mchan/(355) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(372)0661 'phags pa gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 373rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(378) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(380)0662 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 381bsdur mchan/(387) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(389)9

0663 'phags pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 390bsdur mchan/(395) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(396)0664 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 397bsdur mchan/(404) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(406)0665 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 407bsdur mchan/(416) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(418)0666 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 419bsdur mchan/(426) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(428)0667 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 429bsdur mchan/(437) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(440)10

0668 'phags pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 441bsdur mchan/(446) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(448)0669 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 4gobasdur mchan/(455) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(456)0670 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes dra/ ba 457bsdur mchan/(460) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(461)0671 'phags pa byams pas dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 462rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(464) bsdur 'bras gere'u mig(465)0672 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 466rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar 11

chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(469) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(470)0673 bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 471bsdur mchan/(473) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(474)0674 yi dgas kha nas me 'bar ba la skyabs mdzad pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 475bsdur mchan/(481) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(483)0675 yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga 484bsdur mchan/(488) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(490)0676 'jur 'gegs zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ go1zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(496) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(498)0677 ye shes skar mda'i snying po/ ga9bsdur mchan/(500) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(501)12

00678 shes rab skyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 502rgya gar gyi mkhan po tsā na ga dang / lots+tsha ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje de ba tsan+d+ra sa zhus te gtan la phab/ bsdur mchan/(503) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(504)0679 thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ 505bsdur mchan/(506) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(506)0680 'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ 507bsdur mchan/(508) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(508)0681 de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ 509bsdur mchan/(510) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(510)0682 mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba/ 511rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(532) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(535)13

0683 'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 536rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradz+nyā bza dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(544) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(546)0684 'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i gzungs/ 547bsdur mchan/(549) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(550)0685 mdo chen po kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ 551rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(583) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(590)0686 'phags pa sprin chen po/ 591rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra snyo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(623) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(630)14

0687 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 631rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su red dra bo snyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(643) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(646)0688 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 647bsdur mchan/(649) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(650)0689 'phags ma gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 651rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku ring la bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas su rgya dpe la gtugs nas shin tu dag par byas/bsdur mchan/(658) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(660)0690 gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ri 661bsdur mchan/(667) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(669)0691 gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 67015

bsdur mchan/(676) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(677)0692 'phags pa nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 678bsdur mchan/(687) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(690)0693 bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa/ 691bsdur mchan/(694) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(695)0694 bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi rtog pa/ 696bsdur mchan/(700) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(702)0695 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po/ 703bsdur mchan/(705) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(706)0696 tshogs kyi bdag po chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 707dang po/ dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 707gnyis pa/ lha'i dngos grub kyi gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u/ 708gsum pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po bstan pa'i le'u/ 709bzhi pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sgrub pa'i le'u/ 709lnga pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i phyag rgya bstan pa'i le'u/ — 709drug pa/ tshogs bdag chen po'i gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u/ 71016

bdun pa/ mtshan gyi gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u/ 710brgyad pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po mchod pa'i le'u/ 711dgu pa/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i zhal zas bstan pa'i le'u/ 712bcu pa/ tshogs bdag chen po'i rgyud las rgyal po la sogs pa sgrub pa'i le'u/ 713bcu gcig pa/ tshogs bdag chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 715bcu gnyis pa/ bsgom pa'i rim pa'i le'u/ 717bcu gsum pa/ gnod sbyin chen po rnams kyi gsang sngags 'byung ba'i le'u/ 718bcu bzhi pa/ drag pos bsad pa sngags kyi le'u/ 719bco lnga pa/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa'i le'u/ 720rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri rba ka ra shrī tsā nas/ rgya gar yul nas bsnams nas byon te/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la gtad/bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(725)0697 dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud/ 726le'u dang po/ gleng gzhi/ 726le'u gnyis pa/ bsnyen cing bsgrub pa/ 727le'u gsum pa/ lus srog dbye ba/ 728le'u bzhi pa/ mtha' brtul ba/ 729le'u lnga pa/ ma grub na spogs pa'i cho ga dang gso ba/ 730le'u drug pa/ rtags kyi rim pa/ 7310le'u bdun pa/ ser ba dbab pa/ 731le'u brgyad pa/ 73117

rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba phur bu 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(732) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(734)0698 dpal mgon po nag po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 735bsdur mchan/(737) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(738)0699 'phags pa nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ 739rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bza dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(740) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(741)0700 lha mo nag mo chen mo'i gzungs/ 742bsdur mchan/(743) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(744)0701 dpal lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa rgyal po'i rgyud/ 745bsdur mchan/(761) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(764) 0702 dpal lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 766bsdur mchan/(770) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(771)18

0703 lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ 772bsdur mchan/(773) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(773)0704 tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i gzungs thung ngu gnyis/ 774bsdur mchan/(775) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(775) 0705 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 776bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(792)0706 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 793bsdur mchan/(804) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(807)0707 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 808rgya gar gyi mkhan po pu rgya saṃ bha wa dang / lots+tsha ba pa tshab nyi ma gas kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(813) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(815)0708 bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs sngags/ 81619

le'u brgyad pa/ sngags kyi sbyor ba/ 904le'u dgu pa/ sku la rten pa'i sbyor ba/ 914le'u bcu pa/ me la brten pa'i sbyor ba/ 924le'u bcu gcig pa/ phyag rgya la brten pa/ 933le'u bcu gnyis pa/ sbyor ba sna tshogs/ 941rig pa'i 'byung gnas rig pa'i 'od zer gyis shes rab pad+ma rgyas pa'i kha che'i yul bdud ji 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang chen bor paṇ+ḍi ta chen po so ma shrī bha bya zhes bya ba dang bod kyi lots+tsha ba kyu ra dge slong tshul khrims 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(953) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(101)0713 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 102rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1016) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1021)0714 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 1022bsdur mchan/(1028) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1028)0715 srid med kyi bus zhus pa 'phags pa sgyu ma chen mo rnam 21

༄ga /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud/nya)༄tshon /ci ②skad gsungs pa'i gzugs rnams la/ /me tog ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /rtag tu gang zhig mchod byed na/ /dge ba'i brtul zhugs 'di dag dang / /de bzhin sngon ③du bsnyen pa yang / /dran pa tsam ni 'ba' zhig gis/ /nges par 'dod de de dag nga nyid/ /mchod pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal srid sbyin pa'i gzugs la ni/ /tsan+dan gur gum a ka ⑤ru/ /ci rigs par ni byugs yinas kyang / /ut+pal puṇ+ḍa rī (7ka mdzes/ /tsam pa ka dang ma li ka /ke sa ra ni dri zhim pas/ /mchod nas ⑧bdug pa mar bcas pasal / /gu gul mkhas pas dbul bar bya/ /de ltar byas na khyim pas kyang / /de la bsam zhing 0brgyad brjod de/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa'i bshos/ /de yi yispyan sngar dbul bar bya/ /sngar bsnyen la sogs med kyang bla/ /de ltar sbyor bas zla drug gis/ /rkun po dang ni dgra med cing / /the tsom 8med par 91—3

rgyal srid thob①/ /ma bsgrubs tson yang nyin gcig ②bzhin/ /mchod pa byas pas (nga yul rnyed 'gyur/ /las 'di gdon mi za bar ni/ /des phyini 'bum ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /longs spyod sbyin pa'i gzugs la ni/ /tsan+dan gur gum a ka 96darus/ /bdag gis legs par bskus 9)nas ni/ /me tog phreng bas rab tu mchod / /me tog dkar po'i phreng ba yis/ /nyin gcig bzhin du mchod byas nas / /mar dang ldan pa'i gu gul lam/ /kun tu ru ⑧yi bdug pa'ang 'bulasti//me tog a ti mu ta boka /re re cho ga bzhin bzlas nas/ /mjug tu 'bum ni dbul bar bya/ / de nas nyu))longs spyod chen po rnams/ /de yi mjug 8tu 'byung 'gyur te/ /'di la spyad pa dogs nyunyepa med/ /nad sel ba yi gzugs la ni/ /tsan+dan dmar pos bskus nas kyang / /sha ta shing gi bdag po dag /phul nas me tog gtsang ma yis/ /mchod pa'i bshos ni dbul bar bya /mjug tu nad sel dang ldan skopa/ /khro bo'i sngags ni de bzlas nas/ /bdag gam pha rol bo dag gam/ /su yang rung ba'i gcong can yang / /de ni za ma gcig gis 'joms/ /sngar bsnyen la sogs med kyang bla/ /'dod dgur ⑫sbyin pa'i gzugs la ni/ /de ltar yang ⑩ni mchod byas na/ /zhi ba rgyas pa dbang dang dgug /dbye dang bskrad dang gsad ⑩pa dang / /zlos pas mjug 8tu khyad 7par du/ /bskul ༷ )ba'i tshig bcug bsgrub par bya/ /gzhan yang gang dag 'dod pa yis gle/ /yid dang mthun ri gepa'i 'dod pa'i don/ /de yang de ltar yang dag bsgrub2snye/ /sku gzugs rab tu mchod byas nas/ /gang du ci 'dra de lta bur/ /gus par pya stezla ba drug bzlas te/ /sku gzugs nyin gcig gebazhin du ni/ /de ltar kun tu rab mchod nas/ /rtag tu de yi bzlas pa 0ni/ /91—4

blo dang ldan pas kun byas na①/ /grub pa nyid ni (2)ma thob kyang / /dngos grub phra mo nithob par 'gyur/ /yang na khro bo'am phyag rgya'ang rung / /de tshe sgrub ④par nus na ni/ /de yi ri mo gsungs pa dang / / lha yi ⑤brtul zhugs des kyang 'grub/ /de nas gzhan yang brtul zhugs kyi/ /mchog gis yidangos grub gang yin pa/ /cho ga bzhin du mdor bsdus te/ /rgyas par bdag gis bshad par bya/ /de nas khro bo gtso bo yin)/ /rtse gsum shin tu gsal bsgrubs na/ /ur mo'i lcags las byas pa yi/ /rtse gsum sor ni sum cu (kyepa/ /rno la bzang zhing rab legs pa/ /thog ma cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /ri yi rtse mor 'dug nas su/ /ri mo bzang po de bris nas/ /yi dgas ⑨mang po zhes pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor thal bas tshul bzhin bri/ /de nas mchod pa rgya chen (3 dang / /nya dang sha rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /phyogs kyi gtor ma kun tu bya/ /tshes grangs nyi shu gsum gyi dgongs7/ /rtse gsum dkyil 'khor me tog la/ / bzhag nas 7me tog dag gis mchod/ /tsan+dan dmar pos kun bskus shing / /me tog dag gis thams cad brgyanatso/ /cho ga bzhin du lag gis bzung tso/ /ri mo la ni mngon phyogs 'dugatso /khro bo mchog gi 7sngags dag gis/ /rtse gsum pa la mkhas pas bzlas/ /de yi /kā nyes pa sbyang ba'i nyi phyir/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas su/ /khro bo mchog gi tsosngags dag gis/ /der ni me yang rab sbar nas/ /cho ga bzhin du rtse gsum la/ /bdug ri )pa'i sbyin sreg stong byas nas/ /lag pas bsgreng 0ste bzung du senas su/ /dpa' zhing brtan 3)pa'i tshul du gnas/ /ji srid me ltar 'bar gyur pa/ /de srid blo dang ldan pas bzlas/ /rtse gsum 'bar ba nyid kyis na/ /de nas gyen du 'bar snyebar gyur( snye/ /sngags kyi mthu 91—5

yis nyu)mig gsum las/ /'od kyang nyi ma bzhin du 'byung / /rig 'dzin gzhan rnams thams cad kyang / /de la mchod cing dga' bar byed/ /dbang phyug kun dang rab tu ldan/ /'dod pa'i (migazugs can yid bzhin 'gyur/ /de ste rtse gsum du ba 'byung / /de nas (kyelus ni mi snang ④'gyur/ /'on te de ni tsha ⑤gyur na/ /dpung dang lha ma rtsi)yin gyi gnas/ /g.yul ngo chen po la sogs par/ /'jigs shing skrag pa skyed par byed/ /de ltar dang po sgrub pa'i mchog /'di ni rab tu bshad pa yin/ /da (me)ni ral gri bzang po yang / /'dir ni bsgrub ⑧par rab tu bshad/ /ur mo'i lcags las byas pa yi7/ /ral gri sor ⑩ni sum cu gnyis/ /legs hu)par byas shing phan byed la/ /glang po'i so la dngo byed 12la/ /ri yi rtse mor 'dug nas su/ /mchod pa la sogs sngon bzhin bya/ /bdug nyu2pa'i sbyin sreg byas nas 8su/ /ral gri lag par bzung ste bzlas/ /sngags pa'i chang nyusnyepas bzung nas ni/ /rab tu snang ba 'bar ba 'byin/ /'bar ba de ni mthong nas su/ /rig 'dzin mchog tu de 'gyur ro/ /de ste ⑩de las du ba 'byung / /de nas de ni mi snang 'gyur/ /tsha bar gyur na de bzhin du//stobs chen rkang pa mgyogs par 'gyur/ /lo brgya ⑩rab tu tshang bar 'tsho/ /'di la rnam par dpyad hu)mi dgos/ /gal te 'di la ma brten yinas/ /grub pa thob par ma gyur na/ /ral gri brtson 'grus mchog ldan pas/ /g.yul ngor phyin nas thams cad du/ /myur zhing mi ngal nyon mi mongs/ /pham pa med par stong yang thub/ /ral gri bsgrub du )pa bshad zin te/ /da ni be con sgrub pa bshad / /go 51bi da ra'i be con nam/ /yang na seng ldeng dag las ni/ /gshin rje'i be con lta bu bzang / /sor ni bzhi bcu gnyis pa bya/ /de nas blo 91—6

can ①dur khrod du/ /gtor ma cho ga rgya chen bya/ /be con mchog la sngon bzhin du / /bdug pa'i sbyin sreg byas nas su/ /gos dmar bgos ②shing thal ba dang ske/ /me tog dmar pos brgyan ①nas su/ /bsreg ④gzhi der 'dug be con las / /ji lasrid ha ha zhes pa dang / /lag na be con 'gul ba'i bar/ /de srid cho ga bzhin du bzlas/ /de nas dang po khro bo'i bdag /dbang phyug kun dang rab ldan pa/ /de yi chibs ⑥pa ma he la/ / zhon nas (pemakha' la 'gro bar 'gyur / /skra ni lcang lo 'khyil pa stug(kye /snum 5)zhing mthing ga ⑩lta bur 'gyur/ /dus mtha'i tsosprin gyi kha dog 'dra/ /de yi lus mchog stobs kyang che/ /gal te khro bo de 'dod na/ /be con gyis hu ni lha rnams gsod/ /be con sgrub nyanyapa bshad pa yin/ /de bzhin legs 0par mdor bsdus nasatso/ /dgra sta bzang po bsgrub ⑩pa dag /de bzhin bdag gis hurtebashad par bya/ /snga ma bzhin du ur mo las/ /dgra sta bzang po byas pa yang / /yu ba sor ni bcu drug pa/ /dgra sta de ni sor drug pa/ /cho ga snga ma bzhin sgrub 1snyen/ /dngos grub de dag de yi yi'athob/ /de nas gzhan yang lcags kyu'i mchog /bsgrub rdzu )pa bdag gis bshad par bya/ /ur mo lcags ku shelas byas pa yi nya/ /lcags kyu sor ni bzhi par bya/ /de yi yu ba mnyam pa ladu ste/ /sor ni bcwa dzo —9brgyad yod par bya/ /nyi shu dgu yi tshes grangs la/ /nub mo mchod pa gtor ma byas/ /ri yi rtse la 'dug nas su/ /lcags kyu go cha dzo ༄bsgrub par bya/ /ser skya 27las byung mar dag gis/ /bdug pa'i sbyin sreg byas nas su/ /ji srid sgron ma bzhin 'bar ba/ /de srid lag pas bzung ste bzlas/ /de nas de ni thogs zhu 7pa yis the tshom med par nam ( 3langs na/ /'od ni me bzhin kun tu snang / /gyen du 91wa 7

'bar zhing 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams ni/ /bran g.yog bzhin du dbang du 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' mchog bzhin/ /bka' yang rab tu nyan par 'gyur/ /'on te ①de yi lcags kyu'i mchog /du ba ②'byung bar gyur (kyen ni/ /de tshe du ba byung dub yis/ /stobs chen grib ma'ang mi snang (5)'gyur/ /sngags pa bye ⑥ba gsum du gson/ /gnod sbyin rig 'dzin rnams ⑦kyis lamachod/ /bde ba kun dang rab tu ldan/ /'dod par ⑨'byor zhing stobs kyang che/ /khro bo sngags kyis pho )mthu stongs yinas/ /gal te de ni tsha ⑫gyur na/ /nang par bkra shis byas nas su/ /lcags kyu bzang po de thogs nas//bzlas na brgya byin la sogs pa'i/ /lha rnams 'gugs pa gdon mi za/ /gnod lho sbyin rig moste'adzin rnams 8dag dang / /de bzhin lto 'phye mi 'am ci /lha ma yin gyi bu mo dang / /de bzhin dri za'i bu mo dang / /yi dgas ro langs rigs rnams dang / /de bzhin gzhan yang myos dregs rnams/ /bkug nas bdag gi tsolas rnams ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa byed du gzhug /gser 'gyur rtsi dang bcud kyis nya tsholen/ /grub pa yi ni rdzas rnams dang / /gzhan yang yid la gang 'dod pa/ /de dag thams cad de la ni/ /lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs la sogasal/ /ji snyed pa dag 'bul bar byed/ /de yi bka' ni thams cad kyang / /'jigs pas nges par nyen hunyepar 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar kun gyis brgyan pa yihū/ /rang gis gzhon pyo )pas yongs bskor cing / /gnas dang skyed ༷ nyemos tshal mang po / /ngo mtshar rngo 2kun dang rab ldan padu)/ /khyim dang slas kyi gnas rnams dang ske/ /'jig rten ma lus ston par byed/ /rdzu 'phrul yon tan longs spyod kyis / /sgrub 3stepa po ni dga' bar byed/ /ci ༷ gesrid lcags tsakyu 'chang chaba'i mi /91—8

de yi bka' yis ༅nges pa ①ru/ /gnod sbyin mo ①dag rang rang gi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod nye bar spyodabu/ /de ste las kyi skyon dag gis/ /tsha ba tsam du ma gyur na'ang ⑤/ /lcags kyu de yinyid 'dir bzung steg/ /nang par dben par 'dug nas su/ /bu mo gang gis duming bcug ste/ /ci srid 'dod pa bzlas nas 0ni/ /dpag tshad brgyad ⑩brgya na gnas pa/ /de nas myur du 'ong bar 'gyur / /bu mo'am yang na khye'u yang rung / /ci ltar 'dug pa myur du 'grub⑩ / /me tog 'bras bu de bzhin grub/ /shing rta dang ni ljon shing dag /ma grub na yang rtag pa 8ru/ /de yis hu3nges par khugs ④par 'gyur/ /de ltar lcags kyu dam pa 'di/ /bsgrub 8pa rab tu bshad pa yin/ /thod pa'i dngos grub gang yin pa/ /de yang 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /rtse gsum ral gri be con dang ske/ /de bzhin dgra sta lcags kyu yi/ /sgrub pa gang dag bshad pa yi/ /lag pa g.yas pas gzung ⑩bar bya/ /thod pa la sogs gzhan rnams ni/ /lag pa g.yon pas bzung bsgrubs ⑩na/ /de nas de dag bshad pa bzhin/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur/ /shing las legs par byas pa yi/ /thod pa sor ni nyi shu pa/ /mnyam par rab tu legs byas la/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs 8pa/ /ri yi rtse mor 'dug nas su/ /mchod dang lhoshegator ma'i rim par byas / /bdug pa'i sbyin sreg 3 )byas nas su/ /sngags kyang bsrung du nyeb mthu bskyed de/ /thod pa lag pa g.yon pas bzung (9/ /lag pa g.yas pas bsten nas ni/ /de yi kha yang dgab par bya/ /ji 0srid de la 'bar ba dang / /du ba'am tsha ba byung gi bar/ /de srid sngags ni bzlas par bya/ /'bar nas nam mkhar ④'gro bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag por bshad/ /du ba 91—9

'byung 0)bar gyur ②na yang / /de bzhin nges ①par mi snang 'gyur/ /'on te tsha bar de gyur na/ /de yi tshe na gang bsams ④pa/ /thod ⑤pa de las 'byung bar 'gyur / /de la rnam pa (6nyedapyad mi dgos/ /'on te de ni ma grub na/ /de nas sa la mi bzhag tso)par/ /de yi ⑧thod pa blangs nas su/ /shing gi khri la gzhag ⑨par bya/ /ras kyis 7g.yogs te bzhag hunyenas su/ /yid la ci 'dod bsams pa yilcage/ /zan dang bza' dang bya na rnams/ /gang yang rung ba de dag nyid/ ci/ras g.yogs lag gis bzung nas su/ /stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas na/ /grub pa la ni nyin re zhing / /de nas gang yang rung ba'i zas/ /bya na bcangs ⑫pas nges pa ru/ /thod pa de nang gang bar 'gyur/ /sems can rnams ni gang la yang / /bdud rtsi zas ni sbyin par bya/ /tshul bzhin pa yi 'og tu ni/ /gtsang sbra byas te tshul bzhin bza'abu/ /thod pa bsgrub 7pa bshad pa 'di/ /lag pa g.yon pas gzung tsobar bya/ /mdung thung rnon po legs byas pa /bshol nyu tshob med par nyunyebasgrub cho17par bya/ /ur mo lcags las byas pa mchog /bkra shis sor ni sum cu gnyis/ /de nas cho ga snga ma bzhin/ /chu 'gram gtsang du )ma dag tu ni/ /sngon bzhin mtshan mo bsgrub par bya/ /dngos grub 'bras bu gsum du bshad/ /de ltar ji skad sbyo nyebashad pa bzhin/ /mda' bo che yang mkhas pas bsgrub/ /ur mo du )lcags las byas pa zhunyamachog /rab tu rno ba snga ma bzhin/ /bdug pa'i sbyin sreg byas nas su/ /tsan+dan dmar pos gdab par bya/ /sgrub pa pos chogeni cho ga bzhin/ /ri yi rtse mor 'dug nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du mtshan mo bsgrub/ /grub na 'bras bu snga ma bzhin/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub pyo nyamo ni/ /lag pa g.yas pas tsogayogs nas su/ /cho ga snga ma bzhin 91wa 10

byas nas/ /zla ba gza' yis zin pa'i tshe/ /stan gcig 0)pa la legs 'dug nas / /blo dang ldan pas bzlas byas na90/ /de nas mdzub (kyemo de las ni/ /gdon mi za bar 'bar bar 'gyur/ /yang na du ba rang ④'byung ba'am/ /de nas ②tsha bar 'gyur yang srid/ /de nas (7nges par 'bar gyur na/ /rig 'dzin go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /du ba 'byung (3)bar gyur pa ⑧las/ de bzhin mi snang 'gyur bar bshad/ /de tshe rab tu tshar gyur na/ /rkang pa mgyogs pa stirab tu 'thob/ /de ste lag pa g.yon pa yi/ /mdzub mo grub par ma gyur te/ /dngos grub nyams kyang nges par ni/ /las rnams sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /khros nas de yis bsdigs ⑩na ni/ /mi de ji ltar 'dod pa ru/ /de ma thag tu 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /sngags mkhan dag gis bsad 7nas kyang / /de nas shi bar gyur pa de/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa yis/ /ci srid 'dod par slong bar byed/ /rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dpung chen yang / /de nas de yis ⑫bsdigs 8par nus/ /glang po dang ni rta rnams dang / /ljon shing dang ni nags tshal rnams/ /ring por mi thogs 'jig 8par byed/ /ri rnams kun gyi ⑫rtse mo dag /rab tu bzang zhing mtho ba yang / /de nas de yi mdzub mo des/ /ring por mi thogs 0snyil ⑩bar byed/ /mdzub mo dngos grub kun sbyin pa'i/ /grub pa'i mchog ni bshad pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang zhags pa yi8/ /sgrub pa'ang 'dir ni bshad par bya/ / shi ba'i 7spa la zhags ( — )pa ni/ /sbom zhing yid du 'ong ba bya/ /cho ga snga ma bzhin bsgrubs 2spen/ /de yi 3dngos grub de nyid 'thob/ /shing ni rab tu bzang po las/ /dbyug to sor ni bcu drug bya/ /legs par bzhogs medang legs bris du nyepa/ /bzang po yid du 'ong byas nas( ge/ /31—11

de yi mgo bo dag la yang / /rab tu bzang po'i gser gyis ①dkri/ /de yi rtse la nor bu ni/ /pad+ma rā ②gas spras par bya/ /de nas tshul bzhin ri rtse la②/ /cho ga sngon du bshad pa bzhin/ /mngon du 'dug ④pa'i sbyin sreg ⑤bya/ /sgrub pa po yis (6)nub mo bsgrub/ /'bar ba de ni blangs ⑦nas su/ /nam mkhar 'phags 78༄pa gdon mi za/ /snga ma bzhin du grub rnams kyi/ /gtso bor gyur cing 'dod gzugs can/ /du ba tsha la sogs pas kyang / /de yis ⑨'bras bu sngon bzhin 'thob/ /mtshon cha mchog rnams bsgrub ⑩pa ni/ /de ltar mdor bsdus bshad pa yin/ /de nas cho ga las byung ba'iyi/ /dngos grub gzhan yang bshad bya ste/ /ci ltar khro bo mchog gis ni/ /nyid kyis mdor bsdus 8bshad pa'o / /yi dgas mang po zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor thog mar bris nas su/ /rma med pa yi ro blangs 1 nasam/ /mkhas pas 7khrus byas legs par brgyan⑩/ /me tog spos kyis mchod nas su/ /sha dang bcas hunyepa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /las ni dur khrod dag tu bya/ /'di ni gzhan du yong mi tunyebya/ /me tog bkram pa'i gnas mal du/ /nub phyogs sgo phyogs mgo bstan gzhag⑩ / thod pa bzang po zas mchog gis/ /rab tu gang ri du stab blangs nas ⑥su/ /zas mchog dag gi ⑫nang du yang / /tshil chen dag gis blug bupar bya/ /mkhas pas bude dag de yi tshe / /khro bo rdo nyesngags kyis btab pa yi/ /sbyin blugs brgya ni tshang tshang du/ /gzar bus mi yi khar blugs na/ /de yi lce yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas mtshon gyis gcad du nyapar bya/ /lce ni rtsa bar bcad pa las/ /khro bo'i 0mthu yis myur ba ru lta/ /de nas de nyid ral gri'i gzugs/ /bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis 'gyur/ /de nas ral gri blangs nas su/ /grogs rnams la ni re re sbyin//91—12

lan gcig hu)thal ba spar ba gang / /lag pa g.yon pas blangs ②nas su/ /mkhas pas khyim du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /yang na lha khang stong par 'gro/ /phyir yang lta bubar yong mi bya/ /de nas der yang thal ba ④de/ /nam langs ⑤bar du bzlas par ⑥bya/ /nam ni langs ⑦par gyur pa nidu/ /thal ba de ni bsrungs ⑨nas su/ /sar ⑩pa'i snod du gzhag 0bya zhing / /sa la gzhag 8par yong mi bya/ /dgra yi dpung dag mnan pa'i phyir/ /thal ba de ni gtor byas na/ /shing rta dang ni glang po dang / /mtshon cha thams cad 'khrug pa dang / /skye bo mang por ldan pa'i yulas/ /thal ba de yis 8thams cad du/ /lan cig tshugator ba tsam gyis 2kyang / /lus rnams mi 'gul gdon mi za/ /'di ni mtshon ⑩rnams gnon pa dang / /dpung yang gnon byed dge ba'o/ /de bzhin gnyid kyis log bya dang / /myos par byed par sbyor ba yang / /rlung phyogs dag tu song ba 'am / /yang na bsnyen te 8byas na'ang rung / /bgrod dka'i dgra ni mtshon 'khrugs la/ /byas nas 'gro ba mi 'gul 'gyur/ /dur khrod dag gis kyi/sbyor ba yis / /dpung mnan de ltar bshad zin to/ /'gro ba dbang byed sbyor ba ni/ /rnam pa gzhan dag bshad par bya/ /dur khrod dag tu dkyil 'khor bri/ /mchod pa snga ma bzhin du bya/ /gtor ma rgya chen byas nas ni/ /mi yi tshil du )gyi snum du ——dag las/ /mar me 'bar ba byas nas su/ /de nas thod pa bzang po la//mkhas pa dag gis du gesnag tsa 0sbyar/ /du ba'i snag tsa buspyar nas kyang / /nam langs zhugebar du bslab par bya/ /de nas nang bar nam langs 0te/ /du ba'i snag tsas 3 mig bskus na( 3/ /gang mthong de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /de ltar 'gro ba dbang byed pa'i/ /sbyor ba de ni bsgrags 0pa yin/ /btsag gi sbyor ba'i 91—20

dngos grub kyang / /dge ba dag ni da ①bshad do/ /yug snam btsag ni dge ba dag /mi ro'i ②khar ni bcug nas su/ /de nas de phyed (0tshig nas ni/ /grogs byamed par ni mtshan mo blang / /blangs (denas lha yi khang stong du/ /mkhas pa dag gis ⑥bzlas pa bya/ /bgegs kyang rnam pa sna ④tshogs 'byung / /ci srid nam langs ⑧bar du ni/ /de na 'dug 7cing de la bzlas/ /de nas nam langs ⑩gyur pa dang / /ras ni dmar pos dkris nyurnyenas ni/ /mchod cing bsrungs 8nas gzhag 8par bya/ /de nas gang yang rung ba'i ming / /btsag gi yug snam de yis ④su/ /ci 'dod par ni 'dri tsobar bya/ /sgrub pa po yi ming ⑩nas kyang / /bskul nas dogs (/3pa med par yang / /bsgrub par bya ba myur du 'ong ske/ /btsag bsgrub 8kha ru gsungs pa dganyirte /mdor bsdus du kye bshad pa de yin no/ /da 0ni ci ltar rig ( nyepa ru/ /sor gdub bsgrub ( 3pa sbyor bar bcasatso / /cho ga bzhin du gsungs pa shusnyedag /mdor ni rab tu bshad par bya//mi yi ro khyer 'gro ba na/ /der song nas ni de yi khar/ /gser gyi sor gdub gzhag byapar bya/ /mkhas pas khro bo gcig pu'i sngags/ /zlos pas sa)byed de 'dug pa na/ /me yis tshig par gyur pa ni/ /ro yi kha na 'dug pa yi/ /sor gdub lag pa g.yon pas blang / /nam langs bar du bzlas par bya/ /de nas sor gdub bzang po de/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub du shemo la/ /mkhas pa dag gis gzhag 0par bya/ /de yi lag pa g.yon pa yidu sta/ /gang dang gang dag reg 4rnye'agyur ba/ /de kun de yi las byed gyuradu/ /phyi bzhin du yang 'brang bar 'gyur / /'di la dpyod 0par yong mi bya/ /de nas gzhan yang yungs kur ④dag /shin tu ngo mtshar yidang ldan pa/ /khro bo nyid kyi ༅ji lta bar/ /bsgrub phyu91—21

pa'i sbyor ba gsungs pa bshad/ /si ta'i shing las gab tshe ①yang bzang po sor ni brgyad par bya/ /de yi nang du yungs kur ②dgang / /dngos grub mchog ni der blugs sel/ /zla ba gzas ④ni zin bar du/ /nyi ma re re bzlas brjod bya/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ /gtor ma rgya chen dag kyang bya / /gab tse ⑤nang gi yungs kur ༅kun/ /sgra 'byung ⑦ba 'am gas kyi bar/ /de srid yungs kur (8)bzlas par bya/ /de nas yungs mar ⑨grub gyur pa7/ /blangs nas gang yang rung bar ni/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyar byas nas7/ / de yis tsomi nus ci yang med/ /des ni sa yang 'gas par byed/ /chu klung dag kyang skams hu par byed/ /ri mtho rnam pa tsomang po dag /phye ma dag tu rlog 8par byed / /de bzhin ri yi rtse mo yang / /sbyar na rab tu snyil bar byedar+shaste/ /khrag dang sol ba'i char hunyedag kyang / /'beb 7par byed de the tshom med/ /gnam lcags dang ni ser ba dag /glo nyu)bur dag tu 'bab du kye bar byed/ /sa g.yo ba dag sa:sprin bsdu ladu ge/ /rig pa 'dzin pas sbyar byas nas/ /glo nunyebur du yang thogs tsho )med 'gyur/ /mtsho dang rgya tsunamatsho g.yo ba dang / /shing rnams rab tu ldeg 36pa dang / /sa yi 'og kyang g.yo byed kyang / /de bzhin klu rnams bsdigs ( — tshopa dang / /mtsho chen dang ( snyeni ldeng ( nyeka dang / /klu rnams tshar gcad so )bya ba dang ske/ /gzhan 1yang gang 'dod bya ba yi/ /las ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /gsungs rtepa dang ni ma gsungs sosnyepa/ /mkhas pas rang bzhin blos brtags la/ / yungs kur zhustegrub pas gtor tsam gyis/ /thogs si pa med par byed par 'gyur / / yungs kur ni'udangos grub kun sbyin pa'i/ /sgrub pa dag ni bsgrubs ru tshozin to/ /dpa' bo'i brtul dgezhugs spyod pa yisazhu)/ /de dag la sogs sna 91—22

tshogs dang / /snga ma bzhin du sna tshogs dang / /'bring rnams la sogs bsgrub par bya/ /khro bo mchog gi ①cho ga 'di/ /las ni gang dag bshad pa rnams/ /de dag kun la brtul zhugs ni②/ /med par byas na 'bras bu med/ /phyag rgya gnyis kyi ①las rnams ni/ /gang dag 'dir ni bshad pa rnams/ /brtul zhugs byed ni ma nus na/ /de ltar khro bo mchog 'di la/ /sngon bzhin mchod pa byed pa dang / /ji skad bshad zin bzlas (pebyas pas/ /las rnams ji (5)skad bstan pa dang / /dngos grub ji zhuskad bstan (7 pa thob(nye/ /rtag tu bde gshegs sems pa porades/ /brtul zhugs rtag tu mi rung na'ang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bzlas brjod la/ /sbyor bas 'dod pas don rnams 'thobatu )/ de ltar brtul zhugs kyis bsgrubs hu)dang / /sgrub pa sna tshogs cho ga 'dir/ /khro bo mchog gis ci gsungs pa8/ /ma lus par ni bshad pa yin/ /'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba las khro bo gshin rje'i gshed kyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo rim par phye ba ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas cho ga phyi mar ni/ /ji ltar brtul zhugs med kyang rung / /de phyir khro bo bdag nyid kyis/ /gsungs rtso2pa de yi cho ga brjod/ /sngags ni yi ge bcu bdun poli/ /khro bo zhes ni gang brjod pa/ /de la thog 1nyamar ston ⑩bzhin du/ /ri mo bris la de mdun rtsonadu/ /tshul bzhin du ni mchod pa hunyebya/ /nyurtemakhas pas yang na sku gzugs kyang / /byed du bcug ste gi 7de 'og tu/ /mkhas pas brgyad 'bum bzlas par 0bya/ /de yi mtha' mar dkon mchog ni/ /gsum po dag la mchod chen bya/ /de yi 'og tu khro mchog ni/ /ji ci skad gsungs bzhin mchod 91—23

pa bya/ /'on kyang grub ste ①de yi tshe/ /'byung po'i gdon dang dug rnams ②dang ske/ /yid la gang dang gang 'dod pa/ / de yis ①bsam pa'i las kyang nus / /nam yang dngos grub phran tshegs ④la/ /de ni sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /dug la sogs te gang brjod pa/ /las kyi rnams ⑤ni tshig gis 6)bya/ /gzhan du yengs ⑦pa'i tshig gis kyang / /bdag nyid ji ltar 'dod bzhin no/ /de bzhin sems can sdang rnams la/ /tshar gcad ⑧pa dang phan 'dogs stinus/ /gang zhig nag pos zin pa yi0/ /las rnams kyang ni byed 'gyur te/ /chu yi 7nges par gtor ba dang / /lcag gam yang na rkang pa yis8/ /khro bos ji 8skad gsungs 8pa bzhin/ /the tshom 8med par sos par 'gyur/ /de ltar kun tu yid kyis sam/ /yang na tshig gis bskul bar bya/ /ji ltar khros pa med par yang ske/ /phran tshegs 0las ni grub 0'gyur te/ /dran pa tsam 0ni 'ba' zhig gisahu la/ /byed pa po yi tsho )las de 'grub/ /de nas snod la dbab 0pa yidu /las gzhan 22'di ni rab tu bya/ /gzhon nu mtshan dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /nyes pa'i skyon med yan lag tshang / /shin tu bkrus (9te rgyan gyis brgyanas/ /ba las byung ba'i lnga yang blud/ /de yi 'og tu smyung byas te/ /nam langs thupa dang bkrus ༷ )byas du shel/ /dri zhim pa yi dris byugs shing / /gos rnams dang ni rgyan gyis zhustebargyan/ /de ltar mchod pa byas nas ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su kha bstan te/ /cho ga bzhin du ku sha yi/ /stan la bzhag ste de nas ni/ /de yi lag pa gnyis kur yang / /tsan+dan gtor ma'i me tog sbyin/ /a kur nag po'i bdug pa sbyin/ /des ni myur du sngags brjod de/ /sgrub pa cho ga 'di yis ni/ /snod la dbab pa'i las bya'o/ /snod zhu )la dbab 'gyur de yis ②ni/ /dge dang 91—24

mi dge dri ①bar bya/ /de nas byung dang 'byung ②ba dang / / byung ba (gugang yin bden par za④/ /sems can chen po 'di gyis la/ /'di ni min zhes zlog ⑤ par byed/ /rig dusngags chad medam lhag pa dag /sngags kyang 'dir ni tshang bar byed/ /de nas khro bo mchog de la/ /me tog ldan pa'i mchod yon dbul/ /de nas bde gshegs bstan pa yis(she/ /dam tshig dag kyang bstan par bya/ /snod kyis 8thos nas de nas su/ /btang nas de ni sa la 'gyel/ /rig pa khro bo gshin rje'i gshed/ /grub par de nas bzhud par 'gyur/ /de nas snod ni blangs nas su/ /phyis 8kyang rab tu khrus byas te/ /zan zar bcug la zos nas kyang / /mchod pa byas te slar gtang (mngo / /ji skad gsungs hustepa'i las rnams kyis/ /snod la dbab par byas nas ni/ /de nas cho ga phyi ma yi/ /cho ga las gsungs 8las rnams bya/ /de nas gal te sngags ④pa ni/ /rgyal po dbang du byed 'dod na/ /de tshe ri mo 8spyan snga ru/ /dur khrod thal bas gzugs bris te/ /de yi snying gar 'dug thunas su/ /rtse gcig yid kyis khri bzlas te/ /che ge mo zhig dbang 'gyur tu snanas/ /de yi ming ni snga ma bzhin/ /khro sngags ji skad gsungs pa'i hunyamathar/ /sbyar te mjug 36tu swā hā brjod/ /khro bos dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /sbyor ba rtag tu bshad pa yin/ /de nas rgyal po zhu dbang gyur nas/ /mdza' sdug skye bo (lhabatang nas su/ /bdag nyid dang ni nor dag gis/ /nges par bran bzhin legs par byed/ /de bzhin bzlas pa khri byas na/ /bram ze dag kyang dbang du 'gyur/ /rje'u rigs dmangs rigs 0ma lus par/ /drug stong dag gis nges par 'gyur/ /bud med rnams dang bu mo la / /khri dag tu ni bzlas pa bya/ /de nas phan tshun mdza' bo gnyis/ /dbye 91—25

bar bya bar 'dod na ni/ /de nas gcig gis ①gzugs brnyan ②ni/ /de bzhin bris nas snying ga ①ru/ /rkang pa gcig ④bzhag tsog ⑤pur 'dug /de yi ming ni mthar sbyar nas/ /khro bo gshin rje'i gshed bzlas pa/ /che ge mo zhig myur bar yiru/ /'di dang dbye 'gyur phaṭa ces bya/ /de ltar dbye ba bya 'di la/ /stong phrag bcur ni bzlas pa bya/ /de nas sems can rab 'dug ⑦par / /2shes nas legs par gdul ⑨bya na/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la/ /khro bos bya yi cigazhan du min/ /dgra bo'i gzugs brnyan ming smos nas / /dur khrod thal bas bris nas su/ /de nas seng ldeng phur bu la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas te/ /de yi snying gar 0btags nas su/ /de yi 'og tu khri bzlas sonyurte/ /de nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed/ /sngags kyi tha tsomar ming ④bcug stetshe/ /che ge mo zhig sod cig ces/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis mtha' brten ④te / /khri dag yongs su tshang bar (/nyeni/ /gal te de ltar bzlas byas na/ /las de yis skoni 'chi 'gyur te/ /'di la rnam 'o)par dpyad 0 mi dgos/ /rtag tu bde gshegs bsam bya yis/ /ngan pa'i sems kyis yong zhu nyemi bya/ /de yi snying las sdug bsngal dag /bskyed nas 'dag 0pa ma gtogs dzo steso/ /zhi ba dag gi cho ga yis/ /de nas zhi ba dge bar bya/ /ci ltar ji sbyo —9skad gsungs pa yidu )/ /mngon par spyod pa yong tsho — mi bya/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba'i 0phyir/ /bde gshegs bsam pas bya bar bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ci gsungs si )pa'i /de bzhin dngos grub thogs zhu)med pa'i/ /dngos grub 'dod pas thob 'dod na//de ltar khro bo sems mi bya/ /bde gshegs bsam pa gang med pa/ /de nas durtedangos grub nyams su par 'gyur/ /mdor na byang chub sems med pa/ /'jam 91—26

dpal khro bo gtso bo yis①/ /brtul zhugs bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ /rtog las cho ga bzhin gsungs ②pa'i/ /dngos grub mchog ni nyams par 'gyur/ /gang zhig bde gshegs bsam ldan nas/ /brtul zhugs bzang po med pa dang / /de bzhin gzugs la sogs med kyang / /dngos grub mchog rnams des (7thob cing ske/ /nyon mongs med par ci 'dod par/ /'dod pa thams cad rnyed par 'gyur / /gang zhig bde gshegs bsam ldan zhing / /blo ni ma rmongs brtan pa yis / /srid pa nyon mongs ④bgrod dka' rgol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /phyag byas nas ni dngos grub mchog /bde gshegs bsam pa ldan pas 'thob/ /de ltar shes nas de yi tshe/ /bde gshegs lam mchog bstan (snyepar bya/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'jig 'gyur ba/ /'jig rten lha ni yong yimi bsnyen / /de ltar sems can gdug 'dul ba'i/ /las rnams ji skad gsungs pa ④yang / /dkon mchog gsum ni bsrung (dephyir gyi(9)/ /gzhan du gar yang yong mi sbyar/ /de nas gzhan yang bskrad pa'i las/ /'di dag gar yang rung bar ni/ /de bzhin byed par 'dod pa la/ /de bzhin bar ni bshad par bya/ /de bzhin dur khrod thal ba yis7/ /mkhas pas dgra yi gzugs brnyan bri/ /de ste rkang gnyis 'dug nas su/ /'jam dpal khro bo'i spyan sngar ni/ /che ge mo zhig skrod cig ces/ /de yi ming ni mthar sbyar nas/ /de bzhin hūṃ dang phaṭa dag dang / /hūṃ yang (2brjod de khri bzlas na/ /gdon mi za bar bskrad par 'gyur / /yang na thal ba de nyid kyis/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan bri (7nas ni32/ /de yi snying gar 8rkang g.yon gyis/ /gdon mi za bar brdzis nya2nas su/ /nyi ma la ni kha bltas yinas/ /gshin rje'i gshed po bzlas na d+ma 1ni/ /skad cig gis hunye91—27

ni dgra bo de/ /rab tu tsha ba'i nad kyis ①'debs/ /de nas zhi ba'i cho ga yis(2)ske/ /bdag nyid kyis ni zhi bar bya/ /de ltar ma byas zhag bdun gyis/ /gdon mi za bar 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa'i las rnams ni/ /bde gshegs sems pas (kyeyong mi bya/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad la/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa bya/ /byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid can/ /ring por mi thogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas sems can thams cad ni/ /bde phyir zhi ba'i las rnams (0dang / /de bzhin du ni rgyas pa'i las/ /ji skad gsungs pa bshad par bya/ /mchod rten dag gam dkyil 'khor du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa bya/ /dkon mchog gsum po dag la ni/ /yang dang yang du phyag kyang bya/ /nyin par dang ni mtshan mo yang / /dge ba gang dag ci bsags pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la de brten nas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bsam pas bya/ /'di yis sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu sdug bsngal bder gyur cig /de yis dngos grub cung zad gang / /phra mo dag kyang 'thob gyur pas/ /rtag tu sems can rnams la ni/ /mkhas pa dag gis phan par bya/ /mkhas pas ⑥mchod rten las bya zhing / /de bzhin dam pa'i chos kyang bklag(3) /dge ba cung zad gzhan dag kyang / /chung ngu zin kyang 'di nyid la/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob 'dod pas/ /rtag tu sems can rnams la bsngo/ /de ltar 'di ni byang chub sems/ /chos kyi don du yul du 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyer bsnyen pa'i/ /mtshan nyid rnams kyang rab tu bstan/ /de ltar blo gros brtan nasabyas nas/ /dge ba dag ni spel bar bya/ /dge ba dag kyang spel nas su / /sems can rnams la yongs su bsngol/ /sngags pa bde gshegs sems 91—28

ldan gang / /de lta bur ni rtag pa ru/ /sems can rnams ①la phan byas nas/ /zhi ba dag dang ②rgyas pa 'phel/ /thog mar dkon mchog gsum po la/ /mchod pa sna tshogs byas chanas su/ /de yi 'og tu khro bo mchog /gshin rje ④gshed la me tog ni/ /dkar po mchog gis mchod pa bya/ /mchod pa byas nas 'di dag tu/ /cho ga bzhin du bzlas pa bya/ /bde zhing stan la bder 'dug la / /rab tu dang zhing bde gshegs sems/ /de yi ming smos zhi 'gyur zhes/ /khro bo'i tshig gis mthar sbyar te/ /bo ṣaṭa dag kyang tha mar sbyar/ /gang yang rung ba zhig la ni/ /de ltar stong du bzlas pa bya/ /yul dang yul gyi phyogs rnams ⑤dang / /rgyal po dag la nyis 'gyur bya/ /rta rnams yidang ni glang po dang / /ba lang ⑦dag la stong du bzlas/ /ra lug dang ni ma he la/ /rtag par stong du bzlas par gsungs / /yang na lus can thams cad la/ /bzlas pa dag ni byas nas kyang / /byang chub sems dang ldan pa yi'o/ /zhi ba'i mchog tu nges par 'gyur/ /de bzhin du yang rgyas gyur gtso/ /khyad par du ni me tog mchog /dkar po tsan+dan gyis bskus 7pa/ /bzlas shing bzlas pa'i cho ga bzhin / /'jam dpal khro bo'i spyan sngar ni/ /'o mas gang ba'i snod du dbul/ /stong gis rab tu rgyas par 'gyur/ /snying la rab tu dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /rgyas pa de dag bya 'dod na/ /gang yang rung ba de yi ming / /cho ga bzhin du tha mar sbyar / /mkhas pas rgyas 8par gyur cig ces/ /de mthar bshad pa sbyar nas su / /me tog yid du 'ong ba rnams/ /'o mar blugs 7pas rgyas par bya/ /de nas gzhan ④yang dpal 'dod pa/ /der yang snga ma bzhin du ni/ /tsan+dan dkar pos bskus pa yi8/ /me tog yid du 'ong bas mchod/ /a kur nag po 91—29

bzang po yi/ /bdug (1)pa dag kyang sngags kyis dbul/ /nyin re de ltar byas nas su/ /cho ga bzhin du bzlas pa bya/ /dpal ni ②bdag la ③stsol cig ④cesal/ /mtha' ma dag tu sbyar nas su/ /de nas na maḥ(zhe༄swā hār ldan/ /cho ga sngon bzhin khri bzlas 56)te/ /de nas rgya mtsho ⑦rab 'gro ba'i/ /klung gi 'gram du song nas ni/ /lte ba nub par chur 'dug nas/ /me tog puṇ+ḍa rī 6)ka ni/ /tsan+dan dkar pos bskus nas ni/ /bzlas shing bzlas shing chur 'bul ba/ /blo dang ldan pas 'bul byas na(9)/ /de yi mjug becu dpal chen 'thob/ /yang na pad+ma nyunyedamar po ni/ /tsan+dan dmar pos bskus nas ni/ /gal te de ru phul na ni / /de nas de yi mtha' ma ru/ /las 'di dag gis nges par ni/ /mi zad pa yi gter thob ri7'gyur/ /a ti muk+ta'i me tog rnams/ /bzlas shing bzlas shing snga ma bzhin/ /gal te tshig nyu 'bum phul na ni/ /cho gas gsungs pa bzhin gnas pa'i/ /sngags pas nges par de mthar ni/ /'di nor 'bum ni thob par 'gyur/ /'di la rnam par dpyad mi bya/ /de ste de yi snga ma bzhin/ /sum 'bum dbul bar byas na ni/ /gdon mi za bar gnod sbyin ma/ /de yi dbang du 'di 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di yis sgrub pa po/ /rin chen dag kyang thob par 'gyur/ /de ste sngags pas snga ma bzhin/ /me tog sna tshogs mang po ni/ /tsan+dan dag gis bskus pa 57rnams/ /de nas sngags pas tshig 8'bum du/ /chu yi nang du phul na ni/ /sa yi steng na 'dod pa 'thob/ /yang na pad+mo 7dkar po ni / /mngar tegasum dag gis bskus pa rnams/ /me 'bar nang du legs bsregs na/ /de yis dpa' bo mngon sum mthong / /de yi nyunyede la 'dod mchog dang / /nor dag kyang ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan pa zas kyi 91—30

mchog /mar dang sbrang rtsi ①sbyar ba dag(ba /zhag bdun du ni gzar ((bu yis/ /de yi bde la 'dod mchog dang / /nor dag kyang ni rnyed pya5)par 'gyur/ /'bar ba'i me la bsregs (nyanas su/ /yul gru bdun rnams rab tu 'thob/ /'di la rnam par dpyad mi dgos/ /yang na 'bru rnams thams cad kyisal/ /sbyin sreg ⑧don rnams thams cad sgrubadzin/ /sbyin sreg chig 7'bum byas pa yis7ske/ /de dag nyid ni mi zad 'gyur/ /bil ba mar gyis bskus pa 'bum/ /me ni rab tu 'bar ba la/ /bsregs nas sa yi bdag po la/ /nor bcas (3dag ni thob par 'gyur/ /drar 8ba'i 'jag ma ma grug 7pa/ /na maḥsnyig hā mthar ldan pas/ /'o ma las bskugs bsreg tson ni/ /mi yi tshe ni ring bar 'gyur / /de bzhin mar dang sbrang rtsi dag /'bar ba'i me la rtag tu bsreg1me /gdon mi za bar myur 8ba ru/ /yid gzhungs par yang 37thob par 'gyur/ /rgya skyegs du ) shing gi me dag la/ /de bzhin nyin re mar gyi hom/ /byas na tshe dang yid gzhungs grags(nya/ /rgyas dang stobs dang gzi brjid 2rtadang / /dran dang dga' dang mdangs bzang sosnyedang / /dpal dang sems dpa'i dngos grub dag /'thob zhunyepar 'gyur ba nga snyegadon mi za/ /de bzhin zas rnams kun bsregs 29pas / /gzi dang rgyas dang stobs sbyo 7dang grags/ /'dod pa thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /thob par 'gyur bar tsho shegadon mi za/ /ci ltar cho ga phyi ma las/ /phal cher 'jam dbyangs khro bo yi/ /pad+ma'i zhal nas nges 'byung ba/ /de dag mdor bsdus ⑥bshad pa yin/ /'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i sa )cho ga zhib mo khro bo gshin rje'i ri glegashed rnam par rgyal ba'i cho ga zhib mo kun gyi phyi ma las 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi du2khro bo'i cho ga zhib mo phyi ma rim par phye ba ste dgu pa rtog pa 91—31

phyi ma 0)rdzogs so55)// //de nas cho ga thams cad kyi/ /phyi ma'i phyi ma zhes bya ba/ /sbyor ②bar bcas shing rgyas pa yi/ /cho ga da ni bshad par bya/ /yi ge bcu bdun sngags kyis ④ni/ /dpa' bo brtul zhugs bzang po dang / /de bzhin sngon du bsnyen la sogs/ /cho ga dag ni 'dir bshad zin/ /da ni yi ge 'bru gcig pa/ /sngags mcho ga dag ni gang gsungs pa/ /de yi las kyi cho ga bshad/ /dpa' bo brtul zhugs med par yang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi (nakhro bo gang / /ming ni gshin rje'i dugashed ces bya/ /de yi snying po mchog de ni/ /rtsu zhes bya ba'i yi ge gcig /thog mar oṃ bzhag cho ga bzhin/ /ri mo'i spyan sngar 'dug nas su/ /'di ni 'bum phrag bcur bzlas na⑦/ /de yi 'og tu sgrub la 'jug /de nas de yi ri mo mchog /don rnams thams cad sgrub pa gzhan/ /gang gis chadangos grub rab thob pa/ /tshul bzhin du ni rab tu bshad/ /ras ni sar 6)pa khru gang tsam//legs par bkrus 7shing dris bskus la/ /tshon rtsi bzang po sbyin med pas/ /khro bo gshin rje'i gshed bri bya/ /zhal ni bgrad cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /smin ma ser zhing spu /)yang ser/ /char sprin nag po'i kha dog 'dra/ /thod pa dag gis brgyan 57du byas/ /spyan gsum dbu yang hu gyen du brjes8/ /zhal gcig pa la mdangs kyang gsal/ /phyag gnyis pa la be con bsnams/ /phyag g.yon pas ni bsdigs par mdzad/ /zhabs kyang rab tu bzang po 8gnyis/ /ma ho la ni chibs 57par bya/ /stag mulpags na bza' mnabs 8par dgyes/ /'khrugs //cing 'jigs pa'i gsung yang 'byin/ /yan lag thams cad yongs 91—32

rdzogs pa①/ /'od zer 'bar ba bcas pa'i sku/ /de nas de la mkhas pa yis/ /mchod pa yan lag mchog gis mchod/ /sngags pa brtul zhugs brtan pa ni/ /de yi 'og tu brag phug ②zhugs/ /ri mo'i 90spyan sngar 'dug nas su/ /kha zas za ba dag spangs nas/ /ri dbang de ni ji tsam ④du/ /g.yo bar 'gyur gyi bar du bzlas/ /yang na khro bo gshin rje'i gshed/ /bzhad dam g.yos kyi (gebar du bzlas / /yang na rab tu ⑥'bar gyi bar/ /bzlas na de tshe dngos grub 'thob/ /de ltar lha ni ⑦bzlas pa yis⑤/ /dngos grub ya mtshan de bzhin 6)no/ /de nas rig 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /grub par 'dod rnams kun bsgrubs pa/ /ci bsams ⑩pa ni de dag kun/ /ring por mi thogs tha'abyor par 'gyur/ /khros na sa yang 'gas par 'gyur/ /chu dag kyang ni skam hu3par 'gyur/ /ri rnams thams cad brnyil 0bar nus/ /rgya mtsho dag kyang skems 8par byed/ /de la sogs pa'i las rnams ni/ /ya mtshan chen po thams cad dang / /sems can rnams ni thams cad la/ /phan pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed/ /cho ga snga ma gsungs ⑫pa kun/ /cho ga snga ma bzhin du bsgrub⑩/ /bsgrubs nas sems can thams cad la / /'bras bu mchog rnams 0sbyin par bya/ /grub pa'i mthu ni gang yod pa/ /bde gshegs bsam 8na de dag kun/ /'jungs pa med pa'i bsam nyartepa yis/ /skye bo phongs pa rnams la sbyin/ /snying rje can gyis bdag gi tsu )lus/ /phongs pa dag la rtag tu sbyin/ /de ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /dri ma med par bsgrubs sbyo nyenas su/ /dge ba 'di yis na sems can kun/ /bde bar gshegs ldan dge bar 'gyur/ /bde ba thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /dge ba kun kyi snod gyur 0ces/ /yid kyis yongs su bsngo bar bya/ /gang zhig de ltar sngags 91—33

bsgrubs 1kyang / /dri ma med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba rtag tu spyod pa de//dngos grub rtog las gang gsungs (5)pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas byung ske/ /thams cad de la nye bar gnas/ /sgrub pa po de rdzu 'phrul gyisabya/ /yon tan kun dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de ltar 'jam dpal khro bo yirgya/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i cho ga ni/ /khro bo rnam rgyal rgya cher bstan/ /cho ga thams cad bsdus pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyi cho ga zhib mo ( khro bo thams cad rnam par rgyal ba'i cho ga zhib mo bsdus (6)pa las 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi cho ga zhib mo phyi ma'i yang phyi ma rim par phye ba ste bcu pa'o(7)// //'jam pa'i 58dbyangs kyi khro bo yi/ /yi ge gcig pa bshad zin te99)/ /de nas gzhan ri yang de yi ni/ /cho ga zhib 511tu rgya cher bshad/ /gshin rje rab tu 'joms 1gepa yi/ /zhal ni nyu rgyu zhes bya bar bshad/ /de nas 'jam dpal khro bo ni / /hūm̐ zhes bya ba mchog rig bya/ /de yi dkyil 'khor gzhan yin te/ /'dod pa kun sbyin shes par bya/ /dur khrod gnas su (7bya ba ste/ /dur khrod gnas pa gang yin pa'o/ /khru brgyad las ni sgo bzhi pa/ /yang na khru skobazhi pa yang rung / /dur khrod gnas pa bzang po ste/ /dur khrod thal bas bri bar bya/ /de yi dbus su yi dgas ni/ /phreng ba dag gis brgyan (7pa bri/ /sgor ni yi dgas ro smad gzhag1 /mtha' ma dag tu mgo bo gzhag snye /grwa bzhir shu 517la bzhi rnams dang / /thod pa dag kyang bri bar bya/ /gal te bri bar nus na ni/ /mkhas pas de dag thal bas bri/ /de ste de dag riri mo ni/ /bri ba dag tu mi nus na/ /de tshe sa gzhi 1bzang po la/ /tsan+dan dmar pos bskus nas su/ /91—34

dur khrod gnas su dang por ni/ /sngags pas yi ge dgod par bya/ /de nas gshin rje rab 'joms 1)pa/ /de ru spyan drangs mchod par bya/ /'jigs pa'i zhal ni 'bar ba drug /de bzhin zhabs kyang drug dang ldan/ /spyan gsum char sprin sngon po'i mdog /phyag kyang bcwa ②brgyad dag gis brgyan(kye/ /khro bo gshin rje rab 'joms ④pa/ /gzig lpags na bzar shegasol bar dgyes/ /mtshon cha bzang po du ma bsnams/ /yi dgas steng du mchod pa bya/ /'jam dpal khro bo gshin rje'i gshed/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod nas (yekyang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yi/ /'o ma 'bras thug gtor mar dbul/ /a ga ⑦ru yi bdug (kyepa dbul / /mar me dag ni mar las bya/ /de nas gshin rje rab 'joms pa'isti/ /sa bon yi ge gcig pa 'di/ /khro bo'i ༅spyan sngar 'dug nas su/ /stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas par ⑩bya/ /de yi 'og tu mkhas pa yisanyurte/ /dur khrod gnas su slob ma bzung ⑫/ /khro bo gshin rje'i gshed byed pa/ /rtsu gi zhal 7ni zlos shing gzung / /btsud nas de yi snying gar 8ni/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba gzhag ⑩par bya//de nas shu ⑩la'i phyag rgya ni/ /ras kyis g.yogs mate bcing bar bya/ /slob ma dag la ⑩legs bstan nas/ /de yang mchod pa byed du gzhug dī /de nas gshin rje rab 'joms 3nyepa'i/ /khro bo mngon par dbang bskur ḍa gyenas/ /'jam dpal khro bo gshin rje'i chagashed/ /de yi yi ge 'bru gcig sbyin/ /de nas mchod pa yang byas nas/ /khro bo de ni gshegs su gsol/ / shu la ༷ stephyag rgya bcings tsonas su/ /de bzhin rtag par gshegs su gsol/ /khro bo spyan ni drang ba dag /shu pola'i phyag rgya ldan par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas / / shu la tharab tu bstan par bya/ /mkhas pas lag pa gnyis dag gis/ /91—35

sor mo phan tshun bsnol nas su/ /gung mo'i sor mo mchog gnyis ni/ /dbus nas gyen du sgreng 0)nas bzhag② /srin lag gnyis ni nang du bcug /mdzub mo gnyis kyi nang du bzhag② /de ltar de gnyis bsgreng ④nas ni/ /lhag ma rnams ni legs par bya/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /shu ⑤la'i phyag rgya zhes grags pa'o/6nye/ /'di yi nyalas rnams thams cad ni/ /rnam par dpyad ⑧pa med par bya/ /de nas gzhan ⑨yang rim pa bzhin/ /gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa 'di/ /sngags ⑩rnams thams cad ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ⑩ni smra bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ triḥhunyedabus kyi yi dgas kyi'o/ /oṃ rtsu lo lā ha/ yi dgas phreng ba'o/ /oṃ hūṃ dzi zhu traḥtso /yi dgas ro smad de sgo bzhi car tsodu'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ hāḥtshe /'og ste tha mar ro/lha/ /oṃ hūṃ hrīḥ'osnye:ཿtsa)khadu bye/ shu 0la bzhi car ( g+negyi'o / /oṃ hūm̐ hri haḥhu thod pa rnams kyi'o/ /lho phyogs kyi ni sgo phye nas/ /lhag ma gzhan ༷ geni gcad ( 2par bya/ /dur khrod gnas su rtag pa ru/ /gshin rje rab tu 'joms ( 9par ni/ /sngags rnams kyis gi ni rab brgyan shusnyen/ /dur khrod kyi ni gnas su 'gyur/ /tsan+dan dmar pos 'ubaskus pa yi/ /sa gzhi khru zhu )gang tsam la ni/ / ji lta r+sā1bur yang gang yang rung / /dkyil 'khor dag ni bris nas su/ /dkyil nas cho ga shes pa yis/ /sngags kyis mchod pa du)rim bzhin bya / /oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ thiḥ.ā du gats+tsha ya yaṃ phre tha na swā hā/ spyan drang ba'ososte/ /oṃ hūṃ hri kā lo sa thā na hāsu'/ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /oṃ rtsu hrīḥ jiḥkhri shu rmekha/ dri'i sngags so/ /oṃ rtsu r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ka ra la ra na ha haḥs/ me tog gi sngags sol/ /oṃ r+ghaṃ tridage/ hūṃ pa shi kha hā/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ rdza dzi hāḥ0 /mar me'i sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ 47khang ka kha/ gtor ma'i sngags 91wa 36

so/ /oṃ rgyu swā hā1)/ khro bo'i snying po'o/ /oṃ rgyu trīḥjiḥ0gadz+dza ②rgyu pu na rā bug ma nā ⑤ya swā hā/ slar gshegs su gsol ba'i ('u)sngags so/ /'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga gzhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i phyi ma'i yang phyi ma las gshin rje rab tu 'joms ⑧pa'i yig ⑨'bru gcig pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor bkod ⑩pa'i rim par tunyebye ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas de yi ri mo'i mchog /sgrub 32pa po yis rtso bri bar bya/ /ji miskad gsungs 8pa'i las rnams bya'i/ /bzlas pa'i las ni rab tu bya/ /ras phran khru gang tsam po ⑩ni/ /bzang po sar rtso)pa bkrus pa la/ /tshon rtsi dkar po sbyin med pas/ /gshin rje rab tu 'joms (1pa bri/ /zhal drug dbu yang 3)gyen du brjes0 / /de yang spyan gsum 'jigs 'jigs ltar/ /khros pa'i phyag kyang bcwa 0brgyad pa/ /zhabs durnams rab tu gsal ba drug /gzig gi pags 2)pa na bzar gsol/ /tshul bzhin yi dgas steng na bzhugs/ /shu nimil ral gri 22'khor lo dang / /dgra sta mchog kyang sbyin pa'i phyag /lcags mda' be con rdo rje dang / /mda' po che yang bsnams pa ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag ste g.yon pa na/ /dbyug to 0zhags pa gshol dang gzhu/ /thod pa lcags kyu mdung thung dang / /rtse gsum gdengs dang de bzhin bsdigs/ /de ltar ji skad gsungs pa'i gzugs / /bung ba dang ni sprin 'dra ba/ /bris nas de yang legs 3 7par sba/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dag tu/ /bzhag nas bzlas pa dag kyang bya/ /bzlas pa'i cho ga 'dir bshad do/ /rig pa 'dzin pas rtag pa ru/ /'bar ba'i sngags kyis 'khrus bya'o/ /bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /thog mar tshul 91—37

bzhin kha 3)bkrus nas/ /bdag gi (milus la sngags shes pas/ /de nas bsrung ③ba legs ④par bya/ /de yi 'og tu cho ga bzhin/ /mkhas pas khro bo'i khang par 'jug95) /zhugs nas ku sha gyelas byas pa'i/ /stan bzang de la 'dug nas su//de nas cho ga sngon gsungs pas/ /khro bo la ni mchod par bya/ /lag pa gnyis ni dris bskus pas/ /sngags kyi nor bu blangs nas su/ /nyes pa'i skyon dag sbyang ba'i phyir/ /khro bo bdud rtsi lan bdun bzlas/ /de nas sngags pa khro bo la / /mngon par phyogs 'dug bzlas par bya57)/ /rab tu dang zhing rtse gcig yid / /yid ni mi skyo bar du bya/ /de nas mkhas pas bzlas pa'i mthar/ /khro bo gshin rje rab 'joms pa/ /shu 9shela'i phyag rgya bcings gshegs gsol/ /de ltar legs par nyin re bzhin/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sngags 'di ni/ /rnam pa kun tu cho ga bzhin/ /gang zhig bye ba gcig zlos pa/ /de yis riḍa)dngos grub dam pa thobatshe/ /de nas gzhan 17yang ci bstan pa'i/ /khro bo nyid kyis gsungs pa yi/ /cho ga dag gi rtsortasngags rnams ni/ /bsgrub 8pa rnams chal phan phyir bshad / /oṃ hūṃ dri skos te dzā 8swā hā/ khrus kyi sngags so/ /oṃ hūm̐ a mṛ (/— 7ta pra bha baṃ (1sheb/ kha bkru ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ hūm̐ r+shasarba ho ri — sterak+ṣa man ta thā ru ga tā 22dz+nyā ri snyepa ya ti swā hā/ bsrung 20ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥrgyu mdzi 2gesgo ṣa dz+nyā 5ye'i sarba du/ brnya brnya swā hā/ gdug sa pa rnams bcing ba'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥrgyu skṛ ka 0mā rdo nokā ra phaṭa/ ra ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te :bh+yaḥrdu hūṃ rgyu rtsu hūm̐ hūm̐/ ya ma pra ma tha ni na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ na maḥtsosarba bhu ta bha ye bh+yaḥta thā ga to dz+nyā da pa ya ti swā hā/ 'di ni yan lag thams cad bsrung dgeba'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ kā cal ma tha sazhen phaṭa/ khro bo'i khang par 'jug pa'i 91—38

sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ ②swā hā/ gdan gyi sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃ si t+ya de rin)hūṃ rdza rdza/ sngags kyi nor bu blang ba'i (gyisngags so/ /oṃ rdu kro dha a mṛ ta (pedza gad pra bha ⑤su hā/ sngags kyi nor bu la gdab pa'i sngags so/ /'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i phyi ma'i yang phyi ma las gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa'i yi ge gcig pa'i ri mo dang mchod pa dang bzlas pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de yi sngon du bsnyen pa ni/ /bye ba gcig tu nges par bshad/ /khro bo brtul zhugs phyis spyad na/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /shing las byas pa'i 9thod pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa drug sor tshad byas/ /mkhas pas rtsa (7gsum rnon po ni/ /lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du bzung / /gzig lpags (8)kyi ni gos bgos stinas/ /lus ni thal ba dag gis bsku'i/ /rus pa dag gi phreng ba yis/ /rgyan du byas nas brtul zhugs spyad/ /'jig rten 'jig hunyapar byed pa yi/ /gad mo sgra chen dag kyang 'byin/ /dur khrod dam ni shing gcig gam/ /ri 'am yang na tshal yang rung / /mkhas pas zla ba drug tu ni/ /lci ba bza' zhing brtul zhugs 8spyad/ /blo ldan grong du yong mi 'jug /mnyam par bzhag cing nyisatshig mi smra/ /gtsang zhing tshangs par spyod pa dul/ /rtag tu bde gshegs sems dang ldan/ /byang chub sems dang kun ldan zhing ⑩/ /khro bo'i skobartul zhugs gang spyod cing / /rtag tu bzlas la brtson byed pa/ /de ni dngos grub mchog 'thob tso'agyur/ /gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa 'di/ /dngos grub gzhan mdu yong 1)mi 'gyur/ /gang tshe 'di yi brtul 36zhugs ni/ /bsnyen par 31—39
