dang ni/ /de ltar g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnamasasti/ /g.yon pas bsdigs shing dril bu dang / /thod pa bzang po kha ṭ+wāṃ ga(0 /mi mgo rlon dang keng (༷rus dang ske/ /'jigs pa'i mi ro dbyug to rdong)'bar/ /de dag phyag na rtag tu thogs/ /khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po ni/ /shi ba'i ro yi steng na bzhugs/ /'jigs pa mtshon gdengs 'jigs 'jigs ltal/ /dur khrod na ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /sbrul dang srin po thams cad 'joms/ /lha rnams kun gyis phyag byas shing / /khro bo thams cad legs par 'dud/ /sku ni rab tu 'bar ba can/ /'khrug cing rab tu za ba rnams/ /stag lpags na bza' mnabs (6)par dgyes/ /'jig rten lha ni khro bo rnams/ /mtshon cha dang ni mthu spangs nas/ /rjes su 'brang zhing phyag byas pa'i/ /khro bo gshin —rje'i gshed dran bya/ /de ltar 'jigs ④med byas nas su/ /bdag gi sngags kyis 8)dran byas nas/ /spyan drangs tsan+dan gyis bskus 6)nas/ /me tog mang pos 47mchod par bya/ /rtag tu rig pa 'dzin pa yis/ /tsan+dan dmar po dbul bar bya/ /bdug pa dang ni gtor ma yis/ /rim pa bzhin du mchod nas ni/ /slob ma khro bo'i /)sngags dag dang / /sangs rgyas spyan gyi 8sngags dag gis/ /btsud nas me tog 'dor 3lhadu gzhug /de nas rig 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /bdud rtsi thab 7sbyor bzlas nas su/ /phreng ba tsan+dan dkar la sogs/ /mchod pa byas nas slob ma la/ /de nas sangs rgyas spyan yang bzlas/ /khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po ni/ /'jigs pa pha rol gnon pa sbyin/ /lha khyod bdag gis mnos boso zhes/ /de skad slob mas lan gsum smras/ /de nas sngags rig cho ga bzhin/ /bla ma dag la phyag byas nas/ /cho ga bzhin du dbang bskur bas/ /khro bo gshin rje'i 91—47

gshed po tshibazlas/ /'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba ②phyi ma'i yang phyi ma (kyelas khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed rim par phye ④ba ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan (snyeyang gshin rje yi/ /gshed po'i sngags 'di mnos nas su/ /mi ro dag gi (6)gos blangs nas/ /de la de yi gzugs kyang bri/ /de nas tshon ⑦rtsi spyin med pas(8na/ /bzang pos 0snga ma bzhin du bya/ /bzang po khru gang tshad du bya/ /yang na khru bzhi'i tshad du bya/ /gang tshe sngags pa bdag nyid kyis/ /bri bar mi nus de yi tshe/ /bzo bo smyung ⑩ba byas pa ni/ /khrims mnos pa dag 'dri nyu1ru gzhug /shi ba'i ro yi steng du bzhugs8/ /phyag ni bcwa tsobargyad rnams kyis brgyan/ /zhal drug zhabs kyang drug tu bstan/ /'jigs pa gnon ⑫pa 'jigs 'jigs lta8/ /kha cig bzhan ⑩cing kha cig ni/ /ljags 'dril kha cig mche / ba gtsigasahunye/ /kha cig zhal gdangs kha cig 47khros/ /kha cig 0 'jigs pa pha rol gnon/ /khro bo de 'dra'i zhal 'dra ba/ /smin mtshams ser la spyan yang ser/ /ji rimaskad gsungs pa'i mtshon cha rnams/ /phyag na bsnams pa bri bar bya/ /dben zhing 'du 'dzi med pa ru/ /sngags pas de ltar 'drir ⑫gzhug go/ /de ltar bris ༄ nyenas sngags mkhan de/ /ri mo la ni bltas nas 'dug /cho ga shes pas 'bum bzlas te/ /ri mo bris pas de nyid dustekyis/ /de nas bsgrub ri nyel 'jug ༷ ༄par bya/ /gshin rje'i gshed po de yi sngags/ /drag po gang yin de bshad do/ /oṃ ni de yi dbang 0po yin/ /a zhes bya ba gnyis pa yin/ /kro zhes bya ba gsum pa ste/ /dhe zhes bya ba bzhi pa yin/ /ka 91—48

zhes bya ba lnga pa yin/ /ya zhes bya ba gsang ba drug /mān zhes bya ba bdun pa ste / /ta ni brgyad par shes par bya/ /ka ni dgu ste rtsu dang bcu/ /de bzhin phaṭa bya lhag pa ste/ /mi mnyam sngags ni bcu gcig pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyi ni khro bo mchog /gshin rje'i gshed ces bya ba de/ /cho ga phyi ma'i phyi ma ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ①mngon bstod pa'i/ /sngags de de ltar mnos ②nas su/ /cho ga mnos nas bzlas byas nani/ /rig 'dzin go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /oṃ a kro dhe ka ya mān+ta ka rtsu phaṭa/ /gshin rje'i gshed po ④lha'i lha'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ⑤ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ /sarba bigha nān+ta krit+ta yin hūṃ rtsu rtsu phaṭa/ bdud rtsi thab ④sbyor gyi'o / /oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ⑧de swā hā/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi'o/ /de nas gzhan ⑨yang bzlas pa yi/ /gnas dag ji ltar yin par bshad/ /dur khrod yang na ri yang rung ske/ /tshang tshing pad+ma'i mtsho 'gram ⑩du/ /khro zhing gshin rje'i gshed po ni/ /bzlas yin dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /ku sha'i rtswa yi stan la 'dug /ri mo la ni phyogs 'dug ste/ /lag pa gnyis ka dris bskus nas/ /ru druk+ṣa 8yi phreng thogs la/ /sngags pas rtag tu bzlas par bya/ /de bzhin bdug rka/nyepa ar+gha ④dbul/ /myur ba dang ni bul 8ba dang / /de bzhin yi ge 'dres par ni/ /nam yang smra bar yod mi bya/ /rtag tu rab tu gsal bar smras8/ /cho ga bzhin du yid bsams bonas/ /bu don la ni sems bzhag 8ste/ /skye ba med pa'i sems kyis 0ni/ /yi ge go rims (khyabazhin du bzlasabyu/ /'bum gcig 'bazlas pa'i tha ma ni/ /bsgrub par bya ba bshad kyis ( 3nyon/ /mtsho yi 'gram du dkyil 'khor ni/ /dur khrod mang po so)bri bar bya/ /de yi nang du ri mo bkram/ /sems dpa' mtshan mo zhugs nas ni/ /grogs bzang sems kyang ma rmongs pa /31wa 49

gu gul bdug pa de bzhin bsreg0) /zlos shing sna ②ma'i me tog stong / /snying gar ri )phog par bya zhing dbul/ /de nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed/ /ri mo la zhugs khro bo'i cisbyan/ /ri mo de ni nges pa ru/ /g.yo 'am yang na 'gul bar 'gyur / /de nas lha de grub gyur nas/ /gang 'dod pa yi las rnams byed/ /de ste grub par ma gyur na/ /gzhan yang chig 'bum bzlas par bya/ /de nas de yi 5rimatha' mar bsgrub/ /des kyang ma grub gsum po yil/ /mtshams med lnga rnams byed pa yang / /gdon mi za bar 'grub par byed/ /grub pa'i las rnams gang dag 'dir/ /byed par 'gyur ba bshad par bya/ /bsgrub par dka' ba'i las rnams kyang / /yid la gang dang gang 'dod pa/ /de dag mthar phyin myur bar ni/ /rig sngags 'chang bas byas (7par 'gyur/ /ri rnams na kyi ni rtse mo dang / /gcong rong rnams ni bsnyil (7bar byed/ /sa yang rab tu 'gas par byed/ /chu dag kyang ni skams 8par nus/ /dpung rnams mi g.yo gnon ha par byed/ /khrag gi char yang 'bebs par byed/ /stong ngam yang na 'bum yang rung / /de ma thag tu gsod par nus/ /gnod pa dang ni rmongs blapa dang / /de ma thag tu 'bebs par byed/ /shing rta'am yang na gru dag dang / /glang po myos pa gnon par nus/ /pha rol dpung dag 'khrug hu3par byed/ /yul phyogs myur tu rmongs par nus/ /khros nas sa yang g.yo bar byed/ /gling dang nags chosatshal sreg rigapar nus/ /de ni gang gā'i tshematsho yang skems/ /skams ⑪pa dag kyang 'gengs par nus/ /sprin yang legs par gnon par nus/ /char pa dag kyang 'bebs par byed/ /dus min char yang 'bebs par nus/ /klu yi bdag po dag kyang 'gugs/ /de nas 51nyenag pos zin pa yang / /mthong 91—50

ba'am ①yang na sprin tsam gyis/ /'gugs ②par byed de the tshom ①med/ /ser ba dang ni sol ba'i char/ /de ma thag tu 'bebs par nus/ /'bras bu me tog mchos rnams dang / /yal ga dag gis brgyan ④pa'i shing / /bltas pa'am yang na rdo 'phangs ⑤pas/ /glo bur du yang 'gyel bar byed/ /de ni sbyar ba tsam gyis su/ /sa yi 'og kyang 'khrug par byed/ /de bzhin lha dang mi rnams layi/ /gnod pa chen po 'byung bar byed/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'di yis ④ni/ /nges par dbang du mi 'gyur ba'i/ /dngos po 'das dang dud ltar dang / /phyi (9)'byung ba dag gang yang med/ /lha de grub par ma gyur kyang / /mthong ba tsam mam ⑩tshig gis kyang / /dug dang rims 0/dang gdon rnams sogs8/ /zhi bar byed pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /dbang du byed dang dbye ba dang / /gsad 0dang bskrad ④par bya ba dang / /mig 'phrul añja 8bsku ba rnams/ /bdug dang dris byug tsosbyor ba yi0/ /las rnams 'di dag thams cad ni/ /bzlas pa (3brgya byas 'grub par byed/ /sngags pa gter chen yod par ni/ /song ste bsgrub par tsurtebyas rngo 3 nas su/ /bgegs rnams kyi 0ni mi 'jigs par/ /nor de bzlas pa stong byas pas/ /bdag gis 3khyim nas len pa bzhin/ /phra mo rnams ni rgya yis du 'thob/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg bum byas kyang / /gshin rje'i gshed kyi ming tsam gyis/ /lha rnams skrag par 'gyur ba ni/ /ring por mi thogs gdon mi za/ /ma rungs 3par ni bya ba dang / /byad dang stems ༅dag bya ba dang / /rmongs dang mnan du 7pa'i dngos grub rnams/ /bltas pas rnam pa du ma yi/ /cho ga gzhan gyis 3cho ga yang / /ring por mi thogs 'grub par nus/ /yul dang yul phyogs dag tu yang / /gnod pa dang ni nad kyang 'byin/ /rmugs pa dang 91—51

ni gnod pa dang / /rmongs dang mi mthong byed pa dang / /'khrug pa dang ni skrag pa dang / /skyo ①zhing slar yang g.yo ba dang / /nor 'gugs ②pa dang gnon pa dang / /skye bo dag kyang 'gugs ①pa dang / /yun du 'tshe zhing 'jigs pa dang / /'khrug pa 'thab mo ser ba dang / /bru ba gnyid 0kyis myos pa dang / /gang yang gzhan ⑤dag de 'dod pa/ /sngags pas gshin rje'i gshed dran pas/ /de dag thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /de nas cho ga phyi ma 'di / /ji ltar yin pa de bshad do/ /lha ma yin gyi 0phug sgor song / /mkhas pas ri mo bkram nas su/ /kha zas mi za stan gcig ⑦'dug /khri yi grangs tshad bzlas byas nas/ /de nas bud med gzugs mchog ldan/ /bzang po rnams (2 ni sgor phyung nas/ /sgrub (7pa de yi mdun du ni/ /nang du gshegs zhes mudaga' bar byed/ /de nas grogs po yid gcugs 0dang / /sgrub pa po ni lhan cig tu/ /nges par dam tshig dag gis ni/ /de yi gnas su 'jug par bya / /de bzhin ji ltar 'dod pa ru/ /gnod sbyin ma yi ming rnams tsodang / /sha za mo 'am dri za mo/ /yang na gang 'dod pa yi lha'i/ /ming bris de yi mdun bzhag nas/ /ri mo la ni nyin re zhing / /de yi tshig ni mthar sbyar nas/ /ma ⑫skyo bar ni 'bum bzlas na/ /sgrub 8ba po des 'jigs 0gyur nas/ /de dag thams cad 'ong bar 'gyur/ /sgrub 8po ci 0srid 'dod par ni/ /'di ru las rnams byed par 'gyur/ /lha rnams dag ni thams cad kyang / /gnod sbyin la sogs bsgrub hunyebashad zin/ /'di yi cho ga phyi ma yi/ /phyi ma dag kyang bshad par bya/ /ri mchog dag gi rtse mo la/ /yi dgas mang po'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /yi dgas dkyil 'khor bris yinas kyang / /kun la sha yi gtor ma bya/ /grogs 91—52

po sems ni ①dpa' ba dang / /yon tan ldan zhing gzo ②ba dang / /mi ro'i gos la bris pa yi/ /ri mo bzhag la de nas su/ /bdag gi yan lag thams cad las/ /rus pa dag gis khrag phyung ste/ /mi yi thod pa'i nang du gzhag① /lus la khrag ni ci phyin ༷pa/ / mi ro'i ⑤spa yi pir dag gis/ /de nas de yi lus dag dang / /mig kyang rab tu gsal bar bya/ /de la bgegs kyang mang du 'gyur / /de nas yidapa' bos bshad par gsungasasti/ /dpa' bo dag gis las kyang bya/ /de yi 'og tu bzo bo la/ /dpa' bo dag gis 'u)yon yang 'bulame/ /de nyid yongs su rdzogs par ni/ /gyur gyi bar du tshul bzhin gyis/ /tha mar dpa' bo gcig pu de/ /ri mo mtshan mo pho )rab 'bar ram/ /yang na dgod dam g.yo yang rung / /de nas dngos grub thob par bshad/ /ri mo de ni blangs pa yis/ /nam mkhar 'phar 7ba gdon mi za/ /dpal ldan thogs 8pa med par 'gro/ /mtshan mo nyi ma bzhin du 'bar/ /dpa' bo dag gis bsgrub na)pa 'di/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi thog mar 'gro/ /grub pa de la lha rnams kyang / /gdon mi za bar phyag 'tshal 'gyur/ /rig 'dzin rnams ni thams cad kun/ /kun tu bkur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /yang na cho ga shes pa'i rgyal/ /ri mo zhi ba sngon bzhin du/ /blangs ④te bsregs pa'i steng du gzhagatso /de nas bsregs pa der 'dug nas/ /gcig po ral gri blangs ⑩nas su/ /mtshan mo gshin rje'i gshed bzlas pa/ /'bar bar 'gyur gyi bar du 'am/ /du ba'am 0tsha ba'i bar du bzlas/ /'bar bar gyur 8pa dpal dang ldan/ /rig 'dzin du ni de 'gyur ro/ /du ba byung bas mi snang ba/ /nam mkhar 'gro ba'i mchog tu 'gyur / /de tshe tsha bar gyur na ni/ /sa yi rgyal por nges par 'gyur/ /ral gri 91—53

mchog de bya ba yang / /sor ni sum cu 6)rtsa gnyis shis②/ /yan lag thams cad yongs ( dardzogs pa/ /bsgrub par bya ba so yi rdo/ /de ltar cho ga phyi ma yang ske/ /mdor ni legs par bshad pa yin/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo yis54rka/ /mthe bong sbas nas gyen du ni/ / bsgreng bar (pebyas pa'i phyag rgya yiyi/ /be con zhes ni bsgrags 57)pa yin/ /ha nyid kyi (8)ni sngags ldan par/ /las rnams kun la bcing bar bya/ /spyan drang ba yisadang mchod pa dang / /gshegs su gsol dang bzhugs pa dang / /las rnams 7bya ba'i tshe dag dang / /gzhan yang dgos pa 'byung ba'i tshe/ /tshul bzhin phyag rgya 'di bcings hunyenas/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha bzlas so/ /sngags pa rgyal po'i she drung song nas/ /mgo btud pus mo btsugs nas su/ /bdag nyid dang ni nor bcas par/ /gdon mi za bar myur du 'grubanyusnye/ /'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud chen po thams cad kyi phyi ma'i yang phyi ma las bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi gsal shing khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i cho ga zhib mo phyi ma'i yang phyi ma gsang ba 51thugasal shing 8rgyud de rim par phye ba bcu bdun pa'ospu// //oṃ ā tshakro dhe ka ya mān+ta ka nyuge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags gzhan no/ /oṃ āḥrgyu 'di yang de bzhin rtso)no/ /yi ge bcu gcig rgyal po yi/ /de nyid bzlas pas grub ci ci nopar 'gyur/ /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /rtsa ba dang ni phyi ma dang / /de bzhin phyi ma'i phyi ma 'di/ /rtog pa ma lus rgyas pa dag /lha de rnams kyis 27legs thos nas/ /'jig rten 91wa 54

'jig rten 'das pa kun/ /thal mo rab tu sbyar nas su/ /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba ni/ /gshin rje'i gshed la 'di skad smras/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis hu)rtog pa 'di / /bsgrub ②pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rab tu ngo mtshar chabashad lags te / /bzlas dang hom dang mchod la sogs/ /khro bo chen po'i ④brtul zhugs dang ske/ /de bzhin dka' thub drag po dang / /ji skad gsungs pa'i smyung 95)ba yis / /khro bo tī li tī la lasayi/ /sogs pa'ang dus la bab na (peni/ /sngags zlos pa la dngos grub ster/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rtog (nyepa dang / /khyad par gyur pa ci zhig mchis/ /de bas bzlas dang sbyin sreg lho)dang / /smyung dang brtul zhugs dka' thub dang / /med par rang dbang nyid du ni/ /dngos grub dam pa khyod kyis gsungs/ /lha mchog de dag thams cad kyis/ /phyag 'tshal de skad smras pa dang / /khro bo drag tu bzhad pa yis/ /rab tu drag pa'i ⑩tshig tu gsungs/ /drag 4)tu bzhad pa'i 8zhal 'dzum pas/ /lha yi tshogs rnams 'jigs rmongs la/ /ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes gsungs pa'i/ /phan pa'i tshig gis dbugs phyungs hu nas/ /khyed rnams kyis ni gang smras pa/ /sgrub pa bdag ④ni med par yang / /sbyor ba shes pas grub 8'gyur ba/ /lha rnams kun gyis 0mnyan par gyis/ /bde gshegs dngos grub gcig nyi tshos las/ /dgyes 8pa rnam pa tha dad 'gyur/ /de nas ting 'dzin tshul las ni/ /mtshan ma dang ni dngos grub de/ /thog mar byang chub rtsa la brten/ /shes rab de lta bu tsoyang bsgom/ /sems kyang rnam par mi rtog pas/ /bde gshegs dngos grub de dag 'thob )/ /de nga'i begazugs su gyur par byos/ /sa bon ( snyematshon cha mang por ldan/ /khro bo de yi zhal drug bsgyur/ /dril bu gsil sa ba'i sgra yang 91—55

'byin/ /khro bo'i zhal ni bcas par ldan/ /de yi gzi dang mthu ldan byas/ /kun tu dga' ba'i snying por ldan/ /gang gis ①yid la gang bsgoms pa/ /de la nga yi thugs g.yos pas/ /ji lta ba 'am gar yang rung / /mdun nam yang na rgyab nas kyang / /las kun byed nus grub par 'gyur/ /gang dag nga ni phyag lnga bcu/ /be con gdengs pas bsdigs ②par mdzad/ /tri shul ②ral gri dgra sta chuli/ /thod pa shag ti ②thod mar dbyug /de dag yilas ni phyag gsum drug /g.yas pa be con mda' ral gri/ /g.yon na 'khor lo rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje rtse gcig (7mig drug pa/ /dpral ba'i gnyer ma bsnyer ba dang / /khro gnyer bsnyer ⑧ba'i lta ba can/ /'jigs pa'i sbrul gyis 0ro stod dkris/ /thod pa dag gis rgyan du byas/ /char sprin sngon po'i kha dog 'dra/ /zhal gcig 0spyan yang mi mnyam pa/ /'brug gi ⑩sgra dbyangs sgra sgrogs 8pa/ /stag lpags na bza' ⑫gsol bar dgyes/ /mtshon cha mtshon rnams 'bar zhing 'khrug /spyan dang gtsug pud 8rtsa dmar ser/ /zhabs chaganyis gdengs pa'i tsham ngam mdzad/ /sa yi steng na za za lta'i/ /mche ba dag kyang gtsigs 0pa'i zhal/ /bcibs 8pa ma he chibs pa deri ge/ /sems pa'am du )ri mo la bris pa 2/ /sgrub na po myur du mchod byed na/ /de la nga tsho —nyeni myur ba ru/ /dgyes nas mngon sostedu phyogs par 'gyur / /ji ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams ni/ /gdon mi za bar grub par byed/ /rnam par gnon pa'i gzugs 'di ni/ /bdud las rgyal ba yin par bsgragasatso//thog ma du 9bdag gis ( — dam tshig sbyin/ /bsrung zhunyemachog tshul bzhin byas nas su/ /ras ni du gesum cu sor tshad la/ /sngags pa bzo dz+nya )bo yon tan can/ /yid ni bsten 0par bya ba'i phyir/ /dben pa'i gnas su mi mngon par/ /tshon rtsi dge 91wa 56

ba bzang po yis/ /ri mo thog mar bri bar bya/ /zin nas kyang ni dben par gzhag① /su la'ang bstan par yong mi bya/ /nga yi gzugs su gyur par byas/ /sa bon mtshon ②cha bzang por ldan/ /nga yi zhal ni khro bor 'gyur/ /dril bu gsil ②ba'i sgra dang ldan/ /khro bo'i zhal ni bsam bar byardzi/ /nga yi gzi dang mthur ldan byas/ /kun dga' yi ni snying por ldan/ /gal te dam tshig mi ldan pa'i / /skye bos ⑤ri mo de mthong na/ /myur du rnam par myos par 'gyur/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /srung 6)ba drag po kun tu bya/ /grong ngam yang na grong khyer du/ /rnam pa gzhan ⑦du gzhag ⑧gyur tam/ /gong du mchod pa ma byas na / /myur du 'jigs pa skye bar 'gyur/ / ri mo 6)la ni gnas pa'i gzugs/ /de ltar rtag tu goms byas shing / /der bsgyur de yi yid du 'gyur/ /ji srid gang dag goms gyur cing ⑩/ /kun du mdun na gnas pa ru/ /gang tshe mthong bar gyur pa na/ /de tshe ri mo med par yang / /ji lta bu yi tshul nyid kyis3nye/ /rtag tu sbyor ba byas nas ni/ /sbyor ba nyid kyi 8rtag pa ru/ /khro bo kun du sbyor ba ni/ /de las las rnams thams cad byed/ /'di ni gsang ba bstan pa yin//yang na bdag nyid de 'dra bar/ /ji srid cig 3)tu grub pa'i bar/ /yid la legs par bsgoms 8na ni/ /de nas de yi dngos gnas par/ /yid la cung zad gang bsams 8pa/ /dngos po mgoms par byas na ni/ /de nyid 'bras bu yod par 'gyur/ /gang phyir khro bo bsgoms pa yisam/ /khro bo yong ye bsgoms hunyan ni/ /bzlas pa la sogs med par yang / /dngos grub dam pa hu)thob par 'gyur/ /sgrub 2 )pa rnams la dam tshig gis( rnya/ /gal te sbyin par bya na dzo 2yang / /de tshe sa ni rab sbyangs nasazhu rte/ /thog mar spos chus gdab par bya/ /kun du 91—57

ni / /de dang de dag gnyis su sbyar/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i nang du yang / /khro bo sku mchog sa bon yang / /gzhag ①nas tshig gi mtha' mar yang / /khro bo'i dril bu dkrol ba dgod/ /'khor lo'i mu ran nang dag tu/ /zung ②shig pa yi tshig gnyis brjod/ /mkhas pas 'khor lo'i mig gi nang / /sa bon bkod pa rnams ③la gnas/ /khro bo'i 'khor lo bsgrags pa ni/ /shes na ji skad bshad pa yi/ /dngos grub rnams ni thob par 'gyur/ /dngos grub tshul bzhin thob ④'gyur ba/ /de yi sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /thog mar phyag rgya bcings (5rinas su/ /sku nas khyasku ni skur bsgyur ⑦te/ /las rnams tshul bzhin mthong ba yis/ /sbyor ba dag ni legs par bya/ /gdong dang kha mig rkang pa mnyam/ /rab tu dang zhing zhi ba'i sems/ /snying yang de bzhin rab tu dga'/ /dbang tu bya ba'i sngags gsungs pa/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag phyo)pas bsgrub/ /rkang pa ya gcig thung ngu bzhag⑨ /gdong dang nu mjing gcus te gnona'i/ /kha dang mig ni ya gcig 'dzums/ /tsham ⑩ngam gnon pa chen po byas/ /be con la ni yogemig gis blta/ /bsgrub par bya ba sgrub hunyel 'bad/ /gang dag dbye bar 'dod pa yis8/ /de dag dbye ba brtsam 8par bya/ /rkang pa gnyis pa bteg pa yis/ /tsham 0ngam bya ba slar la gzhag⑩ /bzhin bsnyer nyunyephyag rgya bcings nas su/ /khro bar blta ⑩zhing yid kyang khros/ /rab tu dpa' ba sran dang bcas/ /rtsal gyis gnon par rab tu 'dud/ /sngags pa sngon bzhin sngags tshul gnas/ /gang 'dod pa ni gzhom par bya/ /de la rkang pa ya gcig kyang / /drag shul can du brkyang ste gzhagazhu) /bzur te 'dug pa'i tshul tu gnas/ /gdong yang yon por bster bar bya/ /mdzub mo bsgreng gi ste gdengs pa dang / /be con 91—65

phyag rgya dag gis bsdigs1)/ /dgra dag bskrad par 'dod na ni/ /myur du ②bskrad par bya bar 'gyur/ /de nas rkang pa mnyam par gzhagal /lag pa g.yas pa mtho bar bya/ /dpa' dang ldan pas g.yon pa smad/ /zhi bar 'dod na zhi bar 'gyur/ /phyed ni dma' 0bar bkug ste gnas/ /rkang pa g.yas pas tsham ngam byed/ /sngags tshul gnas pas bsgrims na ⑤ni/ /rgyas par 'dod nas 56)thob par 'gyur/ /slar yang de bzhin shes bya ba/ /bzlog ⑨ste bya ba gzhan du med/ /grub pa bdag nyid chen po yi/ /tsham ngam rim pa drug gsungs pa/ /dang po'i ming ni logs kun)par phyogs/ /de yi 'og ma rgyab kyi ⑨phyogasal/ /de bzhin tsham ngam gsum po (1 )ni/ /khro bo che zhes bsgrags rtsonyapa yin/ /bzhi pa mdzub mo bsgreng ri12ba yis(12/ /lnga pa la ni stobs zhes bya0/ /drug pa stobs po che zhes bya/ /'di rnams tsham ngam drug tu bsgrags/ /tsham ngam gdangs pa byas pa yis/ /dgra yi 'khor rnams g.yen spyo btso/ /'khor lo'i mchog la goms byed pas/ /grags 97pa chen po thob par 'gyur/ /khro bo chen pos gsungs pa yi/ /rab gsungs pa yi rgyud 'di dkon/ /khro bo rnam 8par rgyal ba 'di/ /de bas yang 1 ni shin tu dkon/ /gsang ba'i rtog pa bzang po 'di / /kun tu dngos grub kun sbyin par/ /gsang ba'i rtog (16pa de bas kyang //'khor lo 'di ni shin tu dkon/ /hom dang bzlas pa yongs mi da byedagos/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya mi dgos/ /khro bo'i 27rgyal po'i brtul zhugs dang / /dka' thub drag po'ang bya mi dgos/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba'ang mi dgos te/ /gang la 'khor lo 'ba' zhig yod/ /gang gsungs na pa yi dngos grub nas/ /de ma thag tu dngos grub thob/ /de bas 'di ni gsang byas nas/ /thams cad 91wa 66

bsgrub ①pa'i sgrub ②pa po / /bdag gis ④don mchog gang 'dod pa/ /shin tu legs par bsgrub bar bya/ /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba 'jam dpal gyi rtsa (peba'i rtog pa las gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs (nyapa ste (7gnyis pa'o// //khro bo'i rgyal po'i dudangos grub ni/ /sna tshogs thogs med tha dad pa/ /sngags pa 'dod na cho ga mchog /dang por byed yin dngos grub 'thob⑩ /rab tu gsang ba'i sngags 'di ni/ /re zhig ⑩'di yi mtshan nyid ni/ /gzhan dag 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /de yi las ni gang gsungs pa/ /gang dag phyis kyang grub 'gyur ba/ /dpa' bo gcig 0pu 'ba' zhig gi'osnye/ /thams cad nyid de gang gsungs pa/ /thams cad de ni bshad par bya'o0/ /sngags de silas rnams kun byas pa0/ /rgyud la dngos grub gang gsungs pa/ /dpa' bo gcig pu'i mthus kyang 'grub/ /oṃ ni de yi thog ma ste/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dam tshig yin/ /thog ma dang ni gnyis pa yang / /drag po'i rtseg gis 'o 7phul ba'i lugs / /klad kyi 'khor gyis mnan pa'i rigs/ /sngags kyi yi ge phreng bkod lam/ /sngags rnams thams cad gsal byed pa/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i snying po ni/ /gsum po de nas sbyar bar bya/ /de nas khro bo'i rgyal po yi1nya/ /sku hu7ni de yi 'og tu bstan/ /sngags pas sngags rnams kun gyis tsho )mtshan/ /de dag rtag tu rig par bya/ /thogs 0pa med pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /bdag nyid chen po'i thams cad kyis 3/ /bsrung bul sogs pa'i las rnams kun/ /go rims na stebashad pa bzhin du bya/ /thams cad bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ /srung 22ba dag gi ༷ 9byas nas su/ /sngon gyi tshul bzhin rab dben pa/ /sku gzugs don mchog gzhan 91—67

nas ni/ /cho ga ji skad sngar gsungs pa/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod pa bya/ /nyin re me tog phreng ba la/ /lan bdun bzlas pa rnams kyis zhu)mchod/ /mchod nas ka (5cir bī (gur yi0/ /me tog dmar po kha 'bus pa'i/ /brgya ni rtsa brgyad rjograngs rnams kyis/ /bu don la ni phog (nyapar dbul/ /cho ga 'di ni dus gsum du/ /zla ba gcig tu byas na ⑦ni/ /khro bo mngon sum nye gyur nas/ /rmi lam du ni dngos grub ster/ /cho ga 'di ltar sngar byas na/ /gang 'dod pa yi dgos pa dag /de tshe gdon mi za bar 'grubal/ /de yi cho ga mchog bshad pa/ /de ltar zla gcig (spyodabasnyen byas na/ /mi yi las rnams gang bya btso/ /de yi cho ga mdor bsdus nas/ /da nyunyeni legs par bshad par bya/ /de nas dang 8'gro dang sbyar ba'i/ /dug ni rnam pa gsum dag dang / /gdon dang 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / /lto 'phye srin por bcas pa 'jig8 /bdag gis byas ④pa'i phyag rgya'i sngags/ /sbyor ba lan cig cibadag gis bsrung tso/ /yid la bsams ( pa tsam gyis kyang / /gzhan dag gis kyang mchod par byed/ /bzhi ⑫pa'i rims (nye7la sogs de yang / /thos pas myur du med par byed/ /ma dang byis pa'i gdon rnams ladu )/ /thal ba'am yang na sas kyang rung / /bdag nyid dag par bsams nas ni/ /bdag dgar phab nas dgos pa'i don/ /gang dang gang dag 'dod par ni/ /bsgoms du pas de dang de dag byed/ /yid la bsams shepas de dag thar/ /rdo la lan gsum bzlas pa yishusnye/ /chu srin kum bi ri ster la sogs/ /mche ba can dag phyogs med par/ /chu bsal hunyeb yi mchog tu 'byung / /'gro tshe yid la bzlas na ni/ /lam na rkun po tso'ajigs pa med/ /seng ge stag dang dgra rnams dang / /nad kyi ri — tsho'ajigs pa med par 'gyur/ /91—68

rgyal po'i drung du 'gro na yang / /sngags kyis ①sbyi gtsug bcings nas ②ni/ /rgyal po khros pa myur rab tu/ /brkyang nas thal mos (gesbyor bar byed/ /shags 'gyed pa dang rgyan po dang / /mtshon dang me yis 'jigs pa la/ /yid la dran 'acizhing bzlas byas na⑤/ /mi bde kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba'i phyir/ /mi bde nyam ⑥thag gyur pa la/ /sngags 'di myur dran brjod byas na/ /sprin dag mnan par bya ba dang / /'dod bzhin myur du slar yang bzlog⑦ /gnam lcags ser ba 'bab pa yang / /dbyug pa'i phyag rgyas zhi bar byed / /phyag rgya bcings pa (84)de nyid kyil/ /yid kyis sprin rnams dbab ⑩par bya/ /de ltar phyag rgyas bsdigs nas ni/ /smin mtshams dag kyang bsgyur bar bya / /rnam pa de dag nyid kyis ni/ /gnam lcags ser ba gcad rka/nyapar bya/ /sbyor ba mkhas pas ci 'dod pa/ /char pa dag kyang gcad 8par bya/ /gos ni sngon po bgos na 0ni/ /kho ra 8khor yug bsrung (nyabyas nas/ /mid pa nub tshepar chur zhugs te/ /nyin gsum legs par bzlas byas nayi/ /brgya hunyebyin gyis ni sprin bsdus nas/ /'dod pa bzhin du char pa 'bebasatshe/ /de nas sprin chen las byung ba/ /char pas sa steng 0 khyab par 'gyur/ /nyi ma la ni mngon phyogs nas/ /nyin re rtag tu bzlas byas na mi/ /bdag dang de bzhin gzhan rnams kyis/ /nad rnams de nas med par 'gyur/ /rgyal po dbang du bya yang rung ske/ /yungs kur dkar po bzang po las/ /gzugs brnyan legs par byas nas su/ /de yi gzugs kyi steng 'dug la/ /gang gi nyeming smos nyin bdun du/ /bzlas brjod legs par byas na ni/ /de ni myur du cho ga 'dis/ /bran bzhin du ni dbang du 'gyur/ /zhag gcig sgyung 2steb byas pa yis/ /dmangs rigs 91—69

dag ni dbang du 'gyur/ /zhag gnyis sgyung ①ba de bzhin du/ /bzlas na rje'u rigs 'dod pa bzhin/ /zhag gsum byas pas rgyal rigs te/ /zhag bzhi dag gis bram ze dag /bzlas pa'i cho ga bzhin byas na/ /'dod pa bzhin du dbang du 'gyur/ /'bru dang phub ma thams cad las/ /bu dang bu mo gang yang rung ske/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan byas na (geni/ /dmangs rigs la ni mtshan gcig gis/ /rab tu sngang ba bya bar 'gyur/ /rje'u (kyerigs la ni zhag gnyis kyisal/ /de steng (getsog pur 'dug nas (geni/ /de bzhin mdza' dang bral bar byed / /nyin zhag gsum dang bzhi dag gis/ /rgyal rigs dang ni bram ze'o/ /ji ltar ji skad gsungs pa yi/ /las kyis (yebya yi gzhan gyis min/ /gang yang rung ba'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dur khrod sol bas legs pa ru/ /snga ma bzhin du legs par bri/ /de nas seng ldeng phur bu la/ /sngags kyis stong du bzlas byas na / /de yi 'og tu lus la gdab/ /dgra bo de yi ming smos nas/ /de la khros par byas nas su/ /de nas de yi snying gar la'adug /phur bu btab ste ⑨bzlas bya ba/ /de nyid lag pas bzung nas su/ /dus ⑩gsum nyi ma gsum byas na/ /dgra bo gang du btab pa der/ /gzer thabs drag pos btab nas sum/ /'gul mi phod par sa la ltung / /zhag bdun lon nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /ma mo'i gnas su song nas su/ /lag pas be con phyag rgya bcing / /lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo yis/ /bsdigs tsheshing nyi ma nub nas su/ /khros shing dgra yi ming smos bzlas/ /de nas dgra bo mo gdon gyis/ /zin nas spyod 3nyepa sna tshogs pas/ /'chi bar gyur pa 51snyedag ni byed/ /de nas sgrub skopos zhi ba yitshe/ /cho gas de las gluzhi bar bya1 / /ma mo rnams kyi nyu mdun 'dug nas/ /zhi ba'i 91—70

cho ga mkhas pa yis/ /dbang po bsdams 6)shing yid bde bas/ /nyin zhag gsum du bzlas byas nas/ /de nas de la las de yi/ /zhi bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /nyi ma la ni mngon phyogs nas/ /lag pas dgra bo'i mgo byug cing / /dgra yi ming smos mnan nas su/ /nyi ma nub tu bzlas byas na②/ /de yi klad pa na 'gyur ba/ /tshabs chen shi la thug par 'gyur/ /de nas thal mo sbyar nas su / /nyin par zlos shing zhi bar bya/ /sa steng (brkang pa gcig gis 4)'dug /nyin par lag pa gyen du brkyang / /mi dga' khros shing bzlas byas pa/ /dgra 57yi ming smos ci 'dod par/ /nyi ma nub kur de nas dgra/ /mi dga' ba dang myos 'gyur te/ /gnyen dang mdza' bo rnams bor te/ /de nas gzhan gyi gnas su 'gro/ /de la 'dir ni zhi ba 'am/ /'on te rgyas par (yebya 'dod na/ /gtsang sbra byas te gos dkar bgos/ /bde zhing brtan par ma g.yos par/ /mchod pa bzang po byas nas su/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal (7)nas/ /'o ma btung zhing bzlas byas pa/ /zhi bar 'gyur gyis (87bar du'o/ /de ltar 'di ni sna tshogs pa/ /sbyor bcas rgyas par bshad pa yin/ /rtog (91pa'i cho ga bzhin du ni/ /ma gsungs bopa yang legs 31par bsgrub1rta/ /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba 'jam dpal gyi nyu rtsa ba'i rtog nya )pa gsang 15ba'i rtog par gtogs pa ste 35gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bzang po 'di/ /he la'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa ni/ /de las tsho1 bzang po gzhan med pa/ /ji ltar rigs pa bshad par bya/ /dang por he zhes gang gsungs pa/ /bskul 18ba'i sa bon thams cad pa'o/ /de ni len 91—71

dang 'dzin pa ste/ /las la myur du bskul 0)ba'o/ /de bas thog mar bskul ba dang ske/ /don bzhin du ni bzung ②ba la②/ /khro bo ④yi ni rgyal po yi/ /he la'i 'khor lo rim (snyebazhin bstan/ /ho ho ha ha hi hi nyi/ /hi ha ha he ho gnyis sbyar brdzuner/ /khro chen tshig gis ⑦thog mar sbyar/ /zung (kyeshig pa yi tshig gnyis pa'o / /zung drug 'khor lo'i tha (9)mar dgod/ /mu ran rtsibs kyi mig rnams su / /sngags las 'byung tsheba'i re re'o/ /don rnams thams cad bsgrub (nyepar 'gyur / /bcu gnyis dag tu gsungs pa'i sngags/ /gnas su ji ltar bkod ⑫pa dang / /ji ltar smos shing gang gnas pa/ /so so'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /de nas 'di dag bkod pa de/ /sngags rnams bsdu ba tshul bzhin bshad/ /de'i nang mu ran gsum po dang / /dbus kyi mu ran bzang por ldan/ /mtha' yi mu ran drug po dang / /rtsibs kyi zur drug rab bzang ba/ /rab dben 'du 'dzi 32med pa'i sar/ /cho ga bzhin du legs bris nas/ /de yi chaganas su sbyar ba dang / /de yi go rims hu༄bzhin du sbyar/ /de yi tsham ngam gsal ba yi/ /sngags rnams 'di ni bsdu bar bya/ /dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po tshimatshan ni brjod pa'i mchog /bzhag nas de yi gnas dag la/ /sngags ni grub par byed pa gzhaganyu tsho /mu ran gnyis la gnas nas su/ /khro bo'i 4)snying po gzhag hu par bya/ /de ni khro bo'i zhabs kyis mnan/ /dril bu dkrol ba'i sgra yang bsgragasazhu sa/ /khro bo zhabs kyis bcags byas pa/ /rtsibs rnams khro bo mthu dang ldan/ /dbus su snying po dag par ldan/ /rab tu 'bar zhing nges byas pa//mu ran gsum gyi ༄ stobar du ste/ /thams cad don rnams kun grub du shepa'o/ /he he ha ha hi hi hi hi ha ha ho ho/ gnyis su 2)sbyar/ /khro bo chen po'i tshig dbus 91—72

nas / /sa bon bzung ①ba'i phyi rol gzhag② /thog mar bskul ①ba'i tshig rnams rgyadagod/ /khro bo du mas bskul ba ste/ /thams cad kun du don rnams kun / /grub pa'i phyir ni de la gnas/ /de ltar 'khor lo byas pa yi/ /phyi nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bzhag⑤ /bskul ⑥ba'i tshig rnams bkod pa'i mthar khro bo gzhan rnams bkod ⑦par bya/ /de nas gzhan yang rim ⑧bzhin du/ /khro bo chen po dgod ⑨pa'i phyir/ /skul ⑩bar byed pa bcu gnyis po/ /'di dag tshul bzhin bshad par bya/ /dang por khro bo rgyal pos gsungs/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba che zhes bya/ /rdo rje me yi rgyal por bzhagayonye /rab tu drag po'i rtso)shugs gzhag 32gol/ /rab tu drag shul stobs po che/ /rgya chen 8khro bo lnga pa yin/ /drug pa gzhan gyis 8mi thub pa/ /'jigs ⑩par byed pa zhes bya ba/ /khro bo bdun par byed pa yin/ /zur du khro bo brgyad po 7grags/ /phongs pa sgrol ba de bzhin dgu/ /rab tu 'joms nyunyepa bcu pa yin/ /de bzhin tī li tī li bzhaganyunye /tī li tī li chen po dang / /bcu gnyis su ni gsungs pa yin/ /khro bo rab tu snang byed pa/ /bcu gnyis bgrangs pa 'i )'di dag ni/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos kun tu mnan0/ /thams cad rim pa bzhin du gsungs/ /'khor lo'i phyi 3rol gnas pa 'khod/ /'bar zhing drag po'i mthu dang ldan/ /thams cad bstan 3nas 'khod pa ni/ /khro bo chen po snang byed pa/ /mthu rtsal chen po stobs su ldan / /kun kyang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'o/ /sa bon snga ma mtha' yas rnams/ /gug skyed drug dang ldan par bya/ /steng du klad kyi 'khor gyis mtshan/ /sa bon bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'o/ /dang po rdo snyedakyil 'khor na gnas gcig /tsheg (snyedang bcas pas tsodon kun 'grubazhunye/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i sngags kyi nga snyemathar/ /91—73

'bar ba'i phreng ba can gyis bsgrags①/ /sa bon gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /tsheg ②dang bcas par de bzhin gnas/ /rdo rje me rgyal zhes byas pa / /khro bo don kun 'grub byabyed pa'o/ /dang po'i sa bon gsungs pa yang / /snga ma bzhin du tsheg dang bcas/ /rab tu shugs ②drag cher grags pa/ /khro bo'i 0rgyal po khro bor snang / /snang byed khro bo'i rim pa las/ /tsheg ⑦drag de bzhin khro bo che/ /de ni stobs zhu)po che zhes gsungs/ /gnyis par po)'khor lo tsheg ⑩mtha' can/ /gang gsungs khro bo rgya chen ni(te/ /de ni snying por grags phonyapa yang / /mi thub gtso bo'i tsheg nyusnyedang bcas/ /de yi gsum po tsheg bcas pa/ /de yang de bzhin bsgrags pa yin/ /'jigs ④pa zhes bya rab tu che/ /khro 'di khro bo snang byed pa/ /rgya chen gyi ni rim tsobazhin du/ /bzhi pa yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /tsheg tshebacas rab tu drag po nyid/ /su ru khro bo de bzhin gzhag(/— tsho /de yi sa bon lnga pa yin/ /'bar ba'i phreng chen zhes bya bal/ste/ /tsheg nyushedang bcas pa de bzhin du/ /khro bo longs pa grol 2nyezhes bya'o/ /lnga po rgya chen 0nyid yin te/ /tsheg rishedang bcas par bsgrags pa'o/ /rab tu 'joms pa zhes bsgrags pa/ /khro bo'i 3khro bo snang zu byed pa'o/ /sa bon snga ma mtha' med las/ /snga ma tsheg nisnyebacas de bzhin gzhagaci lha /tī li tī li bya ba yi/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster/ /de bzhin de yi sa bon nyid/ /tsheg chabacas de bzhin 'dir bshad do rin/ /khri li tī li ri )chen po de/ /khro bo'i ra )khro bo snang byed pa'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po de dag ni/ /sa bon 'di dag rnams kyis bsgrags/ /khro bo'i rgyal po sbyor ba yi gle/ /rab tu snang bar byed ces sabasgrags/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i 'khor los gnas/ /gshin rje'i gshed po yin par gsungs/ /dang por de 91wa 74

ni 'khor lo bstan/ /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang / /khro bo'i rgyal po de las gzhan① / /khro bo'i bdag po snang byed pa'o/ /de ltar khro bo gsum po de/ /gang dang gang du rab sbyar ba/ /de dang de ru sngags rnams ni/ /skul (kyebar byed pas de bzhin bskul/ /cho ga shes pas nan tan du/ /gang dang (migang 'dod bsgrub par bya/ /khro bo sgom ④dang ldan pa yis/ /he la'i 'khor lo yongs bsgoms nas/ /dka' zhing bsgrub (btu'ang mi rung ba/ /brtul zhugs hom dang bcas la sogs/ /de yis dgod pa ma byas kyang / /sngags dgod (zheshes na bsgrub (3)pa'o/ /he la'i 'khor lo tshul shes pa/ /de yis dka' ba ma byas kyang / /gdon mi za bar myur du 'grub6)/ /brtul zhugs 0hom dang bsam gtan ⑩dang / /ji ltar gsungs pa'i dka' thub dang / /mngon par brtson 0zhing dad pa'i bdag /lan grangs bcu gnyis gang bsnyen pa/ /rtog las gsungs pa'i las rnams byed/ /rab tu ya mtshan ston pa'o/ /ho la'i 'khor lo 8tshul shes pas/ /ring por mi thogs bde ba ni/ /khro bor bsgom hurtepa dang ldan zhing / /te la'i 'khor lo gnas 'dug na/ /khams gsum dag kyang lan cig ④gis/ /thogs 7med myur du g.yos par byed/ /de bas rab tu bsgrims nas su/ /khro bo bsgom nyu9pa goms ho tshobyas te/ /he la'i 'khor lo las 'byung sngags/ /sbyor ba dag gis goms par bya/ /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba yis / /rtog pa dang por gang bsgrags pa/ /de yi rtog pa gsang bshad pa/ /cho ga 'di ni gsang ba'i mchog /khro bo'i 'khor lo bsgrags pa 'di/ /cho ga de bas shin du gsang / /khro bo'i 'khor lo gsang bshad pa/ /rab tu snang byed de bas kyang ske/ /he la'i 'khor lo bsgrags pa 'di/ /rab tu gsang ba'i mchog yin te//91wa 75

tshig gi mthar/ /brnyil 3)cig ces pa'i tshig gis skul②/ /khro bo tī li tī la ②yis / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskul bya ba/ /tshig gi mtha' ④mar gnas pa ste/ /cho ga bzhin du bshad pa bzhin/ /tī li tī la zhes bya ba/ /tsham ngam mchog la de bzhin gnas/ /be con gyi ni phyag rgya bcing (snye/ /gshin rje'i gshed po bsgom yidapa ni/ /rin (7chen rtsa ba phurabartan pa yang / /rtse mo nas kyang brnyil ⑨bar byed/ /yang na ri khar nyu noskye ba yi/ /brtan nyunyepa'i shing rnams 'gyel bar byed / /de nas he la'i 'khor lo yi/lha/ /bcu gnyis pa yi rtsibs hunyal gnas/ /khro bo chen po'i tshig gi mthar/ /zhugs shig ④ces pa'i tshig gis skul8/ /bskul nas de yi tha mar ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gzhag (7par bya/ /khro chen tī li tī la ya/ /de yi tha mar gzhag ri par bya/ /tī li tī la chen po zhes/ /bya ba'i tsham ngam de bzhin bya/ /be con phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje'i gshed/ /yid la rab tu goms byas na/ /rtsig hu)pa shing skam rdo la sogs/ /'babs nyusten phyung ste nam mkhar ri )gnas/ /nam mkha' la ni byung nas kyang / /'dod pa bzhin du ltung bar byed/ /'di ni rang 'byung 0ngo mtshar la/ /'di ni dus gsum sngon du byung / /spyod pa gzhan ( —)yang snga ma bzhin / /khro bo sgom ra pas byed par gsungs/ /he la'i 'khor lo dgod pa ni/ /rab tu gsang ba yin par bshad/ /gsang dang bcas shing sbyor bcas pa/ /shes na dngos grub thob zhugebar 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan snyenayang ci rigs pashuste/ /tsham ngam bcu gnyis sbyor ba dag /mdo dang rgyas pa'i tshul dag gis/ /da (nyeni rab tu bshad par ri 2bya/ /kun tu g.yo ba dang po yin/ /de bzhin rab tu g.yo bar bshad/ /skrag dgepar byed pa gsum pa kye )ste/ /bzhi pa kun tu sdom par 91—80

'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes gsol ba btab pa thugs ①su chud nas/ de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje khyod sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir lag na rdo rje khyod legs ②par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 9kyeshig dang / sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam ④grangs bshad par bya'o/ /u gu mu gu ba li ni/ ban dha ni/ ba la tsa ma na/ba hu ba hu ba hu li brta (peya swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pas 6)spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags chagazhi rnams bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pas kyang gzung bar ⑧'gyur ro/ /byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /tabya thā/ bsgyu brdzu brdzu brdzu (gedha ri/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ brdzu pyadha rihu)/ tsakra badzitso/ tsakra ⑫dha ri/ pa ṭu dhi dhi ri/ bhi ri/ mu ri/ tsi ri/ a hu ri8/ bha ga /gi sgyi rim/ shi ri trang/ shi ri/ ru ru tse ru ru tse/ tsa ri tsa 0ri/ da ri tsa ⑩le/tsu ri mu rihunye/ paṇ+ḍa re/ sdig pa thams cad 'jig yipar byed pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ dus ma yin pa'i du'achi ba 'gog pa nas mi lam ngan pa'i bar du 'gog par byed pa/ tabya thā/ ban dhi da/ ga ga ra ṇizhushel/ murta eni/ pra murta ( 3ni/ nā sha ni/ pra nā sha ni/ nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa ni ④mi lam ngan pa'i bar du 'gog par byed pa/ 'di lta ste/ nā sha ni/ nā sha ni/zhunye brnya ni/ brnya ni/ sbyisdo ni/ sbyin ni/ tsi re mi re/ ma he ha da ( nyeni/ ba du 3ni ba re/ kha du /rtere be re'u/ bi ri bi ri/ bo dhi bo dhi/ su ṣa ṇi4 )la/ sha ra ṇizhunye/ ba ru ba ri ṇis/ par hūṃ ye/ brah+ma litsā ④ri ṇizhu/ in+d+ra ba ti/ dhi dhi rī dunyaya ṇi ri tre/ na mo ma he 6shwa gyur ya ṇi4gye/ ṛ 0shi/ brdzo ⑤ni 91—162

pā pa dza ha ni/ kā la pa ti ni/ bhu ta pa da ni/ sa t+ya ga the/ so ma bā di/so ma pra bho swā hā/ tshe ring bar 'gyur(me/ tabya thā/ ha ra ha ra ha ra mehā ṇi ①swā hā/ tabya thā/ i ḍi bta ga ḍi ta ba di da/ a ye na/ a ri brdzo ⑤ni ka khrirta ⑥ni/ pu tra da da hā ⑦ni/ marga a bhi (nyero ha ni/ hu sa ba ti/ mu pa ba tistim/ hi li 7nyi li/ ya thā pa dzu ya/ ya thā asdi hunyeya thā ba ra na tsa/ ya thā na la/7 ya thā badz+ra ṇa0/ ya thā skṛ chad ya swā hā/ lag na rdo rje 'di ni sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs 8te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 8thugs rjes 0sems can rnams kyi don du bshad do/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa (nyeyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bden pa'i thugs dam gyis rnam par bzhag ⑩bzhin du nga yang 'chad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skyes bu chen po'i mtshan pya smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer byung 0ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'od zer gyi snang ba byung ngo / /'od zer gyi snang ba des bskul bas rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag sanas chas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir byon nas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/shākya thub pa khyod 0kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam phyogangs gzungs sngags chagazhi rnams snang bar byed pa/ mchog tu dga' bar byed pa/ dran par byed pa/ bshad par byed bupa legs so legs so / /bdag cag gis kyang byin gyis zhubarlab bo/ /legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /rigs phyokyi bu'am/ rigs 0kyi bu mo gang la la gzungs sngags du )gzhi 'di dag 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs 0kyi bu'am/ rigs 3 kyi bu 91—163

mo de'i yon tan gyi phan yon nyi shur shes par bya ste/ nyi shu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ②byin gyis brlab ②par 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ba dang / ngan song du 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib ③pa thams cad med par 'gyur ba dang / tshe ring bar 'gyur ba dang / ring du 'tsho zhing grags pa dang ldan pa dang / longs spyod dang ldan pa dang / stobs dang ldan pa dang / gzi brjid medang ldan pa dang / rtag tu nad med pa dang ldan pa dang/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dgyes shing thugs su chud ⑤par 'gyur ba dang /lha thams cad kyis bsams ⑥par 'gyur ba dang / dge bar spyod par 'gyur ba dang ske/ dge ba'i don la rab tu brtson pa dang / snang bar byed par 'gyur ba dang ske/ mchog tu dga' ba dang / dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang /mtshan phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang ⑦/ mi 'jigs par 'gyur ba dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsang ba'i laganas kyi gzungs lasngags ⑩gzhi 'di ⑩rnams gsungs shing ske/ lasangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang rigs ⑩kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi 0bu mo de la bsrung ba 8dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i slad du gzungs ⑫sngags ⑩gzhi rnams bshad par bgyi'o/ /su zhig sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam 0grangs tshe skyong ba'i rig 8sngags 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs 91wa 164

nas klog pa de rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad las bsrung ①bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/shi khi shi khi shi khi shi ga② /tsi tsi tsi tsi/ bha bha bha bha/ ru ru ru ru/ dzi dzi dzi dzi/gra gra gra gra/ hri hri hri hri/ ha ha ha ha/ ma ma ma ma/ ha na ha na me/ sarba pra kyarji chakā/ da ha da ha 0me/ sarba sha tra ba⑤/ pa tsa pa tsa me sarba a nyi te ṣi yin swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ lag na rdo rje sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dngos grub dam pa'i gzungs ⑦sngags dugazhi rnams smras pa legs so legs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs tshe skyong ba'i rig sngags 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa de'i spu'i khung bu rnams su mdangs thams cad stsal par bgyi bar ⑨bshad par bgyi'o//tabya thā/ hi li mi li tsi ⑩li swā hā/ bra h+pha swā re swā hā/0 7bra h+ma a ba su garbe' / a /spe/ pu ṣa saṃ ④sta re swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ni gang nang par langs tsonas klog pa'i rigs ⑩kyi bu'am/ rigs ⑩kyi bu mo de bsrung 8ba dang / yongs su bskyang yiba'i slad du dugazungs sngags 0gzhi rnams lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dukyang gang gi 0tshe skyong ba'i rig sngags 'di dag 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog ④pa'i rigs tsokyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo tsobasrung ⑦ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i slad du sangs rgyas kyis phyibyin gyis brlabs pa'i gzungs 0sngags zhugazhi rnams bshad par bgyi'o0/ /tabya thā/ bo durnyi tsiste/ ba ra ṇis/ da mā char ṇa tedu/91wa 165

dinyi dinyi/ go ri/ gan dha ri/ sar ma tan ta/ badz+ra tu la ni①/ dzā ②la mā 〈li ni/ tsakra bā (geka /sha ba re/ sha ba re/ sha ma re/ sha ma re 0swā hā/de nas rgyal po chen po rnam yithos kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung ⑦dang ske/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gis / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud deni/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang gang sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam ⑨grangs tshe skyong ba'i rig sngags 'di 'dzin cing nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs ⑩kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de la bsrung 0ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i slad du gzungs kyi gsang sngags 'di tsobarjod par bya'o0/ /tar+ya thā/ pudhe su saspre/ sho dha ni/ saṃ sho dha rdzini/ dhu ma pa ri ha 8re/ ār+ya pra ⑩shaste/shārnye7ske/ nir multe/ me nyugeg mye/ hi yir rgya pya gar+bhe sta ra sta pa 0swā hā/ de nas 'byung po'i ma mo 'phrog masadu/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gang 0sgo bzang po'i chos kyi rnam pu stegrangs tshe skyong ba'i rig 8sngags 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa dang / yid la bgyid ri stopa'i rigs 0kyi bu'am/ rigs phyokyi bu mo de la bsrung ( —6ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i slad du gzungs kyi so) gsang sngags zhugazhi rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ pi li sib pi duli/ si li/ ma hā bi pi liso/ge si me gnyeli si(2/ gu ru ṇi/ gu ru gu 0ṇi/ ma hā ku 0ru ṇi phu swā hā/de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lngas rtsen chabacom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar rurtseb btud de( )/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces 91wa 166

gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gang sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs hunyenas klog pa'i rigs ②kyi bu'am/ rigs ②kyi bu mo de la bsrung ④bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ar+bhe ⑤phu/ bar+bhe ༅phu/ nathe ⑦phul/ ku naḥ ②phu/ ma nas ⑩phu/ mu ⑩ta ha ke phu/ shri phu/ s+t+waṃ ge phu/ me ke 4)phu swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gang 0sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de la bsrung ④bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang ba dang ske/ yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa 8dang / zhi ba dang /bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / dug gzhil bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams bcad par tsobagyi'o/ /tabya thā/ he badz+re/ he badz+re/ tī hu tshohā/ bi si bi tsos/ ma hā bi si phu swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i bu dbang phyug chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gang sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs kyi 0bu'am/ rigs du )kyi bu 0mo de la bsrung ⑫ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i slad du gzungs sngags ( nyegazhi rnams brjod par bgyi'o / /tabya thā/ hu lu hu lu hu lu ( stetu lu lu/ sarba bhū zhu)ta pra ti ṣe 0dha rna ka ro mi swā hā/ de nas sde dpon gzhon nus bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud deng 7/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gang 0sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos 91—167

kyi rnam grangs gtsang ma 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi ①bu mo de la bsrung ②ba dang / yongs su bskyang bar bgyi ba'i slad du gzungs ③sngags ④gzhi 'di ⑤rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /tabya shā / nyi li nyi li/ hi li hi li/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ tu ru tu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ sarba sgru 6)ta pra ti ṣe dha ⑦rna nika ro mi ṭ+wā hā/ de nas lha'i bu zla 'od kyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ⑨bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ⑩kyang gang sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs yigatsang ma 'di 'dzin cing ske/ nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs 8kyi bu'am/ rigs 0kyi bu mo de la bsrung ④ba dang / yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ i ge/ baṃ ge/rtsa ge 8nyi ni/ ḍi ḍi/ di di/ tsi tsi phu swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 49dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag ⑩gis kyang gang 8sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ༅tshe skyong ba'i rig sngags 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs 0kyi bu'am/rigs du )kyi bu mo dude la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyang bar 0bgyi'o/ /tabya shā / ha te/ bi ha te/ ni ha te/ sarba pra rdzita/ rī kā pra kyā/ mi tra shud dhe / muste④/ /bi multi / bi ma le/ du nyenirma le pra bha swa tsore/ pra bha ka re phu swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gang ( 7sgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs tshe skyong ba'i rig sngags 91—168

'di ①'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs ②kyi bu'am/ rigs (kyekyi bu mo de la bsrung ④bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ dz+wa ②le dz+wa le/ ma hā ⑥〈 ②le/(nyedz+wa le ni/ suk+kiṇi/ muk+kiṇi/ sha me/ pra sha me/ ma hā pra sha me/ sha me sa mā ⑪dhe / ma hā sa mā dhe/ sa mā 8ba dhe/ dz+wa le/ ma hā dz+wa le/ dz+wa le tsob me 0phu swā hā/ de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon kha ba 8can gyis tsobacom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de⑩/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 8kyang gang sgo ⑩bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs tshe skyong ba'i rig sngags so)'di 'dzin cing /nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs (nyekyi bu'am/ rigs sakyi bu mo de la bsrung du steb dang / yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ u rdu ba re/ u rdu ba re/ ④rdu be'/ pra rdu tsobe/ byā bde0/ ā na ghi/ sa mā adhe/ ma hā phyos zhu mā 0dhe/nī le nī le/ nī la ke she/ ke shi ni/ ku le rdunyeku le/ ma hā ku le/ nī la ku le/ sirnyi/ si du/ ma no hā chare/ ar+bhe/ bar+bhe/ nas/ ku nañca.a/sa ma thetso/ ba ba la/ ku tse/ dwarnye/ nī la ka she/ ku le/ nī 0la/ dharnye / rdzu mgu le/ hu she/ mū she/ ba lo ku she/ ha la ku she/ pha la mu tse swā hā/ de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bde ba'i ri gyuganas kyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de( )/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gang sh+yisgo bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs tshe skyong ba'i rig sngags 'di 'dzin cing / nang par langs nas klog pa'i rigs ④kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de la bsrung 8ba dang / yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ a ma le/ bi 91wa 169

༄ga /'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/① ༄༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sap+ta be tā ḍa ka nā ma (shes ra tsā/bod skad du/ 'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong stong (genyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig snitu bzhugs te/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang yang thabs cig 9gego/ /de'i tshe na mu stegs can kun tu rgyu ba rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gnod par (6)bya ba'i phyir/ ro langs chen po bdun btang bar gyur to/ /de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ba las de dag gis glags 3)ma rnyed/ dmigs pa ma rnyed do/ /de dag gis glags ma rnyed/dmigs pa ma rnyed nas de dag tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ga la ba (deder song 91—182

ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i lus la reg go/ /reg ma thag tu kun dga' bo de sdug bsngal mi bzad 6)pa/ drag pa tsha ba shi la thug pa'i tshor ba rnams dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa (gyikun dga' bo 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag ni sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ drag pa tsha ba/ shi la thug pa'i tshor ba rnams dang ldan na chabacom ldan 'das des ④ma dgongs so/ /bdag 'di ltar nyam nga bar gyur na de bzhin gshegs pas ma dgongs so snyam mo//de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑤gyi bu chen po dang ⑥/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang thag mi ring ba zhig na 'dug par gyur 0to/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa de lta bu de tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑤gyi bu chen pos thos so /de nas de gnyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ga la ba der song ste phyin nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/drag pa/ tsha ba'i tshor ba myong nas bdag la de bzhin gshegs pas ma dgongs so zhes ci de skad ces smra'am/ de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gi ⑨lus la tshor ba dang ldan pa ni dper na sog les mgo bo gshags ⑩pa ltar kun dga' bo la reg pa yang de dang 'dra'o/ /kun dga' bo ma 'jigs rtso)shig /bdag cag gis khyod khri'i steng du bzhag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du bskur 8ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de khyod phonyal yongs su skyob par mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ④gyi bu chen pos tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo hu nyal khri'i steng du bzhag nas/91—183

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du bzhag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod ci sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ drag pa/ tsha ①ba'i tshor bas thebs sam/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de lta lags so/ /kun dga' bo khyod de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung ②shig dang bshad do / /kun dga' bo khyod la reg pa'i ro langs chen po stobs che ba/ gdul dka' ba/ mthong na gnod pa bdun yod de/ bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/phreng ba 'dzin ces bya ba dang / nor bu 'dzin dang / gtum po chadang /gdol ba dang / rma bya'i snying dang / tshe zad dang / la ba can te/ ro langs chen po bdun po de rgyadag ni stobs che ba/ gdul dka' ba/ bsnyen par dka' ⑤ba/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ba'o/ /kun dga' bo ro langs re res kyang 'dod na rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyang 'phen toX / /ri'i rgyal po ri rab yungs ⑦'bru tsam du rnam par 'jig go/ /steng du bltas na sa 'gas par byed do/ /phyogs su bltas na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs mtshams su bltas na mes sreg par byed do/ /de dag gis khyod la reg go//de lta mod kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dumathu dang / chos thos pa'i gus pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis ⑨ brlabs kyis ⑩da dung du khyod kyi lus 'tsho ba yin no/ / kun dga' bos gsol pa/7 bcom ldan 'das legs par bsal ⑫du gsol/ phyir bzlog tu gsol/ phyag rgya bcing du gsol/ skud pas bcing du gsol/ bcom ldana'adas kyis bka' stsal pa/8 kun dga' bo de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 8shig dang bstan par bya'o/ /tabya thā/91—184

ha ra ma hā gā ①rel/ gha sa ra ba til/ dha ra dha ri/ dha ra ṇi tsho ra tsho ra ṇi/ka ro ti 0ti/ kot+ta ⑤sa mā dhi niX/ sa ma ra tsos ra ṇi/ sa ra na liko ta mi ⑨til/ sa be0/ bha ba na⑩/ nā ga re/ bha da nī/ sā dā 8ni ti swā hā/ kun dga' bo gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag lan lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bor na brjed byed thams cad ⑫dang ske/ 'byung po thams cad kyi snying la gnod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad kyis byas pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /de ltar mdzod cig /slar yang mi 'chi ④bar mdzad du gsol/ kun dga' bo de'i phyir nyon la legs par yang zung ⑩shig /tabya thā/ bad tsa le ba le ma hā bad tsa le ba le/ bhi li gi li/ ma hā gi ri tsār+ya/ ni mi ri ni/ ha na ha na ha ti ri/ ma tsa shā0/ ma bi tsa ra thā/ ti 8re (1sgri ra mu le/ ma tha nin tha ni/tsā dul ni/ mā ka 50/ rdza bha ni/ spru dā ni/ bha ⑤ya swa sakṛ ④ni 3/ bha ga ba ti / ta thā ga ta/ bi ta the/ ti bi ༅gha dha re/ pa ra pra de/ ha re tiṣ+ṭha/nī dul dub sa ⑥ni swā hā/ kun dga' bo ro langs 'di dag ni 'tshog pa/ snang ba/ gtum por gyur pa/ gsod par gyur pa'o(3 / /de la rig sngags 'dis ke mo ru 0ka'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bor duro/ / des na du'abyung po chen po shin tu 'khrugs ④par 'gyur ro/ /'dis thams cad kyang snang tsobar 'gyur/ 'dzem 0par 'gyur/zhi bar 'gyur zhing / 'dis 'byung po thams cad kyang dbang du 'gyur 'dis 'byung po thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo nyon cig dang bstan par bya'o/ /tabya thā/ da ra da ra da ra/ ka ra ka ra ka ra/ ma hā 91—185

dkar①/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsa da tsa ra/ ma hā tsa da tsa ra/ ha la ha la ha la/hi li hi li/ hu lu hu lu/ hi re bi re/ ki ri bi ②ri/ be+e ri ( bi tsi ni/ka raṃ ka ri/ sarba sbo tā ⑤nā 5snyen/ pra oṃ (ni/bha bu ni/ nī dusal ba ra ba spus ni/ tsa 67/ tsakra tsakra/ a 3)yu dhe swā hā/ kun dga' bo 'di dag ni gnod sbyin thams cad dang / srin po thams cad dang / gsang sngags thams cad dang /yi dgas 3nyadang / byad dang / sdig pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o/ /rgyal pos bkrabs pa dang / tshulag can nyunyapa phyir zlog 7par byed do/ /de la rig sngags 'di skud pa dmar po la lan sum cu (8rtsa bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud ⑩pa sum cu /)rtsa bdun bor na thams cad burengs par byas par ⑩'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag zung so )shig /chongs shig /legs par rab tu yid la zung byu :shig /rjes su sbyor bar gyis shig /de lta bas na kun dga' bo khyod kyis ci nesprin pa dang ldan pas gzung bar bya'o/ /tabya thā/ dha ra dha ra/ dha dha ra rte/ kha ra kha ra/ ma hā kha rdo ster/ ma hā ( deb le/ ba la nā 'usha ni/ gos nī rmu/ kuṣ+ṭa snye'i/ye hā re/ ku ṭa desne( )/ ka kha kha re/ma kus dha re ṇisma spe/ mu luskasasnye/ k+ṣe ni sa ka kai saste'i ke /sa mem byashā 3ni/ ki ni / gi ri ṇir / bho gi si ri(re/ sa ri tshesnga be rta tā ṭa4nye/ ku ci mā (nyer ka / kṛ te 69swā si/ skan ni ci snyibi 69bud+dha si/ bi bud dha/ bi bud dha/ gre ṭ+wāṃ trī — 499/kṛ 41ta lha zhu ra ba/ bi kṛ 87ta lha ra ba/ ma hā ba ye/ kṛ twa na/ ha ri sasi/zhin na mā ra ya si/ kyin na (nyesarba de ba/ nā ga /yak+ṣa/ garnya ④/ a su ra / sarba a su ra/ sarba bha ya sha ma na/ me dugyes ra swā hā/ kun dga' bo rig sngags 'di sbyin sreg genyagam/ skud pas bcings na 'dod pa'i mthar 91wa 186

gtogs pa thams cad 'jig ①par byed/ ltung bar byed/ za bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo ro langs thams cad rengs par byed pa'i rig sngags zung ②shig /tabya byathā/ se me le/ ma hā ha ha le/ ha ra dha ④ri/ sto ra dha re/ dha rasti/ris/ bi ros/ ku nas⑤/ ku ta ni/ saṃ go tsa ni/ ka tsa ri/ yikha tsa ri/ma ra ni⑦/ hu hu/ ma re ṇal/ ma hā mā ⑨la dha re/ na yo na ma ti swā hā/kun dga' bo gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dmod pa drag po dang mtshungs shing 'dra ste/ 'byung po thams cad rnam par bshig pa'i phyir bal gtsang ma'i 7skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa bzhir bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi bor na/log 'dren thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag zung ⑩shig /legs par rab tu gzung bar gyis shig /kun dga' bo gsang sngags 'di gang yang rung bas gzung bar mi nus so/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na legs par gzung hurtebar gyis shig /tabya thā/ tsa ts+tsha ra8/ tsa ts+tsha 8ra/ ma hā tsa ts+tsha (gyer/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bu ru bu ru/ ma hā bu ru/ saṃ bha le/ ma hā saṃ bha le/ ma hā ba le swā hā/ kun dga' bo lha dang bcas / bdud dang bcas/ tshangs pa dang bcas/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / skye dgur ⑩bcas pa'i 'jig rten na gang zhig gsang sngags 'di la mi spro ba ni ngas rjes su ma mthong ste/ srung ⑩ba dang / rjes su 'brang ba yin no / /gsang sngags 'di ni mi bzad pa ste/ sreg par byed/ 'tshed par byed/'ching bar byed/ 'joms par byed/ 'bar bar 'o)byed pa yin te/ rig sngags lan drug cu yirtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa drug cu 0 rtsa gcig bor na sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed/ rig sngags gcod par 91—187

byed do①/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to②/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /legs par bzung ③lags so/ /mdud pa dor ④du gsol/ phyag rgya ⑤gzhag dupar mdzad du gsol/kun dga' bo de'i phyir/ tabya thā/ bha bha re/ bha re/ bha ra ṇi ha ra 0pra ha re / ha ra nini/ ku tha ni ta ṭi/ le ts+tsha dad ⑨ti/ tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad ⑩do/ /dbang phyug chen pos 0byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 8do/ /khyab 'jug gis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 0do/ /brgya byin gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad ④do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 8do/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad tsodo/ /zla ba dang nyi mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad ⑦/do/ /gza' dang nyi mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad phonyedo/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gyis byas pa'i rig sngags yigacad do/ /phyogs nas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad du )do/ /phyogs mtshams nas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 0do/ /steng nas byas pa dang 'og nas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad ( 3do/ /lhas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 0do/ /klus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad du chedo/ /gnod sbyin gyis ④byas pa dang / nam mkha' lding gis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad ⑩do/ /grul bum gyis byas pa dang / tshor 0ba pas tsobyas pa dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang /gdol pas byas pa dang ⑥/ kla klo dang / ri khrod pas byas pa dang / seng ge dang ske/ sbrul gyis byas pa dang / 'gro lding ba'i yid kyis byas pa dang /g.yung zhu pos byas pa phyedang / to mas la pas byas pa dang / mu da ga ri khrod 91—188

pas byas pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi ①rig sngags 'chang bas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad ②do/ /tabya thā/ ga ga gā ra li phu/ ma hā ga ga gā ra li ②phu/bi ④shi phu/ sha par sid snyi duphu/ tsaṇ+ḍa le 6)phu/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ༷li phu/ tso gi phul/ tsi mi ri 2phu/ tsi tsi mi re phu/ tsakre phu/po) tsakra dha 0re ⑩phu/⑫ kṛta phul/ yosgo ru pe phu/ tsaṇ+ḍi phu'/ so ge phu/ pañca ṭa li 8phu/ pañca li ⑩phu/rnyi me 8su0/ gi pā pa le phu/ dzi ge le phu/ dzi ga la/ ak+ṣe phu/ a narnye ⑫phul/ sa mirnye ⑩phu/ nā sha nī dz+nya )phu/ myu med ni phu/ bid myu dud ni phu swā hā/kri sa nis/ bak+ṣa ni/ mā ra ni/ pin+da ni/ bin bya rna ⑨/ bak+ṣa ni/ nā shā tsoni / 'ad bya ka rna/ gā la bhi nā shā nī ⑩/ dā hā ma si bhasma bhasma ni/ ma sa ni/brnya 0ni su hā/ kun dga' bo gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag ni mtshan mo gzi brjid 'phrog par byed pa'o0/ /kun dga' bo nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe/ ro langs chen po gnod byed ces bya ba zhig yod de/de ston gyi dus kyi tshe 0nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi sno )rjes su zhugs nas/ gang 'od zer de dag gis gang la reg pa 0'od zer gyi dra bas reg nas rims su 'gyur te de yang bcad mdo/ /kun dga' bo ro langs kha gcig dunyapa zhes bya ba zhig yod de/de yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdu bar bya'o/ /klu'i rgyal po sa 'dzin ces bya ba yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdu bar bya'o/ /klu thams cad dang / grul bum thams cad dang / yi dgas tsodang / sha za thams cad kyang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdus/ nam mkha' lding yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdus/ nor 'dzin yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdus/ rlung lha yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdus/ sgyu ma len gyi bu pa ro zhunyepa ṭi / she ru 0dro yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdus9/ phung po ⑥91—189

'dzin dang ①mdung thung 'dzin kyang de bzhin du bsdus/ de bzhin du blon po dang bcas pa dang / 'khor dang bcas pa yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bsdus so/ /kun nas dpag tshad brgya dag tu/ /nga yis ②chad pa dag byas pas nga la 'byung pos byar ci yod/ /nga yis sdang ba thams cad bcom/ /gsod par gyur pa stobs po che/ /ro langs dag gis byar ci ②yod/ /de dag kyang ni nga 'i zhags pas/ /kun nas yongs su bskor ba yin/ /zhags ④pa kun gyis de dag kyang ske/ /rmugs shing shin tu rmongs par byas/ /'di yis bdag gis ⑤kun 'grub cing / /gsang sngags tshig rnams grub gyur cig /na maḥdusid dhā 0nān/sid rgyan tu man+t+ra pā da (nyes ⑨ste re me tsosarba satā nāñca hunyes hā/ sangs rgyas kun gyi zhu stobs gang dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi stobs gang dang / /dam pa'i chos kyi gzi brjid kyis/ /bde legs su ni rab gyur cig /'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi gzi yis rtag tu 'jigs pa thams cad la swā hā/ cho ga ni lan drug cu ⑫rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ kai me ru dang / bal gtsang ma la sogs pa'i skud pa dmar po la mdud pa dor ④ro/ /de bzhin du byab pa skeyang bya'o⑩/ /'byung po thams cad dang / brjed byed dang / sems rnam par g.yeng byed la sogs pa dang / dug byin pa dang / dug byas pa dang / rkang gnyis pa dang /rkang bzhi pa nyurternams la kun tu 'gro ba grub pa'i mchog yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang /lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te18/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so8// //91—190

༄ga /'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo/kyis ༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bha dra rā tī nā ma sru tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe dge slong zhig rgyal po'i khab kyi chu ta la po ta'i 'gram na 'dug go/ /de nas lha kha dog mchog dang ldan pa zhig nam sros nas dge slong de ga la ba der song ste phyin nas chu ta la po ta'i 'gram thams cad snang bar byas te dge slong de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde shes sam/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bdag gis ni mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde ma 'tshal na/ lha khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mkhyen tam mi mkhyen/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong bdag 91—195

gis kyang mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mi shes so/ /lha 'o na mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde 'tshal ba de lta bu su mchis/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa 'di na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs kyis / khyod bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song la zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de khyod la ji ltar lung bstan pa de bzhin du zung la brtson par gyis shig ces smras nas lha de de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas dge slong de nang par langs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas dge slong des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa mdang dgung rmongs nas bdag gi der lha kha dog mchog dang ldan pa zhig bdag ga la ba der mchis te/ chab ta la po ta'i 'gram thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos khyab pas snang bar bgyis nas bdag la 'di skad ces mchi'o/ /dge slong khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde shes sam/ bdag gis de la 'di skad ces bgyis so/ /lha bdag gis ni mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde ma 'tshal na/ lha khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mkhyen tam mi mkhyen/ de bdag la 'di skad ces mchi'o/ /dge slong bdag gis kyang mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mi shes so/ /lha 'o na mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde 'tshal ba de lta bu su mchisal/ des 'di skad ces mchi'o/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa 'di na bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song la zhus te bcom ldan 'das kyis de khyed la ji ltar lung bstan pa de bzhin du 'di zung la brtson par gyis shig ces smras nas lha de de nyid du mi gda' bar hu)gyur to/ /btsun pa 91—196

bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du bdag 'di yongs su zhu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong khyod kyis lha de shes sam/ dge slong des gsol pa / btsun pa bdag gis lha de ma 'tshal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu de ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi ded dpon te tsan+dan ①zhes bya'o/ /dge slong des gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag kyang mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde thos par 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong khyod de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /dge slong chos gsum dang ldan na dge slong mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/'das pa la rjes su phrad par mi byed pa dang / ma 'ongs pa la re ba med pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i chos rnams kyis mi phrogs par gnas pa'i chos can te/ chos gsum po de dag dang ldan na dge slong mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad ces gsungs nas/ ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad du gsung ②ngo / /'das pa rjes su phrad mi byed/ /ma 'ongs pa la re ba med/ /'das pa gang yin de 'gags te/ /ma 'ongs de ni ma phyin pa'o/ /gang dag da ltar byung ba'i chos/ /de dang de la rab bltas nas/ /rnam par rtog pas mi srogs par/ /de dag mkhas pas khong du chud/ /sang tsam 'chi 'am su shes kyis / /de ring nyid du rtun de bya/ /'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni/ /bdag tu shes pa ma yin no/ /sems can kun dang srog chags kun/ /'byung po kun dang thams cad kyang / /bde ba 'ba' zhig 'grub 'gyur te/ /thams cad 91—197

nyon mongs med par shog /thams cad bzang por mthong gyur te/ /gang dag sdig par ma gyur cig /de ltar gnas shing rab brtson la/ /nyin mtshan snyom las med pas na/ /de phyir mtshan mo bzang po yi/ /mdo sde thub pas rtag tu gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad rjes su bsrung ba'i phyir mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde 'di bshad nas/ 'gro lding ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag gsungs so/ /tabya thā/ bi ni bi ra ṇiñca/pa ni pu ra ni/ bud+dha madhe/ ma ni ni/ ṇi ṇi ṇi ṇi/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ pa ra ṭi/gau ri/ garnya ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa 2)li/ ma rta gi/ puk+ka si/ bha ma ni/ dra mi dri/ dra mi dri/ sha ba ri/ sa ra lam bhe/ tī na ma dha ma dha tra riri snar ni/ ma ho la na/da la ba ni/ da la ba ni/ da la bad te/ ma hā da li ni/ tsa li ni/ muñca tsakra pā ti/ ma hā tsakra pā ti/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ ma hā sha ba ri/ zla tsid gi ni / bhū tsi rang gi ni/ ni mi/ ni mong riragi ri/ ni min dhi ri/ bhū dha ni swā hā / tar+ya thā/ e ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ na ṭu mirnyi95ni/ kiṇi/ eng ku/ sid da ta ril/ tsa la lu/ rna tu/ nar lam lu/ gal lu/ ā ba tra gtsistano nertsir/ she ku nir ba rad sa le/ tar ke/ ta re/ ta rod tu/ nor tu/ ti la la lu/khyu ta ba ti ya/ ba ta yi ye swā hā/ tar+ya thā/ ar garte/ na ra garte/ paṃ su ka/ pā yi ye/ ka po ta ka pa yi ye ye ta bo dha ne swā hā/ dge slong rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis sems can thams cad rjes su bsrung ba'i phyir mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo dang / tshig dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / 'gro lding ba'i gsang sngags gzhi 'chang ngam/ 'dzin tam/ klog gam / yid la byed dam/ kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya 91—198

cher yang dag par ston na/ de'i lus la mes mi tshugs par 'gyur/ dug gis ma yin/ mtshon gyis ma yin/ chus ma yin/ rgyal po'i chad pas ma yin/rkun po'i chad pas ma yin te/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par yang mi 'gyur zhing / nges par mya ngan las 'das par nye bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skyes par yang / /mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo bklags na/ /skye ba dran dang dgra bcom dang / /dbang phyug tu yang nges par 'gyur/ /lan cig gis ni gnas kun du/ /dus min 'chi dang bar ma dor/ /bdag gis bdag la mi sbyor bar/ /dus min 'chi dang chos ma yin/ /sems can thams cad srung zhing sel/ /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs skye dang / /rmi lam mi shes mya ngan du/ /brjod na dpal du byed par 'gyur/ /gang gis bris te skyes pa dang ske/ /bud med lus la btags na ni/ /skal ba bzang dang gzi brjid dang ske/ /de yi dpal yang skye bar 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag dang yid 3)kyis su/ /mi dge cung zad gang byas pa/ /de dag thams cad bzang po'i mdos/ /dus ma yin par 'chi las skyob/ /rgyal po chu dang me dang glogan /chom po nad dang dgra dag dang / /g.yul sprod pa dang 'thab par yang / /bzang po dran na skyob par byed/ /rig pa bzang po 'di dang ni/ /gsang sngags 'di dag rtag brjod na/ /mi dag mi zhum gnas kun du/ /de bas 'di ni yid kyis brjod/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal nas rig sngags 'di dag brjod par bya ste/ rig sngags 'dis bdag 'byor par gyur cig /tar+ya thā/ ni mi ni min dhi re/ ti mi ti ming gi li/91—199

tre+e lo ki ni/ a lo ki ni/ tri shu la dha ra ṇi/ a ku pi ṇi kri mi kri ti/ ko li ko li/ kud to kud to/ ku to ki si/ ku ti/ ku pi ti/ bdag dang sems can thams cad lag na rdo rje dang lhan cig tu 'jigs pa thams cad dang /nad thams cad dang / dug thams cad dang / rims thams cad dang /gdon thams cad dang / gdug pas zin pa thams cad dang / chom rkun thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dang hunye/ 'jigs pa dang /gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / 'thab pa dang / rnyog pa dang ske/ sdig pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / mtshang 'dru dun ba thams cad dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyis ngan par spyad pa thams cad dang / thams cad du 'jigs pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig /tar+ya thā/ hi li mi li/ tsi li/ i li mi li/ bi shī tsa na/ par+ṇa sha ba ri/tsi li tsi li swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de ri skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas dang / sha zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos la nas gtan la phab pa// //91—200

༄ga /'phags pa mig rnam par smyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/1)༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tsak+ṣur 3)bi sho dha ni nā ma bi byā tshogeman+t+ra ske/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba ra zhes bya ba'i rig sngags / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya'i 6༄grong rdal 7bzang po zhig na shākya rnams kyi nang na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe sta du sa zhes bya ba na shākya bde ba zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa 8ri/ chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa9ra/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song / chos la skyabs su song / dge 'dun la skyabs su song / sangs rgyas la gcig tu phyogs / chos la gcig tu phyogs/ dge 'dun la gcig tu phyogs/ sangs rgyas la nem nur med cing the tshom 〉med/ chos dang / dge 'dun dang /sdug bsngal ba 11dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam la nem 91wa 206
