ye shes rgya mtsho phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' la 'ja' shar sna tshogs ltar/ /gtso khyod dag pa'i sems can gzigs/ /ngan 'gro kun sgrol dpa' chen 'khrungs / /go cha chen po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos nyid las byung snying po ni/ /yi ge gcig pa gzi brjid che/ /sems can sdug bsngal sa gzhi la/ /mun 'khrigs ①sel la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngags mchog gtso bo'i gsang ba 'dis/ /rgyal sras chos 'phel shes rab bskyed / /bla med go 'phang myur 'gro gsungs/ /gtso bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos kun gyur dang bcas pa yi las dang skye las rnam par grol/ /rgyal ba rgyu med bdag nyid 'khrungs/ /gtso mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos med ye shes me lce yis/ /'dus byas ri bo kun bsregs nas/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gcig tu rgyal/ /bla med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstod pa'i don de thugs chud nas/ /'gro la phan phyir ②cho ga gsungs/ /gsang sngags log par spyod pa dang / /ser sna log par goms pa las/ /'dod pas non pa'i sems rtog gis/ /sngags pa yi dgas rtsiganas su skye(5)/ /dang pos mar me me tog dang / /zhal zas gtor ma phreng ba sogs/ /mchod pa'i rdzas dang yo byad dang / /mi yi lus dang kha zas la/ /'tshe zhing sgrub pa'i bar du gcod6/ /mi sdug nad bskyed lo tog 97'tshe / /gnyis pa gnod sbyin drag 8gyur nas/ /sha khrag chang la snom zhing rgyug /thos bsam ⑨bsgrub bopa'i bar gcod cing / /nad bskyed 11tshe len log lta bskyedanyuge / /rig sngags 'chang gi gdon gzhom phyir/ /sgrub pos 'bad de sngags brjod bya/ /sngags mthu bskyed 1 pa gtor ma dang / /sbyin sreg 1 phyag rgya sngags bcas dang / /mnan pa'i las kyis nags me 15ltar/ /thogs pa med 91—311

par 'joms par 'gyur/ /de dag brtan hu)byed lha yin te/ /de gsal byed pa ras ris yin/ /de kun rnam dag gsol (mibyed pa/ /byang chub sems mchog zhi ba ni/ /log rtog 'khor ba'i zo po chun la/ /ral gri rnon po'i 4sta re ltar/ /'phags pa rdo rje 5khro bo'i phyi rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud las de bzhin nyid kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas sngags dang phyag rgya dag /'byung bar rab tu bshad par bya/ /na maḥ sar+pā sa 7pa ri pu /ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tsā1)/ snying po dam pa'o/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga 7te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tsaṇ+ḍa nyu1ma hā ro ṣa ṇa spo ṭa 512ya hūṃ/ ṭa / ta haṃ me snying po'o51ste/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ge/ sarba thā mtha ta a mo gha/ tsho/ tsaṇ+ḍa 8ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sbo ṭa 19ya hūṃ/ tra 2 )ma ya hūṃ/ ṭa ṭa haṃ me nye ba'i snying po'o/ /na maḥsar+pā pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba shuḥthā a tsa lārka ri gen/ nas nasari snye/ mos moskyo/ sas sas/ tab tab/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ste/ ā be sha aḥ/mas snye / ma la ka /dha ṇa dha sa ṇa/ ti ṇi ti ṇin / khā da khā da/ bi na rnya/mā ra mā ra duṣ+ṭan/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa traṃ/ ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi dza shurtaya badz+ra phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ tri bi la ta ra ga /narta ka /haṃ haṃ haṃ/ a tsa la/ te tser ril/ phaṭa phaṭa/ a hūṃ/ a sa man+ta 1ka /ṭa ṭa/ ma hā ba la sa tā ri lham na ya / traṃ namo haṃ/ shu r+ya du da lo ka / tu ṣ+pe dgan tu lo ka sa brdzu na maḥswā zhushepra ti zhuḍaha ta ba le bh+yo ri/ /dza la ma tra 1ta/ a sa ta na maḥ42su hā/ gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /de nas phyag rgya stang stabs kyiri ri/ /sngags 4brjod pa ni ciga'adir 4591—312

gsungs so/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ1/ sarba shā / oṃ ha na ha na mā ra na mā ra ya dz+nyā na/ khan 34 phaṭa/ ral gri'i 4phyag rgya'i sngags so/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pu ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā / oṃ groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍi snye/ khā da khā da/ pā 6sha na/ brnya brnya/ ma hā ar+ya te97/dharma te swā hā/ zhags pa'i'o(8 kyi/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra 9ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ ha na ha na/ kus ku(1 / mā ra ya duṣ+ṭa bi nā ya kai hūṃ dza/ go cha'i'o11/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ dha 12ra dha ra badz+ra 1lhan li/ kha ṭ+wāṃ 91 ga pā sha dha (15ra swā hā/ gtsug tor gyi'o/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/(5 i bhañja (1 brnya da ha pa tsa bhasmi ku ru ku ru ha na ha na badz+ra/ groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa 8phaṭa/ tho ba'i'o/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pu ra ke bh+yaḥkyi / sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ iṣ+ṭa na ta murti ri/ da ha da ha/ sā dha ya sā 21snya ya/ nga 2bi dza ya bi dza ya/ bi dza ru ya krirti rdu4su hā/ mgo bo'i gaphyag rgya'o ‘/ /na maḥsablo sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ bhu dha ra dha ra/ a tsin zhu)bya ba la bi kra ma ṇi/ bu ra bu sa la ya/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba rinaswā hā/ rdo ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ 9/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/sarba thā/ oṃ badz+ra skṛ 2 byed ya/ badz+ra ma tai 1gi swā hā/ snying ga'i da phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga /te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ hūṃ da ha da ha/ kyin tsi byurā ya si/ ā na ya shī s+t+waṃ lha/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ brnya brta/ du//da ma da ma swā hā/ phyogs bcing ba'o/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ du na du na ma hā pā sha khan ༷dha rā sa pa ri pū ra 91—313

ba'o0)ske/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥrinas/ sarba thā/oṃ ma thā (7ma thā/ ā na ya ā na ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba de baṃ gota ma ta ma/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā 5ri 6)rgyu swā hā/ 'jig rten pa rnams spyan drang ba'o(7ri/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥni / sarba thā/ oṃ sa t+ya sa t+ya/9/ ma hā sā 1 sidha 11ya/ da ma da ma/ ma hā da ma/ ā kur+sha nya ya ā kur+sha 512ya/ a bya 7ba ma hā na ya shudhe swā hā/ drang srong spyan drang ba'om/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pu ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ 15sarba thā/ oṃ dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ ma hā sa t+ya 1 ba di 18ni/ sarba tī te 8swā hā/ sring mo 2 )rnams spyan drang ba'o 1/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ22ske/ /sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ lha/ sarba thā/ oṃ hri hā dā/ ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma/ ha na ha 2snyen/ ma hā nan ye/ ma ra ma ra/ ha swā hā/ ma mo rnams spyan drang ba'o ga/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pu ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga tshote bh+yaḥ snye/sarba pyo nyeshā/ oṃ ha tsho stan badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa gra haṃ/ ma tha ma tha/ bhañja bhañja/sarba bisdi(1/ da ma da ma/ sarba du/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rkang stabs tsham ra ngam gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pu ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ lha/ sarba thā / oṃ āḥshuge / ā kā gsha tshog ga na s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ 'o thug khur rab 'bru sna tshogs/ /spos dang me tog la sogs pa/ /ci 'byor 'byor pa'i gtor ma ni/ /sngags des spro 95zhing spel bar bya/ /na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ 1/sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥs / sarba thā/ oṃ swa bhā ba sarba thā bh+yo /blo swā hā/ na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ sgo ma lasgo sarba ga ga na las ya swā hā/ na maḥsar+pā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ lha/ sarba 91—315

bsgreng nyunye/ /slar bsgyur 52 byed pa zhags pa'i rgya/ /gung mo mthe'u chung so sor sprad / /mdzub (8)mo ming med nang du dgug /mthe bo gshibs 4pa gung 'gram sbyar / /snying ga (5)bkod de go cha'i rgyan / /sor 'khyud khu tshur nang du bsdam/ /mtheb gnyis cung bsgyur mgo thod rgya/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur mthe bo ni/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur (7nyenang bcug nas/ /mthe bong g.yas bsgreng /tho ba'i rgya/ /phyogs bcur brdungs pa 9ltar bya'o/ /g.yas pa khu tshur gung mo bsgreng 1 / /spyi gtsug phyag rgya gtsug 11tu bzhag /g.yon pa khu tshur gung mdzub 1lhabasgreng 1lha/ /bka' rtags phyag rgya rtag tu phyarabo/ /khu tshur gnyis gshibs bosto sbyar ba/ /rdo ba lta bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i 16khu tshur snying gar bzhag1 /snying ga brgyan 18pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis sor mo so sor brkyang / /phyogs bcu bcing ba'i 1rtaphyag rgya'o/ /lag sbyar gung gnyis nang bcug pa/ / dri yi 2 phyag rgyar bshad pa'o / /khu tshur rgyab sprad gung mthe bong / /mthe bong gung mdzub 21pad dang 'khyud / /gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo khong stong shubs 22ltar gdon//bdug spos 'bul ba'i /phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis so sor gung srin bkug glu /mtheb mnan bzhag rnastebarkyang me tog rgya/ /thal sbyar gung srin mdzub mo bkug /mthe'u chung mtheb brkyang zhal zas rgya/ / skyil krung na'adug ste snyim pa zed/ /mthe bo tsho rtoganyis ni nang du bkug / sor gshibs sdo tshonas g.yab byed pa ni/ /dpa' bo gtso bo spyan drang rgya/ /thal sbyar mdzub 1bkug mthe bos mnan/ /byang chub sems tshogs 'gugs pa'i rgya/ /snyim bskyed mthe'u 22chung gshibs te brkyang ske/ /lhag ma brgyad pa /so sor dgug /nyan thos rang rgyal rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma lus thams cad 'gugs rdo pa'i rgya/ /khu tshur g.yas pa g.yon steng da bzhag /91—317

mdzub 1)gnyis brkyang ste so sor dgug /cung zad skyed (kyepar byed pa ni/ /pho nya pho mo 'gugs pa'i rgya/ /khu tshur rgyab sprad gung mdzub (0ni/ /so sor drang por gshibs te brkyang / /mtheb gnyis cung zad sprad de dgugazhon /'jig rten pa rnams 'gugs pa'i rgya/ /g.yon min g.yas pas de ltar bya/ /brtul zhugs drang srong 'gugs (5)pa'i rgya/ /g.yon pa khu (6)tshur gung mo bsgreng (7)/ /dngos grub sring namo 'gugs ri9)pa'i rgya/ /lag g.yas bkan te brkyang nas kyang //mthe bos mdzub mnan gsum po g.yab/ /ma bdun la sogs ma mo rnams/ /las kyi dus su 'gugs par 'gyur / /res kyis bteg cing drang po yi/nye/ /pus mo dag la rkang mthil sbyar/ /spyi bor me tog thal sbyar yang / /phyogs der g.yob cing 'bru 1 tshugs blta/ge/ /skum pa'i stabs kyis 'di kun gyis/ /bgegs tshogs 'joms shing rnal 'byor bsrung bo/ /lag pa g.yas ni gyen du brkyang ske/ /g.yon pa 12snying gar sdigs mdzub ri7ste/ /rkang gnyis sprad nas rting pa rdebs1 / /hūṃ brjod drag skad mdun du lta12/ /sa gsum g.yo byed zla gam stabs / /rkang g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs dang ni/ /ha ha brjod cing zhabs rgya bcing 19/ /phan tshun bsnol nas bgegs la bsnun/ /'khor lo phyag rgya phye mar bya / /rkang g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs dang ni/ /rdo rje thal mo mkha' la bsnun/ /khro gnyer mig can ma mchu mnan/ /yan lag gnyis gnyis me ltar sprad/ /rkang pa mnyam stabs hūṃ sgra can/ /lag gnyis sdigs mdzub zhu )phyag rgya'o/ /rkang gnyis mnyam du bzhag pa las/ /g.yas kyi 31g.yon bskor lte ba yin/ /mdun du g.yas te rgyab tu g.yon/ /gya tshom chogegasum gsum mnan pa ni/ /rtse gsum yin te rtse gsum rgya/ /lag pa steng brkyang dbyig bsgreng tri ltar/ /bgegs la 91—318

bsnun zhing 'bru tshugs blta1/ /g.yas su tho ba hūṃ brjod brdeg /g.yon pa snying ga'i (mi sdigs mdzub danaste/ /gnyis ka bgrad 4pa 'khor lo bya/ /nub 5bltas rkang pa mnyam bzhag dzinas/ /mdun g.yas rgyab dang g.yon phyogs su/ /g.yon pas bgegs gsum mnan bya zhing / /rim pas me dang ral gri dang / / sdigs mdzub 3)zhags pa 8phyogs bzhir bcing / /ha hūṃ drag brjod brjid gnon (9)rgya/ /rkang gnyis pus 'khyud 1 lag pa gnyis/ /gru mo bsgyur na thig gis mnan/ mo /bgegs bskrad phyir ni 'bru 11tshugs blta/ /rtse gcig rdo rje stabs (2su bcad1lha/ /rkang pa g.yas g.yon res kyis ngabaskor/ /lho byang g.yon te shar nub g.yas/ /brkyang zhing drag tu brdab par bya/ /rgyab nas drang dang tho ba dang / /rdo rje dang ni zhags pa'i rgya/ /phyogs bzhir bya ste 'khor lo'i stabasam / /phyag rgya dang ni stang lastabs kyis/ /phyogs skyong rnams kyang skrag byed na/ /'byung po'i tshogs 'joms smos ci dgos/ /thams cad dbang du sdud par byed/ /de nas phyogs bcu bcing ba yi1 / /rkang stabs khyad par bshad par bya/ /shar du rkang pa mnyam pa yis/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen du brdeg /lhor ni rkang rting sprad de gdang 18/ /hūṃ sgrogs 19thal mo mdun rgyab sbyar/ /nub tu rkang sprad lag pa gnyis/ / so sor sdigs mdzub gyen du brkyang / /byang du ral gri'i phyag rgya dang / /rkang pa ya gcig sa la bsgreng 1/ /khu tshur mdzub ni sbyar dpral bar bzlog lha /rkang gnyis mnyam byas res kyis phyar /mche gtsigs 2gas sgrogs dzikhro gnyer blta rje/ /byang shar thig ler grags pa'i rgya/ /khu tshur mthe'u chung mche ba'i rgya/ /rkang pa res bteg shar lhor phye/ /lho nub rkang gnyis res kyis 28brdab/ /zhags pas 'debs dang ral gris gcod/ /91—319

nub byang rkang 1gnyis brdab pa dang / /lag gnyis mtheb sprad 'khor lo bskorarin / /yang na tshe gcig phyag rgyas gdab / /stang ④stabs thams cad ha hūṃ sgrogs5/ /de nas rig 6)sngags bzlog pa yi/7/ /phyag rgya cho ga bshad par byal/ /khu tshur gung mo brkyang rtse sprad/ /mdzub gnyis de yi 34)'gram du bcang yoni/ /sngags dang phyag rgya thams cad kyis/ /lha klu srin po gnod sbyin dang / /mkha' 'gro 1 'byung po mi ma yin/ /gsod nyuskyedang skyod 12de me ltar mdzad/ /'phags tugepa rdo rje 1 khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog 1gepa bsdus tshapa'i rgyud las sngags dang phyag rgya'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //bla na med pa'i ras ris sku/ /cho ga de nas bshad par bya/ /bris sku 'dod pas 1 thams cad du/ /dge ba'i ras bzangs 18btsal nas kyang / /bkrus te sngags kyis 19bsrung 2 ribyas la/ /ngur smrig tu ni bsgyur bar bya/ /rgyud bzangs 51dal zhing dul bag yod/ /chos thos ri mo mkhas la sgrin rna / /sred chung yid gzhungs na khro med pas/ /sen rtsi shun kun tsha la sbyar/ /spong 2stedang mu zi kun 5ltar ljang / /ba bla kra ni bla 37na ser/ /li khri sgo nga mtshal spags bla rmedamar / /rams 28dang mthing shun na'abru nir sngo/ /sbyig dang añja nag )po ste/ / sha twa ra1dag kyang dkar por 'gyur/ /sa snod so btang gi skags snyigs (2byug /pir 'jam rab 'bring tha ma bris )/ /rgyal dang sa ri nam gru dang / /snron snrubs (gesmin drug lha mtshams shis/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /thub pa'i dge ba ras ris la/ /dbus su byang chub shing mchog drung / /gser mdog 'khor lo sgyur ra ba'i chas/ /chos 'chad phyag rgya ngur smrig mnabasanu / /logs su 91—320

'dab bzangs 0)rgyal po gnyis/ /snyim pa me tog bkang ba'i gzugs/ /g.yas su 'jig rten dbang po dkar/ /ngur smrig gyon 2pas thal mo sbyar/ /de ①yi zhabs su mi g.yo ba/ /spyan gsum khros pa klu yis 4brgyan/ /na ra'i stod g.yogs 55)stag smad dkris/ /rin chen rgyan can do ker can/ /rdo ba dmar po'i khri steng 56)na/ /ral gri dang ni zhags pa dang / /g.yon pa cung zad brkyang ste bzhengs(7)/ /gtso bo'i g.yon gyi phyogs nacha la/ /rdo rje 'dzin sngo ngur smrig can/ /rdo rje dang ni zhags 9pa 'chang / /de yi 'og tu sgrub po 7ni/ /pus btsugs 3)spos kyi khang bu 'dzin/ /gtso bo'i 1 zhabs su khro bo che/ /nag po khams gsum brtan 1 pa yi/ /lag gnyis rin chen khri la bteg /gtso bo sasna tshogs pad+ma ste/ /'jig rten dbang dang khro bo yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang bsgrub 15pa'i sngo/ /yan lag lnga pa sdong bo gcig /klu yi bu mo mdzes ma gnyis/ /pang gis 'khyud de 'dzin par mdzad/ /zhi ba rgyas pa 17dbang gi phyir/ /de nas bris sku yang dag bshad/ /dbus su shākya thub pa dang / /g.yas su 'phags pa 'jam dpal te/ /g.yon du phyag na rdo rje'o/ /bsnyen pa'i don du ras ris ni//shin tu blta dka' gsus po che/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi klu yis brgyan1 / /kha nas khrag 'dzag lce 'dril ba/ /mche gtsigs hrīḥsgra cher sgrogs 1 pa/ /spyan gsum nyi ma shar ku'i 'od/ /ngur smrig mnabs 19pa char sprin mdog /sku la thod rlon phreng ba can/ /dbu la thod pa tshar bzhis brgyan / /g.yon du rin chen zur phud 'phyang / /bskal pa'i me 'od 'bar ba yis/ /phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs sreg par mdzad/ /g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pas ral gri 'od 'bar 'chang / /g.yon gyi dang po rdo rje zhags/ /gnyis pa sdigs 5191—321

mdzub tsho1 brkyang ste mdzad/ /rin chen rdo yi 25khri stengs surdzunas/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan nas kyang / /g.yon brkyang pa yi gar gyis gnas/ /de yi bamadun du zhi ba'i byadamu/ /spos khang bzung ba'i sgrub po 6)bri/ /ci 'byor (3 rgyun du mchod par bya/ /mngon spyod bsgrub (8)pa'i ras (95ris ni/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /dur khrod ras la mi g.yo ba/ /mdog nag spyan gsum zur mig lta'i/ /ngur smrig gos gyon 17khro gnyer ldan/ /ral gri dang ni zhags pa 'chang / /bris nas bdag gi 12khrag gis 1 ni/ /spyan phye gsol ba btab par bya/ /ri mo 'di dusani rig 15'dzin kyang / /sgrub po mngon spyod smos ci dgos/ /yang na sna tshogs las kyi phyir/ /mthing ga 37na ra'i rgyan can ni/ /brkyang bskum 51 rdo rje dril bu 'dzin / /pad+ma zla ba la bzhugs bri/ /dmag dpung rengs 12pa'i ras ris ni/ /gser mdog khro bo mi g.yo ba/ /mi sdug mche ba gtsigs 39pa'i sku/ /'bar phreng na 'khrigs pa'i 'od ldan pa/ /zhal bzhi phyag kyang bzhi pa ste/ /ral gri zhags pa dang por 1'dzin/ / rin po sa che dang sdigs mdzub snye'og /zhabs bzhi bdud bzhi 20snying gar 2gero/ /de nas rig 'dzin dngos grub kyi/ /ras ris bri ba yang dag bshad/ /mi g.yo khro bo zhal gcig pa/ /mdangs bzang 27zar ma'i me tog mdog /ral gri zhags pa sdigs mdzub sa can/ /pus mo g.yas bteg g.yon pa ni/ /sa la cung zad btsugs par mdzad/ /mkha' la lha yi bu gnyis kyis/ /dbugs 'byin mdzad 7pa nyams dga'i gzugs/ /g.yas su rnam snang mdzad bri stes ri/ /g.yon du 'od dpag med pa'o/ /de mdun sgrub 1po nyid kyang bri/ /gang yang rig rtem thams cad la/ /mchod de me tog gtor nas kyang / /spyan phye na bza' gsol byas te/ /rten 'brel sngags 91—322

kyis rab gnas bya/ /de rjes smon lam gdab 1pa ni/ /oṃ ldan gebadag gis bsags pa yi/ /bsod nams grangs med gzhal mi lang / /des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bla med go 'phang thob par shog /sems can dmyal ba dud 'gro dang ske/ /yi dgas tshanasagang dag grangs med rnams/ /bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /gang yang lha mi dbul phongs (4)dang ske/ /mi nad mu ge dgra chom sogs/ /bdag gi 5bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /de dag thams cad bral gyur shog /ji snyed sems can thams cad rnams/ /de snyed sdug bsngal rgya mtsho kun/ /sna tshogs de dag kun zhi nas/ /'ga' yang sdug bsngal med par shog /sems can gang dag lus ngag yid/ /mi dge spyod 56pa bral gyur nas/ /dge ba phun tshogs spyod gyur te/ /kun kyang bde ldan thob gyur shog9) /de nas rgyal sras kun btud de / /lag na dri dang me tog sogs//mchod pa'i yo byad kun thogs nas/ /bla 'og tha dad gsal bya'i phyir/ /bde gshegs bsdu don 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ bde bar 9gshegs pa'i bcom ldan 'dasal/ /skyob pa dngos su bzhugs pa rnams/ /bdag la slar yang brtse ba'i phyir / /rgyal ba sras bcas la mi mnga'/ /bdag don grub par 'gro ba la/ /brtse phyir slar yang byon 1 par mdzod/ /de nas gtor 11ma me tog dri/ /dkyil 'khor rgyan dang rdul tshon rnams/ /dngos grub dam tshig gnod spang 12phyir/ /lag pas reg par 1lhami bya ste1 / /gos kyi phur ma la sogs 15pa/ /ci bde pas ni phyags nas kyang / /skye 'gag 17med pa'i sngags brjod nas/ /chu bo la ni dor bar bya/ /'bras dang 'o ma sha kha ra1 / /mar dang bcas pa bskol 38byas te / /'bras zan dang ni lhan cig 19tu/ /dga' bskyed phyir du 21dge 'dun 91—323

dang ske/ /bram ze la ni ston mo bya/ /de nas bris sku brtan par ni/ /gsang ba'i gnas su mchod par bya/ /khyad par tshes brgyad dus su mchod①/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul zhing / /rtag tu sngags 'dzin thams cad kyang / /mnyes phyepar bya zhing khros pa min/ /sems can ma mos spang bar bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la nges bskyed de/ /the tshom ④le lo spang bar bya'o(ge/ /rang gi phung po bsnyen porabakur phyir/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra ldan byas nas/ /gos sbra ②dri ma med pa bgo/ /zas kyang 'bras sogs dri med la/ /nyung ngu bza' dushezhing btung phyo)bar bya/ / mangs pas nyugeganyid dang le lo dang / /dri nga ba ni bskyed /spepar 'gyur / /tho rangs dang por langs 3shenas ni/ /srod thal bar du brtson par bya / / nam gyi 1dgung la gnyid pa'i tshe/ /'gro la phan bya'i sems kyis mnyalam/ /'phags pa rdo rje 15khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud las bris sku'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ste/ /lha bsgom pa yi 1 rim pa ni/ /rang gzugs stong par byas nas su/ /yi ge phreng ba'i 'khor lo las/ /sgra grags pa ni rig pa che/ /zla nyugeba'i gzugs brnyan lta bur snang / /der son pa ni rdo rje sogs / /rang gi phyag rgya nyid yin no/ /hu/de las gyur pa'i sku mchog ni/ /'ja' tshon shar ba ji lta chibar/ /mtshan dpe mdangs 'od 0yang dag ldan/ /brjid cing dgyes pa'i mdangs dang ldan/ /sgeg cing rol pa'i cha byad ni/ /byis pa gzhon nu'i lang tsho 'dra/ /rin chen rgyan dang na bza' ni/ /gzugs mdzes lha yi ci lta ba/ /khros pa'i srin po lta bu ste/ /skra dang kha spu la ༷ shesogs pa//91—324

spu sogs ser zhing rtsub la 'khyil/ /sna tshogs dur khrod rgyan rnams ni/ /rtsub cing blo ldan rab tu khros/ /na bza' rlon pa khrag can ni/ /steng gi khyams (7)su yod par mdzad/ /ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi/ /ngar skad 'brug sgra spyugs glu ni/ /ri rab 'bum bsnyil (2)chal chom ltar/ /lus rab ltos 'gros brgyan du pa ni/ /gzi ldan 'khyud cing phuṭa 50sgra 'don/ /'phro 'du 'od kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyi 'bum dus me'i bskal pa 'dra/ /rab gdug mtshon cha du ma ni/ /lha min dus kyi 'khrug pa'i cha/ /khro bo khro mo'i tshogs 'byung ba/ /thams cad yi ge hūṃ sgra can / /ma mo dang ni mkha' 'gro rnams/ /bh+yo yig drag po'i bdag nyid can/ /thub pa yi ge sum̐ las bskyed/ /rgyal sras rig ma nyan thos dang / /'jig rten skyong rnams sngags 'dis 95)bskyed/ /na maḥsarba ta thā 6ga te bh+yaḥ/ sa 7pa ri pu 8ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba shā99)/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra 7pa ri shudhe/ dharma 31te ga ga na sa mud ga te swa bhā ba 32pa ri shurnye/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā 1 re swā hā/ rang gi lus la sems bcug nas/ /sdig (1 tshopa thams cad rab tu zhi/ /ngang tshul bzang por yang dag byung / /rig par gyur pa'i sems ldan nas/ /drang srong rdzu 'phrul can du 'gyur/ /gzhan yang sdug bsngal zhi nus na/ /rang gi bde thob smos ci dgosal/ /rang rang rigs 12kyi lha rnams kyi/ /gzugs brnyan phyag mtshan kha dog ni/ /dkyil 'khor ram ni ris ma las/ /gsung ba ji ltar bsgom par bya /de nas mi g.yo khro bo chetshe/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 1 phyag 'tshal nas/ /dag cing gsal la snyan pa yis18/ /tshig gi yang 19ni 'di gsol to/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das/ /gtum mo 2 mtshan nyid rab 1ldan pa'i 2/ /nga yi mtshan nyid khyod sbyo stebashad nas/ /de tshe rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos/ /gtum mo'i cha byad 91wa 325

ldan byas nas/ /rang gzugs sngags dang bcas pa yis/ /gsang chen brda 'di bka' stsal to/ /dag pa'i sems nyid hūṃ rdo rje/ /mthing ga'i 1)mdog las rdo rje 'dzin/ /mthing ga nabarkyang bskum (8)khro sems can/ no/ /na ra'i /dergyan bcas 'jigs byed sku/ /gyen skra 6kha spu gyon ri ser dmar/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng du ni/ /me yi nang bzhugs rdor 9 dril 'chang 9/ /rnam snang 'dzin dang gnyis dang po/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pa de'i gsum pa/ /lnga pa'i lnga pa bdun pa'i bzhi/ /me yi 1 sa bon dgug pas 11mnan/ /bdun pa'i dang po gsum pa yin/ /gsum pas bteg go hūm̐ phaṭa bcas/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bla med 'di3nya/ /dgos pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / /khyad par du ni 'byung po sel/ /klu 'dul ba ni dkar po che/ /nam mkha' lding gi cha byad che/ /grub pa'i gter gyi don du ni/ /ser po 'od dang ldan pa yi1lha/ /dmar po dag boni ljang nag dag /drag po'i gdon rnams sel ba dang / /tshe ring ba la shis pa'o/ /lhag pa bskyed mapa'i sku mchog 1sgyu ni/ /'byung bar 1 7gyur pa (1 ride ma thag /sa steng 19thams cad mun nag 'khrigs ske/ /bdud rnams thams cad rab tu tshig /ye shes me 'od chen po 'di / /bzod par 21sla 2la gcig ma mchis/ /bgegs na chen log par 'dren pa rnams/ /dogs 2 pa'i sems kyi 5thag ring 5'bros/ /gsang sngags yi ge rtsu sgra can/ /glog na 'khrug pa yi 28'od zer 'dra/ /klad par yi ge haṃ gi gzugs / /gru gsum me sku yi gzugs ra ribarnyan can/ /'od dmar tshal pa rab 'thor bas/ /bgegs tshogs sreg cing bros 1par byed/ /bong sa bu rnga mo khyi spre'u gzugs/ /ro langs rim lus thams cad kun/ /ha ha glebarjod cing bros rdusnyepar byed/ /rlung gis g.yengs —9pa'i rdul ra dang mtshungs/ /gyen thur hūṃ ri 3gi 91—326

'phro 'du dang / /khro bcu sa bon yi ge rtsu/ /me dang rlung gi 1tshul du 'bar/ /mngon sum rtswa (gyil me bzhin du/ /snying gi hūṃ gis 'das nas kyang / /klad pa'i hūm̐ gis sreg par byed/ /'od dang phyag rgya lha yi sku/ /bskrad dang bcing dang myos byed bsam/ /seng ge dang ni glang chen 'brug /drag po'i sgra skad ci 'dra bar/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags zlos pa ni/ /bgegs dang log 'dren ma lus pa/ /sreg cing phye ma rdul du rlog /snying nang snying po bstan 4pa ni/ /'od 'bar 'od kyis sdig pa'i tshogs/ /du ma rnams kyang zad par mdzad/ /lus ngag yid brtan 'khor lo sngags/ /oṃ dang āḥ5dang hūṃ sbyor gyis/ /dpal 'phel dbang phyug bskyed pa dang / /go cha chen po bskon par byed/ /na tshom s+t+ri yarnyi kā dzā(7/ ta thā ga tā ṭ+wāṃ nyan/ go cha chen po'i gsang sngags 'di99/ /rgyal sras rnams kyang 'dar 'gyur khon/ /bgegs rnams sreg pa smos ci dgos//sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a hunyerta gis/ /ye shes lha dang 'brel par bya/ /rgyal bas dbang bskur sbyor bas ni/ /ye shes dbu rgyan brtag 12par bya/ /gtso la mi bskyod dbu rgyan can/ /'khor kun mi g.yos rgyas gdab bya/ /bdag nyid yi ger byas nas su/ / me gzugs 1 shin tu phra bas ni/ /mtshan mo dus su nyams par bya / /sdang ba hūṃ gi sgra las so/ /'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud las lha 'byung ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga nyon/ /dad pa dang yang mi ldan zhing / /byang chub sems kyang 7ma bskyed de/ /dbang bskur 1lharjes gnang ma thob la/ /sdom tshul dam tshig bral ba'i mi/ /gsang sngags rang 91—327

nyid len pa ni/ /byis pa lcags bsregs byi)mid pa 'dra/ /thog ma med (bsgrib bkru ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ sngags mchog ting 'dzin rnam dag chu/ /bskal pa du mar bsags pa yi/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rnams /dag gyur nas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems su byed/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha can kā ya bāka tsit+ta 9 bi sho 56)snya na a bhi ṣiñca (7)rgyu/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab 8ri bsngags pa'inyunye/ /rin chen sngags las bobyung ba yi/ /dbu rgyan /1lha rdzas cod pan 'dis/ /dbang bskur rin chen mchog tu 'gyurabo/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra shrī badz+ra sa /snyem ya s+t+waṃ yis haṃ/ rat+na mu kuṭa nyusnye.a bhi ṣiñca tshe:/ rdo rje chen po bla na med/ /bzung spe bas phyogs las rgyal gyur te/ /rdo rje lta bur brtan byed nyugepas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung hurte/ /oṃ sarba badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca du 3 rgyu / dril bu dbyangs snyan bla na med/ /sku yi rdo rje rab ri stobaskyed tsho gepas rte/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung mi/ /khams gegasum srid pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /oṃ sa ma ya gha na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca na rgyu/ oṃ snying rje shes rab dbyer med rgya/ /gang gis thos pa nang gi 28su/ /de yi ming mtshan bdag por 'gyur/ /rtag ri 6pa'i ngang gnas blang bar mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra nā sa snam a bhi ṣe dalhaka ta/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ri stebadag bdag mdzod cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu gergyadabyu/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi sanyerjes 'gror bshad/ /rtag tu khyod kyis bzung ra byas nas / /byang chub mchog thob rgyal bas gsungs/ /oṃ shes rab ral gri bla na med/ /gang gis 'chang ba rgyal 'gyur te/ /bdud kyi dpung ni gshegs nas kyang / /mkha' la ye shes 'od 'bar 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba 91wa 328

ta thā ga tā badz+ra 6)tshwa na khan 2a bhi ṣiñca /rgyu/ a cardo rje zhags 5)pa 6thugs 7rje can / /nyon mongs (8)srid pa'i sdong po rnams/ /thabs kyi zhags pas bcings 9nas kyang / /srid pa'i 'ching 1 ba las grol mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā 11badz+ra pā she na a bhi ṣiñca (124/ dbang dang rjes gnang ma thob cing / /dam tshig nyanasdom pa mi ldan la/ /bla ma mnyes par mi byed na/ /sgrub pa 'bras med ngan song 'gro/ /log lta can gang bla ma 'tshe1 / /dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro bar nges / /'dir nyams pas ni nad yams dang / /dgra bo mu ges rtag tu 'tshe/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi 35nyams dga' ba/ /chu klung mtsho la'agram ri ljongs dang / /'bras bu me tog skyed mos tshal17/ /kun dga' ra ba khang bzangs 18mchog /bzhi mdo ri sul shing gcig drung / /phyugs lhas khang brtsegs glang chen bres/ /gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa dang / /chu gling mtshe'u 'gram ne'u gsing 19du/ /bsnyen dang dbang bskur byed pa dang / /dur khrod sogs su las rnams bsgrub3 )la/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor khru gang ste/ /dbang gi 1dkyil 'khor chen po la / /thub pa'i dkyil 'khor gru 52bzhi pa/ /yang na drug gam brgyad kyang bya/ /gzhan ni khru gsum tshad du bya/ /yang na lnga 'am bdun du bya/ / gza' yi na dkyil 'khor khru gnyis te byu/ /yang na phyed 25dang gsum par bya/ /kun du bzhi cha pho brang ste/ /khang pas 7tshad kyi phyed yin te / /khang pa gnyis pa cha gsum pa / /rta babs rdo rje pad+ma'o/ /lha snam /bzhi cha dag tu 'gyur/ /thub pa'i sgo ni bzhi yin te/ /gzhan du sgo gcig pa nyid shis/ /'jam pa'i spyodabyangs ni byang gi sgo/ /chos ni nub sgo rdo rje lho/ /gza' dang 'jig rten skyong sogs shar / /dbang sgyur sdo rilha yi gnas rnams su/ /bum pa phyag rgyar shalhabacas pa 'am /91wa 329

sku 'am rang rang phyag rgya gzhag(1) /thub pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /bad dkar (misteng du lhung bzed do/ /gtso bo'i sa (5)ni sor drug ste/ /lhag ma rnams ri ni sor bzhi'o/ /rigs kyi mtshan mas yang yang bskor/ /byang du 'jig rten dbang sdud ni/ /pad dkar 55)rdo rje gdengs por bcas/ /dbang ldan spyi blugs byams pa'i 'o(6ci/ /shar du 'jam dpal ut+pal sngo/ /mer ni kun bzang 7)yid bzhin norarin/ /lhor ni rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /bden bral mkha' snying ri9pad dkar te/ /nub tu pad ser rdo rje chos/ /nub byang sa snying pad+ma dmar/ /gtsug tor gnod rmedzes steng 'og char/ /gtsug tor dang ni gtun 57shing ngo / /shar du rnam rgyal thod pa ste/ /mer ni 'dod rgyal rtse gsum mo / /rdo rje rtse gcig gshin gshed lhor/ /bden bral ral gri stobs po che/ /nub tu rta mgrin pad+ma ste11/ /byang du bgegs dgra rdo rje rgya/ /nub tu dbyug pa sngon po ste/ /dbang ldan du ni mi g.yo ba/ /de yi rgyab tu nyan thos ni/ /shā 32ri'i bu dang rab 'byor dang / /mod gal bu dang 'od srung 3 dang / /rgyal mchog dang ni sa steng skyong / /rta thul dang ni ba glang 1 ribadag /drag shul dbang chen changs chodabu can/ /bha 17ra dh+wa 41 dza lteng 1 rgyas dang / / dga' bo nye 19dga' sgra gcan no/ /de ltar bcu drug phyag rgya'o/ /pad+ma'i steng du lhung bzed ṭ+wāṃdo / /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /'jam dpal dkyil 'khor bzang po yi/ /dbus ru su ral gri me 'od can/ /rin chen rdo brag 32steng du bri/ /byang du rdo rjes mtshan pa yin / /bum pa bri ba byams 5pa'o/ /shar du kun tu bzang po yi//rdo rje dkar po bri bar bya/ /lhor ni me 'od ldan pa yi/ /lag na rdo rje'i rdo rje bri / /nub tu 'jig rten dbang po ste/ /bad dkar 'od dang ldan pa bri ne/ /91wa 330

yid bzhin nor 'dzin mdzes gzugs can/ /rin chen rdo steng dbang ldan bri/ /mer ni rab 'bar rdo rje yi/ /bgrang phreng pad+ma la gnas bri/ /bden bral du ni rab brjid pa'i/ /go cha 'bar ba bri bar bya/ /rlung du mdzes pa gzhon nu'i lha / /rin chen sgrom ni bri bar bya/ /steng du brtul 1)phod ces khro bo'o/ /pad+ma'i steng du khro bo yi/ /'og tu khro rgyal mngag 5)gzhug gi/ /rdo rje brag steng zhags pa bri/ /khro bo lhag ma sngon gyi ni/ /tshul gyis rgyal bar dgod par bya/ /brtan pa zhes pa'i pho nya mo'i/ /chu gri byang du bri bar bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'chang ba yi/ /mkha' 2)sor ma ni shar du'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'chang ba yi/ /rnam 'jigs ma tsho kyini lho ru'o/ /nub kyi phyogs su bri bar bya/ /mdzod spu (snyem zhes rin phreng 'dzin/ /rin chen rdo steng shar lhor zi(6/ /shar lhor bgegs 'dzin ma zhes pa/ /'khor lo me 'bar rdo rje bri/ /'bar ba'i gtun shing bden (7)bral du/ /'joms tsho pa'i tho ba rlung du bri/ /thal sbyar (9gung mo nang du bcug /pad+ma mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / /sngags 'dis dkyil 'khor byin gyis bobarlab51lha/ /na maḥsarba ta thā 1rtag te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe nyi bh+yaḥ/hūṃ hūṃ ba ba me yaṃ swā hā/ spyan drangs gshegs su gsol ba dang / /srung thub mchog gi sngags yin no/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ15/ sarba bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/he he he/ ā dz+nyā 7pa ra ma ra 1 tshog ga na ā gtsā gats+tsha 1 /bha ga bān shī 1 rgyu swā hā/bsnyen pa 'bum la byin brlabs dang / /lha bsgrub 21pa dang mchod pa'o/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje chos kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /dbus su 'jig rten dbang sdud nyid/ /pad+ma dmar po 'chang ba'o/ /shar du don yod zhags pa ni/ /bgrang phreng sngon po 'chang ba'o/ /lhor ni nam mkha' 22dri med de/ /91—331

rdo rje sngon po 'chang ba'o/ /nub tu gar gyi dbang pad+ma/ /byang du thugs rje shugs po che/ /rdo rje nag po 'dzin pa bri/ /sgrol ma khro gnyer ral gcig dang / /yid bzangs 1ma ni mtshams su bri/ /khro bo dang ni pho nya mo/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rim pas dgod/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag bshad par bya/ /dbus su phyag sbyon na rdo rje nyid/ /rdo rje dkar po 'chang ba'o / /shar du sangs rgyas spyan ma yin/ /lhor ni pad 'dzin mā ma tī/ /nub tu gos 'chang na bza' dkar/ /byang du sgrol ma ut+pa (kyel 'chang / /phyogs bzhir nam mkha' dri med dang / / shugs po che dang ( rdo rje tog /snyems ༷getshul chen po zhes pa rnams/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa'o/ /der yang sngon ltar khro bo rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du bri bar bya/ /de yi cha rgyab dkyil 'khor la / /drag po lha rnams bkod pa ni/ /dpung bzangs (6)la sogs (lerdo rje can/ /brgyad po byang gi phyogs su bri/ /tshogs 'chang bshes gnyen 'gro skyong dang / /mthong dkar 8rig 9byed bden bral med/ /ngan spong brgyad de drang srong shar/ /lhor ni rdo rje dgra sta ma/ /rdo rje tho ba drag shul ma/ /rta rna ma dang khro gnyer ma/ /ro langs ma dang lcags sgrog ma/ /mthong dkar ri7ma ste brgyad po bri/ /dug sel rma bya 'od zer can/ /nor rgyun ral gcig dpung rgyan ma/ /dbyangs hunyeldan dril sgrol brgyad nub phyogs/ /kun kyang rang rig hu phyag rgya can/ /sgo yi phyogs su dgod bya ba/ /thub pa'i 'jig rten skyong pa bzhi/ /brgya byin khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /tshangs pa 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor la'o/ /rgyal dang rnam rgyal mi thub ma/ /gzhan mi thub ma 12spyan ras gzigs/ /nag 7mo che dang u tsurmis/ /gzhon nu 'phrog mo gter la'adzin gyi/ /khro bo mi g.yo sgo bzhi la/ /91—332

nag po 0)che dang dga' byed dang / /ngan 5)spong dang ni tshogs da bdag go/ /mi g.yo dbang bskur dgyes pa yi/ /dbus su khro bo mi g.yo ba'i/ /ral gri me 'od 'bar ba'o/ /phyogs bzhir khro bo mdog bzhi'o/ /'khor los sgyur 4ba'i cha byad can/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /rgya gram g.yas pa'i phyag tu 'chang / /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 5)zhags pa 'chang / /rin chen brag la sku bzhugs nas/ /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i steng du'o/ /mtshams su khro mo bzhi po yang / /gtso bo dang mtshungs sgeg pa'i nyams/ /de 6rgyab sngon ltar khro bo bcu/ /sku 'am phyag rgya'i phreng ba bri/ /dkyil 'khor cha yi rgyab tu ni/ /'jig rten skyong bcu drag shul can / /khros pas rang rig 7'khor bcas bri/ /bum pa tshad ldan ras kyis dkri / /dri bzangs 8)chus bkang lha grangs sam/ /bcu gnyis sam ni drug kyang rung ske/ /kha rgyan dang bcas gzhag 9par bya/ /bla re ba dan gdugs rgyal mtshan / /yon chab bdug spos me tog dang / /sgron ma 7byug chab zhal zas dang ske/ /gling bu sil 11snyan na bza'i 12tshogs/ /gtor ma'i dri bzangs 1 sman dang bcas/ /yid 'ong 7dri zhim zas skom 5tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor spros tshanas mchod par bya/ /sa la pus 1 mo tshad brkos nas/ /'bu nyanasrin shing rdo dum bu sogs / /skyon mang nya/bral nas sa yis dgang / / ba yi 5 rnam lngas byugs 1pa'i sar / /me tog gcal /bkram mchod sogs dbakod/ /lha ni spyan drangs mchod nas kyang / /dge 25mi dge ba'i nermi lam brtag rje /rmi lam bzang na spro gyur nas/ /sa bdag mo la gsol ba gdab/ /khyad par du yang gtor mas mchod / /bu tshur shog ces theg chen gyi/ /tshul chen khyod ni snod yin pas/ /gsang sngags 22spyod tshul 9cho ga rnams/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /91wa 333

dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnams/ /mi g.yo mgon por rab bsgoms ①pas / /ye shes mtshungs pa med pa brnyes/ /skyob pa shākya seng ges kyang / /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med 'dis ba/ /bdud sde (na)shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen rnams kyang dpa' bos bcom/ /'jig rten 'dul phyir chos rnams kyi / /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de 'dra kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu khyod blo gros 'di gyis shig /u dum bā ra'i ④me tog ltar/ /brgya 5skulam na ni re pi 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni ⑦mi 'byung ste(she/ /skyob pa 'jig rten mgom po che/ /rnyed dka' ri9 rnyed par gyur na yang / /gsang sngags khoskyob pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /shin tu dka' ste rmad byung phyir/ /sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad pa/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher hunye'ajigs tsalas/ /myur du sgrol ba gsang sngags las/ /sa steng /gegasang sngags nor bu 'dra/ /rga 7nad 'chi 'jigs spong ba dang / /nyes mdzad grogs gcugs mthun ma'adod dang / /mu ge dgra chom 7bral bde dang / /zas skom gos rgyan longs spyod rtaganyurte /bde bskyed 18dpal 'byor thob pa dang / /myur du sangs rgyas 'dod pa yi/rte/ /gsang sngags thabs 2 ril myur brtson bsgrubs 1/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed na par bya/ /sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims snyedang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims 5byugasum/ /deng nas mchog tu brtan 25par bzung 27/ /'gro la lhag pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /bla ma la ni yon phul zhu/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra bla med sku/ /zhi ba sangs rgyas go 'phang thob 2/ /srog gcod rku brdzun /mi tshangs spyod/ /myos byed 'thung ri dī91—334

dang glu gar rol/ /rgyan byug tsho1)mal chen mtho ba dang / /phyi dro kha zas spangs pa du ste/ /brgyad dang bcu gcig bco 5lnga dang / /khyad par du ni gnam stong la / /dal 'byor thob pa shin tu dkon/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa shin tu dkon / /sdom pa blangs canas srog bzhin du/ /g.yeng med bsdams te bsrung bar bya/ /gsum la rtag tu skyabs 5'gro bya/ /lha mi bde ldan lus thob nas / /dmyal ba dud 'gro yi dgas tshiganas/ /thob nas spang 7dka' de dag ni / /nam yang thob par mi bya'o/ /bdag ni dpa' bo ral gri 'chang / /gsang ba'i 'khor lo sbyor byed pas/ /bka' las 'das pa'i gdug can rnams//dum bu phye mar 'gas par 'gyur/ /slob ma gzung phyir thog mar tsho ni/ /bsnyen pas sngags kyi mthu bskyed 9bya/ /longs spyod 'phel phyir gtor ma gtang ⑩/ /bsod nams 'dod phyir mchod pa brtson/ /bla ma thos bsam sgom la gnas/ /gtong phod dul zhing chos spyod mkhas/ /nad med bzod des snying rje che/ /sngags sgrub brtson dpa' 1 shes rab can/ /brtags nas slob ma lnga 'am bdun/ /dad brtson zhi dul bla ma bkur/ /sdig 12'jigs nad med dbang po tshang / /dbyibs 1 sdug snying rjer ldan pa gzung ’ / /'phags 15pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus 17pa'i rgyud las skye bo gzung ba'i thabs kyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rig lha 'dzin pa yi 1 dngos grub che/ /gzhan du med pa phul byung ba/ /rgyud 'dir bshad pa mnyan nyi par byos/ /mi ni rin chen dang po ste dī/ /gang gang bsgrub 21pa de dang de/ /'grub par 'gyur 91wa 335

gyi gzhan du min/ /ral gri lcags sam shing nyid la411/ /sor bzhi pa 'am sor brgyad bya/ /yu bar rigs kyi rgya lnga bri/ /ba yi rnam lnga dri zhim chus/ /bkrus te dri dang me tog mchod/ /zla drug sngags bzlas (nakhro bo sgomakhu ke/ /ral gri dud 'thul ca'od du 'bar/ /blangs pas mkha' spyod yul 'gro 'gyur/ /tshe ni bar gyi bskal pa ste5/ /lha yi bzhon 65pa sna tshogs bcibs/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gser dngul zangs kyi zhags pa 'am/ /shing gi zhags 7pa'ang de ltar 'grub/ /rgyal mtshan nor bu gi'u (87wang gdugs/ /lcags kyu rnams 9kyang de bzhin bsgrub1 / /lha rnams bsgrub shin thang shing la/ /gang 'dod lha yi gzugs byas te/ /sngags bzlas tsam gyis mdun du 'ong / /ci 'dod gsol 'debs 'dod pa smra/ /klu la nā (2ga ge sar shing / /gnod sbyin la ni gser las gzugs/ /dri za la ni 'o (1snyema'i shing / /mkha' lding 'jim 7pa'i gzugs 515kyis so/ /srin po la ni dur khrod shing / /gang yang gzugs byas rkang pa nis/ /g.yon pas de yi ske mnan te/ /sum 'bum bzlas na mdun du 'ong / /ci 'dod smra tshe dgos pa blang nyu / /shar du ras ris kha sprad drung / /dus gsum khrus bya 18gos rlon gyon/ /sum 'bum bzlas na mar ngo yi/ /brgyad la 'byung po gtor ma sbyin/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du ro bzhag nas/ /rang nyid rin chen khri steng du/ /snying po khri brjod ro 'gul 'gyur/ /mi skrag nyurtekha yi nang du lce/ /pad+ma kha phye lte can mthong / /bcad na ral gri 1rig 'dzin 'gyur / /lha yi gzugs kyis tshangs pa yi na/ /'jig rten khams kyi gnas rnams rgyu/ /gi'u na wang bdun bzlas thig les ni/ /skye bo kun gyis mi mthong ngo ske/ /mi g.yo pus mo btsugs pa 'am pa/ /'jam dpal ris ma'i drung du ni/ /91—336

'jam dpal sngags 'di sa ya bzlas1/ /nya la khyad par mchod pa bya / /mtshan rangs ③bzlas pa'i tho rangs nas/ /dang po rtags sa g.yo bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa nyi ma 'gyur ldog byed/ /phyogs bzhir mkha' la sgra chen po/ /ha ha 'brug skad grag ④par 'gyur/ /gsum par mkha' la rig 'dzin rnams/ /me tog char 'bebs chun 'phyang sgreng 5/ /de rjes rig 'dzin ma lus dang / /'jig rten skyong bas rab bskor nas/ /khro rgyal byon nas gsung snyan gyis/ /ci 'dod bu khyed (6)gsung bar 'gyur/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po mi snang sogs/ /ci 'dod par ni smra bar bya/ /'grub nas brgyad gnyis cha byad can/ /rgyan 7bzang (shelag na ral gri thogs9/ /lha yi bzhin 7pa la bcibs nas/ /rig 'dzin tshogs mang lhan cig tu/ /sangs rgyas zhing mang phyin pa'i tshe/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis phyag byas nas/ /mchod pa chen po thob 'gyur te/ /bskal pa du mar tshe gnas 'gyur/ /ut+pal sngon po lig bu mig /ru rta zangs snod ril bu gzhag3lha /zla nyu ba gzas zin par bzlas nas/ /mig bskus 1 'dod pa'i khams gsal 'gyur/ /bdag ni sus kyang mi mthong sango / /gnam lcags rdo rje sor bcu drug /ngos /lhaganyis rtse gsum dbyibs can te/ /tsan+dan dmar dang dri bzangs byugs /cho 'phrul tshes gnyis nya yi bar/ /mchod cing bzlas na tha mar ni/ /mar me brgya sogs 1 kyis mchod de/ /ku sha khres 1 kyi steng 'dug nas / /rdo rje lag gnyis gzung 1rtom thag /dud 'thul 'od du 'bar nas kyang ske/ /'khor bcas rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /'khor los sgyur ba thob par 'gyur / /'khor lo bdun sogs 21mtshon cha dang / /gser 22dang mal na lham tshangs skud sogs/ /dgos pa thams cad de ltar sgrub/ /sngon gyi tshul du 91—337

dngos grub 'byung / /tshes gcig nyin par sku gzugs kyi/ /mthe bor dza 3)ti sngags brjod brdeg /stong phrag brgyad kyis (5)mthe bo duXlas/ /'od zer phyung nas reg ma thag /dbu 4)spa lcang lo 'khyil gyur nas/ /'khor bcas rig 'dzin rgyal po 'thobar/ /sus kyang mi thub lus grub 'gyur/ /tshe ni bskal pa'i bar du gnas/ /sa la pad 96'dab brgyad pa (7)bri/ /bum pa skud tshosapa nag pos dkri / /tsan+dan gyis byugs 9dris kyang dgang / /pad+ma'i steng bzhag bebad steng /lha'adug /stong phrag brgyad bzlas sa gzhi 1gegs/ /pad+mar snang zhing sa gzhir snang ske/ /chu des gtor la khru gang brko lha/ /blangs pas bskal pa'i tshe tshad 'thobs / /grog mkhar sa la seng ge bya/ /gi'u 8wang gis byugs nyu9dkyil 'khor gzhag51 /g.yo 1 'gul bar du mchod cing bzla/she/ /seng ger gyur nas rgyab zhon nas/ /'dod gzugs lha gnas kun du 'gro/ /sangs rgyas zhing yang mthong bar 'gyur/ /tshe lo khri phrag gcig bskor nas/ /rig 'dzin chen po'i gnas su 'gro/ /'dir gsungs 2 ripa 'am ma gsungs pa/ /sngags dang lha 'di bsgrubs 1pa yis/ /rig 'dzin grub par grags pa rnams/ /ma lus thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'i rtog pa bsdus pa las rig 'dzin bsgrub 25pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /phran tshegs las kyi sbyor ba gtso/ /gza' yi cho ga 'di yin te/ /gnod pa sel dang phan skyed du snyemadzad/ /ba yi rnam lngas byugs ri nopa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su pad+ma ni/ /kha dog sna tshogs 2ge nyis brtsegs kyi tsho/ /dbus su sangs rgyas de bzhin tsho lhor/ /chos ni (2rdo rje chos 91—338

dkar po/ /shar du dge 'dun ljang gu'o1/ /nub tu 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar / /byang du phyag na rdo rje ste / /byang shar du ni 'jam dpal ser/ /mer ni gshin rje'i gshed ngo gnag /dbyug 'chang 4ma he zhon pa'o/ /mi g.yo mgon po srin po 5phyogs/ /rta mgrin rlung gi phyogs su'o/ /dkon mchog gsum po chos 'chad rgya/ /sems dpa' khro bo rang rtags so/ /kun kyang rin chen khri la bzhugs/ /de rgyab cha la gza' rnams te / /shar du nyi ma dkar ser ni/ /rta la zhon te pad+ma 'chang / /nub tu zla ba dkar po ni/ /ku mu da 7'chang ngang pa zhon/ /lhor ni mig dmar kha dog dmar/ /ril ba'i steng bzhugs me sgron 85bsnams/ /lag 9pa mdog ser ut+pal 7'chang / /byang du pad steng nyalhabazhugs pa yi512/ /phur bu mdog sngon glegs 12bam thogs/ /shar lho phyogs su klu la bcibs/ /pa wa ngasangs dkar shing thog 'chang / /lho nub gser gyi khri la bzhugs/ /byang shar spen pa mdog nag ni/ /tshangs pa'i steng na dbyug pa thogasabo/ /nub byang sgra gcan 17dud ka ni / /sbrul gyi steng na 'khor lo 'dzin/ /rnon po ljang gu 1phural gri 'chang / /gtso bo'i 19drung du pad steng 2 snabazhugs/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sar+pā pa ri pū 1ra ke bh+yaḥ/sarba thā snye/ oṃ bha gi ṭ+wāṃ na swā hā/ nyi ma'i snying po'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te tshobh+yaḥrka/ sar+pā pa ri pu lhar ke bh+yaḥ sarba thā dzi/ oṃ sarba tra yaṃ a swā hā/ zla ba'i'o / /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sar+pā pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ sarba thā snye/oṃ a bhir+ya dgeya swā hā/ rnon pa'i'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sar+pā pa ri pū du byer ke bh+yaḥ sarba thā ha/ oṃ su bhi 2shud+dha swā hā/ mig dmar gyi'o/ na maḥ(nyasarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sar+pā pa ri pū 5ra ke bh+yaḥ sarba thā phyi/ oṃ bi su tra tsho 91wa 339

pa kā 3)ya swā hā/ gza' lhag rdon gi'o/ /( rin maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sar+pā pa ri pū ra 90ke bh+yaḥ sarba thā 5ra/ oṃ bhi ka mya dhā (nyaya swā hā/ phur bu'i'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sar+pā pa (7༄ri pu nanor ke bh+yaḥ sarba shāthor/ oṃ su dharmār+ṇa bor ho swā hākyi / pa ba 1nasangs kyi'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ sar+pā pa ri pū 1 ra ke bh+yaḥ sarba bas/ oṃ kroṇ+ḍa bar+ṇa 3)pha ka swā hā/ spen pa'i'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sar+pā pa ri pū /lhar ke bh+yaḥ sarba thā/ rme/ oṃ bi kṛ ta la hu3ku ru tsi swā hā/ sgra gcan gyi'o/ /sngags re brgyad stong brgyad brgya bzlas/ /ci 'byor mchod de sasol ba gdab/ /longs 7spyod spel cing )'jigs pa sel/ /nad med bgegs rigs 21'joms par 'gyur/ / rims sogs byo 3gzas zin nad la yang / /sku yi drung du gsol btab sel/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag gang sbyar ba / /de dag thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /mi dang bya rgod sbrul rus pa/ /skabs su btums nas dgra khyim sba/ /dgra bo nad bskyed stenor rnams brlag bu /rtag tu 'thab mo 'byung bar na nges/ /stag spu 25thod rus lug pa'i spu/ /dgra bo'i sgor sbas skyod na par byed/ /ne'u le nag po wa sbal ri 2rus/ /rang khrag rtsangs 9pa'i mgo bo rnams / /gong bu ming bcas dgra sgor sba/ /dgra bo 'khor bcas shi bar 'gyur/ /mi tshil dur thal rgya skyegs ni 1/ /thod pa so can nang blugs nas/ /gang gi sgor bzhag khang pa 'jig /ku ra sha'i gzugs shusnyebarnyan rkang pas mnan/ /dbang sbyar 'dod pa'i sngags bzlas na/ /rgyal po che yang dbang 'gyur na/ /'byung po gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /bud med skyes phyugs gel sogs la/ /rang ming 7ldan pa'i gzugs 8 tshobyas te/ /rkang pa g.yon mnan ming bcas bzla 8/ /gang dang gang yang nges par 'grub/ /sa la 91wa 340

pha rus dug rang 0)skyur(ge/ /gzugs byad nim pa'i mer bsregs na/ /dgra bo gdon chen nad kyis 'debs/ /phag rtug snu ha arga'i (1)shing / /tsher mes ④bsregs 5)na mgo 'khor 'gyur/ /ne'u le byi la byi tsher spu/ /bsregs (6)na bud med ri7)bu brlag 8)'gyur/ /mi dang ne'u le khwa rus pa/ /yungs mar nim pa'i me la bsregs 9ri/ /grong dang grong khyer skyod 7par byed/ /stag spu thod rus 'ug pa'i spu/ /sa ha me tog na le sham/ /nim pa'i lo ma dug bsregs nyunyebyed/ /nim pa'i 'bras bu dug lan tshwa/da/ /dha nyustedur 'bru bsregs nad skyed mibyed/ /dug khrag dha 15dur 'bras bu yis/ /nim pa'i shing la dgra ming bri/ /tsha gsum lan tshwa 〉khrag gis byugs/ / /lcags snod yungs mar nang bzhag nas/ /nim pa'i shing gi sna me yis btso519/ /dgra bo lha dang 'byed par 'gyur/ /mi khyi ( ze bya rgod rus phye dug /ske tshe yungs mar sbrul shun dang / /nim pa'i lnga dang skags lan tshwa/ /tsher mes bsregs rten nad kyis 'debs/ /ske tshe ri 2 dug skegs 22sbrul shun 20tsha ba'i mar/ /gzugs byas tsha ba'i me la gdung / /char ri miches pa dang thog 'bab 7'gyur/ /'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus sa pa'i rgyud las sbyin sreg 28gi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas tshangs pa khyab 'jug sogs/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis / /bzhengs te thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /snyan pas ched du 'di brjod 36do/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /thabs dang shes rab bsam du med/ /thugs rjes gyur pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /mtshungs rte )med rgya che dam chos gsungs/ /dug gi 'jigs pas sa steng 'khrigs 7/ /nyon mongs mun 'jigs med pa yi/ /91—350

bdud rtsi 'od bzang 'dir 19gus na/ /ngan 'gro'i na'ajigs pa stong bar ris)'gyur / /de (snyanas tshangs sogs 'jig rten skyong / /rdzu 'phrul ldan rnams kun 'dus nas/ /ngom tsho zhing ched du brjod pa 'di/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis rab tu gsol / /e ma sangs rgyas che ba'i bdag /sems can kun la sman par dgyesal/ /skyob chen 'jig rten mgon po yi / /mtshungs med bsam gyis mi khyab thabs / /gsungs pa 'di la gang gnas pa/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho sbyong / /'gro la sman mthong bsgrubs pas ni/ /lhag pa'i bde ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /ngo mtshar spyan ni gdangs nas su/ /ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e 87ma sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /gdod nas thugs su 'gro don chud / /rtog med rang bzhin las grol nas/ /bsam 9mi khyab pa'i 1 go 11'phang gsungs/ /'chang byed dang po ngan 'gro gcod/ /gnyis pa mthong chos dngos grub byed/ /de rjes 'jigs 12med nga 12yi med/ /dogs pa spangs na zad par gyithu/ /sa la bzhugs nas sems can don/ /ma bsams thogs pa med par byed/ /gsang sngags rgyal po skyob bokun la/ /sbyangs nas 'dod don kun grub ste/ /nam mkha' chu gser sadag pa ltar/ /bsgom 1 pa bla med yid rgyas byed/ /de nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus pa rnams 'dus nas kyang ske/ /gtso la me tog gtor byas te/ /ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /'gro la phan dang don byed pa'i/ /cho ga'i ming dang shes rab dang / /snying rje'i dbye bas rgyas gyur nas/ /mnar med la sogs ngan 'gro yi/ /'jigs rnams las 91—351

brgal 1pad+ma ltar/ /rnal 'byor can de mdzes par spyod/ /de nas mthu stobs cher tsho ldan pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i khro bo kun 'dus nas/ /shin tu ngom (gyipas snyan tshig gis/ /ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma sangs rgyas chos chen dang ske/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog bsam mi khyab/ /'khor ba'i mun pa chen por ni/ /bying bas blta dka' rtogs pa yis/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bsam mi khyab / /mthong dang thos pa tsam gyis kyang / /blta dka' 'byung po drag po ④rnams / /lhag pa'i sems ni skyes par 'gyur/ /de nas rig pa'i lha mo che/ /spyan la sogs pa rgya chen rnams/ /ngo mtshar gyur nas spyan gdangs te/ /snyan pas ched du 'di brjod do/ /e ma sangs rgyas rmad du byung / /e ma sangs rgyas dpa' bo che/ /e ma sangs rgyas rab tu zab/ /chos rnams skye med 'gag (5)pa med/ /sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs rol ba ltar/ /sgyu ma gdul du bya tshim mdzad pa/ /spros pa dang bral spros pa bral / /sgyu ma rab tu 'phel bar mdzad/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /gdul ba dag la rab gzigs nas/ /'dul mdzad rdo rje 'chang ba la ngo mtshar rmad kyi gsung gis ni/ /ched du brjod pa 'dis bstod 8do/ /oṃ zhes dang po phyag 'tshal bkra shis ster byed pa/ /ser sna rnam par dag nas yo byad dbang thob dang / /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang ni/ /rab dga' ye shes khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal 'dud/ /tsaṇa yig dri bzangs (9ratsan+dan byugs dang ngang tshul mtshungs/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pas tshe la dbang ba dang / /las dang rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang ni/ /dri med ye shes khro rgyal mi g.yo phyag 'tshal lo/ /ḍa yig nyon mongs sgrib pa gtor 91—352

ba'i zhi gnas dang / /bzod tsanopa dag pa skye ba la dbang thob pa dang / /mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa zhes pa'i tsho stobs dang ni/ /'od 'phro ye shes khro bo dbyug sngon phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma yig sgyu 'phrul chen po lhag mthong che ba'i bdag /brtson 'grus dag pas sems la yang dag dbang thob dang / /khams kyi rnam pa sna tshogs lamakhyen pa'i stobs dang ni/ /'od byed 5ye shes gshin rje gshed po phyag 'tshal lo/ /hā yig ma chags shes bya'i sgrib 'phrog sbyangs pa 6che/ /bsam gtan dag pas rdzu 'phrul la ni dbang thob dang / /thams cad dag tu 'gro ba'i lam dag stobs dang ni/ /sbyang dka' ye shes rta mgrin khro bo phyag 'tshal lo/ /ro yig 'khor 'das nad bral shes dag las dbang thob/ /bsam gtan rnam thar ting 'dzin dang ni snyoms zhugs pa'i/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang lta ba kun mkhyen stobs/ /mngon gyur ye shes 'dod pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /ṣa yig mnyam nyid sdom chen dbang phyug chen po rgyal/ /stobs 7chen dag las mos pa la ni dbang thob dang / /sngon gyi gnas rnams rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs / /ring du song ba'i ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyil la na'adud/ /ṇa yig skyes bu chen po sgra chen klu mchog gtso/ /smon lam dag pas 7smon lam che la dbang thob dang / /dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ /mi g.yo ye shes khro bo stobs chen phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ yig hu lu sprin gdengs 'brug 1 sgra gad rgyangs can/ /thabs dag pas ni ye shes che la dbang thob dang / /'chi 'pho dang ni gang zhig skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs/ /legs pa'i blo gros ye shes khro bo hūṃ mdzad 'dud/ /phaṭa sgras bag chags kun gtor dag pas 11shel dang mtshungs / /ye shes dag pas chos la dbang ni thob pa dang / /zag pa thams 91—353

cad yang dag zad pas mkhyen pa'i stobs/ /chos kyi sprin gyi ye shes khro bo gnod mdzes 'dud/ /de nas chos rje thub pas ni/ /ljags kyi dbang po bkram byas nas / /'dzum 1)pa mdzad pas rab gzigs te/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus/ /lag na rdo rje mthu chen la/ /snyan pa'i gsung gis bka' stsal pa//mchog tu brtan par rab bsngags pa/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /mi gang bsod nams dman pa 'am/ /mtshams med la sogs byed pa yang / /rgyud 'dir zhugs pa'i de ma thag /gser 'gyur gyi ni rtsi bzhin du/ /log rtog ma lus dag nas kyang / /rtog med bde ba'i skur byung ste/ /rmi lam bzang po'i sems bzhin du/ /rnam 'phrul sna tshogs cir (gyiyang snang / /mu mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i mtsho/ /brgal dba'i gzings chen bla med 'di/ /chags 4/gsang med pa'i tshul du ni/ /khyod kyis rtag tu gzung bar bya/ /lag na rdo rje stobs po ches/ /ston pa la ni 'di gsol to/ /rgyud 'di phyung ldenom thag tu ni/ /gdul dka' ba ni rab tu zhi/ /sa steng 6rind dang gdon mu ge/ /bar chad gnod pa kun dang bral/ /slar yang bstan ri7pa 'phel ba'i phyir/ /brtan por bdag gis gzung bar bgyi/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro drag po rnams/ /yid kyis brtul zhugs phyung 8༄nas kyang / /rgyud 'di 'dzin pa'i rjes su 'brang / /lha dang 'jig rten pa dang ni/ /ma mo srin ri9rimo tsomakha' 'gro ma/ /sha za gnod sbyin srin mo 17rnams/ /rgyud 'di 'dzin pa rtso skyong bar byed/ /rgyud 'dzin longs cho12spyod spel bar byed/ /ston pas gsungs pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /legs so shin tu cher legs so/ /rgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor can chen de/ /rgyun thudu bsrung ⑫zhing blo 'phel mdzod/ /de skad kyi ni gsung thos nas/ /byang chub sems 91—354

'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'khor de dag thams cad kyis ha ha zhes ca co dang ga zha ①bton (gete/ sgra ring zhes byas nas gos dang / rgyan risna tshogs bskyod de snying nas phyag 'tshal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dbang byed pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan 4ribargya rtsa brgyad pa'i bsngags pa rgya 95skumatsho'i bstod pa yang dag par brjod pa/ nam mkha'i snying po srid gsum sems can mchog /'byor ldan blo gros rin chen rgya mtsho mnga'/ /sems can dag pa bla med rin chen mchog /thar pa'i sa bon 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /kun mkhyen tshul mkhyen legs dang legs min mkhyen/ /thar mkhyen chos mkhyen bde dang mi bde mkhyen/ /lam mkhyen gces (snyomakhyen dge dang mi dge mkhyen/ /dus mkhyen dge mkhyen stobs dang stobs min mkhyen/ /'gro mchog chos mchog sems can yon tan mchog /lam mchog sngags mchog tshul dang tshul min mchog /rgyan mchog chos mchog 'dzin dang 97'dzin min 98mchog /dag (9kemachog rtogs mchog mchog dang mchog min mchog /zhi rab snying rje'i rab ste 'khor gyi rab/ /'od rab thar pa'i rab ste rten 1 gyi rab/ /rgya rab sngags kyi rab ste thugs brtse'i rab/ /mnyam rab sems can rab ste gsum rig rab/ /legs nyanyusgron mchog sgron stobs dang stobs min 12sgron/ /thar sgron rigs sgron rgyal dang rgyal min sgron/ /dge sgron gzi sgron nor bu'i 'od kyi sgron/ /rgyu skar zla ba'i brgyan 1 las shar ba'i sgron/ /mchog 'od yon tan kun gyi 7'od zer 'od/ /legs 'od thar pa'i pho brang rten gyi 'od/ /'od chen gti mug rab tu 'byed pa'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i 'od 'bar bde ba'i 'od 'chang 7ba/ /rdo rje'i dbang po 'dren dbang sems can dbang / /rin chen 91wa 399

'od kyi dkyil 'khor brgyan (1)dbang po/ /rgyal dbang rgyal ba'i stobs rgyun tshad med dbang / /dpa' bo rig na sngags 'chang dbang srid gsum dbang / /rdo rje bzang po rdor 9 ri'od rdo rje 'bar/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'bar bas brgyan ri / /rdo rje 'od can rdor ge)'dzin rdo rje drag /rdo rje rgya chen rdo rje rab mchog dbang / /na bza' sngo zhing sku yi cha lugs sngo/ /sku mdog sngo zhing sngo ba'i 'od kyis brgyan(6 /ral gri (7rdo 'jibs 98)sngo zhing brtan pa tso)bsnams/ /mkha' sngo gzhal med khang 'bar nang na bzhugs/ /lha zhal dri med shin tu mi bzad 'bar/ /rab tu dras la 'od zer 'phro zhing 'gyur⑩/ /sdig sel rdul ltar 'khrug 11byed phreng mchog can/ /glog gi stobs kyi 8snang bas sgeg la brtan lha / /ral gri mtshon thogs dbang ldan mthu stobs mtshon/ /rdo rje'i mtshon thogs mda' dang mdung thung 'jigs/ /'khor lo'i mtshon thogs bcibs sapa ri dang 'khrul/ /gsal shing 1gematshon thogs tshebagegs kyi stobs 'joms pa/ /bde 'byung 'jig rten gsum bdag rdo rje'i dbyug /sku rnams thams cad nyi ma'i 'od kyis brgyan1 / /grags nya pa'i rigs su byung bas ⑩rgyal po mdzad/ /mu tig phreng bas sgeg cing 5 rimadzes par 37bgyis/ /sku mdzes brnyes shing phun sum tshogs 22pa brnyes/ /rab 'byam ( snyemachog brnyes bus la 'jug pa brnyes/ /mthu stobs lhag gepa brnyes shing grub brnyes 3stel/ /rig ④pa gsum gyi stobs brnyes mthu brnyes pa/ /bde 'dren zhi ba 'dren cing 'od 'dren pa/ /cha lugs nashegasal mchog dar ba chen po 'dren/ /byams tshi'adren nyi ma 'dren cing skye dgu rdo ci'adren/ /legs ra 'dren zhing gi stobs 8'dren snying rje can/ /dri med cha lugs rigasal ba cha lugs 59'bar/ /rnam grags sgeg tso91wa 400

pas grags ①pa'i ba dan can/ /'gro ba'i skabs ri 'byed 'jug dang ldog pa mkhyen / /longs ④spyod gsal bar ston (4)pa'i sems kyis 'jug /sku dmar (5sku mthon sku mdzes sku bzang ba/ /sku ser sku dkar dar ba chen po'i (6)sku/ /sku rol rdo rje'i sku mnga' spyan legs sku/ /rigs 7sku rig sngags 'chang ba na rin chen bsnams/ /gtsug gi nor bu gtsug can cod pan mchog /cod pan can te chos 'dzin rdo rje mchog /dpal 'dzin rin chen dam pa 'chang ba'i mchog /sngags gzhi yi)phyag rgya 'chang ba phun sum tshogs/ /rab mdzes mkha' la gshegs shing rab tu rgyu/ /srid gsum nyi ma gcig pu 'od stong mnga'/ /ri rtse 1 sna'achar ba bdal legs bkra shis pa/ /yon tan mthu stobs khyad 11par rnam par gragasatso / /nor bu chen po nor sdug nor bu'i 'od/ /nyi ma'i nor bu tshul spyod nor bu 'bar/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'gro kun mgon gcig pu/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na nor bu gcig snang ba/ /sems can rnam dag yangs shing rnam par gragasanyunye / /srid gsum srung 0ma gcig pu rgyal sras mchog /zhi ba rab tu zhi ba skyabs 'os rtags /skye dgu'i /nyabadag po pad byung 1 pad+ma skyes/ /kun nas 'od bzang legs nyusnyebashad chos mnga' ba/ /dar ba legs bshad rab dul 19legs bshad phyag /blo bzang 'od bzang bde ldan skye gnas bzang / /mkhas rab zhi rab mchog gi chos dang ldan/ /zhi mdzad rgyal 'byung bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'od kyi 'byung gnas bde mdzad dbang du mdzad/ /legs 'byung shes rab 'byung gnas stobs bskyed ༷ — )pa/ /snying rje'i 'byung gnas blo bzang rnam grags lkumadzad / /rnam grol nges grol shin tu grol ba'i blo/ /blo yangs rnam par tsho 2bkram zhing rnam par grags tso/ /kun tu longs spyod sgo ste blo yi mchog /blo gros 91wa 401

brtan pa dkon mchog gsum las bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'dab ①rgyas 'dra ba'i zhal/ /dag cing spyan yangs cha lugs yid du 'thad/ /snying po gsal ba'i snying po brtan zhing dul/ /ngo bo nyid kyis (gergyun brnyes charab gsal bske/ /spyan zur mnga' ni rab tu gtang legs 0pa/ / 'jigs med (gezhal ras ston gyi zla ba 'dra/ /mdung thung brgya yi 6mtshon mchog mtshon cha rdzogs/ /drag po 'jigs pa sdig sel gsum las skyes/ /rab dul mkhas pa 'grogs (7)dga' 'dris par nasla/ /rab tu drag pa gnyen rab gser mdog can/ /lha chen bde byed gsal shing phyag ma bsnams/ /spyan gsum rig pa gsum ldan me gsum sel/ / 'dod bzang 95me tog mtshon thogs me tog mda'/ /na bza' bzang mnabs 1 cigayas 'phen tshabs cher 'phen/ /legs bris nyamasna tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs mnga'/ /na bza' sna tshogs sna tshogs rgyan 3)gyi dpal/ /zhal ras zla ba 'od zer rgyas pa 'dra/ /zhal mdangs bstan pas 'jig rten kun 'byor 12mdzad/ /bzhad 7pa nyi ma'i 'od zer rab 'jebs skomanga'/ /zhal mdangs rgya mtsho gsal mdzad lam me ba/ /dbang chen rdo rje'i thog lags tshe'ajigs 17pa'i sgra/ /rdo rje drag po nor bu g.yo ba 'dzin/ /sgra brnyan 41 snang bar mdzad pa'i mthu dang ldan/ /blo gros chen po blo gros rno nyu7ba'i mchog /rgyan py-i —3 'dzin dpal 'dzin rin chen zhal dang ldan/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro ba kun gyi gnas / /de bzhin gshegs pa mgon sras phreng ba bzang / /stobs chen 'jig rten blo gros ngo bo nyid/ /skye dgu'i 7bdag po bka' lung mnyam zhing brtags/ /mi yi mnga' bdag mtho ris bskyed napa'i rgyu/ /sgyu 'dra 'dod pa'i mda' dang rdo rje can/ /mthu stobs mnga' zhing spyan bzang sdug par ldan/ /ston pa 91—402

bzang po stong ①nyid lam gyi stegs/ /gces gsum 'phel ba'i rgyu la 'jug pa mdzad / /brtan po rgyu la rab tu nanges gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa kun gyi slob dpon lags/ /gcig pu skye dgu'i cidakyil 'khor cho ga mkhyen/ /rnam par snang mdzad zhing gi gnas nas skyes/ /dbang bskur brnyes 4shing sa bcur legs par gnas/ /gnas chen son pa mchog gnas gcig pu lags/ /skye dgu tshogernams kyi nyon mongs sel ba dang / /sdig 'joms mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di thos nas/ /bde gshegs sras mchog su zhig 'don byed pa/ /'jig rten zla ba gcig shar bzhin du snang / /nam mkha'i snying po sems can gcig pu yi/ /mdun 'dug nang par bstod pa 'di brjod gang 6/ /de ni srid gsum sems can mchog 'gyur zhing / /dri ma'i gnas kun las kyang thar bar 'gyur/ /g.yul dang 'thab rtsod shin tu mi bzad dang / /mu ge'i gnod pa mi nad byung ba na / /mkhas pa su zhig sngar langs dad bskyed 97nonas/ /nam mkha'i snying po la ni bstod byed pa/ /de ni 'jigs pa'i 'byung gnas thams cad dang / /sdug bsngal 'byung 'dren sdig pa rnams las grol/ /de 8ni zhi mchog mchog bde kun gnas dang / /bde ba rgya chen nges par thob par 'gyur/ /bde 'thob longs 79rispyod 'phel bar bya ba 'am/ /rgyal srid 'thob dang byad 1 gzugs nor 'thob dang ske/ /rigs huma'athob yon tan kun gyi gzhi bsgrub 12phyir/ / bton na 1 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom skemed/ /de phyir ji 15ste rtag tu 'dod bde kun/ /'dod na 'gro ba kun la gcig dpa' ba/ /nam mkha'i snying po srid gsum mgon po la/ /rtag tu bsten 7cing sngags kyang bsten 1 par bgyi/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 91—403

༄ga /'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 1ri༄tshog / rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sa man+ta bha dra astot+ta ra sha ta ka nā ma dhā ra tī man+t+ra sa hi ta/ bod skad du//ge 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa (87kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu 9 skurab 'byam ris)ma lus pa dang mnyam pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi chos kyi snang ba gsal ba brnyes pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor kun tu 'phros pa'i sku tha dad pa med cing dus gsum gyi sku mnyam pa nyid brnyes pa/ gzugs sna tshogs can byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mchog dang / rab mchog dam pa sbyin pa / yon tan chen po'i sku sa kun tu mnga' mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mchog kun tu bzang po gzugs sna tshogs can/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin rab 91wa 407

'byam tshosa'i dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po snyoms par zhugs ma thag pa de'i tshe stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra rab kyi (0rdul snyed kyi sku rab 'byam /kun tu yongs su 4rgyas par gyur te/ nam mkha'i khams kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i sku rnams sa'i dkyil 'khor du ma dag tu kun nas 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byam 5)thams cad kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' 6chen po kun tu bzang po'i mgo bo la byugs nas 9)bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad kyi snying po gzungs chen mo /shod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' tsochen po'i mchog lus 'od zer 'bum gyis snang bar byas pa 0de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad g.yo bar byas nas gzungs 'di bshad do/ /tabya thā/ oṃ na mo na ma s+t+ri bhu ba ne 11shwa re/ ma hā bho gā ya/ a sa ma sa mtshe/ a mi 0ta sa ma/ a skonan+ta sa ma/ ga ga na sa ma/ tri bhu ba na sa ma/ a she ṣa sa ma/ be ṣa sa ma/pa ra ma at+pa 15sa ma/ swa bhā 17ba sa ma/ ta thā r+sha 7tā sa ma/ a ra dzaḥ8sa ma/ shud dhi 17sa ma/ bud dhi sa ma/ dharma na )ta thā tā sa mdu nye/ a bhi ṣa ma dunas ma/sa ma sa ma/ e kā rinā ya/ sā ga ra/ bi shudhe( ste/ ā 5 gelo ka / tī tī/las las 3/ bi dza ya bi dza 2 ya/ oṃ pra sa ga ta/ na ya na ya/ hi rdzu nyenir a dhiṣ+ṭha 29na/ saṃ bho ga /yaṃ a na la ya la ya/ dharma du )a gra/ dha ra dha ra/ dza ya dza ya/ hūṃ hūṃ/ dha ma dha ma swā hā/ de nas rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo 'jig rten thams cad kyi mgon po gcig pu sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod 91—408

por zhugs pa yin te/ khyod tshe brjes 1)nas sa chen po tshon thob par 'gyur ro zhes kyang gsung ngo / /de nas lus bde ba dang / sems bde ba dang / dga' ba chen po dang / dang ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba chen po dang ldan bzhin du sad par 'gyur ro/ /mthu che ba (na/dang / dbang che bar grags par yang 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyang de la blta ba'i phyir 'ong ngo / /nang par langs nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yang dag par bsdus pa'i mdo sde rnams bklag 94par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la yang (5)phan pa dang bde ba'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas pha rol tu phyin skyopa thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing sdig pa thams cad dang bral te/ nyon mongs pa'i phyogs rnams bcom lame)/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang bsngags (kyepar 'gyur ro/ /lha la sogs 99pa yang de la bsrung 7ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i phyir brtson par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ji skad bstan pa bzhin du byed pa'i rgyal ba'i sras de ni ring po mi thogs par kun tu bzang po'i sa chen po la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje 37gtsug phud la sogs pa stong gsum gyi bdag po rig 32sngags 'chang chen po rnams dang ske/ spyan chen mo 32la sogs pa rig sngags 'chang chen mo rnams dang / rdo rje snying po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' nya richen po rnams dang /rdo rje 8zhags pa la sogs pa rig sngags kyi lha chen po tshernams dang / rin chen dra ba can la sogs pa rig sngags kyi lha mo chen mo rnams dang / lha mo sgrol ma la sogs tsu 7pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang /dar chen dang / gzugs bzang dang / shin tu blta nyusten sdug pa la sogs pa gzhon nu rnams dang / gzhon nu ma rnams dang /519 bran rnams dang / bran 31wa 411

thams cad gzigs/ /sa rnams kun gyi bdag dang ldananya/ /sems can kun gyi mchog tu gyur/ /sems can kun gyis phyag bgyis pa/ /ngan 'gro kun dang de bzhin du/ /mu stegs can rnams thams cad 'joms/ /phas kyi na rgol ba tshar gcod pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge mi yi mchog /dul zhing nyon mongs 0rnams dang bral5/ /sgrib pa dri ma kun mi mnga'/ /sems can thams cad yongs su skyob / /grol zhing 'jig rten grol mdzad pa/ /ral pa mun dza brtul zhugs can / /tshangs pa tshangs pa'i gnas na bzhugs/ /bgrang nor thogs shing phyag mkhar 6bsnams/ /dag cing dag la 7rnams dang ldan/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs can mnga' dbang /mdzad/ /pad+ma las 'khrungs pad+ma'i spyan9no/ /pad+ma'i ze ba'i kha dog 'dra/ /bzhugs pa'i gdan khri pad+ma lags/ /gtsang ma ut+pal sngon po bsnams / /bsam dag zhi ba'i thugs dang ldan/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /khyod ni dang po'i sangs rgyas lags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing mnga' dbang brnyes/ /bden pa bzhi khodag ston pa po/ /'jig rten skyong ba spyan (lhastong mnga'/ /khyod ni dbang phyug skye dgu'i 12bdag /khyod ni zhi ba'i sems can rnams/ /kun gyi mnga' bdag yon tan gtso/ /khyod ni khyu mchog skye dgu'i dgatso/ /thu 'bo de bzhin tshe rabs dgongs15/ /rnam par 'dren dang 'dul mdzad pa/ /rgyal sras rgyal ba nyid las 'khrungs/ /'od zer stong ldan nyi ma khyod/ /zla ba dang ni phur bu'ang khyod/ /rnam thos bu dang chu lha'ang lagasal / /dbang phyug che khyod khyab 'jug khyod/ / klu yi 1 rgyal po mtha' yas khyod / /de bzhin sde dpon skems 1 byed lags/ /lha min dbang po thags zangs 19ris/ /mig dmar gza' lag pa ba sangs/ /spen pa dpa' bo lha 91wa 458

kun lags/ /lha rnams kun gyis phyag bgyis pa/ /'jig rten chos kyi dri ma bral / /khyod ni 'jig rten gang zag mchog /'jig rten mkhyen pa 'jig rten rig /ye shes can gyi dam mchog pa/ /dam pa sbyin dang gnas dang skyabs/ /bdud kyi las kyis yongs ①mi rdzi(ge/ /kha na ma tho mi mnga' zab/ /dge ba'i bshes /sheganyen kun tu grags/ /khyod ni sman pa zug rngu 'byin/ /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur pa ba'i mchog /blo gros ldan zhing rtogs dang ldan/ /blo dang ldan zhing mkhas pa lags/ /khyod ni bsod nams dpag bsam shing / /byang chub yan lag me tog brgyan75ra/ /rnam grol 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /lus can kun gyi mchog tu gyur/ /yid du 'ong zhing yid 'phrog pa/ /sdig pa mi mnga' tshangs par spyod/ /khyod ni mjug rings 6tshogaza' mchog lags/ /khyod ni drang srong thub pa mchog /khyod ni rgyal tshab dbang bskur ba/ /sa bcu'i mnga' bdag 7gtso bo lags/ /ded dpon 'gro ba rnams kyi gtso/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ston bzhin/ /khyod ni nam mkha' sa chu bzhin/ /khyod ni me dang rlung lta bu/ /khyod ni yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /sems can re ba kun rdzogs mdzad/ /'byung po kun gyis phyag bgyis pa/ /rin chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo 'jam dpal gyis ni bka' stsal pa/ /oṃ bā kye 8do na maḥ9ga hā/ /ji skad smos pa'i mtshan rnams dang / /rig nya )sngags bcas par 'dzin na ni/ /sdig 'gyur 11rnam dag rab tu thob/ /brgya las rtsa brgyad lhag pa'i mtshan/ /skyes bu dus gsum su klog pa/ /de 'dod bsam dgu 12yid bzhin du/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /bzang po'i mtshan rnams dran na ni/ /mtshams 15med skal thub mnyam pa yi/ /las rnams bomi bzad lagang byas pa/ /de dag thams 91wa 459

nas 6)zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen snying po zla ba snang ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rin chen snying po zla ba snang ba khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / ngas dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen snying po zla ba snang bas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig dkyil 'khor brgyad pa bgyid par 'tshal na des naji ltar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod skye bo mang po la shin tu phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / dus gsum du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes sgrub mo pa'i phyir rigs kyi bu khyod spobs pa skyes pa ni bzang ste/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir snying po gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba byang chub tshogasems dpa' brgyad kyi snying po nyon cig /oṃ ma hā hūṃ (6sam hā bī ra swā hā/ snying po 'dis 7ni dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das mchod do/ /oṃ hrī hūṃ 8pad+ma pri 9ya swā hā/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'o/ /oṃ mi hā rā1 ṇa swā hā/ byams pa'i snying po'o / /oṃ ā kā sha gaṅgā nya1ya swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po'i snying po'o12 o 1rtaswā lihri rā tshe ya dz+wa mig hā/ kun tu bzang po'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ku ru bhan 1 ra ha 91—467

༄ji /bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄7na /rgya gar skad du/ a mṛ tsho /ta bha ba nā ma dhā ra tsā/ bod skad du/bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab byang chub kyi shing drung na/ 'khor rnam bzhi dang / lha dang / mi rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs so/ /de nas 'khor rnams kyi nang nas khyim bdag bzang skyong gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rnam du pa bzhi dang / rigs nidrug gi sems can thams cad la/ /spos dang /sman dang / zhal zas kyi mchod pa chen po bshams nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang /btung ba 'di rnams sems can rnams kyi don du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 91—471

snyoms par zhugs te/ zhal zas kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ro dkar po la chos thams cad rdul dang bral ba'o zhes bya ba'i sgra byung bas zhal zas kyi dri ma dag par gyur to/ /yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po bsams te/ zhal zas lha'i bdud rtsi dang / yo byad du gyur to/ /yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ zhes pas 'phags pa dang sems can thams cad mnyes shing tshim par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag rdo rje ltar byas te gzungs 'di gzungs 1so/ /oṃ sarba dharma tā ②badz+ra sid+dha ①rgyu/ oṃ a mṛ cata hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te pad+mo 'bi shwa medamu khe (8tabh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+pa te ⑨s+pha ra ṇa i yaṃ 1 ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru sgu 1 ru dzā 12la tiṣ+ṭha sidha lo tsa ni sarba arba sā hu dha ne 8swā hā/zhes gzungs 'di brjod ma thag tu mchod pa'i zhal zas kyis mchod nas/'phags pa thams cad mnyes pa dang / sems can thams cad bde bar gyur to / /de nas khyim bdag bzang skyong gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dkyi mthu dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam ⑩par dag pa'i byin gyis brlabs 7kyi mthu dang / bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis/'phags pa thams cad kyi pho brang dang / sems can thams cad kyi /7༄gnas dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud /rtel chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod dpag tu med cing brjod kyis mi khyab pa/ brjod kyis tsho )mi rdzogs pa 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang /dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags dang / phyag 91wa 472
