༄ga /mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba/1༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā sa mā dza sru 2hra na nā ma ma hā sru tra /bod skad du/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams kyi ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal na/ dge slong lnga brgya thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa / khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig (47tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun la mya ngan las 'das pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi gtam ston par mdzad de / de'i tshe na phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag nas/ dbang che bar grags pa dbang che bar grags pa'i lha dag lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das 91—511

dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen 1bkur byed do/ /de nas tshangs ris kyi 9gelha tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gnas pa bzhi zhig 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni shākya rnams kyi ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal na/ dge slong lnga brgya thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par rikun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig 4tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun la mya ngan las 'das pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi gtam ston par mdzad de/ de'i tshe na phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag 5rinas dbang che bar grags pa dbang che bar grags pa'i lha dag lhags (yinas bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed kyis bdag cag kyang song la/ bcom ldan 'das la re re nas tshigs su bcad pas mngon par bstod par bya ba 7rigor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas tshangs ris kyi lha bzhi po dag 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas lag pa bskum pa las brkyang ba'am/ brkyang ba las bskum pa tsam gyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas mi snang bar gyur cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags te phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ tshangs ris kyi lha gcig gis tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/'dus pa che la gzhol ba yi/ /lha tshogs kun nas lhags gyur pas/ /gzhan gyis mi thub dge 'dun la/ /blta ba'i slad du bdag cag mchis/ /tshangs ris kyi lha gnyis pas tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ drang por gyur pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di na dge sbyong nanorab brtson pa/ /kha lo pa ltar mig blangs shing / /91—512

dbang po rnams ni legs sdom 0)bgyid/ /tshangs ris kyi lha gsum pas tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ dbang phur 'od pa 'obs 'dra na ba'i/ /phur bu rab bcom bkrir ②mi tshugs/ /de dag sred bral dag spyod cing / /'dren pas glang po gzhon ltar btul④/ /tshangs ris kyi lha bzhi pas tshigs su bcad de gsol pa / gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs mchi ba/ /de dag ngan 'gror mi mchi zhing / /mi lus spangs par gyur nas kyang / / lha yi 5)lus ni thob par 'gyur/ /tshangs ris kyi lha bzhi po dag gis de skad ces gsol nas de nyid na bag bcum ste 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i 'khor thams cad la rnam par gzigs nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag kye ma lha rnams kyi 'dus pa 'di ni 6)che ba yin no/ /dge slong dag kye ma lha rnams kyi 'dus pa 'di ni shin tu che ba yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa'i dus na byung bar gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la yang 'di lta ste/ dper na da ltar nga'i lha rnams kyi 'dus pa chen po 'di kho na lta bu dag 'dus par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la yang 'di lta ste/ dper na da ltar nga'i lha rnams kyi 'dus pa chen po 'di kho na lta bu dag 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag lha rnams kyi ming dag brjod par byas/ lha rnams kyi ming dag zung 77shig /gang dag sa la gnas pa dang / /gang dag ri khrod gnas pa rnams/ /seng ge bzhin du tha dad la/ /sems bsdus mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /kun nas 'dus par gyur pa ni/ /spu 91—513

dag zing zhes byed pa yin/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa dang / /gang dag ri khrod gnas pa rnams/ /seng ge bzhin du tha dad la/ /sems bsdus mnyam par bzhag 1byas shing / /kun nas 'dus gyur spu zing zhes/ /byed pa bdag ②gis brjod par bya/ /yid byad dadag cing rab dang la/ /rtog med 'chi bdag spangs pa rnams/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mthar thug pa'i/ /lha dang mi yi bar na 'khod/ /slob ma lnga brgya phrag gnyis dang / /gzhan yang brgya dang bcu dag dang / /stong phrag du ma rnams dag gi/ /lha rnams 'dus par gyur pa dag /mtha' nas mtha' ma mi mthong zhing / /phyogs rnams thams cad khyab gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni de mkhyen nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnam gzigs te/ /de nas ston pas bstan dga' ba'i/ /nyan thos rnams la dge slong dag /lha tshogs mngon par lhags gyur kyis/ /nges par rtogs zhes 53ribaka' stsal pa/ /tshigs su bcad pas mthar chags kyis/ /de dag rnams kyi ming brjod kyis/ /rtse gcig gyur pa'i yid kyis ni/ /nga yis bshad (6nyepa mnyan par gyis / /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal gyi/ /gnod sbyin stong phrag bdun po dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang //gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gser can stong phrag drug po kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 91—514

'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal 51du mngon par zhugs/ /shar phyogs rnam rgyal tshal gyi ni/ /ri mnyam stong phrag gsum po dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal rinadu mngon par zhugs/ /de ltar stong phrag bcu drug kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag ri /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni//snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi ca'akhor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal (snyedu mngon par zhugs/ /gnod sbyin chu srin rgyal po'i khab/ /yangs pa la ni rtag gnas shing / /brgya stong phrag ni mang po yi/ /gnod sbyin bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /kun gyi bshes 96gnyen lnga brgya dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po kun gyi lha/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de gnyis kyang ni 'dus par lhags / /rdzu 'phrul 7ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /shar phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan 91wa 515

pa ni/ /dri za'i bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bya/ /de ni (1)nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag (bde yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de / /brgyad cu na dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun ④gags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bya 5)stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed (6)par/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub par/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal tsodu mngon par zhugs/ /lho phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /grul bum bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bgyi / /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis 8rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de/ /brgyad cu 9nodang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun 7grags pa ni / /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i 91wa 516

tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /nub phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de/ /brgyad cu 3)dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun nagrags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par / /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /byang phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni lus ngan po zhes bya/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu ( dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan bzhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha 95)dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de/ /brgyad cu 96)dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun rtsigrags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang ske/ /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan//31—517

kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar byed/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de dag gi ni khol po rnams/ /mchod rten mang la gnas bcas pal/ /slu byed g.yon can sgyu ma can3/ /sgyu ma shes dang rnam risashes dang / /ngan spong khro gnyer lhan cig tu/ /de tshe rdzu 'phrul ston cing lhags/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gnod sbyin dang —/ gnod sbyin chen po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon dang / dmag dpon 'di dag kyang der kun nas lhags sate / 'di lta ste/ dbang po zla ba chu lha dang / /bha ra dwa dza skye dgu'i bdag /dbang ldan tsan+dan 'dod gtso dang —/ /mgrin ngan dang ni mgul nges dang / /stobs 55naldan nor bu nor spyod dang ske/ /sgra rab dang ni nye rnga 6dang / /ri mnyam gser can gang po dang / /seng ldeng ba 7dang g.yon can dang / /gnod sbyin ba skyong 'brog gnas dang / /rgyal ba'i /khyu mchog mi rgyal po/ /dri za sna tshogs sde 9dang ni/ /lcags mdung lku91—518

ring dang ma ldan dang / /tshigs lnga ser po yid dga' dang / /gnod sbyin ring po 'khor dang bcas/ /'bras bu gsum dang mgul gsum pa1/ /'gro gnas ji snyed yod pa yin/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lhan cig 'byung ba'i klu dang ni/ /'jog po dang ni yangs pa'ang 'ongs/ /la ba dang ni mgyogs mchog dag /srung byed 'gro dang lhan cig lhags/ /klu bdag bran bzang bu dang ni/ /yul 'khor srung dang glang po che/ /'jigs byed che dang sa srung bu/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i klu yang 'ongs / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gang zhig klu rgyal zil mnan len/ /stobs ldan mig rnon 'dab chags bya/ /de ming 'dab tsho bzang khra tsho ribo yang / /mkha' las tshal du mngon par 'ongs/ /de tshe klu rgyal mi 'jigs byin/ /ston pas 'dab cibazang bde mdzad cing / /gsung 'jam brjod pa de nyid la/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su nye bar song / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dag ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lag na rdo rjes pham byas shing / /rgya ma/tshor rten 5pa'i lha min rnams / /thams cad nor lhas skrag 'gyur cing / /mtsho la skyabs su 'du shes 31wa 519

pa / /thags bzangs 1ris dang rab bkra dang / /rab sim byed dang btang bzung nadang / /stobs ldan bu ni brgyad po kun/ /rnam snang byed pa'i bu rnams dang / /stobs ldan sde dang sgra gcan bzang / /dpa' chen khyod kyi dus lags 4shes/ /dge slong 'dus pa'i nags tshal du/ /go cha bgos (de)te lhags pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams 6la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal (7du mngon par zhugs/ /chu lha mo dang bu mo dang / /zla ba mo yang phyi bzhin 'ongs/ /mdza' bshes ma dang chu lha can/ /lha mo grags ldan nyid kyang 'ongs/ /sa dang chu dang rlung gi dang / /me yi lha mo'ang 'ongs gyur te/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ⑧ni / /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /khyab 'jug lha dang gshol can lha/ /mtshe 9rim gnyis kyang lhags par gyur/ /zla la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /zla ba nyid ni mdun du bdar/ /nyi la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /nyi ma nyid kyang mdun bdar cing / /char pa 'bebs par byed pa dag /rgyu skar rnams kyis mdun bdar lags/ /thams cad bzang po rdo rje can/ /brgya byin khyer 'jig 'ongs gyur te/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /91—520

gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lha mo tshogs can ma dang ni/ /me lce'i rtse 'dra 'chi ltas can/ /zhi ba mo dang dka' zlog stim/ /me tog gos can 'ongs 5gyur cing / /rgyu ba mo dang mtshan mchings bzang / /'chi med rnam pa du ma dang / /gang zhig phyogs su char 'bebs pa/ /'dod lha'i dbyangs can ma yang 'ongs/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni / /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /la dog ldan zhing drag (2)ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /sngo bsangs sngo bsangs chen mo dang / /mi 'dra mi 'dra dam pa dang / /rtsed mos myos dang de bzhin du/ /yid rab 'khrug ma'ang (ge'ongs gyur cing / /phag mo phag mo chen mo dang / /slong ma nges ma lhan cig lhags/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang ske/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dkar mo rgyags byed snying rje dang / /gos sngon mo yang 'ongs gyur cing / /spa dkar mo la 5sogs pa dang / /gos ser mo yang 'ongs par 91wa 521

gyur / /'phrog ma rtag tu myos pa dang / /spel ma rnam 51)pa du ma dang / /dag pa dang ni 'od can ma/ /lha mo grags ldan rnams kyang lhags/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /bde byed dga' ldan 'thab bral dang / /nag po nabatab pa du ma dang / /lum bi ni dang lum bi mchog /skar ma zhes bya legs smon dang / /'phrul dga' rnams dang de bzhin du/ /dbang sgyur 4rnams kyang lhags par gyur/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni / /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lha tshogs drug cu (5de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong dag gi/ /tshangs pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /kun 'ged 6gzhon nu skar rgyal de / /so sor dbang sgyur she91—522

dbang phyug bcu/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa de dag dang / /lhan cig 'grogs te der lhags pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon 1par zhugs/ /dbang sgyur (5)byed pa'i 'phrog ma mo/ /kha dog gzugs mchog ldan pa yang / /bu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing / /de dag rnams kyi phyi bzhin 'ongs/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams / /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dbang por bcas dang dbang ldan bcas/ /skye dgu'i bdag dang bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams de dag der lhags shing / /dge slong rnams kyang der lhags so/ /nag pos smras pa'i tshig la ltos/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'di bzung shel/ /bcing ba gyis dang khyod la legs / /'di dag kun nas yongs bsdus la/ /'di dag gson por ma btang tsho zhes/ /de na nag po sde bo che/ /sde rnams la ni skul byed cing 6/ /khros shing rang dbang med gyur nas/ /rang yang mngon par zhugs gyur te/ /lag pa sa la brdabs nas ni/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i sgra phyung ste/ /de nas lha yis sprin phreng dang / /glog 7dang bcas pa'i char yang phab/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni de mkhyen nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnam nacigazigs te/ /de nas ston pas bstan dga' ba'i/ /nyan thos rnams la dge slong dag /bdud sde mngon par lhags gyur gyis/ /mngon par rtogs zhes 'obaka' stsal pa/ /brtson par byed pa de dag gis/ /sangs rgyas 91—523

gsungs pa thos nas ni/ /de dag spu yang mi g.yo bas/ /de dag chags bral yin par rtogs/ /rgyal sras nyan thos de dag ni/ /slob ma rnams dang lhan cig dga'/ /de dag g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /'jigs bral grags dang ldan pa yin/ /bar gyi sdom ni/ bdun stong gser can ri mnyam dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin chu srin dang / /kun gyi bshes 1dang rgyal po rnams/ /de bzhin khol po gnod sbyin dang / /klu dang 'dab na bzang lha min dang / /chu lha mo dang khyab 'jug dang / /tshogs can ma dang sngo bsangs ribadang / /dkar mo bde byed dbang phyug dang / /kun 'ged rigazhon dang 'phrog ma dang / /dbang bcas bdud dang dge slong ngo / /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha shin tu dbang che bar grags pa rnams mdo sde bstan pas yi 5rangs par gyur nas de'i tshe tshig 'di dag gis 'dus pa chen po'i mdo bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang tshig 'di dag gis mdo sde 'di yang dag par bsnyad par bgyi zhing yang dag par brjod par bgyi lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag du skulags so/ /tabya thā/ te dze 7te dza ba ti/ tsi tre tsi 58)tra ba ti/ la te la ta ba ti/ kha me kha ma ba ti/ k+ṣe 9me k+ṣa ma ba ti/ bha dre ⑩bha dra ba ti/ ya she ya sha ba ti/ dru te dru ta ba ti/ tsa 11pa le tsa pa la ba ti/ kha tse kha tsa ba ti/bcom ldan 'das 'di dag ni gnas gtsang ma pa rnams kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig mdo sde 'di dang nyuge/ gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag rmongs 1 pa ma mchis par 'dzin par bgyid na/ de 7ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'byung po thams cad las bsrung ba 7bgyis par 'gyur lags so/ /'byung po thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la bro 91—524

nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur lags so/ /gang du klog pa der dge bar 'gyur zhing de dag la dgung lo bdun du bsrung ba bgyis par yang 'gyur lags so/ /ji tsam 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de tsam gyis dgung char 'bab 1par yang 'gyur/ 'chad par yang 'gyur/ dgung ser 'beb dpar yang 'gyur/'chad par yang 'gyur lags so/ /bro nad thams cad la byab par bgyis sam/chab la bzlas brjod bgyis te stsal 4na/ des de'i bro nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gnas gtsang ma pa dag ma gtogs pa gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i ris gong ma rnams kyi rig sngags kyang 'di dag lags la/ gsang sngags kyi tshig (5)zhib mo yang 'di dag lags so/ /'di ni 'dir mdo sde yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa lags so/ /tabya thā/ bha le bha la ma le/ du ra du le/ nyi me/phu 6)ba pi ⑦se/ kā tsāk+ṣi ku tse si/ ma sī ṇi nage re tho ra 69/ bam pi skabam po /nyaṭi ste ke(snye/ ta ra ke/ gu ru ga ro she1lha/ gu ga gu mi ting/ tā re rak+ṣa/sru tra ma nu pā la ya ba'i/ 'di ni bdag cag gi rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib tshamo lags te/ gang la la zhig mdo sde 'di dang gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dum bur ma gyur par 'dzin tam/ klog par bgyid na de la mi dang / mi ma lags pa dag mchi bar mi 'gyur zhing gdug pa yang mi mchi/ sbrul yang mi mchi /dug kyang mi mchi la(8/ de'i lus la gnod pa dag 19gis mi tshugs par 'gyur lags so/ /'byung po 3 )thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur 'a/gas so/ /ji srid 'tsho'i py-i lhabar du 'byung po thams 2cad las bsrung ba bgyis par yang 'gyur lags so/ /gang klog par bgyid pa dang / gang nyan par bgyid pa de la 91—525

༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bisna 2bi nā /ya kā ra tā dhā ra tsā tsho/bod skad du/ 'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i gzungs/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze 5ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ 6dga' bo tshogs kyi bdag po su gang tshogs kyi tshomarabadag po'i snying po 'dzin pa des cho ga thams cad dang dgongs pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /tar+ya thā/ na mo stu te/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/da ra da ra/ ḍa ha ḍa ha/ groṇ+ḍa/ bhañja bhañja na/ na mo stu te/ ru ru tsa tsa ye swā hā/ a bhu tā/ bi na duḥkhan man tsed+dha 9pa ra sa ma gats+tsha 7ti/ ha ha ya/ma hā ha stik+ṣa mata nan/ pra go ba ye mo/ /ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu 91—547

༄ga /mdo chen po kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/1tsho༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ā ṭā nā ṭī ya ma nasru tsha ltu canā ma ma hā tshor sru tra /bod skad du/ mdo chen po kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tsho7tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun (8)pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig tsho'orin/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu kha dog 'phags pa/ g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin du ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin brgya phrag du ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin stong phrag du ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang ldan pa nam sros pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste 7phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyu1zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po rnam 12thos kyi bu'i kha dog gi mthus rgyal bu 91wa 551

rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang ba chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /blo ldan khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /lha rnams kyis ni de ma 'tshal/ /dpa' 3)chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa dang / /da ltar byung dang ma byon pa/ /thams cad la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /khyod la'ang bdag ni skyabs su mchis / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rin༄nyan thos kyi dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma gang dag gnas mal dgon pa dang ④/nags 'dab na dag dang / bas mtha' dag na gnas pa dag kyang mchis la/de la 6gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par dad pa dag dang mngon par ma dad pa dag kyang mchis te/ gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par dad pa de dag ni shin tu nyung la/ gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi ༷medagasung rab la mngon par ma dad pa de dag ni ches mang lags te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dunasadage slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams dang /tso dge bsnyen rnams dang ske/ dge bsnyen ma rnams 'di ltar ba dag nyid bsrung hu )ba dang / bskyab pa dang ske/ bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa mngon par ma dad pa dag mngon par dad par bgyi ba dang / mngon par dad pa rnams kyang slar zhing 'phel bar 91—552

bgyi ba'i slad du kun tu rgyu ba dang shi'e/ kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig (gesngags dang / srung geb dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher 'dzin cing / kun chub par bgyid na legs so legs so zhes gsol nga pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la cang mi gsung bas 55)gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po chen yipo rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bar 7gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dun zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung 9rib dang / sug pa 1 rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid 11rgya cher gsol to/ /skye bo gang dag gtong phod 8cing / /phra ma mi mchi /snyeser sna bral/ /gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs mchis pas8/ /mi de rnams kyis marnyed pa lags/tsi/ /gang gi 'char la brten 1 nas ni/ /des na nyin mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po'i 18dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang 8'char 'gyur ba yi sna/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong 51bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags zhuspyodang ldan pa ni/ /dri za'i bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /dri za rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /dri za rnams kyis 2lhamadun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu 2 tshodang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min tsho rīgayul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i ri 5gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang 91—553

shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis ①phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /go 2tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cigaci na /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa / / mya ngan ri 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar shar gyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes geskye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong yibagyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na yi dgas (7)zhes bgyi ba/ /rgyab kyi sha 'tshal phra ma can/ /srog gcod bgyid pa ma rungs pa/ /'jungs shing mi snyan smra bgyid pa'i/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong dunarabagyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /grul bum bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bgyi / /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /grul bum rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /grul bum rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu 49nodang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub bolags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni / /rgyang ring 511gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal pa/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gi tu tam 91wa 554

rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar lho yi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes 1tshoskye bo mchi / /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags / /gang zhig nub pa kho na las/ /des na mtshan mor brjod pa yin/ /nyi ma chen po dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs dgang du nub 'gyur ba/ /de na mtsho chen zab mo ni/ /shin tu 'da' bar dka' ba ste/ /de ni chu sngon rgya mtsho zhes / /skye bos rtogs pa mchis pa yi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang 4gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /klu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing / /klu rnams kyis ni mdun gyis bltas5/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu cadang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming 7mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang 8lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis nyu)rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen 7mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gi 17tam khyod 32la phyag 'tshol cig1 /sangs rgyas rig sadang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar nub kyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags mezhes 8skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid cing tsho17/ /91—555

rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /dga' zhing lhun chen lta mdzes dang / /gang na mi rnams tshe lo ni/ /brgya phrag bcu pa skye 'gyur zhing / /de dag mi rmo mi 'debs (1)la/ /gshol tsho yang 'cha' bar mi bgyid cing / /tshe ring mdog dang ldan na pa dang / /nges par yongs su spyod bgyid cing / /zas su sā 4lu kha dog dang / /dri dang ro dang ldan pa dang / /dri bda' 5)me tog tshogs 'dra zhing / /lha yi bdud rtsi 'dra ba 'tshal/ /na li ke ra bskol bgyis nas/ /tshod mar de 'tshal sran tshod min56)/ /gang na me lce'i rtse 'dra ba'i/ /sman dag 'khrung bar 7'gyur ba yirin/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po ste9/ /ming ni lus ngan po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis cingartag tu rtse/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /gnod sbyin rnams kyis 11mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te'i/ /brgyad cu /tshonyedang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po 8zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min 8phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gi sputam rgyal 51 tshol phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang nyushezhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol 37mchi/ /de ltar 91wa 556

bu mo'am/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor pho'am/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor mo'am/gnod sbyin gyi mngag gzhug pa'am/ gnod sbyin gyi 1)mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig (25nye bar mchi zhing / nye bar 5sku'agreng 9ringam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi gnod sbyin 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ku'i dog pa bzhin skuratshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 6༄nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung 7rib dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don (8)par bgyid pa de la/gal te srin po'am/ srin mo'am/ srin po rgan (9༄po'am/ srin po rgan mo'am/srin po'i bu pho'am/ srin po'i bu mo'am/ srin po'i 'khor pho'am/ srin po'i 'khor mo'am/ srin po'i mngag gzhug pa'am/ srin po'i mngag gzhug ma ⑩'tshe bar bgyid pa/ glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing /nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na 7glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la512/ srin po rnams kyi srin po 51ge'adu ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ku'i dog pa bzhin 57tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 8'di dag lags so/ /tar+ya thā/ hi li hi li/ hu 8lu hu 3 tsholu/ yu me yu me len)/yu mi la ba tī //ye swā hā/ de nas rgyal po chen po ri sirnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 91wa 566

'das kyi spyan sngar kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung 3)ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher brjod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ de nyid du mi snang 2bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (kyede nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gtso la gdan bshams pa de nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mdang rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu kha dog 'phags pa/ g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin du ma dang /4g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin brgya phrag du ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin stong phrag du ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang ldan pa/nam sros pa dang / nga ga la ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i kha dog gi mthus rgyal bu tshor rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang ba chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /blo ldan khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /lha rnams kyis 6ni de ma 'tshal(pe / /dpa' chen (8)khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa dang / /da ltar byung dang ma byon pa / /thams cad la ni bdag phyag 'tshal//khyod la'ang 7bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang dag gnas mal dgon pa dag 11dang / nags 'dab 12dag dang / bas mtha' dag 91—567

na gnas pa dag kyang mchis la/ de na gnod sbyin dang mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par dad pa dag dang / mngon par ma dad pa dag kyang mchis te/ gnod sbyin dang ske/ mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par dad pa de (1tshodag ni shin tu nyung la/ gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi ri ragasung rab la mngon par ma dad pa de dag ni ches mang lags te/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams dang / dge bsnyen rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams 'di ltar bdag nyid bsrung ri /ba dang / bskyab pa dang / bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa mngon par ma dad pa dag mngon par cadad par bgyi ba dang / mngon par dad pa rnams kyang slar zhing 'phel skur bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ kun tu rgyu ba dang /kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun 565pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung (7)ba dang ske/ sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher 'dzin cing kun chub par bgyid na legs so legs so zhes gsol pa dang / dge slong dag ngas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la cang mi 58)gsung bas gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po 9༄chen po rnam thos kyi 7bus ngas cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ nga'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ nga'i spyan sngar kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang /srung /1ba dang / sug pa 1 rkang pa la hu phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya 91—568

cher gsol to①/ /skye bo gang dag gtang (baphod cing / /phra ma mi mchi rdo ser sna bral / /gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs mchis pa/ /mi de rnams kyis (4)rnyed pa lags / /gang gi 'char la brten nas ni/ /des ni (5)nyin mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po ⑥dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang nas 'char 'gyur ba'i/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /dri za'i bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye 7du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis (8)rtag tu rtse/ /dri za rnams kyis yongs bskor cing ske/ /dri za rnams kyis mdun 9)gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu tshudang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa11/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis 12phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag la 3lha'adi skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la 8phyag 'tsho'/ cig /gi betam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar shar gyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes saskye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na yi dgas zhes bgyi ba/ /rgyab kyi sha 'tshal phra ma can/ /srog gcod bgyid pa ma rungs pa/ /'jungs shing mi snyan smra bgyid pa'i1 / /phyogs de 91wa 569

mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /grul bum bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /grul bum rnams kyis 1)yongs bskor cing ske/ /grul bum rnams kyis (gemadun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu ( skadang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen 74ramathong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring ⑤gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /go (6)tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol 57mchi/ /de ltar lho yi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes (8)skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang zhig nub pa kho na las/ / de la 9༄mtshan mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang du nub 'gyur ba/ / de na ⑩mtsho chen zab mo 'di51gle/ /shin tu 'da' bar dka' ba ri rteste/ /de ni chu mngon 8rgya mtsho zhes / /skye bos skortogs pa 8mchis pa yi57/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa / /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu 91wa 570

rtse / /klu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing / /klu rnams kyis ni mdun gyis bltas / /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu (1)dang ni bcu dang gciganas /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi tsho ristobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis ri kyimi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis (gerdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog 965khyod kyi la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gi (nyetam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar 99nub kyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes boskye bo mchi31/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /dga' zhing lhun chen blta 8mdzes dang nyu / /gang na mi rnams tshe lo ni/ /brgya phrag bcu pa skye ④'gyur zhing / /de dag mi nyusnyermo mi 'debs la/ /gshol tsheyang 'cha' 1 tshobar mi bgyid cing / /tshe ring mdog dang ldan pa dang / /nges par yongs su spyod bgyid cing / /zas su sā rmogelu kha dog dang / /dri dang ro dang ldan pa dang / /dri bda' nyunyeme tog tshogs 'dra zhing / /lha yi bdud rtsi 'dra ba 'tshal/ /na li ke ra bskol bgyis na/ /tshod mar de 'tshal sran tshod min/ /gang na me lce rtse 'dra ba'i/ /sman dag 'khrung bar spe'agyur ba yi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid (nyepa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po 91wa 571

ste / /ming ni lus ngan po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis 0)yongs bskor cing / /gnod sbyin rnams kyis 95kyimadun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang (kyemachis te④/ /brgyad cu ⑤dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes 6)mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gau 57༄tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar byang gi (8)phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes (9༄skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong tshebagyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs na ni 511'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid/ /rgyal po dag gi mngag gzhug pa/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur (2mchi ba /snyernams/ /de dag glang po che 'tshal zhing / /phyogs phyogs dag tu rnam thupar rgyu/ /de dag /geni chibs rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang / ra dang / lug dang / sbrul dang / bya dang /91—572

skyes pa dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu ma la 37'tshal zhing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /glang po che 9migacig gis shing rta drangs ①shing byaphyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /chibs rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang / ra dang / lug dang / sbrul dang /bya dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu 95)ma gcig gis shing rta drangs shing (6)phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur snyamachi ba rnams/ /bzhon ⑧pa de dag 'tshal nas (94)ni/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid/ /rgyal po dag ni grong khyer dag /sna tshogs mkha' la rgyu ba mchis/ /'di lta ste/kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / sa la kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / gar bcas sa steng rngukun tu rgyu ba dang / sbubs can dang / grong khyer sbubs can zhes bgyi ba dag lags so/ /byang phyogs na mtsho ka pi bang ka zhes bgyi ba dag nyunyemachis lags so/ /nub phyogs na grong khyer sar 12pa gsar 1lhaldan dang / gos can dang / gos mchog can dang / pad+ma can dang / pad+ma bzang po can dang / sa gzhi r+shacan zhes bgyi ba dag 1lhamachis skolags so/ /chab rgyun mang po'i gnas gyur pa/ /'dzin pa zhes bgyi'i nyu tshomatsho mchis te/ /chab rgyun tha dad de las 'byung / /de las dgung char 'bab par 'gyur18/ /btsun pa grong khyer u shi ra'i 3)sbubs kyi pha rol na/ lus gnas tshodang ni gnas yangs dang / /de bas gnas yang 1rgyun lugs can/ /rgyun lugs mang dang de bas mang / /bar snang mkha' la bya ltar 2gda'/ /btsun pa grong khyer sbubs can gyi sostepha rol byang phyogs na 'dun thus bya gar can zhes bgyi ba yang 91—573

mchis te(1)/ der ni gnod sbyin rnams 'du zhing (5)gnas lags so/ /rkang mi sdug la mchu 'phyangs sa dang / /'jigs rung (4)lto spu can dag mchis/ de na ljon shing 'bras bu rtag /rma bya khrung khrung sgra snyan dang / /khu sbyoshebyug sgra skad chen po dang / /shang shang te'u dag 96dasgra 'byin cing / /rma bya rnams kyi sgra dag dang / / kau dum bha 7 dang chun lag na dang / /bya rnams sna tshogs skad 'byin cing / /me tog sbrang rtsi'i ro la dga'/ /lus ngan po de glu gar gyis/ /pad+ma can dang lhan cig rtse/ /btsun pa grong khyer lcang lo can gyi pha rol na rgyal po dpa' bo zhes bgyi ba yul 'khor mu khyud na mchis lags so/ /bdag gang na mchis pa'i 'dun 9nos de ni khyu mchog can zhes bgyi ste/ bdag gi 7ming ni rnam thos kyi bu zhes 1glebagyi lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ / tabya thā ge/ i li mi li 12yi li lami ling/ kirtsi 7myu le/ hi li kyis hu 9lca lenyuste/hu du me/ hu du ra du 19me/ gau ri / garnya ri/ go sdo mdo ha tsunyeni/ o ri deke mo ke swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis sostedri za rnams dang ske/ dri za chen po rnams dang / dri za'i gesde dpon rnams dang / dmag dpon rnams kyi ming brjod par bgyi lags so/ /'di lta ste/ 'dod myos dga' bas myos pa dang / /glu 7yis myos pa spun dang ni tsho/ /phreng bas myos dang sbrang rtsis myos/ /me tog myos pa spun rnams dang / /rtag tu myos dang dpal gyis myos/ /nor gyis myos dang dga' byed dang / /ut+pal pad+ma zla ba 4)dang ske/ /rnga 29'dzin dang ni khu byug sgra/ /tum da ribu ru dang gtsug lnga dang / /gser spyod bu mo gser can dang / /pa ba sangs dang phur bu dag /'gro gnas ji snyed rgyal po lags/ /de dag ni sa bdag gi sku spun lags te/ de dag 91—574

phyug rgyal po dang / khro med dang sa'i bum pa dang / klu dbal 6)dang / chu 'dzin dang / sprin gdugs dang / ang 5kyegi ra'i gdong dang / chagazi brjid ④can dang / sprin las mngon byung (5)dang / klu'i rgyal mo (6dgom stabs mtha' yas dang / cha byad mdzes dang / lus chen dang / spyad sto dang / zhi ba dang ske/ dpa' ba dang / gser ngad can 59)dang / mchog tu brtson dang / dug can (shedang / dbyangs snyan dang / klu'i rgyal po bdud rtsi snying po dang /rab tu char 'bebs chen po dang / rnam par g.yo dang / 'brug 0sgra dang /rnga sgra dang / bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang / dga' bar byed pa dang / 'brug sgrogs mdang ske/ dpa' sde dang / sred med kyi bu dang / rgya mtsho'i klong dang / klu'i rgyal po yon po dang / klu'i rgyal po chen po de dag la sogs pa klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu /)rtsa bzhi dag 'dus te 'khod pa dang thabs cig nyunyetu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po de dag 'khor dang bcas 8te stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te5bo/ pus mo tsogayas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 8nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba ⑩btud nas/ bla ma la gus pa dang / phu dud chen po hunyebyed pas/ me tog dang ske/ bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang ske/ na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /dar gyi lda ldi dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang /glu ri rtedabyangs dang / rin po che'i me tog dang / rin po che'i lda ldi dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dang / klu'i me tog dang / mu tig gi dra ba mchog tu mdzes pa rnam )pa sna tshogs dpag tu med pa sategrangs ༷ 2med pa dag /bcom ldan 'das 91wa 594

la phul nas bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas smon lam rnams hu)btab pa/ lus rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ②rgya mtsho thams cad dang / sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams dang / gzugs su snang ba thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams las rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re la yang lus kyi sprin rgya mtsho bgrang ba'i ③rgya mtsho thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ grangs med/dpag tu med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/brjod du med pa las yang dag par 'das pa dag dang / lus re re la yang lag pa rgya mtsho'i sprin phyogs kun gyi rgyun du mngon par phyogs pa dpag tu medasti/grangs med pa dag byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdul phra rab kyi rdul gyi cha re re las kyang mchod pa thams cad kyi sprin rgya mtsho phyogs kun gyi gzhi 95)rgyas par 'gengs pa ma 'dres pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa ⑥bya'o snyam pa 'di lta ste/ kun tu spyod pa'i lus (7)rgya mtsho (8)sprin ma 'dres pa dpag tu med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab6)/ gzhal du med/tshad med/ brjod du med pa dag gis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus tshergya mtsho sprin rnams kyis ji lta ba de bzhin du rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog dang 'od zer stug po dang nyi ma dang zla ba thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang ske/ rin po che thams cad kyi phreng ba dang me tog gi rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /91wa 595

rin po che thams cad kyi snang ba chen po'i snying po ①khang pa brtsegs pa ②rgya ①mtsho sprin rnams dang / phye ma dang / shing ljon pa thams cad kyi mdzod rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos dang / bdug pa thams cad kyi gzugs kun tu ston pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sgra thams cad sgrogs gopa'i rol mo'i sgra ②rgya mtsho'i dusprin rnams dang / spos thams cad kyi shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis ⑦nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs nas/ de la sogs pa mchod pa thams cad kyi (8)sprin rgya mtsho dpag tu medakyiste/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med/ tshad med/ brjod du med pa/ ma 'dres pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bste (1 dīstang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /yul thams cad du bkod pa rnam par snang bar byas pa'i snying po can gyi nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis /glenam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bste tsostang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri 51nyamor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /thams cad kun du snang ba'i nor bu rin po che'i char 'bab pa bkod pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po tshergya mtsho cigasprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi tso'od 'phro ba 'bar ba dang ldan pa sangs rgyas la nges par gyur pa'i dbyangs kyi nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun du sgras 'gengs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi dbyangs can nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun nas sgo rin po che 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa snang bar byed pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ma 'dres pa tsho/— tshornams su bkod pa thams 91wa 596

cad snang ba kun du ston pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang hu)/ 'od 'phro ba sgron ma sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsam gyis 9mimi khyab pa rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhal med khang snang ba kun du ston pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi rdul la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi sku snang ba rnam par ①byed pa'i nor bu'i (4)rgyal po rgya mtsho (5)sprin rnams kyis/ nam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho (6༄thams cad la bste (7stong du bya'o / /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /rin po che dang /spos dang / me tog sna tshogs thams cad (shekyi khang pa brtsegs pa ma 'dres pa rgya mtsho asprin rnams dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po kha dog mtha' yas pa thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan hu )pa khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho /lhasprin rnams dang /sdon po che'i sgron ma dang / spos kyi 'od 'phro ba can gyi khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho tsosprin rnams dang / mu tig thams cad kyis rnam par spras pa'i khang pa brtsegs 8pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog thams cad kyi ze ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po mche'i phreng ba mtha' yas pas legs par brgyan skopa'i khang pa ⑩brtsegs pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis brlabs nas phyogs bcu kun du 'od zer snang ba'i snying po can bkod pa thams cad yang dag par 'du ba'i khang pa brtsegs hu tshopa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang ske/ rin po che 8thams cad kyi rdul gyis hunyerab tu brgyan dz+nya )pa bkod pa du ma kun tu ston pa khang pa brtsegs pa (2rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bkod pa thams 91—597

cad kyis rab tu brgyan ri11pa kun tu rgyas par (0'gengs pa'i khang pa brtsegs ②pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sgo kun du me tog gi ④rta babs dril bu'i dra ba dpyangs 55)pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis brlabs te ri nasangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bste ri stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /gser dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi tshong tshong (kyedang phreng ba dang / rin po che'i mgul gdub kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog snang ba ltar 9sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho hu )sprin rnams dang /an+da rnyil dang 'dzam bu chu bo'i 11gser gyi pad+ma sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu rin po che'i sgron ma'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i 12khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu nyusnyerin po che snang gsal rgyal mtshan gyi pad+ma sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang ske/ rin po ches brgyan pa'i pad+ma sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / an+da rnyil 51 mdzes par 'bar ba'i 'od zer ldan pa'i ⑫pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / 'od zer 'bar ba zad mi shes pa'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che 'bar ba thams cad byung 8ba'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang sna tsho/ rin po che 'bar ba mchog dam pa thams cad byung 512ba'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi /spugasung sgra'i 'od zer dang ldan pa'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun du 91—598

khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bste ①stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /spos dang / nor bu sna tshogs ②thams cad kyi shing ljon pa rgya mtsho dusprin rnams dang / kun nas sgo lo ma las thal mo sbyar ba'i sprin 'byung ba'i spos kyi shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / shing ljon pa thams cad kyi gzugs mtha' yas pa bkod pa kun du ston pa'i shing (paljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog thams cad kyi sprin rab tu 'phyang ba'i 95)shing ljon pa la)rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bkod pa thams cad 'byung (7ba'i mdzod mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che (8)'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor hu)rnam lho )par snang bar byed pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lus byed tsan+dan 17thams cad kyi phye mar kun du ston pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / byang chub kyi snying po thams cad kyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od can gyi shing ljon pa'i rin po che'i gos thams cad kyi mdzod nyi ma nya ltar snang bar byas pa dang ldan pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sgra dbyangs thams cad sgrogs 1 pa yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs hu )kun du gtong ba'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho 3lhasprin rnams dang /rin po che kha dog mtha' yas pa'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun du mngon par phyogs pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po snang bar byed pa'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rgyan bkod pa thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan 8pa'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /rin po che sna tshogs 'od 'phro ba'i sgron ma'i phreng ba'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri 91wa 599

rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun nas sgra rin po che'i shing ljon pa 'byung ba'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos dang / me tog dang /pad+ma thams cad kyi phreng ba rin po che'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdan bkod pa kun du ston pa'i nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /bkod pa thams cad kyi phreng ba rab tu dpyangs 07pa'i rta babs stegs ③bus rab tu brgyan /kyepa rin po che'i sprin gyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang ske/ nor bu rin po che'i yal ga dang phye ma'i mdzod yod pa'i sdong po thams cad kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos sna tshogs dang ske/ rin po che'i 0dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba kun nas brgyan pa nyi ma ⑤snang bar byed pa'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis (nyanam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bste 57dastang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad kyi gzhal med khang rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / an+da rnyil gyi ze ba can gyi ⑧me tog bkod pa thams cad kyi cho1bla re 57rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos dang nor bu thams cad kyi bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che'i 7'od 'phro ba'i sgron ma'i gzugs kyi bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul rnam ⑫par ston par snang ba'i dbyangs can gyi /3nor bu'i rgyal po'i bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu sna tshogs kyi gos bkod pa thams cad snang ba 0kun du ston pa'i bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog thams cad kyi chu bo 'bar bar 91wa 600

snang ba'i rin po che'i bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / dril bu sna tshogs kyi sgras kun du rgyas par 'gengs ①pa'i dra ba'i (gyibla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / pad+ma 'bar ba kha dog mtha' yas pa sna tshogs su snang ba'i nor bu'i snying po can gyi pad+ma'i dra ba'i bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / gser gyi dra ba can gyi 'od zer snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi ③bla re rgya mtsho ④spyin rnams dang / bkod pa bsam (na)gyis mi khyab par snang ba'i 'od zer (nyamatha' yas pa bkod pa thams cad kyi rgyan (pebla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis (8)nam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang (9)chen mtsho bosprin tsho/7rgya mtsho thams cad la bste sgo stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /nor bu rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi12/ gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis 8nam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis brlabs la/rin po che bcu'i 'od zer 8snang ba bkod pa'i me tog gi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / mu tig kha dog mtha' yas pa'i mdzod kyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snying rje'i sgo'i sgra'i nor bu'i rgyal po'i gdugs rgya mtsho yosprin rnams dang / rin po che hunyesna tshogs kyi 'od 'phro ba'i phreng ba'i tsho gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nyurtorin po che'i du )rdul kun du snang bas rab tu brgyan lhapa'i dril bu'i dra ba dpyangs 2spyapa'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu thams cad kyi sdong po yal ga'i rgyan gyi gdugs du nyergya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nyi ma rnam par snang bar byed pa'i 'od 'phro ba'i nor bu'i rgyal po dang / spos dang / bdug 24pa thams cad kyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / tsan+dan gyi phye ma'i mdzod kun du rgyas par 91wa 601

'gengs 1)pa'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin ②rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul ①chen po snang bar byed pa shekun du bkod pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams kyis (5nasangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti (6nyestang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'ol/ /rin po che thams cad snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /rin po che 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi gzugs kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams dang / me tog gi sprin snang bar byed pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi 'od zer sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i 'od kyi 7nodakyil 'khor dang ldan pa (8)rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing (9)thams cad snang bar gtogs ⑩pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun nas sgo sangs rgyas kyi yul sgrogs tunyepa rin po che'i yal ga'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / be+e ḍūr+ya tsodang / rin po che'i rigs dang / nor bu rin po che'i rigs dang / nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad kyi 'od zer kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sems can gyi gzugs mtha' yas pa dag sems kyi skad cig phonyel kun du ston pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam las byung ba yid du 'ong ba'i sgra rab tu 'byin pa dang ldan pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du sems can 'dul ba'i dbyangs can nor bu'i rgyal po 8'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti tshestang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /nor bu 91—602

thams cad kyi mdzod kyi 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba zhu)rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos sgrogs (7pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams ①dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa thams cad snang bar byed pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi rdul gyi 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bskal pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud ④pa thams cad du sangs rgyas 'byung bas sems can yongs su min par byed pa sgrogs ⑤pa can gyi 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che mi zad pa thams cad bstan pa dang me tog thams cad kyi ze ba'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / khri stan bkod pa thams cad kun du ston pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti stistang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o / /rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba'i sbyo/7kha dog mtha' yas pa rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams dang / kun du 'od kyi nor bu'i rgyal po'i dzo 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing rgya chen po bkod pa snang bar byed pa'i 'od sti'aphro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bkod pa thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba 7rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa'i 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing gi ze ba'i 17'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin 91—603

rnams dang / gos thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'i spyod pa dbyangs can nor bu'i rgyal po'i 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / mu tig gi sgron ma thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang (11chen mtsho'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho thams cad la bste (bstang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o / /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /spos dang / me tog sna tshogs thams cad kyi rgya mtsho sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang / rin po che 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi pad+ma'i tshon dra ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu rin po che ④kha dog mtha' yas pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog dang ldan pa'i mu tig gi mdzod rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /rin po che dang / spos dang / tsan+dan thams cad kyi phye ma rgya mtsho sprin rnams ⑤dang ske/ rin po che thams cad kyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu'i rgyal po yid 6)du 'ong zhing sdug ri/pa mdzes pa'i dbyangs can rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang ske/ nyi ma'i nana'od kyi nor bu'i tshogs kyi phreng ba rgya mtsho ⑨srin rnams dang /rin po che'i mdzod mtha' yas pa margya mtsho sprin rnams dang / thams cad 7kun du bzang po'i lus ma 'dres pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyisanyuge/ sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang 32chen mtsho'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho thams cad la bste ④stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /zhes de lta bu'i smon lam btab nas/ klu'i rgyal po de dag gis yang bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tsheganang nas rang rang gi stan la 'khod do/ /de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong 91wa 604

chen po'i klu'i bdag po chen po phyir mi ldog pa'i smon lam gyi stobs can g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / phyag bya ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chos mnyan 0)pa'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir 'ongs so / /de nas klu'i bdag po ②g.yog dusamatha' yas rgya mtsho'i rtsisprin bkod pa'i gzi ⑤brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar yinas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te⑦/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba 2lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis 6)bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i 0sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag po ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / ngas nyunyedris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid 8kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na klu thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur/ bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa dang / rab tu dga' bar 'gyur / 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dus dus 32su char gyi rgyun 'bebs par 'gyur8/91wa 605

rtswa dang / shing shel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal thams cad 'khrungs par 0)'gyur gyi/ 'bru thams cad skye bar 'gyur/ bcud thams cad yang dag par skye dubabar 'gyur/ gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i (9sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag po khyod sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di yongs su 'dri bar sems pa legs so legs so/ /klu'i bdag po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyone la yid la zung ②shig dang / ngas ⑥khyod la bshad do/ /klu'i bdag po chos gcig (7)dang ldan na klu thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal rinan thams cad (1)rgyun chad par 'gyur/ bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byams pa'o/ /klu'i bdag po byams pa de la gnas pa'i lha dang mi rnams ni mes mi tshig⑩ /mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ chus mi khyer57/ dug gis mi tshugs/ pha rol kyi dmag tshogs kyis zil gyis mi non/ /bde bar gnyid kyis log par 'gyur/ hu)bde bar sad par 'gyur/ rang gi 512bsod nams kyis yongs su bsrung rngubar 'gyur/bsod nams chen pos 1shegazi brjid tshekyis gzi can du 'gyur/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mi rdzi ’ bar 'gyur/ mdzes pa dang mthong na dga' bar 'gyural/ 'gro ba thams cad du thags thogs nyu2med par 'gyur/ sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad nyu9pa dang / rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa dang / mi'i chos bla ma rtogs nas lus zhig pa'i 'og tu tshangs 91wa 606

pa'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur te/ klu'i bdag po lha dang mi ②byams pa la gnas pa rnams kyi phan yon ni ②'di dag go/ /klu'i bdag po de bas na byams ①pa'i lus kyi las dang / byams pa'i ngag gi las dang / byams pa'i yid kyi ④las kyis gnas par bya'o/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang bde ba thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs brjod par bya ste/ des klu thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun gcod par byed/ bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed de9she/'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dus dus su char gyi rgyun 'bebs par byed/ rtswa (6)dang /shing gel ⑦pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal dang / lo tog thams cad skye bar byed do/ /klu'i bdag po de la bde ba thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs ⑧gang zhe na/ tabya thā/ dhā ra tsā dhā ra tsā'-i/ ut+na bor ṇi0sto/ saṃ pra tikhyi te⑩/ bi 8dza ya brna0/ sat+ya 8pra ti dz+nyā skyas ra hanyu 7/ tshwa hunyen ba ti/ud de pā da ni bi yinā ma nidu 3/ a gi ṣe tsa ni(1/ a bhi bya ( nehā ra/ shu bha ba til/ a tsodzi ma tu kū/ e hi rngo nyaku ma ba hunyel ni/ ba ha hā sau 1ra kle sha 38na/ dhu na 0mā paṃ/ sho dha ya marga ṇadu )/ ni ra ti (7ka /dharma ta 82shud+dha/ lo ka bi ti mi (nyer ra tsa bus/ duḥkha nunyesha ma na shustesarba bud+dha a ba lo ka 5nyen gi a dhiṣ+ṭha tis)/pradz+nyā dz+nyā zhun bi (teswā hā/ klu'i bdag po gzungs kyi tshig don thams cad sgrub par byed pa/ chos kyi sku la 'jug pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sko byin gyis brlabs pa'/ bde ba thams cad sbyin pa 'di dag gzung bar bya/ brjod par bya'o/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang sprin gyi rigs las 'byung ba'i byin gyis brlabs ④bkod pa gzi brjid kyi snying po sprul par 82snang bar byed pa/ ye shes kyi tog gi chu'i rgyun gyi 9sprin gyi dkyil 'khor dpal dang ldan pa/ gser gyi 91wa 607

'od zer rnam par snang bar byed pa/ skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas gcig las byung ba'i rus dang / rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan gzung bar bya/yid la bya'o/ /de dag gis klu thams cad dang / klu'i rigs thams cad dang /klu'i rus thams cad dang / klu'i cho (1)rigs thams cad dang / klu'i 'byung ba thams cad dang / klu'i skye gnas thams cad dang / klu'i rgyal po thams cad dang ske/ klu'i bu mo thams cad dang / klu'i g.yog thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun rin/gcod par byed pa me / bde ba'i yo byad thams cad sgrub par byed do/ /klu'i bdag po de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad snying cinapo can gyi sprin chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rigs las byung ba'i sprin gyis rnam par mdzes (snyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi chu 'dzin (nyal phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ldan sprin gyi gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri skubacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klung (kyegi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms 5)pa'i sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' bodapag med la phyag 'tshal lo//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po'i glog 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen mthu tunyertsal dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin mdzes ⑫la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin sdud tsochen po 91wa 608

la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen (1)gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blta sdug sprin (5)chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen pos khebs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin las byung ba ①snang bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu mtho 'gebs rnga'i sgra dbyangs shin tu rab tu stisgrogs dul phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 6)chen bsil ⑦'byung mi dga' rab 'joms (8)sgra zab sgrogs (9/la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dpal 7la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i /lhachu sprin la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtsal gyi sprin ltar dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra bsgrags nyurtal phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 32kun du ston thul phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rgya chen po skol phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 'dzag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar rnam par sgrogs tshel phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar 'phags 7la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin lta bu'i na bza' mnabs /tshonyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 91—609

sprin gyis lo tog bskyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi gnas la gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa char gyi ① sprin gyi rdzu sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 'du bar mdzad ②la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rnam par rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 0ut+pal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen spos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'od mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu ri45)rin po che chen po'i sprin lta bu la phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar rnam par 'joms (7pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi chu bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dus ma yin pa'i sprin dang lce 'bab pa rnam ⑦par 'joms (8)pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po ltar nam mkha' mtho nas bsgrags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen sgra 'byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen char chu sgyuraskyes la phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snyems ⑩pa'i gzi brjid sgrub pa'i sprin la phyag 91—610

'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ro bro ba drug dang ldan pa'i chu chen po'i sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chu 'thor sprin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rgya mtsho 'gengs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa char hu)mi 'bab pa na sprin gyis kun (༄du 'gebs pa la phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gzugs mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin chen po thams cad rnam par sgrub pa 'dzam labu'i sprin gyi dpal gyi gzi brjid 'od mdzad pa sprin gyi 'od zer can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'di dag brjod pas klu thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad ④pa dang / bde ba (5)thams cad dang ldan pa dang ske/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dus dus su char pa'i rgyun 'bab pa dang / rtswa (67dang ske/ shing gel ⑦pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal dang / lo tog thams cad skyed ⑧par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal pos gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na/ 'dzam 6)bu'i gling 'dir char mi 'bab pa'i tshe gang dag brjod na char gyi 0rgyun chen po 'bab par bgyid pa dang / mi bzad pa'i dus kyi tshe dang ⑪/ gnod pa yi 'byung ba'i dus kyi tshe dang / chos ma lags pas skye bo 'thab pa'i dus kyi tshe dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa 'byung ba'i dus kyi tshe dang / nad dang 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe dang / skar ma ma rungs 91—611

pa gnas pa'i dus kyi tshe dang 0)/ yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa dang 95ci/ de lta bu'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi (2)gzhi rnams bshad du gogasol/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs ⑤kyis byin gyis brlab (6)par gsol/ gang dag klu thams cad la yang dag par rjobaskul 98rim 'debs par 'gyur ba dang / lha thams cad rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms ⑨par 'gyur ba dang /sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ba dang /gnod pa thams cad zlog 57par 'gyur ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyid pa dang / rgyu skar ma rungs pas ⑪ bgyis pa tsorab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis char pa'i bar chad lnga gsungs pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad sel bar 'gyur ba dang / 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char pa'i rgyun legs par 'bab par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi 512gzhi rnams bcom ldan 'das mchog tu thugs rje dang ldan pa/sems can thams cad la phan par thugs brtse ④ba dang ldan pas bshad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das 8de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'tshal lo/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 0klu'i rgyal po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to51 tsho/ /klu'i bdag po khyod sems can thams cad kyi don dang /phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa legs so legs so/ /klu'i bdag po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 1)shig dang / snying rje chen po las byung ba/ 'brug chen po'i sgra can 31—612
