du 'du la tog yar ①dar dir zhing 'dug ste/ klu'i skad chen po yid du 'ong ba'i sgra chen po 'byin cing dbyangs chen po rab tu sgrogs (0pa dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chachar rab tu phob cig /gha ḍa gha ḍa/ ghi ḍi ghi ḍi/ hu ḍū hu khu/ku ḍū ghu 28/ ga ṭa ga ṭa/ gi ṭi gi ②snyi/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ kye kye klu dang / klu chen po dag tshur tshur tshur sheg tshur sheg /dhu dhu dhu dhu/ hā hā hā hāyi/ tī tī/ rgyu hūṃ/ 'brug sgra 9)chen po sgrogs shing (8)/rlung chen po rab tu gtong ba dag sangs rgyas kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ kye kye klu dang / klu'i rgyal po dag klu thams cad la yang dag par bskul gyis ⑨'dzam bu'i gling du char 7phob cig /ghu ḍū ghu ḍū/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ha ha7/ he ho8/ klu chen po dag 'dus shig 1snyesa'i steng du char rab tu 8lob cig / ghu zu lhu zung/ ki ri ki tsheri/ tsi nyi tshori tsi ri/mi ri mi ri/ di ri di ri/ ki li ki li/ zhing thams cad yongs su gang bar gyis shig /'bru dang / shing ljon pa dang / rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang /sman thams cad rab tu skye bar gyis shigatso /byams pa'i sems kyis tshur sheg /sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / lag na rdo rje'i bden pa dang / klu thams cad kyi bden pas klu chen po dag tshur sheg tshur sheg swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po mdongs bu la yang dag par bskul 7lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po dpal gyi ༷ )gzi brjid la yang dag par bskul lo/ /chos kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la 0yang dag par bskul lo/ /dge 'dun gyi bden pas 91—635

'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /lag na rdo rje'i 6)bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /tshangs pa'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po dpal mgrin la yang dag par bskul lo/ /dbang po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /khyab 'jug gi ②bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po phreng ba can la yang dag par bskul lo/ /drag po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can la yang dag par bskul lo/ /drang srong gi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po skrag 'bros 5gebyed la yang dag par bskul lo/ /lha'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can chen po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /klu thams cad kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig ṭ+wā hā/ klu'i rgyal po rab 'joms (0la yang dag par bskul lo/ /gnod rinasbyin gyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa la yang dag par bskul lo/ /srin po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu gong ma yigong ma thams cad kyi ⑦bden pas char rab tu na phob cigatson /char phob cig /ma 'phyi bar tshur sheg tshur sheg /kye kye klu chen po dag klu thams cad kyi snying po la yang dag par bskul lo / /kun nas drang ngo / /sa ra sa ra/ hā hā/ dhu ma dhu ma/ hā hā hā hā/91—636

dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs hu)dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi du phyir de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po ri nisprin chen snying po thams cad la yang dag par bskul lo/ / klu thams cad kyi bden pas klu thams cad kyi snying po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /④dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' lung gis myur du sheg shig(snye /kye kye klu dang ⑥klu chen po dag tshur sheg tshur sheg /hu lu hu lu/ su ru su ru/ dha pa dha pa/ gha ra gha ra/ bhu ru bhu (7)ru/ ma 'phyi 8bar sangs rgyas kyi bden pas tshur sheg /chos kyi bden pas tshur sheg /dge 'dun gyi (9)bden pas tshur sheg /klu thams cad dang 7/ klu chen po gong ma gong ma hu)dag gi hunyebaden pas 'dzam bu'i ⑫gling du 7char phob cig /a la la zhes gar byed cing / a la la zhes glu len pa dang ske/ a la la zhes klu'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po byed cing 'du la char gyi rgyun chen po 'bebs shing / klu chen po rnams kyi chos kyi sgra yid du 'ong ba'i ⑫ston pa dag /gu lu gu lu/ nā ge nā ge/ tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ nā ga nī/ hā hā 7nyi nyi / nā ge 1 nā gi ni nā ge/ sarba nā ga biṣ+ṭa ma bha ni mā ra ṇi/51snye sarba nā ga biṣ+ṭa 19ma bha na no/ ma char ṇi ri gem re ta ra ṇi/ ta ra ṇi/ru ta re/ ta ra ta ra / tā re ri/ kā na bi la ke shi/ bi kṛ bta rda:/ bha ri — tsho'i nā ge/ ā ku /mā bi rin lasbra tha/ bibyud dz+wa (re/ sto rā ra )ru pi ṇi/ kā 0le/ a kā du le/ gardzi ta lha/ sarba me gha bi kurba ṇis༄/ sastso dged ni(9/ sarba k+ṣe ru 〉tra na/ a pū ra ṇi tsakras / tsakra brte/ hi ri hi ri/ bhe ghi bho lhehunye/ sma ra sma ra/ kā li kā li/ ma hā kā li/ skṛ sbyo nod yo/ pra bi sha asne/ mnye(3/ sarba nā ga(nye /ā 8kun+ta ṇi ri/ pū ra ya ri gergyu r+ghaṃ/ rat+na 6)tra ya/ bi kurbi 4 7teg/ badz+re khyi(rte/91—638

badz+re badz+ra pā ṇi/ kā ①la sho dhi re/ nā ga rū ②mi ni/ su rū ((be/ bho gi bho gi/ma hā bho gi/ ④sgo ga rū (snyeb ta ya/ ba le/ bar+ṣa ni(ye/ sarba nā ga saspyo (7)da ni swā hā/ na mo rat+na latra yā ya/ na ma ṇ+ḍa (9)badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ bharnya bhan+ta7/ su rū peyi/ kā la rū pi ṇi skoswā hā/ chos smra bas thog ma kho nar bsrung /snyeba'i cho ga byas la/ chos gos kyi grwar lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa bdun skobor nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad skokyi snying po zhes bya ba 'di zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du rgyun ma chad ⑩par bklag nyi tshopar bya'o/ /shar phyogs su ni ba lang gi lci bas klu'i rgyal po mgo gsum pa zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas te 'bri bar bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po rab tu rgyas nyirtebyed ces bya ba mgo lnga pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /nub phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po snang ldan gtsug phud tsukye can zhes bya ba mgo bdun pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'ol/ /byang phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po sprin skul 7zhes bya ba mgo dgu pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /bla re dang / gos sngon po dang / rgyal mtshan sngon po dang / lha bshos thams cad kyang sngon por bya'o/ /klu tsho rtagand rinal dbab pa ni mngar gsum gyis bya'o/ /mngar gsum gyis ridagang blugs bdun yang klu'i snying pos sbyin sreg 3)bya'o/ /sprin gyi rgyal po rnams 7kyang bris rtete char gyi rgyun 'bebs la 9phan tshun thug cing mthar glog 'gyu bar bya'o/ /'dir dbab pa ni khur 0ba bkra shis ldan dang / pen rtse gi snadang / sha dang / nya sha dang ske/ sbrang rtsi las byas pa'i zas mchog rgyas par bya'o sta/ /de nas chos smra ba gtsang zhing gos gtsang ma bgos pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po bklag rdunyepar bya'o/ /de nas klu rnams dang po'i nyin mo nas brtsams 91wa 639

te / di ri rir sgra sgrogs 1)par byed cing / sgra yid du 'ong ba dag 'byin par 'gyur te/ le'u 'di la the tshom (snyedang brnyas (0par mi (pebya'o/ /gal te rgya mtsho dus (5skulas yol na 'di yang char las rdo steyol bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po brtsegs pa rnam (7)par bsgrags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnga sgra sgrogs (8skal phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gdal po)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'brug sgrogs 7la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin kun du ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin 'dzag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin rnam par rgyas mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyi yan lag mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin lta bu'i na bza' mnabs hunyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyi 'brug skrun mal phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 31—640

0691༄ga /gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄zhug /rgya gar skad du/ gra ha mā tri ka nā ma dha ra tsā/ bod skad du/gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi grong khyer na lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / bdud dang /nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / pa ba sangs dang / phur bu dang ske/ gza' lhag pa dang / spen pa dang / sgra gcan dang / mjug ring shrīdang ske/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs te mang po rnams kyis bstod cing / rdo rje chen po'i dam tshig gi 3byin gyi rlabs kyis brgyan 4pa'i seṅge'i khri la bzhugs sol/ /byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang thabs cig ste/ 'di ltar byang chub 91—670

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gtum po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i sde dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gzhu can dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i bdag po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i rgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu gzigs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhal ras rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i spyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis 1bskor cing mdun du bltas 2pa la chos ston te/bkod pa chen po rgyan gyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ thog mar dge ba/bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i chos ston to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje 'khor de dag la bltas te langs nas bdag gi rdzu 'phrul gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas te phyag 'tshal nas spyan sngar 'dug ste snyems pa dang bcas pa'i skyil mo krung legs par 91—671

bcas nas 'khor de dag la 'gying bag tu bltas te rdo rje thal mo rang gi snying gar 1bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das / gza' mi bzad 2pa'i gzugs can/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/khro ba'i gzugs can dag sems can rnams la 'tshe bar bgyid/ mtho 'phrem mepar bgyid/ mdangs kyang 'phrog par bgyid/ kha cig ni/ nor rdzas 'phrog /kha cig ni/ srog 'phrog par bgyid cing / sems can tshe ring po rnams ni/tshe thung bar bgyid pa ste/ de ltar sems can thams cad la gnod pas 'tshe bar bgyid pa de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis chos 4kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can thams cad srung bar 'gyur ba 5bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang yang khyod kyis snying rje bskyed nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir gsang chen pas kyang ches gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu bar byed pa de ni/ legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs 6shig dang / gza' mi bzad 7༄pa'i gzugs can/ shin tu khro ba 8shin tu 'jigs par byed pa rnams kyi 9rimachod pa dang la/ mchod yon dang / bzlas brjod bzang po gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba ngas bshad do/ /de dag mchod pas mchod 'gyur zhing / /gnod par byed pa gnod byed pas/ /gza' de kun gyi kha dog dang / /ji ltar dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / /lha rnams dang ni lha min dang / /mi 'am ci 'am klu dag dang ske/ /gnod sbyin rnams dang srin po dang / /mi rnams dang ni srul po dang / /drag po gzi brjid chen po dag /khros pa zhi bar byed pa de'i/ /gsang sngags dang ni mchod pa dag /rim pa bzhin du bshad par bya/ /de nas de bzhin 91—672

gshegs pa shākya thub pa nyid kyi thugs ka nas snying rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye ste gza' rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs so/ /de nas de'i mod de la nyi ma la sogs pa gza' thams cad langs te bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lha rdzas kyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par byas te phyag 'tshal nas pus mo btsugs te thal mo sbyar ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag cag la sman yon btags par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 1chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis bdag cag rnams la sogs napas chos smra ba rnams srung dbar 'gyur ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang /dug gzhil 4ba dang / dug gsad 5pa dang / mtshams gcad 6pa dang / sa bcing ba rnams bgyid par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams mchod pa dang / gsang sngags bka' stsal pa/ oṃ me gho'i ya swā hā/ oṃ shrī t+t+waṃ sha be swā hā/ oṃ ra〈 ga ku mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bud+dhā ya swā hā/ oṃ bho gā sba dā ya swā hā/ oṃ a su rot+ta mā ya swā hā/ oṃ kṛt+ta bar+ṇa ya swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta bra 75 ya swā hā/ oṃ byo te she be swā hā/ lag na rdo rje/ 'di dag ni/ gza' dgu'i gsang sngags kyi snying po bklags pas 'grub pa yin te/ kha dog dang mthun 8pa'i spos kyi dkyil 'khor sor bcu gnyis byas pa'i dbus su mchod par bya'o/ /kham pa'am/ zangs la sogs pa'am/ gser ram9/ dngul gyi snod du mchod yon phul bas/ re re la yang bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad do/ /lag na rdo rje/ de'i 'og tu gza' 91—673

rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig lan bdun brjod par 1bya'o/ /des ni/ gza' thams cad srung ba 2byed par 'gyur ro/ /dbul ba'i gdon thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe zad pa las tshe ring bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / gzhan yang sems can gyi rigs gang yin pa dang / gang dag gi rna lam du grags pa de dag kyang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje/ gza' rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mchod pa byas te nyin gcig bzhin du klog par byed pa'i chos smra ba gang yin pa de la gza' thams cad bdag nyid kun gyis 4bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de dang rigs gcig pa rnams kyi dbul ba yang sel bar byed do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 5gza' thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo//bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gza' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gza'i khyim bcu gnyis rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ burnye budhe/ badz+re badz+re/ pad+me pad+me/ sa ra sa ra/ swa sa ra/ swa sa ra/ sma ra sma ra/ bi kri ḍa/ bi kri ḍa/ mā ra/ mā ra/ marda marda/ ghā ta ya/ bhā ta ya/ sarba baspyon/ ku ru ku ru/ sbyin tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ k+ṣu pa ya k+ṣu pa ya/ shārnye/ dān+ti/ dā pa ye/ bcom ldan 'das ma/ bdag nyid myur du bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das/ sgyu 'phrul chen po rnams 'dul du gsol/ bdag gi pa sdig pa rnam par skam du gsol/ tsaṇ+ḍi/ su mu su mu/91—674

mu tsu mu tsu/ bha ba bha be/ u gre/ rū pe/ pū 1ra ya pū ra ya/ ma ma sarba satwanāñca ma no ra thi/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a dhiṣ+ṭha ta sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/rgyuḥswā hā/ hrīḥswā hāḥ/ dhu swā hā/ dhi swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā ya swā hā/ a 2di t+yā ya swā hā/ sau mā ya swā hā/ dhā ra tsā su tā ya swā hā/ bud+dhā ya swā hā/ bri haspa tā ya swā hā/ shu krā ya swā hā/ yo: bas ya swā hā/ rā ha be swā hā/ ke ta be swā hā/bud+dhā ya swā hā/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā 3ya swā hā/ ku mā rā ya swā hā/nak+ṣa tra 4ṇan swā hā/ dā da sha rā shī nā swā hā/ sarba u pa dra pā ni swā hā/ oṃ sarba bibye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'di ni/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ston zla tha chung gi yar ngo tshes bdun nas brtsams te 5gso sbyong dang ldan par byas nas tshes bcu bzhi'i bar du gza' rnams la mchod pa byas te gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas zla ba nya ba'i nyin mtshan thog thag bklags na/ de la lo dgu'i bar du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /gza'i 'jigs pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba dang / zla ba dang ske/ rgyu skar gyi gnod pas 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs dran par 'gyur / gza' thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur/ gza' thams cad kyis ci 'dod pa sbyin par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gza' rnams kyis phyag 'tshal te legs so legs so/ /zhes gsol nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //91—675

bsdur mchan/670 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈sde 〉〉dang 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gnyis 'gyur mi 'dra bas 'dir 〈〈zhol 〉〉la gzhir bzung nas 〈〈snar 〉〉dang dpe sdur byas yod/ (ge〈〈snar 〉〉'jug rings/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉gyis brlabs kyis rgyan/671 1〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉ltas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gyis brlabs/672 15〈〈snar 〉〉khar/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉zad/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsam/ nga 〈〈snar 〉〉 kyis chos/ (ge〈〈snar 〉〉 bcom ldan 'das kyis/ kyi 〈〈snar 〉〉zung / 7 〈〈snar 〉〉zad/ 585〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ ri9ni〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/673 1〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉tshogs/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉la bsrung / na〈〈snar 〉〉bzhil/ 5)〈〈snar 〉〉bsad/6〈〈snar 〉〉bcad/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉bri/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉'thun/ 9〈〈snar 〉〉'am/674 tshosteXsnar 〉〉 brjod par/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ge〈〈snar 〉〉cig ngar〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ tshoge〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 96༄〈〈snar 〉〉675 )//snar 〉〉ru/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉ā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ra/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉ta tā/ 55〈〈snar 〉〉brtsam ste/

༄༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ba su dhā rā 2nā ma dhā ra rji / bod skad dul/ 'phags pa nor gyi rgyun ces 4bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das kau shāsbyi na 5tsher ma can zhes bya ba'i nags mchog 6chen po na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi 7dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rab tu mang po dang thabs cig 8tu bzhugs te9/ de'i tshe kau shāsbyi'i 1 grong khyer chen po na/ khyim bdag zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba/dbang po nye bar zhi ba/ yid nye bar zhi ba/ bu pho dang / bu mo dang /gza' 1 mi mang po dang ldan pa/ dad cing cher dad pa zhig gnas pa de/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste 1 phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 91—678

la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan 'bum phrag du mar 1bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na2/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//khyim bdag khyod 4ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / khyod kyis ji skad 5dris pa'i dri ba lung bstan pas ngas khyod kyi 6sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / /khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das 7legs so zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan 8nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dbul por gyur pa las ji ltar dbul ba ma mchis par 'gyur zhing / bro nad kyis /thebs 1 na yang bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag khyod ci'i phyir dbul po'i don du 'dri/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to11/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni dbul ba mang ba dang /gso ba mang ba dang 1 / bu pho dang / bu mo mang ba dang 15/ gza' 1 mi mang po dang ldan pa lags te/ de'i slad du gang gis sems can dbul po rnams 15kyi dbul ba ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / bro nad kyis 10thebs pa rnams bro 91wa 679

nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang /bang mdzod mang po dang 1ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sdug pa dang / yid du mchi ba 2dang / mthong na yid du 'thad pa dang / dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba dang ske/ sbyin bdag mdzod pas mi 'tshal zhing / dbyig dadang / gser dang /nor dang / 'bru'i mdzod dang / bang mdzod rnams dang / nor bu dang /mu tig dang / rdo rje dang / be+e ḍūr+ya cadang / dung dang / man shel dang /byi ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dbul bas ma 'tshal cing 'byor bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ khyim gyi bu smad dang / bza' 5mi 6rnams brtan 7par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rnam 8grangs de bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 9khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa 'das par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig 〉pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i 11/ kha 1 lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i dbyangs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ rigs kyi bu ngas de bzhin gshegs pa de las nor gyi rgyun ces 1ribya ba'i gzungs 'di thos te/ bzung 7zhing bcangs bklags15/ kun chub par byas/ rjes su yi rang bar byas shing / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan te/ rigs kyi bu da layang ngas de bshad pa'o17/ /rigs kyi bu gzungs 1 'di'i mthus mi rnams 19rnam par tho 'tsham )par mi byed 91wa 680

dol/ /mi ma yin pa rnams rnam par tho 1'tsham par mi byed do/ /gnod sbyin rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /srin po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /yi dgas 2rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /sha za rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /'byung po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /grul bum rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /brjed byed rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /gnon po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /lus srul po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ / lha rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /4lha ma yin rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang ske/ zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang ske/ zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag 'thung ba rnams dang /zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs 5za ba rnams dang / zas su stor 6khung nas 'bab pa 'thung 7ba rnams dang ske/ zas su dbugs rngub pa 8dang / 'byung ba za ba'i bar rnams rnam par 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di dag 9rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gi khyim na yod dam/ snying la yod dam/ lag na yod dam/ glegs bam du chud dam/ thos par gyur tam/ kun chub par byas sam/ bklags bosam/ bzung ngam/ rjes su yi rang bar byas sam/gzhan dag la rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de la yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa 11dang / dge ba dang / grub pa dang /bde ba dang / lo legs par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 91—681

la mchod pa byas te/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di nam phyed na lan gnyis sam/lan gsum mam1/ lan bzhi bton nan de'i lha yi rangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la dga' ba dang / chos gdags pa byas 4pas dga' ba dang —/ dge 'dun gdags pa byas 5pas dga' ba dang / chos smra ba la dga' ba dang 6/ lhag pa'i bsam pas bdag nyid 'ongs te7/ 'bru'i nachar 'bebs so/ /na mo badz+ra dha ra sā ga ra 9nisgo 1 ṣā ya/ ta thā ga tā 11ya/ tar+ya thā / oṃ su rū 18pe/ bha dre da/ bha dra 1 ba ti/ aṅga le/ maṅga le/ maṅga la 15ba ti/ a le/ a tsa le17/ a tsa la 17ba le/ ut+ta ta ni/spyo 5 ud bho da ni/ba su ba ti/ dā na pa ti/ dha n+ya pa 19)/ shrī rim ti/ pra bha ba ti/ a ma le/bi ma le/ nirma le/ ru ru/ su rū na be/ su rū na pa ma le bi ma lo tsa le/a tsa na ste / a na na ste / bi na na ste/na bi shwa 27ke shi 7/ bi shwa 2 ni shi/asku re/ masku re/ pra bsku re/ bī 29ra me/ bi dha 1me/ ri ri me di di me/ du du me/ kha kha me/ ta ta re/ ta ra ta ra/ tā ra tā ra/ badz+re badz+re badz+re ba me/ ṭa ke ṭa ke/ ṭha ke ṭha ri ke/ uska bum 5/ ṭha dzike ṭha 7ra ke / a brta ni ba ra sha na / ṣa da ni badz+ra dhā 1ra sā ga ra nisgo 2 ṣā na da/ta thā ga ta ma nu sma ra/ sma ra sma ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta risat+ya dzim nu sma ra/dharma sat+ya ma nu sma 9ra/ sarga 5 sat+ya ma nu sma 51ra/ da ta da tagan/ pū ra pū rinar / pū ra ya pū ra yagi / pū 55ra ṇir / bha ra bha ra ṇi rje/ a ma le/ su maṅga la / shān+ta ma ti/ shu bha 5 ma ti/ maṅga la bha ni/ ma hā ma ti/ ma hā ma ti/59bha dra ba ti/ pra gu bha gu ba ti/ su tsan+d+ra ma ti/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gtsug / sa ma ya ma nu snyo ra swā hā/ ā 64ba ra ṇi 5ma nu sma tsitsir swā hā/ pra bha ba ma nu sma gyi ra 91—682

swā hā/ dri dī 1ma nu sma 2ra swā hā/ te dzo rnam nu sla 4ra swā hā/ bi dza ya ma nu sma 5ra swā hā/ skṛ 6da ya ma nu sma 7ra swā hā/ sarba satwa bi na ya ma nu sma nar swā hā / oṃ ba 9su dhā 1 re swā hā/ oṃ ba k+ṇi su shri 12ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī 1 ba 1 su swā hā/oṃ ba 15su swā hā/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs te17/gzungs sngags 1 'di'i mthus mu ge 1 dang / nad dang / 'chi ngas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 19la mchod pa 2 byas te/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag nub gcig bton na/ de nas dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /rgyas pa'i don du bdag gi khyim mam21/ gzhan gyi khyim mam / gnas gtsang ma dbang mdzod dam/ gnas gang du yang rung bar de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lha'i phyir tsan+dan gyis 25dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas te/ nub gcig bton na/ rigs kyi bu de'i khyim nor bu cadang / 'bru dang / gser rjedangul dang / yo byad thams cad kyi rgyun 2 mi chen po'i tshang 9tsam gyis gang bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang /gnod pa thams cad kyang med par 'gyur ro / /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir khyod rab tu bsgrims 1la nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di zung zhing / chongs shig /lhogs /shig /ston cig /gzhan dag la yang dag par rab tu ston cig dang ske/ de 5khyod kyi 7yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das las nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di thos nas tshim 91—683

zhing dga' la mgu zhing yi 1rangs te/ rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang /yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis nor gyi rgyun ces bgyi ba blangs lags/ gzungs su zin lags/ bzung 2lags / bklags salags/ kun chub par bgyis calags/ rjes su yi rang 5bar bgyis ( lags te / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par bgyi 8lags so/ /de'i skad cig tsam la khyim bdag zla ba 9bzang po'i bang mdzo 1 rnams yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas te11/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i khyim nor dang /'brus yongs su gang ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / mdzod chen po dang / bang mdzod yongs su gang ba rnams la 12stos/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas kau shāsbyi'i 1 grong khyer chen po ga la ba dang ske/ khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i khyim ga la ba der song ste 14phyin nas nang du zhugs pa dang / nor dang / 'brus 15yongs su gang ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ske/ rin po che phun sum tshogs pa dang / yo byad thams cad kyi mdzod 17chen po dang / bang mdzod rnams kyang yongs su gang bar mthong ngo mthong nas kyang tshim zhing dga' la mgu zhing yi 1 rangs te rab tu 12dga' ba dang /yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas tshe 91—684

dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ya mtshan du 'dzin cing / 1dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis khyim bdag zla ba bzang po nor mang ba 2mdzod chen po dang /bang mdzod rnams kyang nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu khyim bdag zla ba bzang po cadad cing mchog 5tu dad cing 6dge ba'i bsam pa can des nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di bzung 7zhing rab tu bton 8te/blangs shing / bklags9/ kun chub par byas/ rjes su yi rang bar 1 byas shing ske/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan 1 pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis kyang nor gyi gzungs 'di long zhig lha /chongs shig /lhogs shig /ston cig /zung 1 shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig 15dang / de ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse 7ba dang / skye bo phal po che dang / lha dang / 1 mi rnams kyi don dang 1 / phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo su zhig rig sngags 'di las gzhan du smra ba ni lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang /tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa dang / lha 19dang ske/ mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ngas ma mthong ngo //lan gnyis su bton 2tam/ lan gsum du bton dkyang 'gal bar byed pa de ni gnas med do/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni mi phyed pa yin no/ /kun dga' bo 'di dag ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba zad 91wa 685

pa rnams kyi rna lam du grags 1par mi 'gyur na glegs bam la yi 2ger bri 4ba dang ske/ yid la gzung 5ba lta ci smos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 6bka' stsal 7te / gzungs sngags 'di ni sems can dbul po dang / nad sna tshogs kyis 9gzir ba dang / 'jigs pa dang /sems can sdang bas gnod par byas pa thams cad kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa dang / bshad pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang /rab tu phye ba dang / bsngags pa dang / bkrol 1 ba dang / gsal bar mdzad pa dang / bskyed pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa dang / chos kyi 11phyag rgyas btab pa dang / bstod pa dang / snyan par brjod pa dang / go bar 1 mdzad pa dang / bsnyad pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te1da/ de'i tshe thal mo sbyar nas ched du brjod pa 'di 1 ched du brjod cing tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 15bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam gyis mi khyab lags/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dad rnams kyis17/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam gyis mi khyab lags / /zhi ba ci yang mkhyen pa thams cad mkhyen/ /chos kyi rgyal po rga shi mi mnga' ba/ /ye shes pha rol bgrod par phyin 1 gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 1 tshim zhing dga' 19la mgu zhing yi 2 rangs nas rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to21/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di na ji ltar gzung 2 bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di ni khyim bdag zla ba bzang 91—686

༄ga /tshogs kyi bdag po chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba/1༄7na / borgya gar skad du/ ma hā ga na 72pa ti tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad dul/ tshogs kyi bdag po )chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dpal ldan tshogs bdag che/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag dgyes(4/ /gzugs brnyan tsho rimaṇ+ḍal gru bzhir bzhag /zla ba drug tu mchod par bya/ / lha yi 6'khor los sgyur 7ba dang / /tshe 'di nyid la skal ba (8)mnyam/ /bsod nams chen po thob par 'gyur/ /longs spyod lha dang mnyam pa dang / /tshe yang ring ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /mi la sogs pa dbang du 'gyur / / lha yi 99bu yang bran bzhin 'gyur/ /bdag gi bsgo 7ba nyan par 'gyur / /klu yang de yi bsgo 11ba nyan/ /bran bzhin las rnams byed par 'gyur / / lha yi mi longs spyod mnga' ris las/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i skal ba can/ /gdul bya'i dbang gi 1 sku 91—707

sprul pa/ /lha chen tshogs bdag chen pos bya/ /dngos grub dam pa mchog sgrub ②na / /mthu stobs phun sum tshogs ldan zhing / /longs spyod yid bzhin 'phel bar byed/ /'jig rten phan mdzad lha yi lha/ /gang gis (gemachod pa dngos grub yin / /lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po'i rgyud las dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi dag bya ste/ / ba yi lci bas legs par byug /'jam 5zhing mnyen la dbus mtho ba'i/ /dbus su tshogs bdag sku gzugs bzhugs/ /me tog dkar pos de la gtor/ /bdag nyid gcer bur byung byas te/ /log 'dren gzugs kyis (eyang dag mchod / /ba ra ta ka tsho skuzla ba drug /nyin re bzhin du dus gsum du/ /gsang sngags brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /yid la re ba thams cad rdzogs/ /bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ ni bkra shis dpal dang ldan/ /gsang sngags mgo la gzhag 8 par bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /dngos grub ster 9byed yi ge yang / /de 'og gral la gzhag nya ༄par bya/ /nyi ma lta bu'i yi ge yang ske/ /de yi rjes la bklag (11par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang po/ /yi ge mchog ni blang bar bya/ /gsal byed yi ge dang po yang / /de yi mjug /2tu brjod par bya/ /rin chen yi ge swā zhes bya/ /las kyi yi ge hā zhes bya/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /lha chen dngos grub sgrub pa'i rgyud las lha'i dngos grub kyi gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //91—708

de nas tshogs kyi bdag po bshad/ /tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar/ /glang po che yi mgo bo can/ /mche ()ba ya nagacig chag pa dang / /phyag g.yas la phug bsnams pa②/ byi ba'i stigadan la bcibs 5)pa6/ rin po ches 7 sku brgyan pa / zla ba tshes pas dbu brgyan 98ri pa/ 'od gsal ba/ 'od zer 'phro ba/mdog bzang ba/ kha dog bzang ba/ gsus pa che ba/ rgyan gyis spud 3)pa'o/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i rgyud las tshogs kyi bdag po bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par me tog dkar po blangs te/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku gzugs bris te/ kha dog dkar po glang po 7che'i dbu can/phyag g.yas na la phug bsnams pa/ g.yon 11na rin po che'i nor bu bsnams pa/gsus pa che ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan ri12pa/ zla ba dang byi ba'i 12khri la bzhugs pa mkhas pas bya'o/ /de la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bdag la zhal phyogs par bzhag la/ bdag nyid log 'dren gyi gzugs kyis 7yang dag par mchod do/ /tshogs kyi bdag po zhal gcig paphyag bzhi pa sgrub pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o // //de nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams su tshogs kyi bdag po dkar po glang po che'i mgo can/ byi ba tshal zhon pa/ mig gsum pa/ zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa/g.yas na la phug dang dgra sta / 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa tri shu tu la dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/lte/ /lag pa g.yon pa 2 khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo dang gung mo 91—709

bu'i yi ge las/ /nyi ma'i yi ge 'og tu spras/ /dbyangs yig drug pa'i 'og tu sbyar / /thig le nā das brgyan par bya/ /mtshan gyi dang po'i yi ge ni/ /de yi rjes la brjod par bya/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pa de nas sbyar/ /lnga pa'i dang po bri bar bya / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang po/ /'byung ba rlung gi yi ge yang / /dbyangs yig brgyad pas brgyan pa ni/ /de yi rjes la bri bar bya/ /zhi ba'i yig 'bru gnyis pa yang / /kun gyi 3)mthar ni brjod par bya/ /mtshan gyi rigasang sngags zhes bya ba/ /'dod pa thams cad grub byed yin/ /mtshan gyi dgasang sngags bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad 0par bya ra/ /skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par ni/ /me tog dkar po'i rtsa ba blang / /tsan+dan dkar po dag las ni/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku gzugs ni/ /mthe bong gi ni tshad tsam bya/ /gsus pa che la phyag bzhi pal/ /mkhas pas byas te legs par bya/ /rin po che yi snod du gzhug6 /dkar chen mngon par gsal 7ba'i tshe/ /nang gi cha ris sku khrus gsol/ /gsal zhing dngas ( —skal yid du 'ong / /dri dang ldan pa'i bum pa yi9/ /me tog dkar po'i dri yi ⑩ni/ /'dag chal ldan pas khrus bya'o/ /de nas de ma thag tu ni / /dkyil 'khor dbus su spyan drangs la/ /me tog dkar po dbul bar bya/ /la phug la dur bcas pa yi/ /gtor ma chen po'ang de nas dbul/ /spos dang dri dang mar me dang / /lha bshos dag gis mchod par bya/ /gsang sngags 'di 11la phug dang / /la du dang / chu dang / dkar gsum gyi 12gtor mas tshogs kyi bdag po la phul te/ spos dang me tog rnams kyang dbul/ de ltar byas na 91—711

sgrub pa'i zhal zas bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas cho ga bshad par bya/ /dngul zhes bya ba'i rin chen la/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i gzugs byas te/ /yid bzhin nor bu ti lag na thogs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po khru gang tshad/ /rin chen 2me tog dkar po dgram / /gsang sngags 'bum du bzlas byas pas/ /nad dang sdug bsngal zhi bar 'gyur/ /shel dang dung las tshogs bdag sku/ /mkhas pas ji ltar 'byor par bya/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar 'gyur/ /rin chen shel las tshogs bdag sku/ /mthe bong 0gi ni tshad tsam bya/ /se na pra zhes bya ba'i sngags/ /rig pa 'bum du bzlas byas te/ /shel gyi sku de khrus byas nas/ /skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par ni/ /bdag nyid shar du kha bltas (5༄nas/ /gos dkar gyon te khrus byas la/ /thal sbyar yid kyis (zhenagasol pa gdab/ /bdag la gnod pa'i bgegs gang yin/ /shel gyi sku de me long steng sma/ /mi g.yo mi 'gul rab tu bzhugs / /bdag nyid khrus byas shar du blta/ /dza ra pa dang rkun ma ni/ /gang yin me long nang du 'byung / /de tshe de yi /ngos zin 'gyur/ /tshogs bdag shel gyi sku de ni/ /mchod pa rab gsal 7legs byas la/ /nā 11ga ku ru zhes bya ba'i/ /rig pa 'bum du bzlas byas na/ /nad dang sdug bsngal 12gyis nyen la/ /sku de bstan pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad rnams thams cad sos par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal las kyang thar bar 'gyur/ /zhi ba chen po'i cho ga yin/ /rin chen gser zhes bya ba la / /tshogs bdag chen po'i 1 sku byas te/ /rgyal gyi nyin par mig phye nasang/ /mchod pa gerab tu gnas pa bya/ /ba ra zhes bya'i gsang sngags ni/ /'bum 91—713

gsad hu)pa'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum la/ de'i nang du 9gedagra bo'i gzugs spra tshil las byas pa rid pa/ gnag pa/ skra zeng dab/ til mar gyis byugs te/snying gar ④ming rus bris la gzhug go/ /de'i sker ro skra las byas pa'i thag pa gdags so/ /de ltar byas nas tshozheriganod sbyin chen po brgyad la/ la du dang /la phug yidang bcas pa'i gtor ma dang / gnod sbyin chen po brgyad la nya sha dang sgog btsong ⑦du sbyar ba'i dmar gyi gtor ma re re bsham/ klu chen po brgyad la gtor ma che ba gcig dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi la re re bya/ gal te ma 'byor na che ba gcig bya/ lha bshos re re dbul bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang drag po'i rdzas sbyang ki'i (8)thod pa dang / zi ra 9rinag po dang / ske tshe dang / yungs kur 0dang / yungs hu7nag gzhag 32par bya'o/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad nyi par bya/ /bsgom nyi tshopa'i rim pa 'di lta bu/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ /shin tu gsang ste bsgrub par bya/ /ya yi rang bzhin stong pa las/ /snang ba 35rang bzhin hūm̐ dang ni/ /ya tshogs brgyad pa'i sa bon 'byung / /ming tegi sngags las rab tu bskyed/ /khro bo'i 1 sprul pas stong gsum bkang / /'od bsdus thog ma'i hūṃ la 418'dus/ /tshogs kyi bdag po chen po de tshe/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa ni/ /khro bo chen po 'jigs pa'i gzugs / /yum dang 'khor yang rdzogs par bskyed/ /phuḥtsho tshobargyad klu brgyad sems dpa'i tshul/ /rgyal po de bzhin khro bo'i tshul/ /yi ge lha 2dang ming las bskyed / /'od zer tshul 22gyis spyan drangs la/ /dzaḥ dang dzaḥyi ga'aphro 'du tso91—717

gzhan 'phrul dbang byed la thug pa man chad bcing bar ①bya'o/ /'og tu ni sems can dmyal ba la thug pa yan chad bcing bar bya'o/ /thad ka kho ra khor yug tu ni ri la thug pa tshun chad bcing bar bya'o/ /de'i sngags 'di dag kyang bzlas par bya ste/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ ru ru du bi rdo getiṣ+ṭha ba hoḥ tsho ru ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba hosmi ⑤su hā/ 'di bton pas rims dang / nad dang / mi ngas dang /nyes ⑥pa thams cad dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / g.yan pa la sogs pa'i nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro swā hā/ lha mo nag mo chen mo'i gzungs rdzogs so༅// //bsdur mchan/742 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉de bi/ 〈〈khu 〉〉de'i/ ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉li/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dha/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ṇi/ (6)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉por/ smyo ni〈〈khu 〉〉pos/(de〈〈snar 〉〉rigs pa 'di/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉 rig pa 'di/ 15〈〈zhol 〉〉gis/ 1 sna〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 lhamo/742 0)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcings par/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉 ro ru/ rdo ste〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rtse/ 4〈〈g.yung 〉〉bud sto si/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bad sto si/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bā to si/ 〈〈khu 〉〉tha tiṣ+ṭha pa hoḥ/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉ba to si/⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉snye tiṣ+ṭa bad sto si/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bi tiṣ+ṭha bā to si/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 bar bltas/ sti〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sto/91wa 743
brtsar 'bras re'u mig da 'asgem/ (216)91wa 744

༄ga /dpal lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa rgyal po'i rgyud/9)༄tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī de bī kā li rdo pra ma rā dza tan+t+ra kā (5 li/bod skad du/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa rgyal po'i rgyud rig 4)sngags dang gsang sngags kyi mnga' bdag dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ ri rab kyi rtse mo rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal chen po na bcom ldan 'das dpal drag po chen po phyag na rdo rje lus bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ srid pa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid dang ldan nas bzhugs so/ /'khor ni brgya byin dang / sha za dang / srin po dang ske/ ma mo'i tshogs bye ba dung phyur gyis bskor te bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dpal phyag na rdo rje pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te bka' stsal pa/ nga'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad nyon cigazha /'dod pa'i khams 'di na bdud kyi ma gshin rje'i sring mo zhes bya ba rgyal tshab chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 91—745

bstan pa 'dzin pa cig yod kyis 1/ khyed kyis de la mchod pa gyis shig /bstod pa gyis shig /ngas kyang khyod la byin gyis brlab bo zhes bka' stsal pa dang ske/ 'khor gyi nang nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin stan ldesalas langs te dpal lha mo nag mo la dge ba bcu'i sgo nas bstod pa/ sngon 'das bskal pa dang po'i pha rol na/ /dge bcu'i las la sems rab cher sbyangs nas/ /lam gyi khyad par gong ma rab rdzogs kyang / /mtho ris skyes pa rnams la dge ba bcu'i/ /tshul gyis don mdzad phyi rol bsgyur snib yi/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'das pa'i dus na srog gcod rab spangs pas/ /sku tshe ring zhing gzugs byad phun sum tshogs/ /gzhan gyi lan chags gnod pa'i rkyen dang ldan / /'chi bdag 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma byin len spangs 4tshul la rab spangs sgrupas/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis 6)longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /gter gyi longs spyod mi 'grib rab brtan brnyes/ /sbyin pa'i gter 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mi tshangs spyod pa'i bka' (7)rnams bsrung 8ba dang / /mngal gyi grong khyer dman 9las rnam par 'phags/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags ring du 7spangs pa ste/ /dge sbyong chen mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod / /nyon mongs brdzun 11tshig spangs pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /1gegasung gi dngos grub 'jig rten 'dul ba'i gtso/ /gsung mchog rnam dag brnyes pa'i rang bzhin te/ /bden par gsung 1 ba khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phra ma'i skyon spangs mi phyed 'khor dang ldan/ /nyid la rnam par dul r+shaba'i 'khor gyis bskor / /lha dang lha min bden pas 'dul mdzad ma/ /dkar mo'i 'khor tshogs khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ngag 'khyal spangs pa'i yon tan sbyin pa 91wa 746

yis / /ting 'dzin rtse gcig mi g.yo bar chad spangs/ /dgos 'brel tshul gyis bstan pa skyong mdzad ma/ /byis pa 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nga rgyal khengs sems spangs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /zhi ba'i tshig 'jam lha mo dbyangs snyan ma/ /tshig rtsub gshe ba'i gnyen po byed pa ste/ /ngag rtsub 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod1rwa/ /rang sems brnab sems spangs pa'i khyad par ni/ /'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnam par spangs pa'i rtags/ /bdag med rtags su seng ges rna ba brgyan ci/ /brnab sems spangs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod / /gzung ba'i yul la gnod sems rnam par spangs/ /phyi rol yul 'di gnyis med chos su gzigs/ / gang la (ciganod sems yang dag spangs pa'i rtags / /sbrul gyi rna rgyan sku)can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /log par lta ba'i chos 5phyogs rnam spangs te/ /sangs rgyas chos las 'khrungs pa'i gzugs brnyan khyod/ /lta ba rnam par dag pa'i ngang tshul can/ /spros bral don dam ston la phyag 'tshal bstod / /'jig rten 'di na las gnyis dag ma dag /ma dag mi dge bcu las ngan song grub/ /dag pa'i dge ba bcu las mtho ris grub/ /las 'di dge ba dang por rab sbyangs pas/ /gong tsho rinas gong ma'i sa la rab gnas kyang //dge 7ribacu'i (2)rtags ni dman pa'i zhing 'dir bstan/ /gdug pa'i 9tshul can 1 'gro ba 'dren mdzan ma/ /bstod par 'os pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo la/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos sras kyis lam rnam pa lnga'i tshul gyis bstod pa/ dam pa rnams kyis bgrod pa'i khyad par ni / /tshogs kyis sbyangs nas 1 don dam mthong ba yi12/ /gnyen po ye shes rim par sgom 1 pa la/ /mthar phyin pa la gshegs pa'i don mchog lags/ /de bas 91—747

lha mo khyod kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /'di ltar rab ldan khyod kyi khyad par te/ /dang po'i tshogs las yang dag rab bsags pas/ /dang po'i 91༄sa las sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin brnyes/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa la don dam ni/ /rnam par mi rtog skye med tshul gyis gzigs/ /dpal ldan byang chub sems dpa'i khyad par ni/ /rang sems sa gnyis dag la rab brten nas/ /de bzhin sa gsum dag pa'i pha rol son/ /rang sems bzhi pa'i sa la cher bsgoms pas/ /lnga pa'i sa la bsam gtan pha rol son/ /rang sems drug pa'i sa la cher sbyangs pas/ /bdun pa la ni thabs kyi na/pha rol son/ /rang sems brgyad pa nyid la cher bsgoms pas/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo smon lam nyid/ /dgu pa la yang stobs kyi yon tan sgrub/ /de yi stobs kyis ri ye shes 'phen par 'grub/ /'di dag rnam par rdzogs par byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas sa (4)la smin pa'i smon lam can / /sa brgyad non pas gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang ma/ /'gro ba 'dul phyir drag mo'i 5tshul ston cing / /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag kyang khyod kyi lam ltar myur 'grub shog /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can gyis dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo la gnyis su med pa'i sgo (yenas bstod pa/ dpal ldan lha mo gnyis su med pa ste/ /don dam spros bral chos nyid 'di las btsal / /don dam kun rdzob gnyis su med pas 98)bden/ /'khor ba myang 'das 9gnyis su med pas zab/ /sems can sangs rgyas gnyis su med pas 'phags/ /las dang rnam smin gnyis su med pas bstod/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis su med pas smin/ /yul dang yul can gnyis med gcig gi ngang / /spros dang spros med don dam dbyings kyis bsdus/ /bsod nams 91—748

ye shes gnyis med tshogs chen te(1)/ /mthong dang dam pa gnyis med dag pas bstod / /bdag dang gzhan gyi chos ni ngang tshul gcig /gzung (5dang 'dzin pa gnyis med zab mo'i mthu/ /mtho ris ngan song gnyis bral dag pa'i zhing / /bzang ngan gnyis med rang bzhin gcig gis darabastod/ /bskyed ༄med rdzogs pa gnyis med lhun grub mchog /sems dang phung po gnyis med sems nyid de/ /sgrub dang bsgrub bya gnyis med grub pa'i ngang / /bdag gzhan gnyis med tshul mchog gcig gis bskyodardon/ /yab dang yum mkha' gnyis med byang chub sems/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i don/ /stong dang mi stong gnyis med zhi ba'i ngang / /gyur dang 'gyur med rtsol bral phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgra tshig gnyis med brjod pa med pa'i ngang / /lus ngag gnyis med sems nyid gcig gi tshul/ /rtsol byed rtsol (65bya gnyis med don gcig pas/ /rnam par spros med don dam dbyings kyis bstod/ /mu stegs (7)sangs rgyas gnyis med tshul gcig pasal/ /dbyings dang ye shes tshonaganyis med don rtogs te/ /srid dang rnam grol yang dag don gcig pas/ /thams cad gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi dang nang med gnyis med 99gcig gi 〉ngang / /sems ldan sems med rnam dag zhi ba'i tshul/ /snang dang mi snang gnyis med gcig gis 11mthong / /gnyis med don mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'di dag rnams ni don dam zab mo'i tshul/ /spros pa med pa'i don dang lha /'brel pa ste/ /'di rnams lha mo khyod kyi 1 thugs la gsal/ /'di ltar bstod pas bdag kyang khyod ltar shog /de'i tshe de'i dus na dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pas dpal lha mo la phrin salas kyi sgo nas bstod pa/ sems nyid phrin tshalas rnam tshabazhi'i nya khyad par ni/ /sems 91wa 749

nyid gud na med cing sems kyang med/ /don dam spros bral kha dog gzugs kyang med/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems/ /mthun 1)par bstan pa'i zhi ba'i nadapal lha mo/ /snye mdzad zhi 'gyur zhi ba'i ngang tshul can/ /zhi ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni/ /rtags kyi sku mdog dkar mo shin tu dngas ril/ /kun du zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gi dgra dang nad rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /mthun 955par bstan pa'i rgyas pa'i dpal lha mo/ /rgyas mdzad rgyas 'gyur rgyas pa'i ngang tshul can/ /rgyas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni/ /rtags kyi sku mdog ser mo shin tu brjid/ /kun du rgyas mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gi 6bsod nams ye shes rgyas par mdzodam/ /mthun 7par bstan pa'i dbang mo 8dpal lha mo/ /dbang mdzad dbang bsgyur 99dbang gi ngang tshul can/ /dbang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni/ /rtags kyi sku mdog dmar mo shin tu brjid/ /kun du dbang mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gi nad dang dgra rnams dbang du mdzod/ /mthun 51 par bstan pa'i drag mo 41 dpal lha mo/ /drag mdzad drag 'gyur drag mo'i ngang tshul can/ /drag mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni/ /rtags kyi sku mdog nag mo shin tu brjid/ /kun du drag mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//bdag gi nad dang dgra rnams drag mos sod/ /khyod kyi rang bzhin cir yang ma grub la/ /'di ltar 'dzin 12nyid cir yang snang 1 ba ni/ /phrin tshalas rnam skabazhis 17'gro don mdzad pa lags/ /bdag kyang las bzhi rang bzhin lhun grub nas / /khyod ltar gzhan gyi don la brtson par shog /de nas dpal lha mo nag mo la klu'i rgyal po dga' bos sku'i yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ gsang 91wa 750

sngags rnal 'byor grub pa'i bdag nyid ma/ /yon tan rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/ /don du snang ba med kyang gdul bya'i phyir/ /rtags kyi phyag rgya 'di ltar bstan pa'o/ /khams gsum gdul phyir gdan du bong bu zhon/ /mya ngan mi 'da'i rtags su lcags sgrog mnga'41sa/ /bdag don lhun grub glang chen ko bas brgyan gel/ /gzhan don phun sum tshogs phyir re ldes dkris/ /byang chub sems ldan spyi gtsug zla rgyas gsal/ /shes rab rtogs phyir lte ba nyi mas brgyan ci/ /dug gsum sdong po gcod pa'i ral gri dang / /bsod nams gter gyi phyag mtshan ne'u le bsnams/ /dbang drag rdzogs phyir ral pa kham nag sprug /nyon mongs 'dren phyir rno dbal mche ba gtsigs/ /'khor ba ljags la gtar 4)phyir rkan (5 sgra brdebacas/ /gdug 9)pa zhe 8ril gnod 9liphyir sdang mig bgradabo/ /thams cad dbang du sdud (11phyir spyan rtsa dmar/ /snyoms pa'i tshogs mchog mi 'gyur sku mdog gnaganyu2 /ma mo 'dul phyir dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sku gsung thugs 1lhartags 0phyag rgya kha ṭī gsor/ /sku gsum rdzogs byed thod pa'i phreng bas brgyanam/ /drag po myur mgyogs bstan phyir tshub mas brgyanak+ṣa/ /nyon mongs sreg tsophyir me dpung 18nang na bzhugs/ /'dod khams skyong nyurtaphyir yongs 'du'i 2 )shing la brten / /lha min 'dul phyir rdzong gi dka' zlog tsho rtam/ /dpa' brtan bstan /phyir stag gi sham thabs bsnams / /bstan pa bsrung na phyir drag mo'i cha lugs 6rdzogs/ /nga rgyal dbang bsdud 2 bdag med sgra sgrogs 58phyir / /thabs kyi snyan cha g.yas pa seng gis brgyan rta/ /zhe sdang dbang 'dul dug chen 'dul ba'i phyir/ /shes rab snyan cha g.yon pa sbrul gyis brgyan / /'du byed mi rtag rtags su dril bu sgrogs 1/ /chags phyir rngam mdzad rak+ta'i rinarba 91—751

klong 1'thung / /dam tshig bsrung ri phyir zhing lpags rgyan du mdzad/ /tha dad las /rnams 'dul phyir rma bya'i 'phru/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams rab sbyangs canas/ /ye shes rig pa'i tshogs rnams shar ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin gnas mchog byang shar mtshams rinan brten / /dbu ma'i sa la gnas phyir dre'u la 7zhon/ /nyon mongs gdug pa 'dul phyir ma yi tshul/ /mkha' 'gro ma mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas grul bum gyi rgyal po sbrul mgo dgu pas dpal lha mo nag mo 8la sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas bstod pa/ don dam gnyis med byang chub sems yin yang / /srid gsum gdul phyir rtags kyi phyag rgya ni/ /rang sems rnam dag drag po'i gzhal yas khang / /rak+ta 9)khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil pa las/ /keng rus thod phreng zhing gi pags pas brgyan / /sku mdog gnag hunyel rab 'jigs khro mo rgyal/ /sngon mo ral pa 'dzings ma'i 1 sprul pa 'gyed/ /sku yi sprul pa dpal ldan re ma dzu51 / /gru gsum ser nag zhal gyi dbyings su bzhengs / /yon tan rgyas mdzad ser mo mkha' la bzhad/ /phrin ribolas rgyas pa thams cad nye bar mdzod/ /gsung gi sprul pa dpal ldan re ma ti/ /gru gsum dmar nag zhal gyi dbyings nas bzhengs15/ /dmar mo chen mo dmar chen gtum ma ste/ /dbang gi phrin salas thams cad grub par mdzod/ /sku gsung thugs ldan sprul pa rgya mtsho ma/ /drag po 'joms mdzad bdud dpung zil gyis gnon / /'gro drug sgrol mdzad sems can kun gyi ma/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobasakye tsho/ /de nas dpal 1 lha mo la lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags zangs /tsheris kyis don dam pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ spros bral 'od gsal yang dag zhi ba'i ngang / /thugs 91—752

kyi thugs mchog rnam dag bden pa'i yum/ /gdod nas stiganyis med nam mkha'i snying po ni/ /dpal ldan khyod kyi rang bzhin khyad par gsal/ /'di ltar rnam dag brjod med ngo bo la/ /byis pa rnams kyis bstod tsha pa byed pa ltung ske/ /blun po rnams kyis dngos por rab brtags nas/ /gzugs can tshul du gang zhig bstod pa'i tshig /rgyal ba'i don yang ( thugs chud khyod nyid la/ /tshig dang yi ge'i pa sgo nas bstod pa rnams/ / nams kyang 9gegrol bar 'gyur ba'i chos nyid min/ /gdod nas gnyis med bde chen ma rtogs 6 par/ /khyod kyi smon lam rtags 7)kyi cho 'phrul la/ /don du bzung 8rinas gang zhig bstod pa rnams / /khyod la brten 9/nas thams cad ltung 1 )bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig skye ba med par shes pa dang / /gdod nas gnyis med snying po bsgoms nyu1nus na/ /gang zag des ni khyod nyid bstod pa yin/ /khyod kyi gzugs dang kha dog 'dzin pa yis/ /bskal pa grangs med 'das par rab bltas kyang / /khyod kyi gzugs dang kha dog mthong mi nus/ /gang zhig gzugs su mi 'dzin rnams kyis 32mthong ske/ /sgra dang tshig dang brjod pa thams cad kyis/ /khyod ni bos kyang bskal par mi thos te/ /'di dag spangs pa'i rnal 'byor de yis ni/ /khyod kyang bos nya la de yang khyod kyis thos/ /gang zhig lus ngag dge bas khyod bsgrubs tshepa'i/ /blun po de yis nams kyang 35khyod nyid spangs/ /lus ngag spangs pa'i sems kyis khyod mchod nas/ /mchod na dngos grub de yis gter 17 thob 'gyur/ /khyod ni rgyal po 1 mang po'i yon tan sdud1 / /chos kyi dbyings na rgyal ba rnams dang mjal39/ /zab mo dbu ma'i rang bzhin ston pa'i phyir/ /mi mjed 'jig rten shin tu rtsub pa 'dir/ /phyi rol tshul gyis thams cad 'dren 91—753

mdzad ma/ /khyod kyi sku ni 'di ltar rab brtags te)pa/ /sgrib pa mang po stong nyid ngang du gshegs/ /stong nyid dam pa stong pa yang dag khyod/ /stong pa gnyis med shes pa rnams kyis ribastod/ /'di ltar bstod na bstod par 'gyur grang bas/ /khyod ni bstod pa'i yul can ma yin yang / /byis pa drang phyir don la 'di ltar bstod/ /de nas nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po rdo rje gser mig can gyis 4dpal lha mo la bstod pa/ dpal ldan lha mo dpag par dka' ba'i don/ /thabs kyi cho 'phrul nam mkha'i mkha' ponanol spyod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa khyod nyid la/ /sgo gsum rdul snyed dbyangs kyis 6phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gis khyod ni mchod pas ma bsgribs tsho75kyang / /dpal ldan dngos grub dam pa thob bya'i phyir/ /'dod pa'i yon tan mkha' la char 'bab 9depas mchod pa'i tshogs 'dis dbang po rgyal gyur cig /dpal ldan khyod ni dge sdig bdag po ste/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa'i tshogs/ /khyod kyi thad du 'gyod pas rab bshags na/ /thugs rje'i shugs kyis sgrib 9pa byang bar mdzod/ /khyod kyi khyad par yongs su 'phags pa ni/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad bdag don phun sum tshogs/ /dga' mthun 1 phrag dog med pa'i spros pa ni/ /rjes su yi rang khyod kyi rgyud la 'bul/ /'di ltar yon tan ldan pa'i sku mchog ni/ /nag mo bzang po 11'jigs pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum kun du 'gro don la/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i tshul gyis bskul bar spobs1rte/ /yang dag khyod ri snyekyi yon tan sku mchog ni/ /gdug pa 'dul zhing bstan pa bsrung khuba'i phyir/ /sems can zad par ma gyur bar du ni/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rigebazhugs par gsol ba gdab/ /'di ltar phyag 'tshal mchod nas bshags tshopa dang / /rjes 91—754

dbyangs gcig gis tshe dang ye shes phonodapag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā (5)yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ saṃ myakle bud dhā rdo ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ pu rje pu bye ma hā pu rje a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu 6 dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ sku ra ④pa ri shud+dha mudharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya tsho'u pa ri bā re swā hā/yang de'i tshe sangs rgyas bye ba phrag sum cu shes drug gis dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis tshe dang ye shes rinanodapag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā 'iyur tshwa na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā 1 ya/ arta te/ saṃ myakle bud dhā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ pu rje pu khye ma hā pu khye a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu 6 dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ sku ra hunyepa ri shurta 1 dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/yang de'i tshe sangs rgyas bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lngas dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis tshe dang ye shes 1nyidapag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā 1 yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā 15ya/ arta te/ saṃ myakle bud dhā saya/ tabya thā/ oṃ pu tre pu tre ma hā pu rtse a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu 5 sna dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ stu ra 'osnyepa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/yang de'i tshe sangs rgyas bye ba phrag gang gā'i 19klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā 1yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā 22ya/ arta te/ saṃ samyakle bud dhā da riya/ tabya 91wa 780

thā / oṃ pu rtse pu tre ma hā pu rje a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu 2 dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra ①pa ri shud+dha (0dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes ri skudapag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger ④'dri'am༄snye/ yi ger 'drir (6da'ajug na de rdo skutshe zad pa las tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur te 58natshe yang ⑨rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga nyu )ba te a pa ri mi ta ā nyunyeyur tshwa na su bi ni: nyurtata te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te / saṃ hunyemyakle bud dhā 6ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ pu rtse pu bye ma hā pu khye a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu rgya dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ tsham sarba saṃ sku ra 10pa ri shud+dha nya dhasmra te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba 32bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes tsodapag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am gi tshoyi ger 'drir —4'jug na de sems can dmyal ba dang byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten du nam yang skye bar mi 'gyur de nam du yang mi khom par skye bar mi 'gyur te/gang dang gang du skye ba thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri ri ci mi ta ā zhu)yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā 2 tshoya/arta te/ saṃ ru myakle bud dhā 59ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ pu rtse pu khye ma hā pu khye a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu rgya dz+nyā na si bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ sku ra 7pa ri shurta 3 dhasmra te ga ga na sa muṅga te /swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ gang ri tshozhig tshe dang ye shes ( 1dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am 2yi ger 'drir lha'ajug na des chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'drir ra 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā tshogeyur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ saṃ 25myakle bud dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ pu ṭī pu khye ma hā pu 91—781

rtse a pa ri 1)mi ta ā yur pu ṣ+yo dz+nyā na si bhā ro pa tsi terin / oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra (cipa ri shud+dha (4 dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/gang zhig 5)tshe dang ye shes rdzu nodapag tu med (7)pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am 'a)yi ger 'drir 9'jug na des 1 skuchos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong byed du bcug pa dang rab tu gnas par byas pa yin no/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā hunyeyur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā 32ga tā ya/ arta te/ saṃ 0myakle bud dhā 1 ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ pu rtse pu rje ma hā pu rje a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu t+ma dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra 7pa ri shud+dha ladharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shurnye ma hā na ya pa ri bā rmorto tshore swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes rtsonadapag tu med pa'i mdo sde 19 'di yi ger 'dri'am da yi ger 'drir 41'jug na de'i mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā 2yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā 22ya/ ta thā ga tā 2༄ya/ arta te/saṃ 5myakle bud dhā 7ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ pu khye pu khye ma hā pu khye a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu rgya dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te / oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra rme pa ri shurta — dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā sdo nore swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes 9dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am 2yi ger 'drir ge'ajug na de'i sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam ra yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /o na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā 5yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā zhusteya/arta te/ saṃ myakle bud dhā ya/ tabya thā/ o pu ṣ+yo pu rtse ma hā pu bye a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu 6 dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ o sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shud+dha dharma songete ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shurnye ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang 91wa 782

na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ sku ra 97pa ri shud+dha dhasmra te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shurnye ma hā na ya pa ri bā re ṭ+wā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes ②dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am ge/ yi ger 'drir (pe'ajug na de de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā ⑤yur tshwa na su bi nirtsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā rdogaya/ arta te/ saṃ lamyakle bud dhā ⑧ya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ pu bye pu rtse ma hā pu ṣ+yo a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu rgya dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te / oṃ sarba saṃ skya ra (ṇa ripa ri shud+dha madharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shurnye ma hā na ya pa ri bā re ṭ+wā hā/ sa phyogs gang dang yegang du mdo sde dkon mchog 'di 'dri 12ba'i sa phyogs de yang mchod rten du 'gyur te/ phyag bya bar yang 'os par 'gyur ro/ /byol song gi skye gnas su song ba'i nyunyebya dang ri dgas 8gang dag gi rna lam du grags nyadepar gyur pa 516de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā ri1 yur dz+nyā na su bi nirtsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā 1 ciya/ arta 37te/ saṃ 2 simyakle bud dhā 1ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ pu rtse pu khye ma hā pu rje a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu ṣ+yo dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro pa getsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā /gang zhig tshe dang ye shes 2snyedapag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am ste/yi ger 'drir so 'jug na de bud med kyi lus su nam yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā jiyur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā 2 ya/ arta te/ saṃ 2 simyakle bud dhā zheya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ pu rje pu rtse ma hā 91wa 784

yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ saṃ ①myakle bud dhā geya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sku ra ②pa ri shurta dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am/ yi ger 'drir 'jug na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu ma med pa'i sangs rgyas (5)kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā yur tshwa na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ si 6)myakle bud dhā (peya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ sarba saṃ smra ra 8pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ⑨ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ sa phyogs gang du mdo sde 'di 'dri ⑩ba'i sa phyogs de yang mchod 7rten du 'gyur te/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /byol 8song gi skye gnas su song ba'i bya dang ri dgas 1 gang dag ribogi rna lam du grag 8par gyur pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ saṃ tsomyakle bud dhā ho ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sku ra 18pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde 'di yi ger 'dri'am/ yi ger nyuḍa'adrir 'jug na/ de bud med kyi dngos por nam du yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā yur dz+nyā na su bi ni: ta te dzo — rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/saṃ myakle bud dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra nyepa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga 2te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ gang zhig tshe dang ye shes 91wa 800

dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'di lta ste/ pad+ma dkar po dang / nyi 'od dang / gzungs 0)kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / pad+ma'i spyan na dang / ye shes dbang phyug dang /pad+ma'i (gyidabang phyug dang / rdo rje 4snying po dang / rin chen snying po dang /kun tu bzang po dang / sgrib pa rnam par sel ba 5)dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang glu/ byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang /phyag na rdo rje dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang / blo gros (phyirargya mtsho dang / mthu chen po thob pa dang / zla 'od dang / dra ba can gyi 'od dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa tsho nodang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad sel ba'i blo gros la sogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 2grangs med pa dang / gzhan yang gtsor byams pa la 9gnas pa'i dge slong mang po 51 )dang ske/ dge slong ma mang po dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma mang po dang ske/ lha'i tshogs dang / klu'i tshogs dang / de bzhin du gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / grul bum dang / sha za dang / mi dang / 11mi ma yin pa nyu2bye ba phrag drug dang / khro bo chen po rdo rje t+t+waṃ mdzad dang / rdo rje gshin rje gshed dang / rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / rdo rje rta mgrin dang / rdo rje bgegs mthar byed dang / rdo rje gtsug tor dang / rdo rje gnod mdzes rgyal po 1snyel sogs pa bdun cu 1 dang / spyan ma dang / mā ma tī 15dang / gos 417dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / 'od zer can dang / dbyangs can ma dang /phag zhal ma dang / khro gnyer can dang / ri khrod ma dang / dug sel ma dang /91wa 827

nor rgyun ma dang / dkar mo dang / yid bzang ma dang / rnam par rgyal ma phudang ske/ dpal phreng mo dang / sa 'dzin bzang mo dang / rdo rje dbang phyug ma la sogs pa stong phrag drug brgya dang thabs cig na tu bzhugs so(ge/ /de'i tshe 'khor de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la bla ma dang / bkur tshogeste dang ske/ rim gror 55bya ba'i phyir mchod pa du mas mchod cing bsngags pa du mas stod 6par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po thugs rje chen po yongs su 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms tso par zhugs ma thag tu sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos shing ltas bco 98)brgyad du gyur 9to/ /de'i ltas de mthong nas lang ku'i rgyal po sgra sgrogs 7shin tu snyems h+phapa dang ldan nas rang gi 12'khor du ma dang lhan cig 1snyeder lhags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 14sgra sgrogs kyi 1 sems kyi rtog 57pa thugs su chud nas sku'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer bye ba phrag du ma byung ngo / /'od zer de dang sa g.yos pa de dag gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyang shi gsal bar gyur to12/ /de'i tshe sgra sgrogs 1rtastems pa dang bcas pas de'i 'khor thams cad kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du yams nad la sogs pas rnam par 'tshe ba de thugs kyis yongs su 2 ridagongs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gdong bcu gcig pa drang srong rig (1sngags 'chang bye ba phrag brgya stong dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags na nas zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i tshogs rnams kyi 2rinang nas lha'i bu rin po che pad+ma'i dra bas brgyan nasnyepa zhes bya ba bzhengs te 91—828

dge bgyis 1)te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du gang brjod pa/ /tshe 'dir phan yon bcu thob 'gyur/ /rtag par lus la nad med dang / /lha dang sangs rgyas kun gyis risabasrung (kyi/ /nor 'bru rin chen gos rnyed dang / /dgra sdang dul zhing 'jigs med dang / /bza' rnams bkur cing rigs btsun thobasku/ /dug dang 'dre gshin (gegadon bral dang / /lus la dri zhim kun dga' dang / /bsam ngan mi snyan rjod 96)byed dang / /rims nad bral zhing dgang sla dang / /dus min 'chi ba sangs par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang yon tan bzhi thob ste/ /'chi khar sangs rgyas zhal mthong dang / /mkha' la 'od 'byung lhas mchod dang / /nam yang ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing / /bde ba can nam bde 'gror skye/ /rig sngags 'di dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes snying po 'dzin pa la/ /byang chub sems dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam par thar pa'i chos sgo 'thob/ /bskal pa du mar dge bsags dang / /rig sngags 'di rnyed 97ci'agyur ba ste/ /dad ldan khrel 8yod ngo tsha shes/ /blo bzang brtson ldan snying rje che/ /mdog dkar ngang bzang gsong por smra/ /sems 'jam 9rulus ngag dal bar spyod/ /bla ma la gus brtul zhugs che / /sred pa chung zhing sbyin la dga'/ /sangs rgyas gus shing sems bcas pasatso / /nyin mtshan rgyun du rig sngags 'don/ /bcu bzhi 'am ni bco 17lnga dang ske/ /khyad par du ni tshes brgyad la/ /gso sbyong sku yi mdun du blang / /skyon 32med tsan+dan dkar sogs shing / /rigs nya bzang las byas sku gzugs sam / /yang na sa rdo rin chen sogs/ /bzang las bde bar gshegs gzugs bya / /yang na ris su bris kyang rung / /sku gcig po 'am lha tshogs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas par byas pa la/ /mngon sum bzhin du dmigs byas na/ /myur du 91—833
