rten 'das mchod dam pa 'dzin/ /thos bsam bsgom ༅brtson de ni dgra las rgyal / /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i ②glu'o / /oṃ tha dad kyis (ge'aching dbyer med grol ba yili/ /thabs dang shes rab bde chen byang chub lam/ /rnam thar ye shes mtha' yas dpal ster ba/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal phreng ma'i glu'o/ /oṃ bsam pa bzang po gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /byang chub phyogs chos dpag bsam shing chen 'khrungs/ /ye shes thugs rje rgyun chu rlan mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid bzang ma'i glu'o/ /sgra sgrogs ⑤'khor bcas 'dar gyur te/ /rlung gis btab pa'i rtswa yidang mtshungs/ /thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas su/ /ched du brjod pas 7 'di gsol to/ /oṃ mgon po rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gtso bo rab tu che ba'i lha/ /bsod nams du mas skyed tsho pa'i sku/ /ye shes mtha' yas thugs mnga' ba/ /blo ldan srid mthar mdzad pa po/ /tshul ldan tshul khrims la sbyor mdzad/ /gtsang ldan bram ze tshangs pa che/ /mdzad spyod mkha' mnyam spyod phyag 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa cheblo/ /'khor la legs so legs so zhes/ /oṃ āḥtrīḥ1 sirgyu swā hā bcas/ /yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ /lcags 1)myu can gyis nya nya ra nas/ /klu phyugs 'bum 1 phrag 'dren pa ltar/ /dge sbyong kun slong dkar pos mini/ /byang chub rin chen gling 'jog mdzad/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o // //91—838

de nas bcom ldan thub pa che/ /mgon po yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sna tshogs snang ba zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms bzhugs tsho)nas/ /yan lag cha shas thams cad las/ /'od zer sna lnga bye ba phrag /drug cu (2 drug cu'i 5cimatha' gzhal ba/ /grangs med dag ni bkye bar mdzad/ /zhing khams grangs med bdun gyi bumatha'/ /phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad du/ /'od kyis tshorigang nas 'od de las/ /snyan pa'i tshigs bcad (6)'di snang ngo / /sangs rgyas dang dzotshoni chos la brnyas (8pa spang 99/ /le lo che dang spyod pa chog 'dzin spang 1 ri/ /'gyod dang chos la ma nges 'byed nyunyapa spang / /nga rgyal che dang 'dod chags spyod pa spang nyu2/ /'gro rnams med na byang chub lam med do3lha/ /'gro la brten nas byang chub che thob 'gyur/ /byang chub che lam thugs rje chen po ste/ /'gro rnams med na gang la skye bar 'gyur/ /de skad grags pa'i 97de ma thag /phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs sangs rgyas sras/ /brjod kyis 1 mi lang gtso bo mchog /spyan ras gzigs dbang grangs 17med gtso/ /thams cad 'khor 1 dang bcas pa rnams / /mi mjed nyu3zhing 'dir lhags 16par gyur sna/ /'di nas shar phyogs zhing khams ni/ /grangs med bdun gyi 21mtha' nyid nas ga/ /zhing khams seng ge spungs par ni/ /sangs rgyas seng ge rol pa yi/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i 32gtso/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge'i sgra/ /mdog dkar shel gyi ri 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems mchog 39bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs / /glog ri lha'agyu 57bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon 2 po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor 22ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yisa'i / /dngul gyi me tog du mas gtor/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs 91—839

rgyas / /'od zer ngo mtshar ①ldan pa dang / /rmad byung sbyo —dachen po'i tshigs nanobacad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur④/ /'gro ba'i gti mug mun pa bcom/ /shes rab mtha' yas gsal bar mdzad/ /bdag kyang snying po 'di yi 95)mthus/ /phrin chunyelas 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ hrīḥ(3)si ha nā da 6)hūm̐ phaṭa/ /snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i 9༄ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs ༅thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs / /lho yi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams rin chen brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dpal tsunabazhugs pa'i/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu 8'khor los sgyur ba byed(snye/ /gser gyi ri bo mdog 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog chosa'agyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor nyu5ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi(14 / /rin chen gser gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor lho 1bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo nyushematshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung che ba'i tshigs bcad nyugekyis/ /zhing rnams rnam na )par g.yos par 'gyur 1ske/ /'gro ba'i ser sna rka snye'aching ba bcad/ /sbyin pa'i 'byung gnas gter chen rdol/ /bdag kyang snying po 'di yi na mthus/ /phrin tsho snyelas 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ pad+ma dhā nalhar dha ke 26rgyu phaṭa/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i 3 ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs )thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /31wa 840

grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams pad+mo brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i nyu)'byung gnas bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i rinagatso/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /pad+ma nir te shwa ri rin/gtso/ /pad+ma rā ci ga'i ri 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig 5snyemakha' la gshegs/ /glog tsho6)'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor 7)ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /pad+ma rā tshonaga'i me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar ri9snamadzad/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ri ldan pa dang / / rmad byung /lhachen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyuranyu20/ /'gro ba'i 'dod chags 'dam rdzob bskams/rnyi/ /tshul khrims byug bospos char du phab/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin malas 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ pad+ma nir te shwa tsher hrīḥ51lha/ phaṭa/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / thub pa'i 51snyeg la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni / /pus btsugs tshethal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /byang gi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams rdo rje bkod pa na/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje thogs med bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sem sa dpa'i gtso tsho/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /thugs rje chen po mi gshol stob/ /rin chen mar gad ri bo (2'dra/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog nasa'agyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ri thob du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /mar ga ta yi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar 2snyemadzad/ /91—841

bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo 41)mtshar ldan pa dang / / rmad byung ponachen po'i tshigs bcad (1)kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur ske/ /'gro ba'i le lo'i nags tshal bsregs(5ra/ /brtson 'grus bskul ba'i me phung sbar/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin (6)las 'di nyid grogs (3)bgyid do/ /oṃ rat+na a 8)gra a pra ti ha ta rtsu phaṭa/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang ske/ /thub pa'i 9ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs 7thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /byang shar phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams tumagater chen brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas don yod 'byung gnas bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i 12gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun don yod zhags tu pa can/ /shel gyi ri bo'i mdog 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor tsob du ma 15byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /rin chen shel gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor khobar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo 1 mtshar 1 ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad 517kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur / /'gro ba'i zhe sdang ri bo bcom/ /bzod pa'i nyi ma lhang 21nger mdzad/ /bdag kyang snying po 'di yi ri mthus/ /phrin na las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ hrīḥtri lokya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha na0a pra ti ha ta hrīḥha 25rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i 25ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs 91—842

thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /shar lho'i phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med 0)bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams bdud rtsi brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas sman gyi 'byung gnas bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun ha la ha la che/ /pu sha ra ku'i ri bo 'dra/ /byang chub sems mchog (2bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ri ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi༅ / /pu sha ra ku'i 95)me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar 965ldan pa dang / / rmad byung 3)chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur9shel/ /'gro ba'i phrag dog dug sdong sbrul9kyi/ /bsam gtan bdud rtsi'i borgya mtsho rlabs/ /bdag kyang snying po de 11yi mthus/ /phrin nyanalas 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ ha la ha la hrī cho18pad+ma gar+bha rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i /zug la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis 8ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /lho nub phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid na/ /zhing khams pad+mas brgyan sapa na/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i snying po bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i 1 gtso / /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun pad+ma spyan gyi 18lung / /zangs ma zhun gyi (19ri bo 'dra/ /byang chub sems mchog bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor 21ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong 91—843

dang ldan pa yi/ /zangs ma zhun gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang/ / rmad byung 1 chen po'i tshigs bcad rdo kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur ske/ /'gro ba rmongs pa'i thibs po bcom/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi lirlung chen 'phyo/ /bdag kyang snying po de dzode yi mthus/ /phrin 6)las rtsoda'adi nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ pad+ma a lo kā ra (8)rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i (rig la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus 7btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /nub byang phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi 11mtha' nyid na/ /zhing khams stong brgya zhes bya bar/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig 12dpal bzhugs so/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso//mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun rdo rje chos dbang phyug /nor bu spug 1lhagi kha dog 'dra/ /byang chub sems mchog (༄bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la 15gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa 7yi/ /spug gi snying po'i 3 tshome tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / / rmad byung nya chen po'i 19tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur rim/ /'gro ba'i mnar sems zhen pa bsal lha/ /mthu stobs chen po'i rdo rjes btab/ /bdag kyang snying po de 22yi mthus/ /phrin snyolas 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā 2 notu hūm̐ na swā hā/ snying po de 29skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i rna ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus 91wa 844

btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /steng gi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs hu)med bdun gyi mtha' nyid na/ /zhing khams gtsug tor brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor rgyal po bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /ha ri ha ri ha ri la/ /zhon zhes rab tu grags pa yi/ /rje btsun chos kyi gtsug tor de/ /in+d+ra nī la'i ri bo risamadog /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /in+d+ra nī la'i me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar mdzad/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas / /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / / rmad byung rdo chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis / /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyuraskyi/ /'gro ba'i log lta'i sgrib g.yogs sel/ / dag pa'i tshonasmon lam 'khor lo bskor/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi (6rimathus/ /phrin 7༄las 'di nyid grogs 98chibagyid do/ /oṃ bh+rūṃ (9༄hrīḥha hūm̐ swā hā / snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i bog la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo 11sbyar nas bzhugs/ /'og gi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi nyurtamatha' nyid na/ /zhing khams za ma tog kyisnyemadzes na/ /sangs rgyas gnon 0pa'i dpal bzhugs so/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun mgrin pa sngon po rgyal/ /an+da nya rnyil gyi ri bo 'dra/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du 91—845

ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /an+da 3)rnyil gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 2ri'athor bar mdzad/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / / rmad byung du nochen po'i tshigs gebacad ⑤kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur(6ri/ /'gro ba'i shes bya'i sgrib nags tso)sel/ /ye shes ral gris rtsa ba bregs/ /bdag kyang snying po de rdzunanayi mthus/ /phrin 59)las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ snying po de 7skad phul nas kyang //thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang tshogs 'dus nas / /rig sngags mthu chen 'chad pa dang / /gzhan don rdzogs par mdzad pa de'i/ /shin tu dga' bar mdzad pa la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya rnams 11ni spyi bor bzhag /'dzum 8pa'i mdangs kyis hunyelegs so byin/ /nam mkha' snyan pa yis kyang ribobakang / /de r+shatshe phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi15/ /khro bo'i pho tshorgyal po ma lus rnams/ /sa steng 572thams cad gar gyis bkang / /g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang zla gam dang / /zlum po gru bzhi gru gsum 'gros / /mchong ci yodang gyed mchongs 2 /hril po dang / /rdebs tsha lhadang btsir 2ba'i tshul gyis su/ /bgegs rnams stabs 2nyekyis tshar gcod mdzad/ /lag pa thal sbyar phye btsum bskyed mi/ /sor mo gcig du gebasnol dzo cigacig 'khyud dang ske/ /kun bsnol 2 kun 'khyud kun gdengs dang / /rgyab bsnol 3res 'khyud kun 'khyud dang / / re mos 29'khyud sgreng sa rikun sgreng dang / /mnyam gzhag 81dang ni mchog gi rgya/ /sa gnon skyabs ri — sbyin mchog sbyin sogs/ /phyag rgya du ma bgegs sel rimadzad/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs/ /91—846

sor drug tshad ldan phur bu ni/ /brjid ldan rtse ri1mo rno dbal can/ /mgo bo rked pa rgya (lde)mdud tshul/ /sor tshad phyed phyed ldan pa la/ /zur ni bcu drug rked pa la/ /sor gnyis zur brgyad ldan pa'o/ /sor gsum zur gsum rtse rno ba / /dbal mtho cung zad par reg pa/ /ngos dang skabs ni zab pa ste/ /sngags kyi byin brlabs ( childan pa brgyad/ /khang ba'i zur dang phyogs bzhi por/ /g.yas su phyogs par gegazugs par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 95dz+nyā na sā tsho ga ra be+e 7ro tsa na byu 8༄ha rā dzā 99ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nya tsho.ar+ha te bh+yaḥsaṃ nyi myakle bud dhā 12ya/ na ma ār+sā 1lhab lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā ñjasatā ya/ ma hā kā 15ru ṇi kā ya/ na mabyuṇ+ḍa tshabadz+ra kro dhā 3 ya/ hu lu hu lu/tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ a mṛ 18te hūṃ phaṭa/ ltas ngan thams cad 'joms 19pa dang / /gnas khang byin gyis brlab 2rtepa dang / /tshe dang longs 27spyod rtag 22pa dang / /dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang / /dang po thal mo sbyar byas te/ /phyis ni lag g.yon sdigs mdzub 2 bcas/ /oṃ dang a la la la ho/ /zhes brjod rngam cing khang lhab yi / /nang du 'jug pa khro bor bcas/ /de nas rtsu sgras se gol gtogs/ /de nas oṃ āḥbadz+ra dang / /s+thā dzin pā 2 ṇi bh+yaḥ.a haṃ/ /rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rtsu phaṭa brjod/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i stan 8la 29ni/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas nas/ / bsrangs te gi mig ni sna rtser phab/ /dal ba'i rlung ldan rkan 2la ni/ /lce ni ricung zad reg par bya/ /lte ba cung zad 'khum pa yis/ /sems ni bag yod gnas par bya/ /rtag pa ma yin mi rtag min/ /gtsang ma 5ma yin mi gtsang min / /bde ba'ang 7ma yin sdug bsngal min/ /bdag dang ngar min bdag 91—875

med min/ /blang dang dor 1ba'i 'jig tshogs min/ /sems ma yin zhing sems byung min/ /phung khams tshon skye mched med ma yin/ /yid min rtag min mi rtag min/ /mun pa ma yin shes rab min/ /'gro min 'ong min gnas ma yin / / sna tshogs sprin glog du ma ni/ /mchi'adod gzugs du ma sgyur ri byed pa/ /mkha' 'byung nam mkha' la ni thim/ /'gro 'ong ston pa 'dod bskul ba33/ /med mod na yang /de ltar spyod/ /yul gyis ma skyes dbang po 9ri min/ /dus kyis ma yin gtan gyis min/ /rgyu dang de bzhin rten 7gyis min/ /gnas skabs gzhan yang de 11la medad/ /de la sems pa'i 1 sems nyid kyang / /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi gnas/ /gar 7yang ma song brtags kyisnyen stong / /brtag 415par byed pa rtog 1 pa tsam/ /dngos rnams brtags 18pa ming tsam ste16/ /kun rdzob tsam du ming yig la/ / brten nas zhe skurang gi 1sems bzung na snye/ /drod kyi bzhi pa dang por bzung lha/ /phyung ba'i gnyis pa de la brten/ /de la dang po gnyis pas bskor/ /dang po'i 24bco 5lngas mnan pa ste dzi/ /bcu drug pa ni grogs su bzhag /yi ge drug la grub pa ni/ /sangs rgyas drug gi rang bzhin te/ /'od zer rnam pa drug tu tsho 2bcas/ /rlung drug gis ni dbang byas nas/ /yul ni rnam pa drug la 'jug /yul drug dag gis 9dbang byas nas/ /nyon mongs rnam pa drug dang bcas/ /nyon mongs rgyas par 'gyur ba yin/ /phung po rnam pa drug dang ldan/ /phung po grangs kyi dbye bas ni/ /yan lag drug drug 'phel bar 'gyur/ /yan lag rdzogs pa'i grib mar ni/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems sgrib byed/ /sgrib gnyis go bas mthug 1po ni/ /bsal 2dka'i lhari bo dang bcas pa/ /rtag chad gnas su zhugs pa'o/ /srog rtsol bsdam tsho pa'i sbyor 91wa 876

ba yis/ /phyi rol snang ba nub par 'gyur/ /rtsol dang bral nas dga' skye ste/ /yi ge la ni sems gnas 'gyur/ /yi ge gsal ba'i 'od zer ni/ /ba spu khung rnams thams cad nas/ /sems dang bcas pa ldang 1 'jug ste/ /slar yang thig le bsdus nas ni/ /yi ge nyid kyang mi dmigs so/ /'dzin pa de las thos nas kyang / /sgyu ma'i rnam pa rjes dran bya/ /de la goms na nas ting 'dzin ni//nyams pa med par pathob par 'gyur/ /ting 95'dzin de brtan 6gyur nas ni/ /lus (7)'dis rig pa 'dzin pa 'thob58ri/ /rig 'dzin de la gnas nas ni/ /bla med byang chub de thob 'gyur/ /skad cig de la dngos 9rnams ni/ /nam mkha' 7lta bur dag nas kyang / /mkha' ltar kun la khyab par spyod/ /rten ni 11spyan ras gzigs dbang ste/ /lus ni 'phags 512pa 'jam dpal lo/ /yan lag phyag na rdo rje ste/ /mgo dang thod cho1lhani ma pham pa/ /gtsug tor sgrib pa rnam sel nyid / /nyi zla kun tu bzang po ste/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' tshadang / /rnam riboshes nyid dang ri bcas pa'o/ /thams cad dbyer med 'gyur ba ste/ /bsam gtan la ni gnas pa'i phyir/ /stsal rnams so sor bsdu bar bya/ /sems glong 17bas ni nges par 'grub/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /dus ni rtag pa ma yin te/ /mi rtog sems nyid 'brel gyur nas/ /dus la tha dad mi rtog go1 / /nyi ma'i 'khor lo chu rgyun dang / /nam mkha'i phyogs na 19ji lta bar / /sems kyang sems kyis btsal bar bya/ /gzhan ni go skabs mi byed 21do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma na dra ba zhes bya ba las/thun mong gi ( /sngags byung ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //91wa 877

de nas drang srong gnas nas ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs ldan zhes bya ba/ /bskal pa du mar sbyangs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rig 'dzin zhig /rgya cher rang gi 'khor bcas la/ /dkyil 'khor drung 1du lhags dusanas ni/ /rmad byung chen po'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /phyag 'tshal bskor 95 ba du ma byas/ /thal sbyar 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis ni/ /ston pa la ni 'di skad gsol/ /oṃ mtha' yas spros pa nyer zhi zhing / /zhi mdzad dul tsho rizhi rab spyod mdzadadun)/ /rtog bcom rtog mkhyen rtog yongs zhugs/ /ye shes kun rgyal phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi las zhi gyur mtha' tsho'achi'abyung ba/ /chos rnams kun mchog zhi chos che/ /spros med las spros dkar bcu bya/ /mtha' yas chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ / grol 'gyur ༷ grol mdzad dag pa che/ /dag par spyod pa gtsang ma mgon/ /tshogs rdzogs tshogs ldan tshogs spyod rgyal/ /tshogs rtag bdag nyid phyag 'tshal lo rab mdzes thugs rje'i nyi mas brgyan / /'jig rten rab gsal mdzad pa'o9ri/ /rtag pa don chen rtag 1 zhugs la/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /khams gsum bag chags 11kyis dkrugs 12pa/ /thibs po'i ling tog 12zhugs pa rnams//mngon du snang bar brjod pa dang / /sems la gsal myur shin tu dga'/ /mngon sum med la brjod bral yang / /lkog tu gyur pa smos kyi cho14dgos/ /lkog don mngon du byed pa la/ /phyag rgya dang ni 'dra 'bag mchog15 /mngon sum thob 17ldan ming nas kyang / /don la sems kyis 1 gsal ba skye/ /don gang yang yang goms pa las/ /sems kyi 'jug 1 pa rtog pa ste/ /de bsal 19mi rtog blo 'bras bu/ /sgom pa'i pha rol phyin pa'o/ /blo dman rnams kyi sna'ajug 21pa dang ske/ /'bring po 'gro bar bya phyir dang / /rnon po rdzogs sangs rgyas 'gyur 91—878

phyir / /gzugs brnyan byung tshul bshad du gsol/ /myur du 'jug 1ridang grol ba dang / /myur du byang chub cher 'gyur cing 2/ /gzugs brnyan dge ba'i tshul 'byung can/ /'dren 4pas de ring bshad du gsol/ /mkha' sprin rtag 5ripa med pa la/ /mtshan mar gzung du med pa ltar/ /rnam rtog gis dkrugs snyusems la ni/ /su zhig mtshan mar 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dmigs pa'i mtshan ma gsal byed pa/ /gzugs brnyan 7tshad dang ldan pa ste/ /legs par 'gyur ba'i yid 'jug cing / /byin brlabs nasanges par 'jug par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dren pa gtsos/ /ljags kyi dbang po rab bkram nas/ /gzugs brnyan dge ba'i tshul byung ba/ /nga 9las nyan 1 par brtson pa ni/ /legs pa 11lha yi drang srong mchog /rig 'dzin byang chub sems khyod legs/ /rtse gcig nyanasems kyis nyan 1lhanas kyang / /legs par gsungs ngapa yid la zhog /khyod la yang dag bshad bya ba/ /byin brlabs dgye ba'i 15gzugs brnyan ni17/ /tshon gyis ris su bris pa 'am/ /rin chen rigs sam sa rdo 'am/ /shing la byas na mchog tu bsngags/ /dang po'i 1 las can sems can la/ /dmigs pa gsal bar 'gyur ba dang / /byin rlabs 12mchog ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /tsan+dan dkar po gsal zhing drang / /gzhon zhing chag gas 19med pa la/ /bsang 2 zhing dud pas bdugs nas ni/ /dad ldan ngang tshul bzang pos bzhag21 /'jig rten dbang phyug mgon gyi sku/ /bco 22brgyad sor tshad ldan pa la/ /gdan khri dag ni sor snyedagu ste/ /rgyab yol sor tshad drug gis bskyed/ /bzhengs te ldem bag nyams dga' ba/ /rin chen du ma'i gzugs kyis brgyan ga/ /g.yas kyi dang po bgrang phreng ste/ /gnyis pa mi 'jigs 7stsol ba'i phyag /g.yon pa 91wa 879

dang po pad+ma dmar/ /gnyis pa ril ba spyi blugs thogs/ /zhal gyi grangs ni bcu gcig la/ /mdun gyi zhal gsum mtshan bzang can/ /byams pa snying rje dga' ba'i mdangs/ /dkar po dkar ser dmar skya bo1ri/ /g.yon gyi gsum ni khro bo'i zhal/ /sgeg pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa ste/ /dmar dang dmar ser le brgan 2no/ /g.yas su gtum po'i 5khro zhal gsum/ /sngo dang ser dang ljang gu'o ri / /rgyab tu khro gtum mdog dmar ba/ /rta skad rab tu 'tsher ba'i zhal/ /khro bo'i gzhal rnams mche ba gtsigs 6/ /mig gsum dbu skra ser po ni/ /gyen du thor tshugs 7bcings pa'o/ /steng du sangs rgyas 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /byi ru bcag pa'i mtshan 'dra ba'i/ /dbu yi cod pan nang rnams su/ /'di dag phyogs bcu'i thub pa rnams/ /re re bzhin du gzhug shepar bya/ /dbu rgyan cod pan ldan pa dang / /rna rgyan mgul 9rgyan dpung 1 tshorgyan dang / /lag rgyan se mo dor 11bcas pa/ /do shal rkang gdub ske 1lharags can)lha/ /rgyan dang na bza' mdzes pas brgyan/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /ri khumo dag la dga' 'gyur 15nas/ /yid gzhungs dal spyod khro ba med/ /sred chung shes rab snying rje che / /thabs ldan ri mo rgyud la mkhas/ /bsam pa bzang ldan tshul khrims bsrung 17/ /'dri 1 chos gzob 1 la gzhungs pa yis/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas su bri/ /gzugs bzang yid dal gtsang ldan pa'i/ /bu mos bkal ba'i ras la ni/ /tshon 19bzang ngur smrig mdog bya'o/ /'thas par 2 ribacags 21te 'jam por bya/ /thig pir 2phyogs su da bshad nas kyang / /ser skya tshon gyi gzugs brnyan ni byu/ /tshad la mkhas pa tshad ldan pa'i/ /nan tan du ni bri bar bya/ /dkar po wa yi shel yin te/ /dmar po sems rtso li khri'o/ /sngon po 91wa 880

rams dang mthing 3)shing ste/ /ser po ba bla tshogedag pa yin9 —no/ /nag po snag tsha nyid yin te/ /ljang gu params dang ldong ros sbyar(lde/ /yang na spong 6rim nyid kyis bya / /smug rtsi rams dang skags sbyar ter sku/ /gzhan yang ci rigs tshonasasbyar bar bya/ /sbyin dang bral na grugs phyorapar 'gyur/ /shing spyin boser dang ka pi ta / /lo mi /nga)ta dang than dza ra/ /de dag so sor sbyar ba yis1rte/ /gsal zhing dkrugs nyartemed dag par byed/ /a ta pas ni snum 0par byed/ /gan to has ni rtag par 'gyur/ /rgyas par gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /yang na sgo gcig pa yang rung ske/ /dkyil 'khor cha rim gsum pa 'am1ge/ /yang na gnyis sam gsum yang rung ske/ /dbus su gdong chosabacu gcig pa 1 ni/ /mdzes pa'i lha mo bzhi ldan bri/ /shar du spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/snye/ /dkyil 'khor rnam snang 1tshegatso bo can/ /de yang spyan sogs lha mo bzhi/ /phyag bzhi pa dang bcas pa'o/ /lhor ni 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /dkyil 'khor shāka 2 )thub gtso bo can/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /'bebs pa'i phyag rgya ldan pa'o/ /nub tu rigs 21ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /sems dpa' bzhi bzhir bcas pa'o/ /dbus su rdo rje dbang mo yang / /mdun du rdo rje rtag pa ste/ /g.yas su rdo rje dpal 'byung ngo //rgyab tu rdo rje dpag med de na/ /g.yon du rdo rje don grub bo/ /shar du lha mo spyan ma ni/ /mdun du rdo rje sems dpa'o 2/ /g.yas su rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje chags pa ste/ /g.yon du rdo rje legs pa'o/ / lhor ni rilha mo mā ma khri ni / /mdun du rdo rje rin chen no/ /g.yas su rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /rgyab tu rdo rje rgyal mtshan no dzī/ /g.yon du rdo rje bzhad na pa yin/ /nub tu na bza' dkar mo yang ske/ /mdun du rdo rje chos yin te/ /g.yas su rdo rje rnon po 2 yin/ /rgyab tu 91wa 881

rdo rje rgyu zhes pa/ /g.yon du rdo rje smra ba'o/ /byang du lha mo sgrol ma yang / /mdun du rdo rje las yin no1/ /g.yas su rdo rje srung 2ba'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje gnod sbyin te/ /g.yon du rdo rje khu tshur ro/ /'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams / /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ste/ /g.yas kyi dang po rang rigs rtags / /gnyis pa ri thams cad skyabs sbyin 4te/ /g.yon gyi dang po pad+ma yang ske/ /phyogs kyi kha dog ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pas phyogs kyi mdog ldan pa'i/ /sngags nor phreng yang 'chang ba'o/ /'khor gyi lha mo de dag kun/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yon pa'i tha ma bum pa 'chang / /lhag ma gong ltar shes par bya/ /byang du khro bo'i dkyil 'khor yang / /khro mo bzhi tshorabazhir bcas pa'o//dbus su rdo rje hūm̐ byed de/ /sngon po ut+pa la yi mdog /mdun du sngo bsangs 6skuchen po ste/ /g.yas su rdo rje drag mo'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje brjed byed 7pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje mthu chen mo/ /shar gyi 'khor lo'i nacha rtsibs la/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed po gnag9 /mdun du rdo rje dbang zhal ma/ /g.yas su rdo rje khyab 'jug mo/ /rgyab tu rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ /g.yon du rdo rje skul 0byed ma/ /'khor lo rtsibs ni mnyam pa la/ /khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub ser/ /mdun 517du rdo rje gnag 12byed mo/ /g.yas su rdo rje me chen mo1 / /rgyab tu rdo rje zla bo mo1 / /g.yon du rdo rje rnon po ma15/ /rtsibs gsum rdo rje gtsug tor ser17/ /rdo rje khro mo khrag 'thung mo/ /rdo rje 51 rlung 'dzin chen mo dang / /rdo rje snang 1 dbyed mor 19bcas pa'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs la rta mgrin dmar/ /mdun du rdo rje rmongs byed ma ske/ /g.yas su rdo rje zhi ba mo/ /g.yon du rdo rje tshol byed ma/ /lnga pa'i rtsibs la de bzhin du/ /khro bo bgegs mthar byed pa ljang / /mdun du rdo rje gsor 91wa 882

byed ma/ /g.yas su rdo rje gtum mo stegyori/ /rgyab tu rdo rje ro langs ma/ /g.yon du rdo rje rengs byed mtshon / /rtsibs drug 'khor lor bri ba ni/ /rdo rje gnod mdzes rgyal ljang sngo/ /mdun du rdo rje chu dbang mo/ /g.yas su dngos 2grub 'byung ba mong/ /rgyab tu rdo rje mtshan mo dag /g.yon du rdo rje mkha' dbang phyug /de ltar rdo rje nakhro bo khro mo rnams/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'o//khro bo phyag gnyis mda' gzhu bkang / /g.yas na 96)be con kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / /tho ba rdo rje rgya gram dang / /'khor lo gtun shing rdo rje rnams/ /rang rtags medaphyag rgya 'chang ba'o/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub tsho zhags pa'o/ /kun kyang stag gi 9sham thabs can/ /khro mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ /g.yas na gri gug cang te'u 1 ste/ /g.yon na thod khrag mkha ṭ+wāṃ ngo / /zhing lpags /rnyedag gi chos gos te/ /gzig 1snyegi pags tshepa'i sham thabs can/ /khro bo'i g.yon na sgeg pa'i tshogs/ /de rgyab cha yi snam bu la/ /phyogs rer lha mo bzhi bzhi dang / /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/ /phyogs rer brgyad brgyad bkod pa ste/ /sum cu 15rtsa gnyis bzhengs 17pa'i tshul/ /de bzhin bskor 1 bzhin sems ma mchog /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog 18dang / /'bebs 19ma rang rtags phyag rgya g.yas//gnyis pa mi 'jigs phyag rgya ste/ /g.yon pa phyogs mdog pad+ma dang / /gnyis pa dar gyi chos gos so/ /kun kyang sgeg nyams ldan pa'o 1/ /de rgyab dkyil 'khor cha la ni/ /shar du brgya byin glang chen zhon/ /g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can/ /g.yon pa phyogs mdog pad+ma ste/ /gnyis pa rang mdog phreng ba bri/ /de yi g.yon du tshangs pa ser/ /ngang pa'i khri la bzhugs pa la/ /g.yas kyi dang po 22nyi ma 'chang / /me 2 phyogs su ni me lha ste //91—883

mdog dmar 1༷ra zhon me phung 9mi'adzin/ /lho yi phyogs su gshin rje sngo/ /thod dbyug bzung ba ma he zhon/ /bden bral du ni srin po gnag( —sku /rtse gsum bzung nas srin po zhon/ /nub tu chu lha dkar po ni/ /klu yi khri la sbrul zhags bzung ske/ /de yi g.yon du sa bdag dkar/ /bum pa bzung (4riste rus sbal zhon/ /lha min phyogs su rlung lha ljang / /ba dan bzung ste sha ba zhon/ /byang du gnod sni sbyin mi la zhon/ /ljang nag phyag na gter sgrom mo/ /byang shar dbang ldan dkar po ni/ /rtse gsum bzung ste khyu mchog zhon/ /sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi / /phyogs kyi kha dog go cha can/ /pi wang ral gri zhags pa can/ /rin chen dbyug tho g.yas kyis 'chang / /gnyis pa skyabs kyi phyag rgya ste/ /g.yon pa ma la bgrang phreng ni/ /phyogs kyi kha dog ldan pa'o/ /kun kyang sgeg nyams phyogs kyi mdog /rim 6bzhin stag gzig dom seng ge'i/ /khri la bzhugs pa'i gzigs pa can/ /rang rang phyogs kyi sgo la ni/ /bsrung tsho7ribartson shin tu 'grus pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor cha brgyad 'khor na yug tu/ /bza' shing me tog spos shing dang / /mdzes pa'i shing tshogs tshal gseb tu/ /mdzes pa'i bya sogs 9dud 'gro dang / /lha yi bu dang bu mo sogs/ /de bzhin klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za grul bum bu mo'o/ /rol mo byed pa du ma bri/ /'di ltar dad na tshol las ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i nang rol du/ /gza' 17dang rgyu skar sum cu 1 drug /rin chen pad+ma la gnas bri/ /smin drug pad+ma dmar spo po 'chang //snar ma mgo ni 1 ut+pa la/ /nab 15so pad dkar lag lotri shul3 / /rgyal ni bgrang phreng skag sbrul nag /mchu ni pad ser bre 1 /mnyam gzhag1rta /me bzhi pad dkar dbo 2 dbyug pa/ /nag pa pad+ma sa ri ras/ /sa ga po ti lha mtshams 2191wa 884

bum / /snron ni rdo rje snrubs thudabyug ste/ /chu stod du ril ba chu smad pad/ /byi bzhin ri rigaser gyi 'khor lo ste/ /gro bzhin ri kyichu skyogs mon gru dang / /mon gre shel sgong khrums stod kyis/ /ral gri snyeskukhrums smad ku mu da9/ /nam gru ba dan tha skar gyis/ /shing lo bra nye dbyug sran tomer/ /zla ba ku mud dkar po ste/ /nyi ma pad+ma dmar po'o/ /mig dmar me yi phung po ste/ /gza' lag ut+pal sngon po'o/ /phur bus chos kyi glegs bam mo/ / pa batsho risangs ni bgrang phreng bzung 9ri/ /spen pa lag na ral gri 'chang / /sgra gcan bdud rtsi'i gzhong bu'o/ /nang gi grwa yi char tshegatogs pa/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad yin te/ /rtag dga' ma dang rgyal ma shar/ /don grub ma dang mi pham nyunyulhor/ /nub tu bde ba bde dga' ma/ /myur grub ma dang gtan ma byang / /rtse lnga rtse gsum rdo rje dang //sngon po ser po rin chen dang / /dkar dang dmar dang ut+pal dang / /ut+pal sngo cho12dang ku mu da/lha/ /dang po phyag na rim bzhin 'chang / /skyabs sbyin pad+ma bgrang phreng ni/ /lhag ma rnams kyis chosarim bzhin 'chang / /de dag thams cad phyogs mdog go/ /rgyas pa'i spros pas skyo na yang / /lnga bcu brgyad dam sum cu ri15bdun / /nyi shu dgu 'am nyi shu lnga/ /bco 7lnga dgu 'am lnga 'am gcig /yi ge phyag rgya gzugs pho brnyan tshogs/ /sprul pa ༅/sku yi cho 'phrul te/ /rang gis nyurtaji ltar 'dod pa yi/ /sems kyi byin brlab 2 nyid du 'gyur/ /bde gshegs sku dang po ti dang / /phyag rgya sogs pa rab gnas bya/ /nyams sam dri mas gos pa ni/ /bkrus tsho 1dang bshig nas dag byed la 2/ /rtog pa med pa'i sems kyis su / /de la bsod nams dpag tu med/ /gzugs sogs sngon snyepas dman gyur kyang zu/ /de yis bsod nams mtha' yas 'thob gi/ /phrin nelas dang ni 91wa 885

sku gsang ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /de bzhin nyid de stong pa nyid/ /byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dang / /mtshan dang dpe byad kun rdzob ste/ /sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'o/ /sum cu 91gnyis dang brgyad cu tshogeni/ /yi ge brda dang spros pa'i sku/ /longs rin sku bsod nams rgyu mthun 4)'bras/ / sprul sku las kyi rnam smin 'bras/ /tsho kun rdzob don dam mtshan nyid ldan/ /dag dang ma dag skal ldan la/ /bde (6cigashegs phrin 57las gzugs shesku gnyis/ /31gas gnyis la ni sku gsum byung / /rnam byang kun nyon mongs pas stong / /lus ngag yid kyi spyod yul min/ /dmigs med nam mkha'i khams rtogs (9)pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi chos sku'o/ /rtag chad med pa'i rten 'brel ni/ /skye 'gag med par thugs chud pa/ rme/ /yid kyi 11rnam shes 'jug lam gyis/ /bsam gtan goms pas shes par bya/ /dad pa'i lcags kyu shes rab can/ /lha klu 'bum phrag dkar po'i sems dge ba/ /kun slong byang chub gter gyi rin chen nor/ /thob par 'dis mdzod 'khor myos sgyur 12ba 'byung / /sems kyi dbus gces de phyir spyod spyad 1 pas/ /dbang por bya ba'i rgyud kun khyad par du/ /pad+ma'i dra ba phyag stong gis brgyan par1 / /myur du sgrub pa'i thabs mang gsungs pa rnams / /bsdus brtson dang byas ldan pas gces su bya/ /bla ma'i lung yod snying rje gang ldan pa/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras tshogs rnams kun dgyes nas/ /'jig rten skyong tshogs dga' ba smos ci dgos/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las gzugs brnyan 'byung ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //91—886

de nas dga' ldan gnas 'khrungs pa/ /bskal pa du mar tshogs bsags pa / /rig pa gsum ldan lha yi bu/ /mdzes pa'i tog ces mtshan gsol ba/ /spyan ras gzigs la cher dad nas/ /bzhengs te thal mo sbyar byas shing / /'khor tshogs chen po dang bcas pas/ /mgrin gcig tu ni 'di skad gsol/ /oṃ khams gsum kun gyi bla ma gtso/ /'dren pa mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sa gsum ye shes 'od po che/ /bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /rig sngags bde ldan byin brlabs 3)can/ /g.yung drung rtag pa dam chos gtso/ /kun rtog sel 92niskyob phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par brtse ldan spyan ras gzigs/ /byang chub sems tshogs 'byung tshogs rgyal/ /bya ba byas nas bskal par gnas/ /pad tshon 'chang tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa du mar bsags pa yi ri/ /thugs rje (55ye shes las byung ba / /rig 53nisngags phreng ba byin brlabs (2༄can/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /sems can rnams la phan don phyir/ /phyag rgya phrin (94las ldan par gsungs / /las kyi dri ma dang ldan zhing / /nyon mongs bdag rgyal kyis bcings nas/ /le lo ser sna'i 'dab 11rdzab can/ /khur dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams/ /myur du grol bar bya ba dang / /thugs rje nyi ma bkram byas te/ /srid 'dab stug sna po skems nyisapa dang / /myur du sangs rgyas 'grub bya'i phyir/ /lha dang gsang sngags blang ba dang / /phrin 1 las sbyor ba ldan pa dang / /brgyud 15pa rgyun gzhan 7med pa yi/ /sbyor ba'i tshul 'byung bshad du gsol/ /rig sngags rjes gnang med pa ni/ /bsgrubs kyang 'bras med ngal ba ste/ /'dren pa med pa'i shing rta ni / /'khor lo bzang yang gang du phyin/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba gcad 1 pa'i phyir/ /91—887

rig sngags ral gri rno dang mtshungs/ /bdag 'dzin go cha 'bigs 1)pa'i mdung ske/ /sdug bsngal mtsho skems 90nyi ma che/ /kun rtog rdul phung bsregs ( —7pa'i me/ /shes rab me tog 'khrungs pa'i brlan/ /nad ngan kun sel sman mchog ste/ /bag tshogs sel ba'i sred med bu/ /bag chags bkrus pa'i dugechu rgyun yinaX6/ /longs spyod 'phel ba'i gter chen nyid/ /'khor ba las brgal 3rigru gzings te/ /nyes pa kun sel rlung rdo ridang mtshungs/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa che'/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas chen gyis1 / /srab 'jam ring ba'i ljags bkram nas/ /tshangs pa'i gsung snyan dbyangs kyis gsungasanyusto/ /'gro la thugs rje chen po yi1 / /sngags 'byung brgyud pa'i rim /lha'abyung ba'i/ /cho ga dam pa nyan brtson pa/ /shin tu legs so lha yi bu/ /nyams dga' dge ba'i sa phyogs su/ /sa yi cha mnyam dkyil 'khor ltaratsha/ /pad+ma 1gegadan 'dra'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /tshon sna ma lus rnams kyis bris17/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rig pa'i lha mo khro mor mi bcas/ /'jig rten skyong sogs ma lus pa'i/ /sku 'am phyag rgya bkod pa dang ske/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyang bkram par bya/ /mar me yon chab byug spos tsodril/ /zhal zas gtor ma sna tshogs dang / /gzhan yang zas skom sna tshogs dang rka/ /rgyan dang na bza' lhab lhub dang / /sil snyan me tog phreng du ma/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i tshig gis brgyan19/ /slob ma gus pas bla ma la/ /yon phul brtson byas 'di skad gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems kyi gnyenan 7/ /dmus long lam log las 'dren pa/ /rab rib sel ba'i thur 21ma can/ /bdag la 'dren pa'i sgrol ma sogs/ /shes rab snying rje'i skya ba can/ /thos 91—888

bsam bsgom tsho1)pa'i gru gzings can/ /las tshonacan sdug bsngal chu sgrol ba'i/ /thabs brtson nyan pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub lam mthong dpag yas thugs / /'gro rnams thar lam rten gzigs pa/ /dge brtson dge la bskul tsho4ba'o / /dge bcu med pa dag la stsol/ /dam tshig sdom gnas ngang tshul bzang //bag yod dbyangs mkhas ltung ba med/ /chos don gnyer ba'i don skyabs por/ /skyabs dang sdom gnas bdag la stsol/ /dpa' tshoXbartan (7zhi dul tsho skuspyad pa yi/ /dga' slad slob dpon 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ gti mug rnam dag bder 9gshegs thugs/ /rnam par snang mdzad skyabs su mchi/ /zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje thugs/ /mi bskyod pa la skyabs su mchi/ /ser sna rnam dag longs spyod gter / /rin chen 'byung tsoldan skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags rnam dag pad+ma'i gsung / /'od dpag med la skyabs su mchi/ /phrag dog rnam dag phrin nyunyelas rgyal/ /don yod rdo rje skyabs su mchi/ /āḥ1rtaganas med mkha' dang mnyam spyod pa/ /chos dbyings chos la skyabs su mchi/ /skye med skye snang ltar grub 1 chos/ /'phags lam brgyad la skyabs su mchi/ /don gcig tsotshogs lam bcu gnyis grangs/ /gsung rab yan lag skyabs su mchi/ /rgyu 'bras snang ba'i so sor rtog15 /nyan thos dge 'dun skyabs su mchi/ /gcig gam tshogs spyod rdzu 'phrul che/ /rang rgyal dge 'dun skyabs su mchi/ /snying rje shes rab byang chub 'brel/ /sems chen tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /gsod 17dang rku rdzun sna 'khrig spyod dang / /tshig rtsub phra ma ngag 'khyal 12dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log lta spyod/ /thar pa'i srog gcod bcu po spong 19/ / chang 'thung tshotil mar tshir 1las dang / /mgar dang rgya skyegs rtswa 2shing gcod/ /srog 91—889

chags tshogs dang mgo skum tshong (1 / /mtho ris lus kyi gags rdo chen spong / /rtags dang phyag rgya 'dra 'bag dang / /rten dang dge 'dun rtags yi ge/ /bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'i yo byad sogs/ / 'gom dang bshig snyepa gtan du spong //mchod pa rnying 4dang sgog pa dang / /'bags dang lhag mar gyur pa dang / /sha dang dman 5 pa'i lag gi zas/ /srog chags yod pa'i chu rnams spong / /deng 96skunas bzung ste ji )srid pa/ /byang chub snying po nathug bar du/ /sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i 9chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims sogs/ /nam du mi dor brtan por gzung bo/ /lha dang slob dpon yid byed cing / /rdo rje dril bu 11phyag rgya gzung / /'gro la zang zing mi 'jigs skyabs / /chos kyi sbyin pa ci 'byor stsal12/ /theg gsum tha dad chos tshul rnams / /mi 'gal sbyor bas rgyun du spyodami / /lus ngag yid dang longs spyod bcas / /ser sna med pas mchod 'os mchod/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa'i/ /rig 'byung sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ /des spyod dam tshig dam pa rnams/ /sdom tshul brtan por gzung 1 bar bya/ /'gro rnams kun la snying brtse dang / /yi dgas 15rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ / 'dzam bha sal ni chu yis mchod/ /yi dgas 1 dag kyang chus mnyes bya/ / rdo rje 1 slob ma rab dga' nas/ /ci 'byor lha dang bla ma mchod/ /dga' chen las sbyor slob dpon dgongs/ /snying rje 19bdag la gzigs nas kyang / /lha dang sngags dang byin brlabs na thabs/ /de 21bdag brtse phyir stsal du gsol/ /rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs bzhugs pa'i/ /nyams dga' thar pa'i grong khyer che/ /yid bzhin longs tsho 2spyod char du 'bab lha/ /khang chen der ni bdag 'jug 'tshal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /zab 91wa 890

mo 4)sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /spros bral dmigs su med pa'i don/ /lam chen bdag la stsal du gsol/ /de nas slob dpon sngags rig pa/ /de nyid bcu sbyar mkhas pa pos(na/ /g.yon pas michos gos rtse bzung ste༄/ /lag pa g.yas chos phyag rgya can/ /gsang bstod 'dzum pa'i mdangs 'od 7de)rgyas/ /dad 6dang ldan pa 7'di skad brjod/ /o bu shog theg pa chen po yi/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga rnams/ /khyod tsho la nges par bstan par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang sngags rab bsgoms 9pas/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes rnams/ /shākya seng ge dpa' bos kyang / /gsang sngags sbyor 1 chib mnyam med kyis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang 'dis 11bcom mo12/ /'jig rten rjes 'dul rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /'khor lo bskor 1lhanas mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir kun thob gebya ba'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /sngags dang rdzas kyi bsrung skab dang / /lha yi rten mig de la mchod / /u dum bā 17ra'i me tog ltar/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /brgya 1 lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /sngags 12kyi spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ /de bas kyang ni ches dkon te/ / gang gis mtshungs med 1)sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa du mar bsags pa'i /sdig /gang la sdig khur ci yod pa/ / lha yi 21dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang / /byin brlabs na tsam gyis byang gyur nas/ /blo gros dri ma med pa yis/ /spyod tshul brlabs 54pa zhugs nas lha/ /ngan 'gro 55sdug bsngal rgyun bcad nas/ /mtshan ldan sku ni gzhan don spyod/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed 91wa 891

rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mtshungs med de 37ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pas/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams ni/ /gang du skyes kyang gzung ba'i phyir/ /deng nanas khyed rnams theg chen rigs / /sha stag tu ni skye nges te / /theg pa chen por 4cher 'byung ba/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i lam mchog 'di / /gang du rgyas 55par khrid nas kyang / /bde bar gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur / /de bas spro la brtson par gyis/ /slob ma ku sha dge ba yi/ /stan la nyal nas rmi lam dri/ /bsang 6dang sbyang 7ba byas nas kyang / /chus bkrus 'di rnams bklag 8pa dang / /bkra shis du ma bklag 9byas te/ /gdong pa dar gyis bcings nas kyang / /'bras kyi me tog phreng ba ni/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor dbus su dor1 / /slar blangs mgo la bcing (11bya ste/ /pad+ma ldan rigs mtshan gyis 512brgyan1lha / /mig phye de la lha rnams dang / /byang chub phyogs chos mtshan ma yi/ /yon tan ye shes stobs mnga' ba/ /mchod rten lha tshogs bcas pa bstanabo/ /yid ches dad pa 15mngon byas la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod par 35bya/ /de nas dag pa'i sras de la/ /mar me la ni mar me ltar/ /'dod pa'i lha ni stsal bar bya/ /brjod pa dang bcas 'brel pa yis/ /rtsa ba'i snying po nye snying tshogs//sngags kyang gsal bar sbyin par bya/ /zhi ba shel gyi phreng ba ste/ /rgyas pa la ni a ru ra/ /dbang la lung thang dmar po shis/ /drag po rwa 1 'am ru druk+ṣaḥn/ /po de tses ni las kun byed/ /sngags bcas stsal 19nas mgo la bcing hūm̐ dang bcas pa'i rdo rje yang / /lag pa g.yas su gzhag rna nopar bya/ /stod g.yogs kriṇ+ḍa 21sa ri 22ste/ /smad g.yogs kha dog sngon po'o/ /dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i kha dog ste/ /zhal zas snod ni pad+mas brgyan lha/ /sems can kun don 91wa 892

spyod pa'i rdzas/ /thub pa'i 1bkra shis bzhed pa'i rtags/ /gdugs nya bum pa dpal be'u dang / /rgyal mtshan 'khor lo pad+ma stsal/ /nad sel bde byed 'tsho ba'i phyir/ /'dod yon phyogs ris nagrub pa'i rdzas/ /gi'u wang drur 4tshob li khri gezho/ /bil ba sbrang rtsi a ru ra/ /ka ra bī tshone)ra'i 'bras bu rnams/ /hrīḥ7zhes dag pas stsal na bar bya/ /gur kum 9༄ga pur gla rtsi dang / / ba yi tshe'o mas sbyar byas nas/ /tshig 'dis 11lce la gzhag 12par bya/ /oṃ yan gar nges pa'i tshig rig dang / /ming gi rnam grangs chos rig dang / /dri ba lan ldon spobs pa :lharig /phyi nang mtshan nyid don rig shog /badz+ra dharma pra be sha /oṃ bcas brjod tshecing lce la ni/ /lan gsum rdo rje gzhag 15par bya/ /tīḥ16yig dmar po me 'bar 1 bsam/ /gang la goms 1 pa de 'byung zhing / /goms 19pa gzhan gyi dbang med na/ /rtog pa'i 'byung ba chad pa'i phyir/ /kun rtog phyag rgya la dmigs bshad/ /dmigs pa'i rten gyi 2 )sngags la yang / /byin brlab sematha dad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sa la dbang bskur thob 'dod pas/ /phyag na 'khor lo 'chang la dmigs/ /ting 'dzin brtan la rdo rje ste/ /dpal na thob 'dod pas rin chen dmigs/ /gzugs bzang 'dod pas dpad+ma ste/ /spobs pa 'dod pas ral gri'o/ /gzhan don 'dod pas rgya gram ste/ /rdo rje dkar pos 25sems gsal 'gyur/ /shes rab 'dod pas glegs bam mo/ /khang bzang gis tsini mi'i rgyal po'o rje/ /thub gzugs rtag tu sangs rgyas 'jam/ /thal sbyar ba 2 ni 'gro bas bkur/ / 'khar gsil 9byams dang snying rje skye/ /lcags kyus 'jig rten skyong bas bsrung 1/ /rin chen ze'u 'bru 2lce bder 'gyur/ /dril bus skad snyan byed par 'gyur/ /bgrang phreng gis ni lung bstan 'thob/ /khri 91—893

rkang gis ni nye dbang 'gyur/ /lha sogs bdug 17pa dung yin te/ /mdung rtse gsum pas g.yul las rgyal/ /pad+ma dmar pos lha ru skye rino/ /ril ba spyi blugs tshangs 2ris skye/ /sprin mdog lnga ni drang srong skye/ /me long gis ni lha zhal mthong ske/ /pad+ma rā gas ye shes skye/ /pad+ma sngon pos dag pa'i zhing ri / /pad+ma dkar pos dge tshogs 'phel/ /ri bos bu dang bu mo 'phel/ /dgra stas bdud kyi bar chad gesel/ /'khor dang sems mthun 'bring gha phyiras/ /phub (7kyis dgra dang gcan gzan na'ajoms/ /rnga yab dkar pos sdig pa 'phyag /me tog snye mas nad sel byed/ /rin chen mdas 9ni yid 'ong grogs/ /gzhus ni nor dang go 'phang rnyedas/ /chu shel dug dang tshad rims 511sel mi 'jigs phyag gis 1rta'ajigs skrag 1 'joms/ /dgra la rdo rje gtun shing ste/ /rdo rje nag po ngabadud 'dul 'gyur/ /rin chen ral gris rig sngags bzlogam /lto ba na las lhung bzed de/ /rims nad sel byed zhags pa'o/ /'bru 'dod pas ni 'bru'i 17ste ma/ /nor dbyig 'dod pas rin chen phug /yang na lung bstan 'dod pas na/ /mgo la sangs rgyas dmigs par bya/ /mngon par shes pa lnga 'dod na/ /sangs rgyas lnga po dmigs par bya/ /de nas mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /'dzum 1 pa'i mdangs kyis pad+ma'i zhal/ /sa yi snying po la gzigs nas/ /sa yi go rims 1 'di gsungs so/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rtog 16pa ni/ /gsang sngags thams cad sa bdun te / /gsang sngags sa dang sngags sbyar sa/ /rig 21'chang sa dang rig na gsal sa/ /rig lhamachog sa dang rin swochen sa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sa rnams so/ /gtsug tor chen po'i sangs rgyas sa//gnas skabs drug tu rgyal bas gsungs/ /kun tu 'od dang pad+ma'i gaspyan/ /yi 91—894

ge 'khor lo tshogs chen sa/ /rdor 'chang ye shes bla ma'i sa/ /rdzogs sangs bde ba chen po'i sa/ /sa'i 〉snying pos gsol ba/ mgon po 'phags pa thugs rje'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /byin brlabs 52lcags kyu lta bus 'khor ba'i btson ra nas/ /klu phyugs 'bum phrag drangs ltar dge ba kun slong gis/ /byang chub rin chen sa la 'jog mdzad ngo mtshar che/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi jim ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las byin rlabs 5'byung ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du/ /rab dga'i tshul du 'khrungs pa'i lha/ /ting 'dzin yangs pa zhes bya ba/ /rtogs pa rgya che zab pa 6zhig /'khor dang bcas pa bzhengs byas te/ /me tog rin chen rigs byung tsho ba/ /ston pa'i phyogs su char bzhin phab/ /mkha' la gdugs ri kyi bla re 9bkang 1 / /'khor dang bcas pas 11mgrin gcig tu/ /gsang 12bstod nas ni tshig 'di gsol/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje theg pa bla med pa'i/ /rdo rje rig 'dzin mchog grub pa/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung phyir/ /bdag dang sems can kun tu yang / /dngos grub 1 'byung rim bshad du gsol/ /la la sems ni g.yengs khupa yis/ /bla ma'i rgyud don bral mod kyang 15/ /sngags rgyud sdig 7pa 'chang byed 'byung / /snyan tshig rmongs rnams ngo mtshar skye/ /gdams ngag med pas 1 'gro ba bsku18/ /dngos grub med pas bstan pa gzhig19 /sred 2 pas lan cig sogs 2nyepar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa dmyal tshogs ngan 'gror 'gro/ /la la las kyi skye mched sgo/ /dbang po rten khang na dmar myur la/ /gdams 2dngag 91—895

rgyud tshul yod med kyi/ /chos tshul bzhin du spyod byed cing / /gang la dbang du bzung 1ba yi/ /bu 'dra bas kyang brnyas 2gyur nas/ /sdang ba 'phel nas rtsod par 'gyur / /des kyang gnyis kur cadamyal sogs 'gro/ /la la thos chung shes rab dman/ /rmongs pa gzhan rkyen nga rgyal can/ /bstan pa dang ni 'chang byed la/ /skyon smod 5smra bas 6dmyal sogs 'gro/ /la la mi dge'i 7bshes gnyen gyis/ /log lam 'jug pa'i nges 'dzin can/ /yang dag lam smod brtson 8pa dor/ /log sgrub can de dmyal bar 'gro/ /la la bsam med sngags brjod med/ /mar me bdug spos gtor ma sogs/ /'byung pos brlams te bdag nyid dang / /'khor bcas tshe thung longs spyod 'grib/ /la la 'dod sred gtum rdeb 9che/ /mkhas khogazhan dag la phrag 11dog gis/ /sgro skur 12tshul 'chos 1 chos la dmodas/ /rang nyid lta ngan bsgrub bel rtsod/ /ther zug 17blo yi mun pa can/ /'byung po drag po'i rigs su skye/ /la la ser sna rab 'jug pas/ /lha dang bla ma ( tshig gis bstod/ /zas dang longs 12spyod rgyan gos dang / /me tog bdug spos gtor ma sogs/ /nyung ngu mug tshul rgyun stsal 19na / /zas skom dag gis 2 gdungs pa yi/ /yi dgas 1dman pa'i rigs su ni//yang nas yang du skye bar nges/ /de phyir de dag spangs nas ni/ /ya rabs bsam pa bzang 22ldan pas/ /tshul bzhin blangs te thos bsam gyis/ /gtan la phab don ma 'khrul bar/ /brjod cing yid la byed pa dang / /the tshom med par brtson byed pas/ /'gro tshogs sgrol byed thabs thob na snye/ /rang don 'ba' 2 zhig smos ci dgos/ /de nas lag na rdo rje gtso/ /ye shes mtha' yas mnga' ba'i skus/ /'gro la snying brtser phurab gzigs 27nas/ /gsang ba'i skad 91—896

kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /nga la nyan 1par brtson byed pa/ /shin tu legs so lha yi bu/ /lha dang dngos grub 'byung 'brel ba'i/ /ting 'dzin nga yis bshad par bya/ /khyod nyid rtse gcig yid kyis ni/ /legs par nyon la yid la zung smyon //shin tu zab cing rgya che ba'i/ /dam chos thob pa shin tu dka'/ /rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po gtso/ /rang gi sems la bskyed par bya/ /shin tu gsal na dngos grub 'gyur/ /dang po stong pa'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa yi ge 5byang chub sems/ /gsum pa sgro btags ming tshogs sems/ /bzhi pa gzugs brnyan phyag rgya'i sems/ /lnga pa byin brlab brgyas 'debs sems/ /sgra dang brag cha'i getshul 'byung bar/ /gtso bo'i 'khor gyis 6 khyad par gsol/ /dbus su yi ge oṃ la ste/ /shar du hūṃ ste lhor ni swā ri/ /nub tu hrīḥyig byang du hā/ /rigs kyi rigs ni yang po yang bskyed/ /lha ni gang du 'pho 99 'gyur bas/ /dkyil 'khor de yi rigs 'byung yin/ /rigs kyi phyag rgya de nyid kyi bo/ /rig pa rigs kyi rgyas 'debs shing / /rigs kyi lha tshogs pho mo rnams/ /nyams 11dga' dben pa'i tshul gyis su/ /phan tshun du ni bltas nas gnas/ /ldem 12bag na bza' 'phyang 1 'phrul dang / /'phur lding sil snyan rin chen tshogs/ /du ma'i tshogs kyis brgyan bya ste/ /la la ldem ngabazhengs 'gying dang bcas/ /la la rdo rje skyil krung skabacas/ /la la 17pad+ma'i skyil krung lha ste/ /la la sems dpa'i skyil krung 1 can/ /la la khro thabs brkyang bskum can/ /la la zhal phyag zhabs kyang mang / /la la zhabs ni gnyis yin te / /la la zhal gcig phyag kyang gnyis/ /la la pad sdong pad+ma can19/ /la la pad+ma mi 'jigs phyag / gun dhe 2 bum pa 'khar gsil 1dang / /rnga yab 91—897

legs so skyabs 1sbyin phyag /rdo rje dril bu mda' gzhu dang / /'khar (0rnga shing rnga rdza rnga dung / /zangs lcags rdo dang rus pa'i rnga/ /ring zlum rked nyag rdo skuleb phyal che/ /chung phra sbom 4yangs dog pa dang / /ral gri chu gri gri rings tshonadang / /gri leb gri zlum gri kyog dang / /sta zur sta leb phyal sta dang / /sta 96)chung gzhog rtsorista 'bigs sta dang / /zlum sta 'phreng sta gzhar 9nasta dang / /mdung dang mdung (9rirtse gsum 1 'phen mdung 117/ /'khor lo kha ṭ+wāṃ gtun shing skyogs/ /snye nyi ma tig bu me tog dang / /sdong bu lo 'dab yal ga dang / /ba dan 1 bad gdugs rgyal mtshan spungs/ /rgya gram pad+ma rin chen sgrom/ /'khor lo glegs snobam ut+pal lo15ma/ /de la sogs 19te mchog mtha' yas/ /phyag rgya stong snyed tshang ba 51 tsho'am/ /brgya rtsa brgyad dam bzhi bcu drug /nyi shu gnyis sam bcu gnyis drug /bzhi 'am gnyis sogs mos pas 'byung / /phyag rgya bcing nyi ldan phyag rgya ste/ /des ni lha la rgyas 'debs byed/ /goms 19pa'i stobs kyis phyag rgya che/ /seng ge'i sgra ni seng ge zhon/ /rgyal po rol pa'i stabs 2 tshul can/ /rtse gsum sbrul dang mi 'jigs 21phyag /pad+ma sdong bcas ral gri 'bar na/ /dpa' bo'i lcags kyu thod pa ni/ /nang ma bdun 2 gyi cha gnas pa/ /gtum po drag po 'od ldan ma/ /g.yon du klu yi dbang phyug mo / /pad+ma dang ni zla ba'i steng / / 2phyogs mdog 27sems dpa'i skyil krung 2 can/ /yid bzhin nor bu rta la bcibs ri/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje pad+ma rin chen phyag /skyabs gsol mchog sbyin phyag rgya can/ /'khor ni sems dpa'i skyil krung 27ste/ /mdog bzang sgeg pa'i lha mo ni/ /yid myur rin chen bzang mo dang / /pad rgyal mo dang rta rna mo/ /rin chen pad+ma zla nyi la/ /'khor lo grogs kyi tshul du'o/ /91—898

pad+mo tsho1)'byung gnas rma bya zhon/ /zhal gcig 92)phyag bzhi 95ldem bag can/ /pad+ma skyabs sbyin lcags kyu dang / /ril ba spyi blugs (gephyag na 'chang / /sgeg mo phreng ma glu gar ma/ /pad zla sems dpa'i skyil krung (dengo / /mi bskyod (rmepa ni mkha' lding bcibs/ /ral gri pad+ma mda' gzhu dang / /skyabs sbyin gang ba'i bum pa thogs97ri/ /bzang 'dzin ma dang rnam sbyangs ma/ /sa srung /se mo 9dang rab brtan mo/ /de dag gang gi mcha byad mtshungs/ /don yod zhags pa klu steng 17bzhugs/ /rin po che dang zhags pa dang / /skyabs kyi sbyin lcags kyu 'chang ba'o/ /seng ge mo dang glang po ma/ /stag nyusnyegadong 'khyu mchog gdong ldan ma / /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la'o/ /ha la ha la ru 1)sbal steng 17/ /rdo rje dril bu skyabs sbyin dang / /chos kyi za ma tog 'chang ba'o/ /nyi 'od ma dang zla 'od ma/ /chu dbang mo dang nor phreng mo/ /dge ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa'o/ /mgon po pad+ma rgyan lung che/ /chu srin steng du rol pa'i tshul/ /ḍa nya ma ru dang bgrang phreng dang ske/ /mi 'jigs phyag dang lcags 13srog go/ /lu gu rgyud ma 'khor lo ma/ /gsang ba mo dang ring bsrel mo/ /glang sor rdo rje chos dbang phyug /chos kyi 'khor lo chos 'chad rgya/ /skyabs 19sbyin pad+ma po tir na chibacas/ /dga' ba dga' skyes snang byed ma/ /sil snyan ma 21rnams pad zlar ni/ /phyed krung 25ldem bag tshul du'o/ /rje btsun chos kyi gtsug na tor ni/ /ha ri ha ri ha ri zhon/ /zhal gsum phyag ni brgyad pa la/ /'khor lo rdo rje mda' gzhu dang / /pad dkar bgrang phreng skyabs sbyin dang / /bdud rtsis gang 2 chiba'i bum pa 'chang / /mkha' lding gdong ma shā ri'i gdong / /nyi zhal zla zhal lha mo'o/ /mgrin sngo dga' bo nye dga'i steng 25/ /zhal gsum phyag drug pad+ma dang / /po ti skyabs 2791wa 899

sbyin bgrang phreng phyag /seng ge nyatshogadong mo klu zhal mo/ /dga' byed mo dang srog byed mo/ /pad zlar sems dpa'i skyil krung tsho ngo / /dbus su mgon po gdong bcu gcig /gsang 'dzin mo dang 'dzin pa mo/ /sngags srung rdo ba dang grub srung rim/ /gong ltar cha byad phyogs mdog go/ /phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i cha la tsho'ini / /gtso bo sems dpa' bzhi dang bcas/ /shar du rdo rje dbang phyug ni/ /thogs med yid dang grub dbang phyug /rdo rje du ciphyag rgya gter sgrom can/ /kun kyang pad+ma zla ba la'o/ /lhor ni rin chen dbang phyug ste/ /grub chen dbang phyug dang phag zhal/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / /gru 7ci'adzin dbang phyug ces 98bya'o/ /nub tu pad+ma'i dbang phyug ni/ /skyes bu seng ge'i zhal dang ni / /pad+ma'i phyag dang sbrul nag phyag /rtse bran rgyas 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /byang du dam tshig dbang phyug dang / /'khor lo 'chang dang stag lpags 'chang / /kun grub dbang phyug sgra 9dung 'phel/ /phyogs dang phyogs kyi mdog can no/ /'jig rten skyong ba bcu po dang / /rgyal po chen po sde bzhi po/ /kun tu grags pa'i lha chen rnams/ /bstan 1 la dga' ba dgod 11par bya/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das don du/ /rigs bzang skye ba bzhes dgongs pa/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di 'byung 12ba'i/ /sangs rgyas stong yang dgod par bya/ /de ltar rgyas par spros pa 1lhani/ /lha rnams grangs 1 ni rgya che bar/ /tshig 15stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu bdun/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha/ /mgon po gdong bcu gcig pa yi/ /lha grangs dkyil 'khor bkod 16pa'o/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor bcu/ /'jig rten dbang gi 1 dkyil 'khor lnga/ /rig 12pa'i lha mo'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ /rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bdun/ /dkyil 'khor 91wa 900

de dag re re la/ /sems kyi dkyil 'khor lha mang ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni nyi shu lnga/ /rgyu 'bras tshul du rnam pa dgu/ /ye shes cha la lnga yin te/ /chos nyid ngo bos gcig tu rgyal/ /gang gang mos pa de dang de'i/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par spro ba 1)'am/ /gcig tu mos pa'i sbyor ba yisazhes/ /byang chub rdo rje mchog thob nas/ /khams gsum rgyal por longs spyod che/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mo bar 'gyur/ /gtsang sbra che zhing dad sems can/ /rtse gcig sgrub la nan tan stsolang / /blo bzang /zhesa'agro la 'jug cing sbyong / /ngag snyan ngang gis khro ba med/ /g.yo sgyu 'dod brkam g.yeng ba med/ /lus ngag dal zhing thos pa mang nga rgyal ser sna chags pa med/ /gtong phod snying rje drag ldan pas/ /spyan ras gzigs la gang dmigs nas/ /de yi snying po rtsa sngags la/ /bar chod med pas rab brjod nas/ /gzhan la phan phyir (7smon lam brjod/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la 'jigs tshonepa brgyad snang tshe/ /khro bo chen po'i tsho rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /de dag myur du sel byed shog /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la nad rims sherigang byung tshe/ /gso dpyad 〉sman dang sman par ni/ /bdag nyid gyur 1nyenas myur sel shog /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu ge'i (2nang du byung gyur 1 tshe/ /phyogs gcig nganas ni rnam tshagayos nas/ /zas skom rgyun chad med par shog /spyan ras gzigs mgon 7phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang du 'khrug pa che byung 1 tshe/ /rang dbang gis ni sems gyur ho/nas/ /bde bas phan tshun sdum par shog /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /byol song gcig la gcig za dang / /zas skom dkon dang gzhan 'jigs tshe19/ /de dag sel ba'i skyabs gyur cig /spyan ras 91—901

gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi dgas 3)zas skom gdungs pa dang / /log par lta ba'i gnas zhugs tshe/ /nad bral bdud rtsi kun snang shog /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i skyabs dang thabs mkhas dang / /shes rab gru 2dang ldan nas kyang / /thabs kyis sdug bsngal las grol bshog /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims zhags (5)ldan lam la rtag /mya ngan 'das pa'i ri bo 'dzeg6 /'dus ma byas kyi khyim 'jug shog /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan song gnas rnams mthong nas kyang / /der phyin de rnams zad pa yi/ /gnyen po sa sar 7'byung bar shog /spyan ras gzigs mgon phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmyal rnams tsha grang gcad 58)gtubs tshe/ /go cha che dang bsil grib du'odang / /drod kyi 'od du gyur par shog /rig sngags yang yang brjod pa yis/ /yang dag lam nyid rtogs 7par shog /kun 'byung sa bon rul nas ni/ /sdug bsngal phung po skam par shog /mgon po mya ngan 'das thob nas/ /'jig rten phyogs bcur rab grags 'gyur/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bsnyen pas bgegs kyi mthu bcom nas/ /dngos grub myur du rnyed bya'i phyir/ /bsgrub 1)pa la ni brtson par bya/ /zla ba dkar po'i tshes gcig nas/ /khrus byas gos sar 12gyon byas nas/ /sku gzugs bzang po'i mdun 'dug nas/ /smyung 1dbar gnas nas nyin gcig 1 la/ /dus gsum sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad/ /brjod cing ci 'byor mchod par bya/ /tshes tshebargyad tho rangs dus nas ni/ /dben par gdan khri bzang po la sku gzugs nub tu gzigs nas gzhag17 /bza' btung kyi dngar 18bas sbags pas 19mchod/ / a ka 21ru dang du ru ska / /bdug pa rgyun nadu bsreg ri par 91—902

bya / /'bru dkar 'o ma'i zas bza' zhing / /zhag gsum bzlas pa ci nus bya/ /de nas zhag gsum bar du bdag /'o ma zho dang 'bras chan 1)'tshal/ /lha la mchod pa cher bskyed nas/ /byang chub shing drung stong rtsa brgyad/ /du ru ska yi (2mar du sbang / /dum bu re re sngags re dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i drung du bsreg /sa yang g.yo zhing sku yang g.yo/ /steng zhal nas ni snyan pa'i sgra/ /legs so legs so rigs kyi bu/ /khyod ni nan tan brtson 'grus can/ /'dod sman don gnyer gang yin pa/ /mkha' la 'phur ram rkang mgyogs sam/ /drang srong rig 'dzin rgyal po la/ /bdag dang skal ba rdo nimanyam 'dod na / /de ring nyid du stsal bar bgyin/ /bco 6lnga'i tshes la sku gzugs de/ /bde gshegs ring bsrel yod pa yi/ /mchod rten nang ngam drung du bzhugs/ /gso sbyong blangs nas smyung ba tsho)noyis/ /skya snar me tog brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sngags re brjod pas sku la brdegan /de tshe mdun zhal rtsa ba nas/ /'brug sgra chen po lta bu 'byung / /sa chen rab tu g.yo bar 'gyur/ /de tshe bdag nyid ma skrag par/ /sngags bsgrub 9rjes su dran bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /thugs rje che dang ldan pa la/ /bdag nyid gus par 1 phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /mgon skyabs re gnas gyur nas kyang / /'gro ba kun gyi re 11'dod rnams/ /tshul bzhin du ni skong bar shog /de tshe 'dod pa stsol ba la/ /lha klu tshogs kyi bar chad med/ /sngags kyi 'dod don kun 12grub yin/ /bsod nams 12rdzogs byed smon lam mo/ /phyag 'tshal rten ngal bskor ba dang / /mchod rten brtsig dang 15dkyil 'khor ni/ /rnal 'byor yan lag las ldan pas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi 91—903

don gyi phyir/ /rgyun chad med par brtson pa na/ /dge byed smon lam rgyas pa ni / /de dag myur du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir smon lam mchog tu bshad/ /gang la dge spyod g.yel ba yi/ /le lo can ni bdud bzung she nas/ /gya tshom smra zhing chos la smod / /bstan pa 'jig gepar byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir dmangs skurigs gdol pa can/ /log spyod can ni ring du song / /ser sna le lo nga rgyal can/ /bag med g.yeng dang bcas pa ni/ /bdud kyi 'ching lam log lam pa/ /zhugs dang slar la gtang 5bar bya/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma 'dra ba zhes bya ba las dngos grub 'byung ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas nad dang gnod pa 7sogs / /sngags brjod tsam gyis bsal spubar bshad / /nad gdon gang dang gang la yang / /sngags pas drag tu gsal btab la/ /rang gis chosartse gcig sems kyis holhabazla/ /dang por 12snying rjer bcas pa yi/ / sngags kyis 1 nad dang gdon las grol/ /de tshe mchod la brtson par bya/ /smyo nad nyin re ldang ba dang / /nyin gnyis pa 'am nyin gsum pas / /nyin bzhi nyin bdun ldang ba'i rims/ /'byung po mkha' 'gro sha za 'am / /smyo byed brjed byed lus srul po/ /'dre gdon drag pos bgyid bomod kyang ske/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis sel bar 'gyur/ /yang na srad bu kha dog lnga/ /mdud 17re sngags re brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mdud ldan mgul 1 lam dpung par gdags / /kha na ma tho bsags 1 pa yi/ /sgrib kun zhi zhing byang 'gyur 1rten/ /bgegs sogs nad lta smos ci dgos/ /bde rlabs 1bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /97wa 904

spangs dang 'bras kyi phreng ba dang / /shu ba phol mig rma mdze 3)dang / /me dbal lhog pa g.yan la sogs/ /ma rungs pa yi nad rnams dang / /ral gri mda' mdung la sogs pas ci / /myos sam de yis nyen 95༄pa dang / /sbrul dang sdig pa rtsangs ④pa dang / /bung ba mchu rnon la sogs pa(5ra/ /gdug 96pa rnams la lan bdun dang / /brgya rtsa brgyad dang stong du brjod/ /yang na sa ser 'jim pas byugs(ge / /de yis 78nad las grol bar nges/ /bgegs sam rlung la sogs pa yi / /gzhogs 99༄gcig phyogs su nad langs sam/ /rna ba 'on nam sna sub 1 snan//brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa 'am/ /'bru mar zho dang ru rta dang / /lan bdun brjod nas sku nyamabyug dang / /zos shing rna ba snar byugs nas32/ /sos par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /nyi 'od kyis kyang rig sngags 'chang / /bsrung 12dang lam 'gro bskyab 1 pa'i phyir/ /byin brlabs 55ldan pa'i tshig 'di gsungs/ /na mo bud dhā saya gu ra be / na mo dharmā ya tā yi 12ni/ /na maḥsang ghā 19ya ma hā te/ tri bh+yo pi 5 swā hā nā ma 1/nyin mtshan dus su 'di brjod pas/ /sdig kun byang zhing nad rnams zhi/ /lam du bgegs bdud mi phrad 22cing / /rtag tu sems dga' dam pas na 'thob//byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od kyang / /bsrung )ba'i don du sngags 'di gsungs / /sha ma ta he ru sha na ho/ /ādz+nyā 7pa te/ su ru te/ shaṃ ke ṭi/ ba 22ra ma bya na te/ su ru shes / kā 1la ṭa te/ khi ma te swā hā/ tshon sna 2lnga yi skud pa la/ /bdun bzlas mdud pa nyi shu tsho gcig /na sar btags na nad sel 'gyur/ /gzhan yang yon tan grangs med 'thob / /sbrul gyi rma ni sgo phye la / /bdun bzlas rma khar btab na sos/ /seng ge stag gzig gdom dred kyi/ /91wa 905

pags la 1nyi shu rtsa gcig bsngags(5/ /brjod nas gra khrims can la bskon/ /de ma thag tu rims sel 'gyur/ /blo sku bur gdon 5༄gyis nyen rdo dpa la lan bdun brjod pa'i gu gul bdug /sdong ros yungs kur 97lan tshwa dkar/ /sbyar nas nyi shu rtsa gcig rin brjod/ /nad pa'i mal bzhag nas bdugs na/ /'byung po 'bros te nad las grol/ /bo til mar nang du ru rta btsos/ /byugs pas gzhogs 9nad rna nad dang / /zha ri grum myur du sel bar byed/ /yang na rtsi mar nyid la bya11/ /til mar lte bar bskus pa yis/ /myur du bu thon 'gyur bar nges/ /rtsim mas 12sha ma sa/ thon par nges/ /du ru ka (snyadang sbyi mong sbyar/ /snying nad drag po sel bar 'gyur/ /ba rog mo yi 15phyi dron gyis/ /rma khar bslan 17na mes tshig sos/ /srin bu ring mo 1 snying la za/ /rta dkar gcin la khyor gang 'thung 18/ /des ni srog chags bud 516par 'gyur/ /'bras la rams — ci kyi lo ma yi 1/ /khu ba bskol bas byug 22par bya/ /bong na bu'i rtug pa gsar pa btsir ske/ /nyal kur mig tu blugs 25na sos/ /mtshan ma 25spangs 2 tshol skud rdusnyedakar ro/ /de ku nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad brjod shu dag dkar//dpung par btags pas g.yul las rgyal/ /phug ron ril ma nyi shu brgyad/ /bzlas bcas bskus pas lcags na sgrog dang / /shing sgrog la sogs grol bar nges / /thal ba'am phye sdo tshom la ni sngags/ /stong bzlas me tog srin bu grol/ /gdon dang yams 1nad bzlog 2pa la/ /dri bzang rnyichu la bzlas nas bkrus/ /bu med bu 'dod don du ni/ /stong bzlas ba mar btung bar bya/ /byi ba sbrul dang ru 5sngal sha /phye ma gtor na phyugs rnams rengs/ /mar ga ni dang shu dag dang / /lga shadang go da stod sbrang rtsi sbyar/ /sngags 'di yis ni shes rab 91wa 906

'phel / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+sā 91)ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi 2risatā (5ya / ma hā satā ya/rdo ma hā kā 5ru ṇi kā tshoyinaya/ tar+ya thā/ khā hi khā hi/ ba (7li te swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /na ma ār+sā 78ri ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā (shenaya/ ma hā satā 91 ciya/ ma hā kā (nyunyeru ṇi 32kā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ pad+me phu/ma hā pad+me /2phu/ pad+ma lo tsa ne laphu/ a mo gha be te/ na mo a dota tsho12ku tā laya/sa ra sa ra/ gats+tsha ga61rte/ i me ma k+ṣi ro gi nyu nā sha ya swā hā/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas kyang / /thal bas 517mig ni phyi rol bsku )/ /mig nad thams cad 'joms na/par 'gyur/ /skud pa dkar po mdud pa bdun/ /sngags (2bdun bzlas pas rin rna ba yi/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms na par byed ni/ /gur gum buka ra cha mnyam na tshopas/ /sna yi nad ni sel bar byed/ /a ru ra yi phye ma dang / /sbrang rtsi bsres pa'i 'dag pas 8ni/ /so yi nad dang lce yi nad / /thams cad 'joms na(par shes par bya/ /oṃ rgyu shrī gi )rgyu shu k+ṣe phu/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig chu la bzla/ /'thungs pas 31ma zhu'i gnod pa sel/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā seb lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā /ya/ ma hā satā ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kā snyeya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ rat+na she/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa a su ra marta ka / dzā la dzā ri la/ sbyin da sbyin da / hu ru hu ru/ kyi ri kyi ri/ ha na ha na/sarba dz+wa ro ru dra 8ka /ban dhe na/ mā ra dgeya mā ra 4 tshoya/ sarba gra haṃ swā hā/sngags 'di mtshal gyis bris nas kyang / /mgul du btags na nad rnams sel/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i sngags gang gis/ /las rnams de dang de la sbyar/ /sbrang bu srin bu sbrul lhog pa/ /g.yen 41pa shu ba ske nad la/ /sbrang rtsi pi pi ling gis byug /gang zhig brtson gedu zhugs pa la/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa la/ /91wa 907

tsan+dan lde 14gu snying gar rin nobyug /gang gis gemig nad sel ba la/ /shing 0dngar tshogechu 'am spos chu 'am/ /la pol sha yi )khu 8)yis bya/ /rna ba la ni til mar gyis/ /gzhan gyi yi ge gsal ba dang / /'thab mo shags 'gyed 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /bum pa chu yis gdong pa bkru/ /gang yang byis pa bsrung 9ba ni/ /seng ldeng phur bu sor bzhi pa/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / /don yod zhags pa'i sngags ring 1 tshodag /stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas btags na/ /tshe ring nyid du bde bar spyod / /ba lang rwa dang po so 'cha'41/ /shing kun dung 1 sbrul pags 1 pa dang / /ras bal sa bon drung 1 tshopo dang / /de bzhin du ni ser po gnyis/ /nas kyi phub ma g.yengs pa'i skra/ /byi la'i rtug 15pa bri 15ha ti/ /shug nyi tshopa bya rog sgo 1snyeng dang / /ba lang mig pa na le sham/ /da du 19ra dang lhan cig sbyar/ /de rnams bsres pa'i dud pa yis/ /bgegs rnams sel phyir ru dra yin1/ /dud pa bcu drug zhes bya ba'o na/ /pu shel tse lhadang ba bla dang / /btsan dug gi ni sbrul shun gyisam/ /bdugs na rims nad thams cad sel/ /nad gzhan dag kyang sel bar byed/ /ba lang lci ba'i na khu bar 2dzini/ /so ma ra dza'i 22phye ma gdab/ /yi ge hrīḥ yis byin brlabs smyonas/ /mgrin pa sngon po'i rtsa ba'i sngags/ /brgya rtsa brgyad brjod 'thungs pas ni/ /dug dang rims nad sel bar byed/ /skyer pa bskol ba'i khu bar ni/ /so ma ra dza'i 1phye mar 2sbyar/ /ril bu rgya sran tsam gyi lhatshad/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sngags brjod nas/ /zos pa tsam gyis dug rigs rnams/ /zos kyang lus la gnod pa med/ /'o mar yung ba sung gagacig 7bskol/ /so ma ra dza blugs te blud / /so so 'chang tshal ha la'i sngags/ /brgya rtsa brgyad sngags grangs tshang ba/ /brjod de ciblud na skyugs 91wa 908

nas ni/ /dug gis tshugs 1par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyim gyi dud pa rgyam tshwa dang / /skye du dmar rtsa 2lo mar bcas/ /phye ma mar sar tsho sbrang rtsi bcas/ /ha ri chen po rtsa ba'i sngags/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis 2btung bar bya/ /sbrul nad thams cad sel bar byed45/ /shu dag ru rta a ga la ru/ /yung ba bong nga dkar po rnams/ /don yod zhags pa'i sngags kyis mnye/ /byugs tshi pas dug rnams tsho thams cad sel / /rgyam tsha 9srang gang mar srang gnyis/ /gcin srang brgyad dang lhan cig bskol / /rdo rje chos kyi sngags kyis 7'thungs/ /dug nad thams cad sel bar byed / /rgyam tsha tshwa 11gsum mar srang bzhi/ /sbyar te mi shol 12sngags brjod nas / /byugs na reg pa tsam gyis ni/ /sdig pa sbrul gyis 1 zin pa sel/ /ku ma tsheri dang ser po gnyis/ /lcim rtsa 15myang tshwa spar 17bcas la/ /gar dbang sngags dang chu yis btung / /dug nad thams cad sel bar byed/ /ser po gnyis dang ldong ros dang / /go thal gur gum le brgan 51 rtsi/ /pad+ma rgyan lung bsngags kyi 1 btung / /dbyig dug thams cad 'joms par byed/ /gang la gza' dang rgyu skar gyi19/ /'tshe ba byung 2 rin de 21bsal phyir/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad maṇ+ḍal gyi 2/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams na dbus rnams su/ /mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /mkha' lding gzugs su 'gyur ba 2 la/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bcu gcig gis/ /gus pa'i tshul du mchod byed bkod 5/ /nyi ma zla ba lag 'dzin pa'i/ /khyab 'jug gis ni byi ba'i gzugs/ /mnan pa'i mkha' lding mig sman mdog /nor rgyas bu gnyis lha yi gzugs/ /mig gsum ldan 0pa brjid pa'i lus 7/ /rin chen lnga yi sder gshog 2 can/ /rdo rje mchu rno khro dang bcas/ /nyi ma bye bas brgyan 29pa'i 'od/ /snying gar nyi ma 'od 91wa 909

'bar la/ /gi yig nag po sngags kyis bskul/ /spu rnams zings kyis gyur nas kyang / /phyogs bcur rdo rje khyab par 'phro/ /gza' dang rgyu skar sog byas te / /gdon dang klu rnams sreg par byedakyoste/ /thugs rje tsho2)mi bshol ba yi sngags / /'brug sgra lta bur gsal bar brjod/ /gang yang grangs med stong phrag ni / /las rnams thams cad sngags 'dis ( ci'agrub/ /mkha' lding dkar po brjid pa'i lus/ /klu yi gdon las sbyar bar bya/ /de la mgrin pa sngon po yi / /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskul bas 4༄ni/ /sa steng 75gtum po klu yi gdon/ /du ma nges par sel bar byed/ /klu dang tshangs pa'i srin po bsreg ri /'gro la mdze 7nad gtong bar byed na / /mkha' lding dmar po sbrul za ma/ /me tog thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga9 /g.yon na 'chang ste g.yas pa na/ /ral gri me 'od 'bar ba 'chang —/ /mgon po seng ge'i sgras bskul khonas/ /dba' rlabs bebaskal pa'i me dang mnyam/ /sbrul dang rin chen dbyug tho can/ /mkha' lding sha za'i gdon la ni/ /mgon po ha ra'i 12sngags kyis bskul/ /mkha' 'gro'i gdon la mkha' lding ni/ /ljang gu 1lharal gri phur pa 'chang / /pad+ma ral gri sngags kyis bskul / /las rnams gang dang gang la yang / /sngags dang phyag rgya ldan sbyor ba'o1 ske/ /ci 15ltar mos te phyag rgyar bcas/ /lus kyi phyag rgya sems kyi rgya17/ /ngo bo nyid kyis 1 mtshon pa yi12/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rgyas 'debs 'gyur/ /da ni phyag rgya bshad par bya/ /sku yi mdun du langs nas kyang / /rkang pa g.yas pa yid 19tsam bskum / /lag gnyis so sor thur du brkyang / /gung srin so sor mthil du bkug / mtheb mdzub 21dag ni so sor brkyang / /gru khug lag mthil mdun du bstan / /'gro 'am 'dug kyang dgra dpung las/ /rgyal 91wa 910

phyir sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra ri1ā ya/ /na ma na.ār+sā ba lo ki te 9)shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā la ya/ ma hā satā 5ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi tsikā ya/tabya thā/ oṃ a ba te pa ra ba te/ e h+ye hi swā hā/ yang na sngon ltar lus bsrang ste(ge/ /snying gar 8thal sbyar spro ba bsnol/ /mdzub 99nomo gnyis sbrengs tshertse mo sprad/ /mtheb 11gnyis mdzub tshigs 32dang por bkug /lag mthil cung zad ma reg 1 pa/ /gzungs sngags gang brjod phyag bya'ogaci/ /bgegs kyi pa'atshe ba 'byung 7ba'i tshe/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'dis bsal 1 bya/ /na mo rat+na tra 1 yā ya/rte/ na ma 2 )ār+sā 1ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 22ya/ ma hā satā na ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya ye/ tabya thā/ oṃ sarba dharmā 22khyi maṇ+ḍa na lā ya/ e h+ye hi 8pa ra ma shurta satā 29ya swā hā/ yang na sgom la 'jug pas ni/ /thog mar phyag rgya 'di bcing ngo / /pus btsugs ra1spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ /mdzub dgeganyis bkug la rtse sprad nas/ /de la mtheb ralhaganyis sbyar da )bar bya/ /'di tsho ni bdud las rgyal bar nges/ /yang na lag gnyis rgyab sprad nas/ /sor mo rtse rnams reg par bya/ /mtheb zhiganyis brkyang sdo nas mdzub nang tsho sbyar/ /smin mtshams 9su ni gzhag 4 )par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra 1lnga ya/ na ma /ār+sā ba lo ki /te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā cigeya/ ma hā satā 5ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa na mo badzā 45ya me swā hā/ khyad par du ni lha ji mthong 'gyur/ /yang na 'greng ste 42mnyam gzhag (rgya/ /snying gar 5 tshobazhag la sngags 'di brjod/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma 51ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 52ya/ ma hā satā ri ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sarba de ba a ri na le 55swā hā/glo bur rtsod pa rgyal byed yin/ /yang ni 'greng ste 57ting pa sprad/ /lag gnyis 5 91—911

'jigs byed tshul du 1bya/ /rtsa sngags gang rung brjod pas ni/ /ting 'dzin yan lag brtan par 'gyur/ /yang na napad+ma rgyan lung gi ri/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis thal sbyar srin lag gis/ /mthe 4bo'i sen mo mnan gebyas te/ /mthe'u chung rtse mo'i gung mo sprad/ /gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya ste//dgug na mdzub 5rtse bsgul 7zhing dgug /yang na g.yas pa'i mdzub na mo dgug /g.yon pa slar btang bya ba'o9no/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma 1 rimār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā 11ya/ bo dhi satā 12ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā 1 kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/oṃ brah+ma e h+ye hi swā hā/ yang na sor rtse rnams bskyed na/ /mdzub 〉mo g.yab la 15lha chen rnams/ /yang na phyag rgya 'di bcas la/ /nyi zla gzas bzung 36dus su ni / /gzungs sngags ba mar cho17la 1 bzlas na19/ /phyag rgya stabatab nas zos pas ni/ /shes rab 'phel dang tshe 'phel 'gyur 1/ /nad med gzugs bzang 'thob na par nges/ / 'grang ste darkang gshibs 2 thal sbyar nas/ /mtheb bsnyeganyis lag pa'i nad bkug pa/ /snying gar 2phyogazhag na bya spyan ras gzigs/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i 'khor lo'i 2 rgya/ /mchod sogs las kyi sngon 'gro ba'o/ /de bzhin sdig 9bshags la yang ngo / /mdzub 1bkug mthe bo sen 2mor bcas / /lag gnyis rgyab sprad gar dbang rgya/ /thal sbyar mtheb mdzub /so sor brkyang / /mgrin pa sngon po'i phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub tshomo gnyis bkug lhag ma brkyang ske/ /mi bshol ra ba yi phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis rgyab sprad mtheb 5gnyis brkyang ske/ /bdug pa bzang la sngags 'di bzlas / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma 9ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 1ya/ ma hā satā lhaya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ na mo rat+na sha ri tsan+d+ra a lo kā ra marga te dza su pra tsa ka 91—912

bi sha rā dzā nya)ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ rasne rasne/ ta ta sha rat+na/ ta ta sha rat+na pri te ma he rasne pra bha ten / rat+na gar+bhe nasaswā hā/ snga 4bar brgya rtsa brgyad brjod do(snye/ /nor yang thob pa'i gter rnyed 'gyur/ /'gro gzhan bdag la byams 'dod na/ /so shing la ni nyi shu gcig / ldob skyen 9'dod pa shu dag 9gel / /stong rtsa tshon brgyad bzlas snying gar pa'obasku/ /gang bshad phyag rgya dang bcas pas / /gdug bopa'i sngags 'dis bgegs kyang 'bros/ /na maḥsarba bud dha dharma saṃ ghā 1lhaya/ na mo rat+na tra ti yā ya/ na mo 1 ār+sā 1 ba lo ki 15te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā 19ya/ ma hā satā 1 ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya 18shā/ na mo badz+ra pā 51ge'i su/ tabya thā ri/ oṃ hu pi hu pi/ ka pa du pi/ pra gā ya ni swā hā/rnam grangs bdug pas sangs rgyas bdug /lha rnams dag kyang mchod par bya/ /yan lag g.yas pa'i mthe bo 1ni/ /lag mthil bzhag nas sor mos na dgab/ /rna ltag phyar 22nas mdzub 2 rimo ni/ /brkyang bskum bskul bas spro ba dang / /g.yon pa mi 'jigs phyag rgya ste/ /dus ma yin par 'chi sogs bzlog gi /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /sor mo bsnol te bkod pa las/ / mthe bong 27mthe'u chung so sor 2 tshoni/ /sprad de sprad pa shes rab rgya/ /oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā / de bzhin bsnol nate bkan pa yi/ /gung gnyis nang du gshibs bsgreng ba rte / /mar me'i rgya ste sngags 'di'o/ /oṃ dī pa ta rilo 1tsa na swā hā/ de nyid sbubs nas gung mo gnyis/ /rtse sprad zangs 2pa bdug spos so/ /oṃ dhū dpa dha ta swā hā/ rting sprad so so byungs sar dgug /byug ri pa'i tshul ni byug pa'i rgya/ /oṃ dha le dbe t+ya swā hā/ rting sprad sor mo gyen du 7bgrod/ /zhal nas 'thor sha tshul bshos kyi rgya/ /oṃ nai bi byi pro k+ṣa 8te swā hā/ lag gnyis 91—913

bkug nas rtse brgyad sprad/ /mthe bong gyen du yan pa ni/ /na bza' dam pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ bhā 1tshos ra ṇi zheswā hā/ snyim pa kha phye bteg na pa'i tshul/ /ro ma stsal pa'i phyag rgya'o/ / oṃ māṃ (༄: ldanahrīḥ/ sa ka la gha 76rin pa ri wa re rnakhyad/ pa ri ke ra a a/ a pa ta raṃ te/ a geb ta chi'o ro te1 dī/ a pa ta ro tu/ da sha di ka 11 lo ka 1 pā 1lhal/ sa pa ri wā re nya bh+yaḥyi rda ba li groṇ+ḍistu khā ho de tusko/ pi bas1 ske/ ya the 12bo ya thas/smyo/ dzaḥtho )rgyu baṃ hoḥ 1/ saṃ tre bhā sarba satā tsho ceni/shārnyi 2 ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi ku ci noru/ ba shaṃ na ku na9ru/ ā ri pa ra ṇa ku ru gusteX rte/ka ro ta kur+sāskyo 1/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ār+sā 22ba lo ki te shwa ra gsu/ ā tsho༄1 pa ya ti swā hā/ oṃ a kā 5ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ādz+nyā tsho zhen da pan+da snatāta oṃ āḥ/ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ hrī dzi (bha la dza len drwa ya swā hā/ longs spyod rtag phyir gnod gnas la/ /chu gtsang rtag tu sbyin par bya/ / oṃ āḥhrīḥ lo ke 41shwa ra hu ce nu smṛ 8 ti ka rā ya swā hā/ yi dgas rnams la sra 4snyer zas/ /ci phyir chu dang bcas pa stsal/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i rnal 'byor grogs/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po yi dgas 7kun brtson 'gyur/ /sems kyi lcags kyu ldan bya ste/ /nyon mongs sems la rab drangs te / /lha klu 'bum phrag sems dga' ba'i/ /kun slong byang chub rin chen gyi dī/ /las la bsgyur 4(ba'i lhag bsam bskyed/ /mdzad pa rgya che 5 kun grub 51'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las sngags kyi 52sbyor 5nyeba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 91wa 914
