che / /nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba/ /'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa zhig /mchod pa'i bkod pa chen po dang / /bstod pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pa yis/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byas/ /bskor 0)ba du ma byas nas kyang / /phyag 'tshal gsang bstod phyogs gcig tshoge'akhod(na / / pus btsugs gi thal sbyar 'di skad gsol/ /mgon po rinayon tan kun gyi rgyal/ /ye shes rmad kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /thar pa'i lam chen nyi shar rgyal/ /'dren pa rgya mtsho phyag 'tshal lo / /mtshan dpe mthar thug med pa'i sku/ /gzi brjid rgya che mkha' khyab la/ khriblo gros yangs pa'i nam mkha' can/ /sku yi gsang ba phyag 'tshal lo tshangs dbyangs du ma bsam mi khyab/ /nam mkha' yangs pa'i mtha' bkang nas/ /tshad med yan lag bcu gnyis byung / /gsung gi gsang ba phyag 'tshal lo /ting 'dzin rnam thar bsam gtan sgo/ /bsam yas bsam du med bsam 6pas//bsam mi khyab pa'i shes rab dang / /thugs rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs 'ching gcod (75pa'i/ /ma rig g.yul las rgyal byed pa/ /kun rtog dra ba sel ba yi/ /sgron ma de 8ring bshad du gsol/ /byis rnams mun pa'i thobs su ltung 9/ /nyan thos 'dod chags tshogs kyis bospag /rang rgyal gsang ba'i bzod 11dang ldan/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'ching bas 'jigs / /nyon mongs mnga' bdag gsang sngags la/ /shes rab snying rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan spong ba'i/ /thabs mchog du ma bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa che12/ /'od zer phyogs bcur rgyas byas nas/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs chen gsung snyan pas/ /nam mkha'i khams chen rab bkang nas/ /shes rab snying rjer 'brel ba yi1snye/ /sbyor ba'i cho 91—915

ga du ma rnams3bye/ /bsdus pa'i don du byas pa 'di/ /nyi ma'i snying po nyan pa ni / /legs so byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dpal dang ldan pa khyod legs so/ /rtse gcig gus dang bcas pa yi/ /sems kyis (2legs nyon yid la zung (ge/ /nyams dga' bde ba'i sa phyogs su/ /shin tu dga' ba'i sa las ni/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham pa bya/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas/ /shar ram lho yi sgo 4gtod 5bya/ /dkar po ser po dmar po dang / /ljang ku'i (7tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /dkar po'i lte ba (7'tsham (se bar dmar / /mu khyud gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /gser dngul zangs sam sa nyid la/ /bum pa lto yangs mgrin pa phra/ /kha g.yel zhabs tshod zhum pa la/ /shin tu gtsang mar bkrus nas kyang / /ga pur gur gum 9cu gang dang / /gla 1 )rtsi gi'u 31wang chu yis bkang / /bya gri seng gri 12ha sa der/ /ka ri kur ni de ba ko/ /nas 1 'bras til gro mon sran dang / /gser dngul byi ru mu tig dang / /man boshel yin te rin chen lnga/ /bum par stsal nas ras dkar gyis/ /mgul pa bcings nas 15kha rgyan yang / /dri zhim shing lo me tog gzhag(19 /me tog phreng dang bcas pa de/ /pad+ma'i dbus su bzhag nas kyang / /rgya mtsho chen por 91 tsho'akhrugs pa nas/ /dpag bsam shing chen 'bras bur bcas/ /'jig rten dbang gis gang ba yi1 / /sngags kyang mtha' yas khyab dmigs nas/ /sngags kyi mthu yis sangs rgyas nas/ /dgongs pa rgya chen skyes gyur nyi te/ /legs so bkra shis 'bab par 'gyur/ /rgyal sras rnams dang rig pa yi/ /lha mo tshogs dang glu 2 len dang / /bkra shis du ma brjod par 'gyur/ /de tshe mkha' la ye shes kyi/ /'od zer bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /shing chen yongs su smin pa las/ /91wa 916

bdud rtsi 17char chen 'bebs par 'gyur/ /'jig rten skyong la gtor ma sbyin/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras mchod par bya/ /skar ma la sogs 'bab pa 'am tshes gcig nas ni nya yi bar/ /sngags kyi phreng ba brjod 5par bya/ /lha la yang yang bskor bar tsho bya/ /las rnams gang dang gang la yang / /lha yi dbang gyur sbyar bar bya/ /de dang de ni las rnams la/ /ci bde bar yang sbyar bar bya phyan tshegs las la spyan ma'i sngags/ /lhog pa 'brum bu gal sogs la/ /mi bshol ba yi sngags kyis 5sbyar e/ /gdon rigs bzlog du ril gar dbang ste/ /byad stems rig sngags bzlog 8)pa la/ /don yod zhags pa'i sngags kyis bkru/ /shes rab 'phel ba rdo rje chos/ /klu nad ha la ha las sel/ /tshe 'phel pad+ma rgyan lung ste/ /mgrin sngon sngags kyis dpal 'phel byed/ /ha ri chen po 9ribadug spos te/ /gdong bcu gcig pas glo 7bur sel/ /seng ge sgras ni mdze nad sel/ /rnal 'byor yo byad 'dod pas ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sngags kyis 1stobakru/ /bkra shis rol mo du ma dang / /gtsang sbra gos gsar 12ldan pa yis / /snyan pa'i 1 gdangs dang ldan pas bkru/ /myur du sgrib pa 'byang ba dang ske/ /'dod yon kun grub sngags phreng ni/ /gang dang gang yang sbyar bar 'gyur / /phran tshegs gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /zla ba gzas bzung 1 gyur pa'i tshe / /mar sung gcig ni dngul snod gzhug15 /sku gzugs mdun bzhag sngags brjod nas/ /zla ba sos nas mar blangs te/ /zos sam lus la byugs pa yis//nad rnams zhi zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /ldong ros gi'u 15wang cha mnyam pas/ /sku yi mdun bzhag sngags stong bzla/ /chus sbrus 1 dpral bar thig 1 le ni/ /khams gsum mthong zhing 'dod gsum 'grub/ /chu dron 519sbyar nas lus bkrus na 91—917

na / /nad dang bgegs rnams dag par 'gyur/ /bse 'bras la ni brgya rtsa brgyad / /bzlas nas khro zhal g.yas la byug /dgra dpung phyogs su bstan na ni / /dgra g.yul shin tu nyes par 'gyur/ /bal bu 'bras bu sngags rer bcas / /bal 14bu le la brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sku yi drung du bsregs pas ni/ /mi yams phyugs nad thams cad 'chad/ /skud pa gtsang tshon/ma mdog dmar po/ /sngags re btab pa'i mdud pa bdun/ /zhal gcig steng zhal btags nas ni/ /nad pa la btags rims nad zhi/ /sngags re mdud tsho pa nyi shu gcig /mdun zhal steng bzhag blangs 4)btags pas/ /mkha' 'gro 'byung po ro langs gdon/ /drag pos zin pa 'joms par byed/ /gal te des kyang ma sos na/ /mdud re brgya rtsa brgyad brjod nas/ /zhal gcig mdun zhal dbur btags te/ /blangs te btags na nges par grol/ /sdug bsngal nad pa yun rings gdungs(de //khyim du 'dre gdon 'jigs zhugs nas(6ri/ /'bru re sngags (7༄re thang 'brom 'bras / /sku mdun 8)brgya rtsa brgyad grangs 99ske te/ /gong ltar bsgrubs 0pa'i skud pa yang / /lus la btags na grol bar nges11/ /mi mdza' ba dang 'khrug pa dang glu/ /byad stems 12drag po bzlog 1 pa la/ /sku la spos dang me tog mchodami/ /bi nā 15ya yi gzugs mdun du/ /bra bo'i 'bras bu dgra ming bsregatso /sngags re mdud pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mdud ldan g.yon gyi khro zhal gdagasanyi / /zhag bzhi lon nas 1 sku las dgrol/ /mdud pa re re'i bar du ni/ /sngags re brjod cing bcang 19bar bya/ /bdag la sdang byed skyabs su 'ong / /rdzas dang sngags kyi nus pa'o/ /brtson pa'i bar chad bsal ba ni/ /tshon sna lnga yi skud pa la / /mdud re 2 sngags re brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mdud nas mdud stobazhag steng 91wa 918

btags pa/ /zhag gcig lon dgrol shi)lus btags na/ /las rnams bkra shis tshul du 'grub/ /gang zhig ༷na bsgribs ri pa'i gshegs ldan pas/ /las gang 'dod bzhin mi 'grub cing / /dus dus bkra mi shis byung na/ /gtsang sbra bum chu bzang po gnyis/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bgrangs du0re re brjod/ /dang pos ri5sku gzugs bkru bar bya/ /gnyis pas bi nā (peya ka bkru(ge/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis sngags btab nas/ /rang nyid de nas bkru bar bya/ /bar chad byang nas 'dod kun 'grub/ /ci ri3)ltar sprul pa'i gdon bsal phyir/ /byi la'i mgo rus thal ba dang / /sa bzang chu gtsang 9༄sgrus pa'i sa/ /byi la yi ni gzugs byas te / /sku yi mdun du bzhag bonas kyang / /khro zhal g.yon par srad bus gdagasarmolha / /rta mgrin sngags ni stong phrag brab/ /gzungs brgya 12bzlas pa'i ral gri yis/ /dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad du gtub3lha/ /dum bu re re sngags re dang ske/ /dong gi nang du dor bar bya/ /de dag gnod pa gtan du sel/ /mig nad sna tshogs ma rungs la/ /'bras bu gsum pa zhib tu btags/ /sbrang dkar khye'u 'tsho khonu zhor bcas/ /bu btsas gsar 15pa'i bud med dang / /khyi phag dag gis ma slomathong byas17/ /thum po 'dzum pa'i zhal la btags/ /sngags stong bzlas nas sbyar ba des/ /mig tu blugs na mig 'bras skye/ /mig nad thams cad sel bar byed/ /mig rnon dag kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ /lhag ma ma yin khron pa'i chus18/ / ga bur gu gul 19cha mnyam bskol/ / khyor gang bldag ri )par 'gyur ba 21de/ /rtsa ba'i zhal gdangs 32sngags stod snyebazlas/ /bgrol nas ril bu byas mid na/ /ha la ha la'i dug 'joms 'gyur/ /glang po dkar po'i gi'u 5wang ni/ /mthing bum bzhag nas sku yi mdun/ /stong rtsa 91wa 919

brgyad bzlas yan lag bskul/ /dpral smibar thig le byas gyur na/ /lha klu 'byung po 2mi rnams dga'/ /khyo shug mi mthun brtags gepa la/ /ngur pa'i mthug rgya sgro sku'i 5mdun du/ /stong bzlas lag tu blangs na 'dum/ /chu skam rigapa 'am char med na/ /ling ga'i drung du sku bzhugs la/ /cher mchod nas ni sku'i mdun du/ /stong brjod chur (75skyes char chen 'bebs/ /gang zhig char che ring 'dod ni/ /'gog par snyoms zhugs phyag rgya bcing / /sku yi mdun du rtag par ni/ /a ka ru nag bdug 98)pa sogs/ /mchod pas po'o rgyun du mchod bya zhing ske/ /brgyad nas nya bar sngags stong brjod/ /mig gi mngon shes bsgrub tshepa'i phyir/ /dri zhim dkyil 'khor gru bzhi la/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan kha dog bzhi//bla re yol ba dkar po yi11/ /dbus su pad+ma lnga bris te/ /ring bsrel ldan pa'i sku gdung 512bzhugs/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i dri chu dang / /bdug pas hunyergyun du mchod par bya/ /ba mdog ser skya'i mar gyi ni/ /sgron me'i 〉phreng bas mchod par bya/ /man shi ri ka ku shu dang / /pad+ma dmar dang sngon po dang / /rgya mtsho chab kyi dbu ba dang / /nya rkun skonag po'i sgyu 16gu dang / /ma brlabs 1 pa dang gu gul dang / /ku ba nas dang gi'u 1 /wang dang / /gur gum 39dmar dang ser po dang / /tsha ba gsum dang cha mnyam brdungs / /de rnams phyed tshad gla rtsi dang ske/ /ga bur stsal nas re re'i tshad/ /sngags ni stong phrag re re'i 21grangs/ /sku yi mdun du brjod par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 52dbus bzhag nas/ /sngags khrir bcas te nya la ni/ /zangs kyi za ma tog tu stsal/ /sku yi steng zhal btags nas ni/ /mchod pa byas nas gsol ba gdab lha/ /'khar na4ba'i thur mas mig tu stsal/ /ling thog gam ni mchi ma 'dzag dz+wa /sprin dkar sprin 97wa 920

dmar g.yos pa dang / /klad 17pa na dang mig nad dang / /glo bur long dang thibs ri pa sel/ /nyin gnyis bskus na lus kyi nad/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sel bar 'gyur/ /gsum pa gdon 5snyernams 'bros par 'gyur/ /bzhi pas sgrib pa thams cad byang pa/ /lngas ni rtsod pa'i g.yul las rgyal/ /drug pas rmi ngan tshorabyad stems sel/ /bdun pas glo tshormebur 'chi ba med/ /bdun ()phrag gnyis kyis dbang phyug 'thob/ /gsum gyis 'byung po dbang du 'gyur/ /bzhi pas gnod sbyin lnga pas klu/ /lnga pas lha mi srin po rnams/ /drug pas mkha' lding ri bdun lha/ /bdun pas nanag po chen po 'grub/ /brgyad pas ma mo dgus gter 79skumathong / /bcu pas 'gro ba'i sman par 'gyur/ /bcu gcig lha mo'i 1 tshokhang par phyin/ /bcu gnyis rig 'dzin drang srong khyim/ /bcu gsum klu yi khang par phyin/ /bcu bzhi sum cu 11gsum pa'i gnas/ /bcwa 512lnga mtshan mo kun mthong ste/ /bcu drug khams gter mthong bar nges/ /bcu bdun rdo rje sa gzhi dang / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor thogs 1 pa med/ /bcwa brgyad pa 1rwani nyi ltar mgyogs/ /bcu dgu 15rgyal sras kun mthong 'gyur/ /nyi shus spyan ras gzigs nyid kyis/ /lung bstan dam chos bshad par 'gyur/ /nyi shu gcig gis gzugs khams phyin/ /mngon shes lnga dang ldan par 'gyur/ /lo gcig gis ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing khams 17du mar phyin 1 pa dang / /dam chos nyan dang zhing spyod 'gyur/ /mig sman sbyor ba bla med 'di/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs can la gsang / /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sna tshogs sman gyi sbyor ba yis / /bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub byed nyon / /ga bur gla rtsi gi'u 12wang dang / /gur gum 19dz+dza 2 ti li shi dang / /ka 91wa 921

tan la dang sug smrel dang / /tsan+dan dkar dang pad+ma dang / /gser gyi me tog ut+pal sngo/ /re re la yang sngags stong bzla/ /sbrang rtsi dkar po lhan ①cig sbru/ge/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su sku yi zhal/ /dbu ma la ni gdags ((bya ste/ /tshes gcig nas ni bcu bzhi'i 94)bar/ /nyin re sngags stong brjod par bya/ /mchod pa nargya cher mchod par bya/ /bstod dang gsol ba gdab (6)par bya/ /dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen tsho ragang / /bcwa 8)lnga'i nyin par lnga stong bzla/ /de nas gtsang ma'i snod bzhag ste/ /dgos ḍapa gang dang gang la yang / /lha ni de dang de dag sbyar/ /gang la bgegs kyis tsheganod gyur nas37/ /pad+ma gar gyi sngags kyis bdun/ /'go nyu ba'i nad yams bsal ba dang / /ha la ha la'i sngags bzlas pas 1lha/ /gos la sogs pa bdug 51stepar bya/ /gzhan dag dga' bar ge'adod pas ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng sngags kyis / /mig gi steng du byug mi par bya/ /rgyal po rgyal mo la sogs pa/ /pho mo dbang du bya 'dod na/ /rdo rje chos kyi phreng sngags kyis/ /dpral bar thig le bya ba'o/ /mdze la sogs pa'i nad la ni/ /seng ge sgra yi nyu2phreng sngags kyis/ /lus la reg pa bde bar byuganyu3 /long du zhugs 2 pa'i nad la ni/ /ha ri chen po'i sngags dang chus/ /rang gi khong du btung bar bya/ /byad stems rig sngags bzlog tsho nyapa la/ /don yod zhags 22pa'i sngags kyis bdug lha /dug nad sel la mgrin sngon 2gete/ /sgrib pa sbyong ba'i don du ni/ /gdong bcu gcig pa nyid kyis sbyar/ /rgyal srid thob par byed pa ni/ /mgon po pad+ma rgyan lung ngo / /de nas sbyor ba bshad bya ba/ /'byung po sha za mkha' 'gro dang / /lus srul po dang brjed 3 byed kyis/ /nyin gcig 27nas ni nyin bdun bar/ /glo bur ba yi rims rnams dang / /rtag 91wa 922

pa'i rims dang drag po'i rims/ /brtun byed la sogs rims rigs dang / /glo bur ba dang rtag pa'i gdon/ /nad drag po ni ji snyed dang / /dug rigs rims dang lba ba dang / /'bras dang lhog pa me dbal dang / /shu ba rngo dang 'brum bu'i rigs/ /phol mig me dbal bal ldog 1)sogs/ /mngon du gang dang gang snang la/ /sngags stong bzlas pa'i 'jim pa ni/ /sku zhal dbus la btags nas ni/ /mchod pas mchod de sngags khri brjod/ /tshes gcig nas ni tshes brgyad bar/ /gsol ba yang ni gdab tsho byas nas/ /tshes dgu'i snga dro dgrol bar bya/ /bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ / ri dri bzang ༄byugs 5pas nad rnams 6sel/ /cho ga de ltar ldan pas ni/ /sna nad ru rta 'bru mar byug /yang na gre bar sngags bcas gdags / /byis pa gdon gyis nyen pa la//'bru mar ram ni srad 8bu bya/ /dud 'gro la ni chu nyid dam/ /yang na srad bu bya ba ste/ /rtsi mar dag gis 9mchog tu 'gyur/ /sbyor rnams gang dang gang la yang ske/ /sku byad mtshan dpe ldan pa 1 ni/ /me long nang gi gzugs ltar dmigs / /gsol ba btab pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /dang po skye mched drug ldan sems/ /thun mong 11rigs can sra ba'i khams/ /gnyis pa mos dang ldan pa ni/ /thun mong kun du zhugs pa'i rigs/ /gsum pa rigs 12pa'i rtags ldan pa/ /rig 1 'dzin gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rigs/ /bzhi pa lhag sems mthun riboldan zhing / /gsang sngags sngon du gyur pa yi15/ /lnga pa blang dor med pa'i sems/ /drug pa bdag gzhan dbyer med sems/ /bdun pa chos rnams rgyal ba'i sems/ /brgyad pa 'phags pa'i bden pa'i sems/ /dgu pa rten 'brel zab snang sems/ /bcu pa mtshan bral grub pa'i sems/ /bcu gcig 91—923

mtshan bral snang ba'i sems/ /bcu gnyis chos kyi sgo yi sems/ /bcu gsum lhag par 'byung ba'i sems/ /bcu bzhi shes bya mthar thug sems/ /rgyas dang gsal 1dang khyab pa dang / /rtag 9gedang 'gyur med gya rnam pa'i/ /gnas skabs bcu bzhir rab tu rtogs/ /sems rtogs gyur nas ri risangs rgyas chos/ /rgyud kun du ni rgyal bas bshad/ /'od zer lcags kyu khyud mo'i ri yi bar④/ /spros pas lha 5'bum phrag dge kun slong sems/ /dkar po skyes nas byang chub rin chen gling / /thob mdzad blos bsgyur 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las sku la rten 6pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs/ /rgya chen rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /shar lho mtshams 7na bzhugs pa yi/ /nya na ka tsho cizhes la sogs pa/ /drang srong tshogs rnams mgrin gcig tu/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad gsol/ /oṃ kun mkhyen 9ye shes nyi ltar lha/ /mtshan dpe du mas brgyan tshamadzad pa/ /bdud las rgyal ba rkang gnyis mchog /'dren pa rnams la phyag 'tshal mo zhi ba chags 11bral 'od gsal ba/ /rgyun chad med pa'i ho 'khor lo'i tshul/ /skye rga na 'chi las sgrol zhing / /rnam dag bsgrub 1lhagasum chos phyag 'tshal/ /sa chen sa chen gzhan rnams kyang / /sa la 'dren mdzad tshogs chen rdzogs/ /rgyun mi 'chad sadu sku 'byung ba/ /thal sbyar pus btsugs 35phyogs gcig 'khod/ /de nas rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /dbang phyug chen po nya9mchog gi lha/ /spyan ras gzigs 1 dbang thugs rje can/ /'gro la thugs 1 brtse'i slad du ni/ /rig 91—924

sngags bla na med pa gsung nyusta/ /sngags de myur du 'grub pa dang / /skongs dang ngag la sel ba'i phyir/ /me yi las la brten pa'i phyir/ /sbyor ba rim pa bshad du gsol/ /de skad gsol nas drang srong tshogs/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas kyang / /mchod pa'i char chen phab pa ste/ /thal sbyar pus btsugs rinaphyogs gcig 'khod/ /de nas rgyal sras kun gyi yab/ /'gro ba'i gnyen tsho gcig 3)'dren pa'i gtso/ /sbyin sreg gelas kyi cho ga 'di/ /nan tan du ni bka' stsal to/ /sa bzang dri bzang chur bcas pas/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham pa ༅cibya/ / zo'abras phye ba mar 'bru bzang rnams/ /shing 97rtsi shi 'am brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bsgrags pas nad yams gnod pa zhi/ /nad la mar lhag nyung zhig btung / /nad gzer gang yang 'joms par 'gyur/ /yang na 'bru men phye ma 'am/ /sa 'am spra tshil gzugs byas te/ /srad tshonadabus khro ba'i 9zhal btags mnas/ /rig sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod de11/ /ral gris gtubs nas sbyin sreg nya bya/ /brgya phrag lngas ni sdang byed nyams/ /yang na dug gis gzugs ho brnyan btumañja/ /dug khrag nim pa'i shing la bsregs /drug cu 8rtsa bzhi 51 cigangs kyis ni/ /tshar bcad pa yi dbang du 'gyur/ /'byung po drag po zhen kye2pa la/ /gu gul yungs kur 19de ltar bsreg /bal po nyese'u lcug ma la//bu ram sbrang rtsi zho mar sbag na /sku yi 3lhamadun 34du bsregs 32pas ni/ /'go ba'i nad yams tsho'achad par 'gyur/ /gu gul dkar po nyi shu gcig /bsregs na byang chub sems dpa' 'gugs/ /zho mar sbrang rtsi lung tang shing / /nyi shu rtsa gcig sku mdun bsreg /sa chen rgyal sras kun mnyam pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po des rnyed 'gyur/ /gang gi 2 bsod nams rgyas 'dod na / /dri 91—925

bzang 1chu dang sa gtsang la/ /gru rinabazhi khru gang dkyil 'khor bya/ /dri bzang shing la khru gang brtsigan /mdzi rlo sha ka yungs kur ri'usprang / /'o ma zho mar a ka yiru / /tsan+dan dkar 7po dmar po dang / /dri zhim mtho gang tshad kyi shing / /'bru bzang tshad dang bcas pa dag /dang por sngags stong bzlas (khunas kyang / /brgya rtsa brgyad du bsgrags pa yis/ /tshe ring nad med rgyal srid 'thob pe/ /stong gis 'jig rten pa dag 'grub/ /khris ni 'dod pa'i lha yin te/ /'bum gyis gzugs khams mngon du gyur / /sa yas rgyal 7sras kun mthong zhing / /mngon shes drug dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bye bas rgyal ba kun mthong 12zhing / /zhing khams du ma spyod par 12'gyur/ /gzhan yang phran tshegs las rnams la/ /ci sasrid nyi shu rtsa gcig nas7/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du sbyoras/ /sngags dang lha la sems brtan 17bya/ /nad yams 1 medag po bsal ba la/ /gtso bor 'bras bu gsum bsreg go/ /gdon chen rnams ni bsal ba la/ /gu gul sgog pa rnga mo'i sha /brgya rtsa brgyad 19du bsreg par bya/ /mi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /phra mo nad dang gdon rigs la/ /drur ba yungs kur 21mchog tu bshad/ /'bru rnams gang dang gang 'dod la/ /'bru rig dade nyid sbyin sreg 32bya/ /char pa dbab par 'dod pas ni/ /tsam pa ka dang rnam gsum dang / /mngar gsum nā ga ge sar dang / /dbang po lag gi sbyin sreg ni/ /ci 'dod char pa 'bab par 'gyur/ /gal te bcad 25par 'dod pas 27ni/ /thal ba de dang 3 tshoyungs kur 2gyis/ /nan tan phyogs bzhir gar dbang gi 9/ /sngags kyis yang yang gtor bar bya/ / yungs kur zho mar sbrang rtsi dang / /'bras yos kyis ni byis pa sos/ /gdon nam 1rims las 'jigs pa dang / /khyim bsrung ra bar 91wa 926

ni 'dod pa yis/ /pad+ma dmar po'i sbyin sreg 17ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig 2)kho na bya//sems bzang gzhugs tsho — ring 4'dod pas ni/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i sbyin sreg 5)bya//phran tshegs 567yams nad sel ba la/ /lo ma tsam gyi sbyin sreg tsho7༄bya/ /phyugs 8nad sel bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ /'o ma me tog dkar bcas bsreg9 /nad dang gdon bcas sel ba la/ /mngar gsum 'bru bzang ga pur bcas/ /drur 1 rab dkar po'i yams 17shing rnams/ /712 bud shing 1lha'o ma can rnams ni/ /me tog bzang po'i boshing la bsregaci15 /gdon nad zhi bar 'dod pas ni/ /'bras bu gsum sogs shing rnams bsregaslo /gdon phran la ni mngar gsum dang / /drur 1 ba dkar po bsregs pas zhi(13/ /mi lam ngan dang ltas ngan gang / /'bras phye mar sngags 19sel bar byed/ /gos dang snod bcad 2 rdzas dang lus/ /gzhan grib ngan pas gos pa la 1/ /'bras phye mar dang spos dkar dang / /me tog dkar po bsreg par bya/ /ting lo sa/byid kyi me tog bsreg lha /mig nad thams cad sel bar byed/ /ma su li ma rtsa bar bcas/ /bsreg 2 na rna ba'i nad sel 'gyur/ /tsan+dan gla rtsi ba mar bsregs lha/ /sna yi nad rnams tsithams cad sel/ /mu zi gu gul ri lu bsregs / /so dang lce yi nad sel 'gyur / /so rna rna dza dang ka ku ra/ /bsregs pas ske nad 'joms par byed 9/ /sbrang rtsi tsan+dan sha ka ra/ /bsregs pas glo nad sel bar byed/ /'bras bu gsum dang zho sha lnga/ /bsregs pas snying nad sel bar byed/ /'u su sbrang dang byi dang ka /bsregs pas mchin pa'i nad sel 'gyur/ /me tog kha dog lnga bsregs na/ /pho ba la sogs nang grol nad/ /ma lus thams cad zhi bar byed//lus mdzes pa yang thob par 'gyur/ /nor 'dod pas ni seng ldeng mer/ /ba 91wa 927

ser 17zho dang mar bsreg bya/ /gos mdog gang dang gang 'dod la/ /de dang mtshungs pa'i me tog dang / /srad bu sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /shing mdog de dang mthun 5pa yin/ /dri zhim dag la bsreg par bya/ /rnyed 'gyur the tshom mi bya'ol/ /pri yang ku dang ka 45ling kun /pad+ma'i ze ba yal sdong la/ /bsregs (snyucing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /gter gyi longs ri spyod rgyas par 'gyur/ /'bras dang myu gu'i 2'bras bu sogs/ /bsreg (sheran longs spyod brtan 57par 'gyur/ / dan khod pa la 11'bras bu gsum/ /brgya bsregs bu dang bu mo 'phel/ /'bras yos 'phel bar 'dod pas kyang / /spri cho1 ka nyunyedza 6ti me tog dkar/ /ba dkar 'o ma zho mar bcas/ /bsregs pas 'khor dang dmag dpung 'phel/ /de 'bum grangs kyis rgyal srid 'thob/ /mngar gsum bil ba'i 'bras bu la/ /'bum gyis rang nyid rgyal por 'gyur/ /sngags mthu rgyas pa'i don du ni/ /nim 15pa'i shing la mar dang ni/ / yungs kur midakar po sbrang bcas la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad 1 du bsreg par bya/ /gang gis rgyal po 'khor dang nyu2bcas/ /dbang du bya bar 'dod pa yis/ /yungs kur 19rgyal ba'i yungs kur snabacas/ /rgya 21sran drug tu bsreg par bya/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams dbang 'dod na/ /mya ngan med pa'i yam shing la/ /'bras bu gsum dang gur gum 25ni/ /stong phrag gcig tu bsreg par bya/ /gnod sbyin tshogs dbang byed pa la/ /'bras bu gsum pa'i shing la ni/ /'bras bu gsum dang dgu gul la/ /stong phrag gnyis su bsreg par bya/ /lha rnams dbang du bya 'dod pas/ /a ru ra yi shing sar zuril / /'o ma zho mar sbrang rtsi la/ /sum stong bsregs gepas lha dbang 'gyur/ /bud med dbang du 'dod pas ni/ /til dang 'bras sogs phub ma la/ /91wa 928

'bras dang rang byung 17brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bsregs rin pas bzang mo dbang du 'gyural/ /byis pa dbang du 'dod pas ni/ /pri yang ku yi sbyin sreg ribya/ /las rnams gang dang gang la yang / /de dang mtshungs pa'i sems kyis tsho sbyor/ /zhi ba zhi ba'i yid kyis te/ / skal bzang 755blo ni rgyas pa la/ /chags dang 'dun 96༄sems ldan pas ni/ /dbang du 'gyur tsho la the tshom med/ /khro dang bcas pa'i yid kyis ni/ /drag po'i las su 'gyur ba yod/ /brtan po dal 'byor ldan pa'i blo/ /rgyun rtag (8gsal ba yod gyur 9ḍapas/ /ci ltar bsam 1 )pa de 'grub kyi/ /gzhan du yang ni de ltar min/ /mig la skyon zhugs lus kyi ni / /dngos gang gsal bar blta te/ba ltar/ /bla ma dang ni bral gyur na12/ /sngags kyi nye byin brlabs ngasnang ba medabo/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas kyang 17/ /rnam pa kun du bla ma la/ /smod 7pa 'bad de 1 spang bar bya/ /smad 19pas dmyal sogs ngan 'gror 'gro/ /bla ma'i ngag las byung ba dang / /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya mchod/ /oṃ ru ru spru 2 ru 1spyo 22la tiṣ+ṭha sid dha lo tsa ne lhasarba arba sā dha ni swā hā/ bsang gtor dang ku sha dgram pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzā la dzā gi lā na delārka 9swā hā/ sbar ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā tsā 7/ oṃ asna 8ye ā dī sa bya ā bi rdzosha ma hā shri ye ha 1bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ mchod mar gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ til gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pā de — swā hā/ /zho dang zan dam pa'i'o na/ /oṃ badz+ra bha smi ri ku ru ku ru swā hā/ ut+pa la lo snye/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye phyog hā/ 'bras kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a pra ti :ha ta badz+ra swā hā/ ku sha'os / /oṃ badz+ra bi shedz+ra ya swā hā/ lag pan gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mā le put+pa ye swā hā/ mngar gsum dang dkar gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā be gā 4 riya swā 91—929

hā / nas kyi'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā 1 ya swā hā/ sran ma ma sha'i'o9nas/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ gro'o ci/ /oṃ badz+ra yadz+nyā ya saswā hā/ u 95dum bā ra'o ge/ /oṃ ti ti pri mi 7su hā/ byang chub shing ngo tshonas/ /oṃ badzā 9ri ṅgā ya tshog hā/ n+ya mgro dha'o12ske/ /oṃ badz+ra rna kā ya 12su hā/ a mra'i'o57/ /oṃ āḥtrīḥ// thams cad du bsang ba'o15/ /chus ni dag par byed pa dang 16/ /rdul sogs mun pa zhi bar byed/ /zhi ba chu yi dkyil 'khor bar/ /dkar po zlum po kho na'o/ /sas 1 ni rtswa 1 shing 'bru me tog /skyed 16dang dngos po rgyas par byed/ /rgyas pa'i 2 tshos yi dkyil 'khor ltar/ /ser po gru bzhi pa na'o/ /rlung gis sdud dang 'byed pa dang / /dbang du byas nas g.yo bar byed/ /dbang la rlung gi dkyil 'khor ltar/ /zla gam dmar po'i kha dog go/ /mes ni smin cing sreg stopa dang / /drag shul gyis 2 ni yal bar byed/ /drag po gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor ske/ /nang dmar rgyab ni nag por bya/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ni/ /mun pa'i sgrib pa zhi bar byed/ /zhi la 25shar du bltas pa ste/ /dpal ldan gos kyang dkar po'o/ /nyi ma byang du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /dngos po rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /rgyas pa byang du bltas bya ba/ /gos ni ser ram ljang gu 50shis/ /nyi ma thal nas mtshan mo ni/ /dbang na du dngos po 'gyur 22ba'i phyir/ /dbang la nub phyogs bltas pa dang / /gos kyang dmar ser 9rab tu shis/ /nyi ma lhor 'gro'i dus su ni/ /shin tu grang ba'i 0chu yis ni/ /rtswa 1sogs dadangos rnams bsad nas kyang / /des dang 'thor dang dengs pa dang / /skabs tsho dang g.yar dang dub pa dang / /rab tu g.yos dang bcas par 'gyur/ /mngon spyod lho yi phyogs bltas nas/ /gos kyang sngo dang nag po bya/ /tsam pa ka dang 91—930

pu ti ka /lag skyes pad+ma dkar po dang / /ku mud dkar po zla seng rnams/ /chu gtsang dang bar bcas 1)pa dag /zhi ba'i las la mchod par bya/ /mañju (2)nā ga bi bsha ri/ /su mu le dang a spras dang / /gser mdog chen po chu dung dang // tsi'u le ra ser dang pad+ma ser/ /chu bo chen po chur bcas pa/ /rgyas pa'i las la bsngags pa'o/ /mu tsi tshanan dang man du chu dmar/ /lo yi che dang nya sha rnams97)la/ / sin dhu 8cir dang (9 pad+ma dmar/ /ku mu da rigs nyu byedamar po rnams//lu ma'i chu dang bcas pa ste/1/ /dbang gi las la mchod par bya/ /ut+pal k+ṣe pa la ka dang / /ud khye nyi pa dang ma mi shispos/ /dzu mong sbyin la mgo bo dang / /phag rna daṇ+ḍita pa mal rnams/ /khron pa'i chu dang lhan cig tu/ /mngon spyod las la mchod par bya/ /sā 8lu dkar po 8zan dang zho/ /pri ka spos ni zhi ba la / /sā 1 7lu dmar po'i zan 'o ma/ /tsan+dan dmar po dbang la'o/ /gro dang ma sha bser 3— )ba'i zan/ /hu lu ka ni rgyas pa la'o/ /nas dang bra bo'i 519zan gu gul / /btsos pa'i sha dang lhan cig ste/ /drag po'i las de zhal zas dang / /bdug spos bye brag shes par bya/ /rtsi mar dang ni a ba 2 se'i/ /sdong bur ldan pa'i mar me 1ni/ /zhi ba'i las la shin tu shis/ /yang na pad dkar sdong bu'o//til lam shin tu dngas na ma dang / /sa ri ha yi sdong bu ni/ /rgyas pa'i las la shin tu shis/ /yang na ba yi lag gi cha/ /na ke la yi mar dang ni/ /pad+ma dmar po'i mar dang ni/ /dbang gi las la shin tu shis/ /yang na ba ya ma ri'o / /yungs dang tsi na li mar dang ni/ / tsi tra'i sdong bu mar me ni/ /yang na gso 2nama'i shun pa yis tsho/ /mdog dmar 2 dal zhing gsal ba ni/ /gangs 2ri'i rtse ltar dkar 9'bar ba/ /bar bre smra gul spos dkar dri/ /zhi ba'i las 91—931

ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mdog dmar g.yo zhing mog pa la/ /nyi ma thal ku'i ri rtse 'dra/ /shib sgra ma li ka la'i dri/ /dbang gi shi)las 'grub the tshom med/ /mdog ser mig g.yo dngas pa ri la/ /nyi ma shar ba'i ri ltar 'bar/ /lhab sgra tsam pa ka yi dri/ /rgyas pa'i las 'grub the tshom med/ / le brgan ④mdog ldan 'khyil zhing smug /hur 5༄sgra rul dri bro ba dang / /nags kyi ri bo ltar 'bar ba/ /mngon spyod las la 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten ting 'dzin ldan grub 6pa'i/ /drang srong rigs la dpag med kyang / /me yi lha ni bzhi bcu bzhi / /sbyin sreg 7las la spang bar bya/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i ting 'dzin can / /bcu gnyis grangs ni gzung bar bya/ /gnya' nasan ka 9947dang sa bi bokyi/ /tuk+ṣa se'u mya phye tro dang / /lto ba yid skyes khro bo dang / /dmar po mṛ 3nyeta cho ma li / /bhi 12su ya ki 1lhabacu gnyis po/ /phan 'dogs la sogs las la sbyar/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg lathal bas ni/ /'byung po phra mo zhi bar byed/ /dbang gi tshethal bas 'byung po 'ching / /rgyas pas 'dod pa'i las sbyin byed/ /ri bo'i lartse la gtor 1 bar bya/ /drag pos 'byung po sel bar byam/ /lam gyi gzhung du gtor 19bar bya/ /zhi dang dbang gi zhing phyogs dang / /ra ba skyed 2 )mos tshal du gtor/ /dag par byed pas chu bo ltar/ /rgyas pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ginyedang ske/ /gang bar byed pa rgya mtsho na ltar/ /sbyin sreg gis 22ni lha mnyes shing / /sngags bsgrub 2 sngags kyi dilas rnams 'grub/ /drang srong tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /dri za'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams thams cad ni sha/ /sbyin sreg 2 gis ni rab dga' nas/ /rnal 'byor grogs byed bsrung 2 ba dang / /skyob phyir tshe ring dpal 'phel zhing / /nad 91wa 932

med longs spyod rgyas pa dang / /bsam pa bzhin hu)du 'grub par 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma 2)dra ba zhes bya ba las me la brten ri pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /rdzu 'phrul 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /mkha' risal yi ge sprul nas ni/ /'gro don sna tshogs mdzad pa zhig /'khor bcas dkyil 'khor der lhags nas/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyas par mchod/ /phyogs gcig 'khod 5)nas ston pa la/ /mgrin gcig gsung ni snyan pa yis/ /'di skad tshig ni gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan 65pa'i sku/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /chos kyi longs spyod ji (gesnyed pa/ /rdzogs par longs spyod mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /gang la mkho ba de'i gtso bo/ /'dren pa gzugs brnyan du ma 'chang sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa'i sku/ /bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'gyur rnam dag byang chub lam/ /phyogs chos byang chub sum cu 8bdun/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs 9/brtson mdzad pa/ /chos rnams lhun grub 7sku phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag rgya mtshor ldan rnams la/ /thugs rje rgya mtsho rgyun byung nas11/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho spyod 12mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /sngags dang rdzas dang phyag rgya'i rim1snye/ /sna tshogs kyis ni don mdzad phyir/ /theg cipa kun las khyad par du/ /sngags kyi theg pa 12khyad par 'phags/ /nan tan sgrub pa smos ci dgos/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'chang 17bas kyang / /nad dang gnod sel ’ bskal pa yi/ /sgrib rnams 'byang bas khyad par 'phags/ /91—933

dbul po rigs dang dman 1)pa yang / /zhugs ma thag nas bde ldan zhing / /cung zad grub nas nus mthu ni/ /dpag med 'byung bas khyad par 'phags/ /mgon po bcom ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpal chen ye shes kun gyi mdzod/ /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gzi can/ /'gro ba 'dren gtso ded dpon gyi/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pa yis 'gro la risna tshogs phan don du/ /ci ltar 'gyur mdzad bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa che / /pad+ma'i spyan gdangs 'dzum mdzad nas/ /tshangs pa'i gsung ni snyan pa yis/ /'gro la phan phyir 'di skad gsungs/ /dge byed phyag rgya sngags dang bcas/ /'gro la phan phyir zhus pa ni/ /legs so rdzu 'phrul 'khor lo che/ /shes rab 'chang ba khyod legs so/ /sems dpa' chen po de phyir ngas/ /khyod 5la ngo mtshar legs par bshadakyi/ /khyod kyang rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /legs par ri zung 8la rgya cher spros/ /ras sam gro ga shing shun gang ske/ /'jam zhing 'onag ris med pa la/ /gur gum bogi'u 1lhawang sen rtsi dang ske/ /tsan+dan gyis ni phyag rgya bri/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud bcas/ /'od dang ldan pa bri bar bya/ /dha ra dha ra 12dang po ste/ /gnyis par dhi ri dhi ri spro/ /gsum pa dhu ru dhu ru ste/ / mithe bisne 1 bzhi lnga pa/ /tsa le tsa le gnyis bri'o/ /pra tsa le gnyis drug par ro/ /ku su me dang ku su ma/ /bdun pa 7bris te brgyad pa la/ / ba le 15yi li mi li bri/ /oṃ mi tsi ti dza 7lam dang / / swā hār nyu bcas pa dbus su'o1 / /phyag 'tshal bcas sngags mtha' mar bri/ /rab rdzogs sngags kyis lhar dmigs nas/ /gtsang ma'i mchod pas mchod bya ste/ / sngags stong 19brjod nas lus la gdags sna/ /'di ni bsrung 2lhaba'i mchog tu 91wa 934

'gyur / /nad dang yams dang gdon rnams dang / /'jigs 3)pa brgyad las skyob ( par nges/ /rig sngags bzlog na tsho(khyad par du/ /rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga la / /'od kyi ra ba zlum po yibasku/ /ri mo gnyis dang bcas pa bri/ /rwa na rnams la ni hūm̐ gnyis par/ /rig 56sngags bzlog (pedang bcas pa bri/ /lte bar oṃ hrīḥswā hā'i bar/ /bdag nyid bsrung zhes 98dbri bar bya/ /mu khyud dang por bri tshalabar bya/ /gzigs dbang yid bzhin nor sngags so/ /gnyis par gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gsum par pad+ma gar dbang gi/ /sngags rnams g.yas su bskor bar bya/ /gal te nad yams bzlog 7pa la/ /'dab brgyad pad+ma mu khyud gsum / /sngon ltar yi ge bkod pa la/ /mu khyud gnyis par spyan gyi sngags/ /gsum par rten 'brel sngags bris nas/ /lus sam mgul 17du thogs pas ni/ /nad rims dang ni lhog 512'brum sogs1lha/ /rlung gis bordul 35bzhin sel bar 'gyur / /de nas tshig de thos ma thag /lha min bu mo nad bdag mo/ /sa tu de bi zhes bya ba/ /bzhengs te thal mo sbyar byas te / /bu mo khris ni mgrin gcig tu / /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad gsol/ /rje btsun 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pohu tsho / /mgon po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi sngags 'di gang 'dzin pa/ /gal te 'brum nad byung na ni/ /bdag ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro / /dam bcas 'di ni dran par bya/ /tre ba la bya'i 1 rika 19ka ba ni tan tsho/ /su ma ya bi lā 21sa ka ka ra ni/ /kyi shun pañca tra li he na 22yi/ /ke na ka ta 2lhatsa ra ṇi / /ya mi rna gnad ma na 27tsa/ / ya mi pa ra nad bur dwa/ /dwa tsa pid :tra tsin+t+ra 2rtand dam / /sa stu 1de wi me bha ba rta/ /lha mos de skad gsol ma thag /mgon pos 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /oṃ oṃ bha bita bin+ti lhami ti/91wa 935

ga tsan+d+ra ka ra ni3)/ a mu ka su ka pya/ lo hi ta gi dha pa rigerak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/byin brlabs rin ldan pa'i sngags de ni/ /rgyun du gebazlas pas (pe'agrub par 'gyur / /oṃ ha na du kāse rū pa shidha ri swā hā/ srad bu ma nyams dkar po la/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig mdud par bya/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlas nas kyang / /lus sam mgul du gdags par bya/ /kre hi ti ka (8)ti ga tra tha prag shigashes /ta thā yo thā botsa la 17he rtsu ༷ rgyu phaṭa/ sran ma rdog po re re la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad brgyad bzlas pa yi/ /'bru bdun thum por byas pa zhig /dri bzang 1snyebacas la mgul du thogs / /yams nad kun dang 'brum nag nad/ /shin tu gdug pa kun sel 'gyur / /de nas rig sngags 'chang ba mo/ /dpal phreng mas ni 'di skad gsol / /bdag gi rig sngags 'di zlos bopa/ /rims nad kun dang bral bar 'gyur / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 515ba lo ki te shwa rā tsheya/ bo dhi satā therteya / ma hā satā ya/ ma hā (2kā ri 0ṇi kā ya/ na mo badz+ra mā ra bi tsho )dza yā tsusto ya/ta /thā ga tā ya/ / arta te saṃ myakle na bud dhā nagaya/ tar+ya tsho — thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ma hā badz+re/ sarba dhī ra sa thā/ ha na ha na badz+ra/ sarba dz+wa ra pra tsho nasha ma na ye swā hā / mi skra mi rus sle tres dang / /gu gul yungs kur 2shesgog skya dang / /shing kun gla mortsi 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs 1brgyad phyogs bzhir hrīḥ geyig bri/ /mtshams lhabazhir bris te dbus su ming / /sngags 'di mu khyud dang po la/ /gnyis gdong bcu gcig pa yi sngags/ /bris nas lus sam mgul du thogs/ /nad rims thams cad sel ba dang / /rnal 'byor kun dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /'gro ba'i don du 'di skad gsol/ /rang 'byung can gyi thuras la ni/ /sen rtsi'i ra 'khor lo rtsibs 29bzhi pa/ /mu 91—936

khyud gsum dang ldan pa bri/ /rtsibs gyo)bzhi trī (geḥl g.yon skor gedu/ /dzī tsho riḥ ghi wa shi du ku ru hrīḥ/ /mu khyud dang por mgon po ni/ /pad+ma gar dbang sngags bri'o / /gnyis pa ut+pal dmar po phreng / /gsum pa lcags ('gyu nyi shu gcig /dbus su rba yig hrīḥr tsho bcas bri/ /lha dam nyid kyang dam byed na/ /'gro ba gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /gsol dang bkra shis brjod pa dang / /bgegs kyi gnod pa sel 'dod pas/ /rtse gsum rdo rje rgya gram ste/ /dbus su naspyan ras gzigs dbang mgon/ /pad+ma gtsug tor sngags bri'o/ /rwa (9ri rnams kun la ju yig ni/ /bgegs ming ud 7tsa ta nyamayis bskor/ /mu khyud dang po 12spyan ras gzigs / /ha la ha la'i sngags bri'o/ /gnyis pa sne khro bo rta skad sngags/ /gsum par bgegs dgra'i sngags bris la/ /de rgyab me yi phung po bri/ /gang zhig 'khor lo 'di bris pas/ /sred med bu ltar mthu che ba/ /gdug thupa can yang 'thor byed na/ /phran tshegs dbyer 3geb smos ci dgos/ /gang la ser sna rnams chags 7shing / /longs spyod 'phel bar mi 'gyur na/ /phun sum tshogs ldan dpal 'phel phyir/ /skyob pa'i phyag rgya bshad par bya/ /rgyal po 'am ni dge 'dun la/ /gtsang ldan ras bzang blangs nas kyang / /dag par bkrus te dri bzang 51 byug /legs par brgyan 51 nas thig btab ste/ /gur gum nya6dang ni gla rdzo — )rtsi yis/ /pad+ma 'dab ma 21bcu drug na bri/ /phyogs bzhir na 'dab mar dpal be'u ste/ /mtshams bzhir yid bzhin nor bu bri/ / mtshams brgyad 3gel ni yi ge ginuste/ /oṃ dang badz+ra da ke hūṃ/ /yi ge drug gis bskor bar bya/ /mu tsho —khyud dang por mi bshol 5sngags/ /gnyis pa shegadong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gsum pa sa 5ut+pal phreng ba ste/ /yang 1tog rtse na'am mdzod bzhag nas/ /91—937

gsol btab mchod na longs ri17spyod 'phel/ /bud med gang zhig bu 'dod pas//de bzhin pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /phyogs bzhir hrīḥ ni mtshams dubasu drang / /dbus su khye'u yi ri gzigs ri5)shig bri/ /phyogs bzhir yid bzhin nor bu britsho6ri/ /sngags bu stsol bcas bri bar bya/ /mtshams 7bzhir oṃ dang a ma ra/ / dzī wa na tī 8ye swā hās bskor/ /mu khyud dang po (shenaspyan ras gzigs/ /pad+ma rgyan lung can gyi sngags/ /gnyis par gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gsum par ⑩ut+pal dmar po'i phreng / /'od 'phro rtag par mchod pa dang / /phul du byung ba'i bstod pas bstod/ /gsol ba 'debs shing sngags bzlas na/ /bu stsol 'gyur la the tshom med/ /bsrung 51nyedang nor 'phel dbang byed dang / /bu slong ba yi phyag rgya ni/ /smin drug snar ma rgyal la bri412/ /lhag ma rnams ni ci bder bri / /gang zhig sems stor yid mi dga'/ /glo bur yi mug skye 'gyur na/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa yi/ /dbus su rang gzugs mtshan ma bri/ /'dab mar rdo rje mdog bzhi pa/ /gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ /mu khyud la ni spyan ras gzigs/ /don yod zhags pa'i sngags bri'o/ /gnyis par rdo rje phreng ba bri/ /de'i rgyab 'od kyi phreng ba bri/ /rtag par mchod cing gsol ba gdab / /nad sel tshe ring bsod nams 'phel/ /gang zhig 1 shes rab 'dod pas ni/ /dpal be'u rgyal po'i du mar ni/ /tri yig rgyab tu sngags 'dis bskor / /smyo dang kā 1 la de ka 15la/ /ma ni swā hā zhes pa byi17/ /de rgyab mu khyud 'khor ba la17/ /mgrin pa sngon po'i rtsa sngags bri/ /de rgyab 'od kyi 1 ra ba brim/ /gang gis 'di 'chang mchod pa la/ /nad dang gnod pa kun bral te/ /dug dang rims nad 'joms pa dang / /shes rab myur du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /91—938

yul du lo thog 1)nyams pa dang / /thog 'brug ser ba rgod pa dang / /klu dang sa bdag gnod pa ste/ /de bsal tshogesbyor ba bshad par bya/ /shing kun ge dkar po ma nyams pa/ /nyams dga'i sbyor ba nyi rim ri4ril/ /rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa / /mig sman gyis ni bri bar zhebya/ /grwa rnams la ni hūm̐ yig la/ /oṃ dang dzi ni tshogati ti te/ /hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ /mu tsho khyud dang po 8mgon po che/ /gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags phreng bri/ /gnyis par 9skuthugs rje chen po mgon/ /mi bshol 57ba yi sngags kyis bskor/ /gsum par rdo rje phreng ba dang / /me yi 'od dang ldan par bri/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bstan tsam gyis/ /klu yi rgyal po mthu ldan rnams/ /'khor dang bcas te lus skams 11'gyur/ /gang gi khyim du gdod pa dang / /ma ho rta sogs yams nad can/ /bsal ba'i thabs kyi 12phyag rgya ni/ /brtan par drang srong tshogs rnams nyon/ /ko bi da ri'i shing la ni/ /khru 1 gang khru gnyis dbyibs gru bzhi/ /gas 'grugs chag sogs (2med pa la/ /shin tu srab 'jam sor gnyis rngams/ /shing de la ni rta babs gzugs/ /'khor lo gdugs dang bcas pa yi/ /brtsegs pa'i g.yas zur dang po 17ni/ /rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ste/ /gnyis pa 1 ut+pal dmar po'o/ /gsum pa 18'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 19ser/ /bzhi par pad+ma dkar po'o/ /g.yon zur dang por pad+ma dmar/ /gnyis pa ri ut+pal sngon po'o/ /gsum par nor bu bzhi rgya gram/ /nang khang 1du ni pad+ma bya/ /'dab ma brgyad pa 'od ldan pa'o/ /lte ba dang ni 'dab 22brgyad la/ /oṃ dang pi shā tsi par+ṇa lha/ /sha ba ri sarba byā 2 snyil/ /pra ri sha ma ni swā hā zhes/ /rbaḥ 'ayig la ni bskor bar bri/ /mu khyud dang po rna spyan ras gzigs/ /gdong bcu gcig gi 9sngags bri'o/ /gnyis par 91wa 939

chos kyi gtsug tor gyi/ /rtsa ba'i phreng sngags bri bar bya/ /rgya skyegs dang ni mtshal yin te/ /de la shing spyin 3)byug par bya/ /mchod dang gsol gdab sngags dag ni/ /bdun stong re re brjod byas nas/ /sgo gong la gdags byung ②'jug tshe/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta phyugs yams nad ma lus la/ /rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /'jig rten mgon gyi rig sngags mthus/ /myur du sel bar mnan pa dang / /bzlog ci dang bcing bar dunamadzod 6ces brjod/ /phyugs bdag chen pos 7)skyong ba ltar/ /glang po rta bong ma he'i tshonatshogs/ /brtan zhing nad dang gnod pa med/ /shin tu 'phel zhing rgyal 9bar 'gyur/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dmag dpung chen po 'jigs pa la/ /khyad par du ni skyob pa yim/ /phyag rgya sbyor ba mnyan par gyis//yung bas ras sam shing la ni/ /pad dkar steng du kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / /ral gri 'od ma bri bar bya/ /de la gdu bu /lhagasum gyis bskor/ /dang po rmo gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gnyis pa 12seng ge sgra yi sngags/ /gsum par ha ya chen po'i sngags/ /de rgyab me miyi ra ba bri/ /'di la gsol ba btab nas ni/ /g.yul ngor khyer 15te zhugs pa gang / /dgra dpung chen po 'bros 'gyur te/ /rang nyid g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /longs 17spyod phyir lho tshoni byang bltas bri/ /dbang byed 1 pa ni nub tu ste/ /g.yul bzlog nya6pa ni lhor bltas bri/ /lhag ma rnams la shar bltas bri/ /dkar ser dmar dang sngo ba yi/ /dbye bas zas dang gos shes bya/ /'dzum dang rngam dang dgod tshodang khro/ /bzhin gyi rnam pa gebashad pa yi/ /sngags dang sngags kyi 'od phreng 22dang / /lha yi kha dog dbye ba dang ske/ /snod la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang / /rgyan 2 yang de ltar shes par bya/ /91wa 940

kun kyang rin chen pad+ma'i gdan/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan par ni/ /sngags kyis 1)yig 'bru'i lha rnams bzhugs/ /sngags rdzogs nas ni sngags su dmigs/ /gang gis phyag rgya 'chang byed la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang / /rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs rnams dang / /'jig rten 'dren pa'i tshogs bcas dang ske/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang tshogs chen dang / /khro bo tshogs bcas ma lus dang / /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan rnams/ /ci 'dod las rnams ma lus pa'i/ /grogs dang dpung du byas nas ni/ /tshul bzhin du ni bsgrub (2pa la / /brtson 'grus gang dang gang gis kyang / /the tshom du ni mi bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba las phyag rgya la brten rdo pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas mkha' la gshegs pa yi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i drang srong mchog /mtshan dpe du ma rgyas pa che/ /nyi ma'i gong bu zhes bya ba/ /drang srong rje dpon tshogs kyi mchog /'gro don rdzogs mdzad thugs rje can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po la/ /sangs rgyas tshig gis 'di skad gsol/ /oṃ 'od zer du ma ther zug gi/ /srid 'dam rastug po sel byed rgyal/ /yon tan ye shes kyis brgyan 6sku/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /gsung snyan yan lag brjod bral chos/ /bag chags ri bo snyil 7mdzad rgyal/ /skye 'gag bral ston sde snod gsum/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /skye 'gag gnod bral mnyam bzhag na pa/ /ting 'dzin shes rab 'phel mdzad rgyal/ /ye shes gzigs pa mtha' yas thugs/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /sna 91—941

tshogs sman dang sngags sbyar nas/ /lha yi gong bu'i ril bu byi)ni/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dngos grub ma lus rdzogs pa yi/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma lham namadzad pa'i/ /mgon po pad+mas bshad du gsol/ /'gro rnams ma rig 'dam la bzhen/ /srid 94pa'i thag pas 55rgya gram bcings/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mun pas g.yogs/ /nga rgyal phrag dog chu bos g.yengs/ /ngan rtog log 6lam g.yang sar ltung 7/ /bag med ser sna'i dug gis myos/ /sdig pa'i grib mas rnam par rgyas / /bag chags 'thug 9po'i ri bos mnan/ /mgon po 1 khyod ni 11thugs rjes ngal ba med/ /nyes pa'i rgya mtsho bsal ba'i phyir/ /shes rab thabs 'byung bshad du gsol/ /de nas 'jig rten mgon po nya rje/ /thugs rje thugs dpal 1 mnga' ba yi/ /thugs dam rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu /sabacas / /khyad par gsung 15'di bka' 17stsal to/ /mtha' dag gzugs sgra thos pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul bsgyur dang gzhan sems shes/ /'das dang ma 'ongs don shes dang / /mtha' yas shes drug las spyod pa/ /dngos dang rtags 51 dang cha mthun 1 gyis/ /rnam pa bcwa 19brgyad dag tu 'gyur/ /phra dang yang 2 byedang mchod par bya ba dang / /bdag por gyur dang dbang du 'gyur ba dang / /gar yang phyin yang 'dod dgur 1ldan pa dang / /dga' mgur 2naganas te dbang phyug yon tan no/ /rnam pa brgyad kyis dper na bya yis/ /longs spyod dbang dang lus 2 la dbang / /tshe la dbang dang rkang mgyogs dang / /chu la mi 'bying lhamakha' la 'gro/ /sa 'og 'gro dang mi snang ba/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs / /dngos po gang dang gang bsgrub 7rnams/ / ril bu las ni 'byung 'gyur gyi / /gzhan ni 29myur du 'grub mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 91wa 942

ril bu ni/ /mtshams (1med la sogs byed pas kyang / /rnyed ma thag tu dngos grub 'gyur/ /nye dang dbang ldan lha yi sras/ /ma mos dbang du byed 2gyur na/ /'byung po sha za lha min mi/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro 'byung po klu/ /dud 'gro la sogs rdzogs gzugs can/ /sems can gzhan lta nasmos ci dgos/ /dngos grub bzang po 'dod pa yis/ /khyad par ril bus 94 'di bsgrub bya/ /gi'u rinawang dang ni lig bu mig /sdong ros bzang por sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu 6rgya sran tshad byas nas/ /snod gtsang nang du gzhag 7par bya/ /sku yi mdun du sngags brjod na/ /sngan nachad ma mthong snang ba 'am/ /sgra thos sam ni bde gshegs gzugasal/ /yid 'ong mngon du byung ba sogs/ /mar ngo gsum gyis 'byung bar 'gyur / /de nas zla ba gzas bzung tshe/ /ci 'byor mchod de snyim par bcug /bzlas brjod byas nas nyi shar na9/ /du bar 'thul dang dri can 'gyur/ /dud 'thul lus la byugs pas kyang / /snang ba dang 'od gzugs can dang / /'dzam gling phyogs rnams rgyu ba dang / /longs spyod che dang ldan 'gyur te/ /shi 'phos nas ni khodaga' ldan gnas su skye 1/ /dri ma tsam gyis lus byugs kyang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang byed cing 12/ /thos pa 'dzin cing sgyu rtsal 1lhamakhas/ /shi nas 'dzam gling 'di nyid du/ /lcang lo can gyi gnod sbyin ni/ /'khor la pāgazhon nu'i rigs su skye/ /yang na mi yi rgyal po 'am/ /glang 15po nyid du skye bar 'gyuras / /'bar ba lus la bskus na blta1 / /rig sngags 'chang lus nyi shar mdog /bskal 18par gnas te 'dod dgur 19spyod/ /'jig rten kun du thogs med rgyu/ /mkha' lding sa 'og chu bran 'gro/ /sangs rgyas kun nas phyin nas kyang / /dbang por gnas te rgyal por gnas/ /sprul pa'i rdzas kyis bde 91—943

gshegs mchod/ /'dod nas shi 'phos 'jig rten khams/ /gzhan 'das sangs rgyas dag tu skye/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yisatshi/ /bdag nyid yid du 'ong 'dod pas/ /gur gum tshogeg bur gla tsho ge rtsi dang / /gi'u bawang bsregs snyenas sngags stong bzlas/ /brdungs te phye mar byas nas kyang / /sngags stong bzlas te chu gtsang gis/ /ril bu rgya sran tshad byas nas/ /re re la yang stong stong brjod/ /rlung dang nyi mas 6)ma reg paratsho ri/ /bskams nas snod gtsang gzhag 8par bya/ / ril bu ①tsam cig yimur na yang / /rgyal po blon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mthong na bu bzhin gzigs pas 31na/ /tha mal skye bo smos ci dgos/ /nor rnams gzhan gyis ster ba dang / /bsgo ba la ni ngag btsan 'gyur / /ga pur gur gum gi'u wang 12dang / /tsan+dan gan da 1 brda dang / / gla rtsi ngadag ste cha mnyam du/ /re re sngags stong bzlas nas su/ /brdungs te ril bu byas pa dag /g.yon pa'i zhal la gdags par bya/ /bdun /snyenas nya yi bar du ni/ /sngags bzlas pa dang mchod pa 7bya/ /bdugs pas nad dang gdon rnams sel/ /mig la byugs pas rgyal po dang / /rgyal mo bu dang bu mo dang ske/ /blon po la sogs dbang du 'gyur/ /khar bcug tsam gyis grol bar 'ong ske/ /gdams pa thams cad don yod 'gyur/ /spyi bor btags na byad stems dang / /g.yul las shin tu rgyal bar 'gyur/ /gal te phye mas bdugs 3 pas kyang / /sdig pa thams cad byang 'gyur te/ /kun gyi 18mthong dang dga' ba dang / /gzi byin 'phags pa kun gyis mchod/ /ga bur gla rtsi gur gum nyu9dang ske/ /tsan+dan gla rtsi ka ko la/ /spos kyi rgyal po pad+ma dang / /ut+pal sngo dang tsan+dan dmar/ /re re la yang stong stong tshwa )bzlas 1/ /cha mnyam phye ma rtagi'u ༷ lha91wa 944

wang bcas/ /ril bu tsa na ka tshad bya/ / grib skams 1)byas nas lus la 'chang ge/ /gling bzhi kun khyab rgyal srid 'thob/ /kra ku la yi thang chu dang / /sdong ros bed dang ut+pal sngo/ /rgya mtsho lbu ba gi'u po ༄wang dang / /yungs bodang skyer pa gur gum 9gedang / /ga pur dang ni gla rtsi gsum/ /re re la yang sngags stong bzla/ /de nas sku yi mgul btags te/ /stong bzlas dril nas ril bu bya//mig nad sel na chu dang sbyar/ /so nad la ni rdziraka ka ru/ /rna ba'i nad la ru rta ste / /ut+pal mu tig mig nad la/ /gre ba'i nad la ba sha 7ka /glo nad la ni ba le (peka(ge /sha ka ra yi mthang dang sbyar/ /rlung nad la ni mar dang sbyar/ /mkhris mnad la ni tig ta dang / /bad kun la ni sga nyadedang sbyar/ /mdze nad la ni dug mo nyungs/ /ma zhu ba la kha ru 〈be/ /spangs nad rnams la thug po ṇ+ḍache/ /bgegs dang yams nad sel ba la/ /gu gul dang bcas bdug par bya/ / ril bu'i mayon tan mtha' yas ni/ /nam yang brjod par mi nus so/ /gu gul la ni stong bzlas pa'i/ /ril bus 36bgegs tshogs sel bar byed/ /ke 17su rtsa dang sge'u 51 rigasher dang / /ba la ta 39ka tsha ba gsum/ /ser po mu zi phye ma rnams / /sbrang rtsi dang bcas ril bu tsho )bya/ /pad+ma gar dbang sngags stong bzlasal/ /zos 27pa tsam gyis lus rgyas te/ /nad dang gdon dang dgras mi tshugs / /'dod rnams thams cad grub 2par 'gyur/ /ta ku'i rtsa ba ba ru ra/ /skyu ru ra dang til ti la/ /mnyam byas srin bya'i khrag dang ni/ / ril bu 2byas la 2stemig la byug snye /klu dang yi dgas na khang pa dang / /sa 'og thams cad mthong bar nges/ /byis pa zla ba gsum pa'i lce/ /nyin gcig spos por 5 nang du gzhug /gnyis pa ra 'o gsum dang 'byung / /bzhi pa ril bu tshil chen 91wa 945

btsotshol/ /lnga pa sbrang rtsi na nang du ste/ /drug pa dngul chu'i nang du bzhag na /bdun pa rigs ngan thod par ni/ /byi la'i khrag gis bsku 4kyil gzhag55 /skams canas bya dang spyang ku'i 7sha /lhan cig rang gi na khar bcug na/ /de ma thag tu mi snang 'gyur/ /gzhan yang yon tan dpag tu med/ /ldong ros gyen du bcas pa dang / /dza 9) lo ma sa bon bcas/ / ril bu 1 7sngags stong bzlas pa yis11/ /bar snang la ni 'gro bar nges/ /bas 912ma dang ki ram dang / /ma ka ri dang su mi tam/ /bra pan ta ma'i ril bu 12ni/ /nyi zla gzas thubazung dus su mid/ /shes rab phul du 'byung ba ste/ /thos pa 'dzin 'gyur smos ci dgos//gi'u 15wang sā 17pho tsi na 1 dang / /sre ta sbrang gi ril bu 1 /bya/ /sngags stong bzlas nas khar bcug na/ /'das pa'i don rnams shes par 'gyur/ /gi'u 3)wang sug pa phye 2 tshom dang / /ba ra swā 21ta ha su ri/ /a lhar hu ri sbrang rtsir bcas / /ril bu byas nas sngags stong bzla/ /mid pas ma 'ongs don rnams shes / /gzhan yang nad 'don /byed pa yi / / ril bu 5chen po bshad par bya / /rgyal dang rnam rgyal na gu la/ /kun dha na gu li dang ni/ /ru ṇi a pa ya ba ni/ /i pa ya na ta ga 27ra/ /gan dha ga 27dang pri yang kun / /'khor lo che dang 'khor lo dang / /birgyu 29ka ṭi de bzhin du/ /so ma ra tsa un na ti/ /re re la yang sngags phreng dang / /brgya rtsa brgyad du brjod par bya/ /de nas brdungs te :sbrang dang bcas/ /byis pa la ni dpung par te/ /bu 'dod mo la mgul par gdags/ /'di btags /pa yi de ma thag /'jigs pa brgyad dang nad las grol/ /ba mar shu dag ba phyir bcas/ /lcags kyi snod du btsos pa yi / /ril bu a mra'i 'bras bu tsam/ /sngags 'di stong phrag brgyad brjod 91wa 946

de / /phyis ni nyi shu gcig brjod nas/ /snga bar mid pas shes rab 'phel/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo 1)ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā tsho ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi 4kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ derishurnye mṛ 6 rta/ ba la bsnya 7ni swā hā/ srod dang tho rangs dge sbyong dang / /dal smra gsong po dul bag can / /khrus la dga' zhing dri bzang bsten ri/ /spyod lam rab zhi khro ba med/ /rtag tu bsngags 9brjod brtse sems can/ /spyan ras gzigs nyid cho1 )la cher dang ske/ /gdung bag gdong /1la mchi ma can/ /lung thob bla mar rab dga' ba'i / /skyes mchog 12de la rab dge 51 zhing / /'jig rten skyong gi 1rilha rnams dang ske/ /'byung ba tshal sogs smos ci dgos/ /rtag par rang gi 17yid la ni/ /snying po gsang sngags bcang bar bya/ /nye ba'i snying po lus dag pa'i/ /lha yang rang la nye bar byed/ /rtsa ba'i sngags rnams brjod mang ba/ /khri dang 'bum dang sa ya dang / /sa ya gsum dang drug brjod de/ /kha cig la yang bzhi dang ni / /lnga tsam gyis ni de grub yin/ /las la sbyar ba bdun dang ni/ /bcu bzhi nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /brgya dang de bzhin stong gis rdzogs/ /de ma thag tu chu 1 yin te/ /cung zad ba ni mar gyis bya/ /brtan 1 par gyur pa 19ka ra sten / /ches brtan 21pa la srad bu yin/ /sman dang sngags kyis sel byed de/ /ril bus ring du skyong byed yin/ /sngags sgrub 2pa la mi mos pa'o/ /mdun du rtsom na de dag rnams/ /de skad gsungs pa'i de ma thag /rdo rje snying po nyi 'od dang na / /pad dkar rin chen snying po dang / /pad spyan gzigs kyi snying po dang ske/ /ye shes dbang phyug pad dbang phyug /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams / /rang rang sde dpung sder bcas pa/ /'khor gyi 2 dkyil 'khor chen po 91wa 947

rnams / /'jig rten dbang la cher dmigs nas/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rnams bkram byas te 1)/ /rin chen rigs las 'khrungs pa yi(mi/ /mchod pa (yinam mkha' gtos 4par bkang / /rol mo du ma lhab lhub dang / /sil snyan lha yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /sprin mdzes tshogs rnams rab 'khrigs ltar/ /bkod pa mtha' yas bsham bya ste(5sku/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /mgon gyur ye shes mnga' ba rnams/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung snyan la/ /yi ⑥rang skyes nas mtshan chen brjod/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog brtan (medache/ /'jig rten dbang po dbang phyug che/ /pad+ma sems dpa' pad 'byung che/ /rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa chen po chos rgyal gtso/ /blo gros chen po sems dpa' che/ /pad+ma 'chang dang pad+ma dpa'9she/ /pad+ma'i mgon khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma las byung dam pa'i yid/ /pad+ma gsal mdzad dga' mdzad po / /pad+ma'i rdo rje pad+ma'i sku/ /khyod mchog spyan khel phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang ba kun chen thabs po che/ /che mnyam dga' ba dgongs pa che/ /dpa' bo chen po brtan chen rgyal/ /bde ba chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bsam chen mkhyen chen theg chen po/ /rnal 'byor chen po mes po che / /bde stsol bde mdzad dga' mdzad che/ /pad+ma rgyas 37zhal phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos mnga' don mnga' pad+ma rgyal//dag pa chos mnga' chos mchog 'dzin/ /rmad 'byung 12chen ldan chos rab 'chang ske/ /chos kyi 1 tshogs khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog sems dpa'/ /rin chen sems dpa' chos sems dpa'/ /dam tshig sems dpa' las sems dpa'/ /kun mkhyen sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'jig rten dpa' bo dpa' bo mchog /rnam par gzigs gtso skyob mdzad che/ /91wa 948

cig ①tu bzhugs so/ /dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams gtsor byas nas chos ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ gang bcom ldan 'das la de yis 2thal mo sbyar zhing phyag 'tshal nas zhal 'dzum par gyur pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba yod de/gang sngon bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig na 'jig rten rnam par gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig 98༄rten gyi khams su/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po rgyal po 4de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las bdag gis blangs te/ gang yang bdag gis dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po gtsor byas pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu brgya stong mang po yang 'dus so/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don yod zhags 5pa'i ye shes kyi gtso bo'i 6ting nge 'dzin bcu pa brgya stong bdag gis rab tu rnyed do/ /gzhan yang gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das sa gzhi'i 7phyogs gcig tu rab tu spyod pa las rtog nasapar bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe sa phyogs de dbang phyug dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs ris gtsor byas pa'i lha'i bu stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis srung 79cib dang / skyob 7pa dang / sbed pa'i don du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po rab tu spyod na bcom ldan 'das sa'i phyogs gcig po de mchod rten du 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag don yod zhags pa'i snying po nyan pa de dag ni sangs rgyas mang po bye ba khrag khrig 91—1003

brgya stong la mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 4)bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po thos pas bdag gis du dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed par 'gyur ro/ /gang kha cig bcom ldan 'das sdig pa'i skyon byed pa/sdig pa'i chos thams cad la yang dag par spyod pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ dam pa'i chos la smod pa/ mnar med pa la gzhol ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la smod pa po de gal te 'gyod par gyur cing slan chad gcod cing sdom par gyur 4na/ bcom ldan 'das des nare zhig 56de nyid snang 3 bar gnas pa gcig gis de bzlas na de'i skye ba 'di'i las yongs su dag cing yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /phyir bzlog tshon par 'gyur ro/ /rims nyin gcig pa'am/nyin gnyis pa'am/ nyin gsum pa'am/ nyin bzhi pa'am/ de'i phyir khrag tu 'khru ba'am9/ tshad pa'am/ lag pa na ba'am/ rkang pa na ba'am/ mgo na ba'am / ha la ha la yis btags 1 tshopa'am/ mdze'am/ rkang shu'am/ 'brum bu phra mo'am/ lhog pa'am/ 'bras sam/ bye'u 'bras sam/ g.yan pa'am/mtshan bar 11rdol ba'am/ 'brum bu'am/ brjed byed dam/ khyab par na ba'am / gsod pa'am/ 'ching ba'am/ brdeg 12pa'am/ bsdigs nyusnyepa'am/mi snyan par brjod pa'am/ mdor bsdu 7na bcom ldan 'das lus kyi na tsha'am/sems kyi sdug bsngal 15lam/ rmi lam ngan pa mthong bas de'i las yongs su dag cing zad par 'gyur ro/ /sngar nyid nas dag pa'i sems tshadad cing lhag par mos pa rnams shin tu yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po dang / rigs bzhi pos ji snyed du bdag la sgyu dang g.yos kyang 91wa 1004

mchod par byed/ gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po nyan par byed pa dang ske/ don 'dzin par byed pa/ 'chang bar byed pa/ klog par byed pa/'dri 1)bar byed pa/ 'drir ge'ajug par byed pa/ kun chub par byed pa/sems can gzhan rnams nyan du 'jug par byed pa'am/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i rna bug tu gtugs te zlos nadapar byed/ sngags kyi tshig 'di sems par byed pa dang / dor ba med pa/ gzugs med pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ yang dag par 'byung ba med pa/ yun ring du 'byung ba med pa/sgyu ri rimed pa/ gos pa med pa/ mnyam pa'i sems g.yeng ba med pa/ phung po lnga dang bral ba'i sbyor ba 'dis ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de dag la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas brgya stong gis zhal ston 5par 'gyur ro/ /khyed kyis tsho6bzlas pas sdig pa bshags 3par 'gyur ro/ /ji snyed po tir bri ba 8byas nas khyim du bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mang pos 9ci bya ste/phan tshun 'gran pas nyan pa'am/ rje 7dpon gyis 'jigs pas sam/ gzhan gyi ri11rjes su 'jug pas sam/ gzhan smad par bya ba'i ched du nyan pa ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi byin gyis brlabs 12su mkhas pas shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi rna bug tu de'i sgra grags 15par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ gang la la'i skyes bus ngatsan+dan nam/ ga bur boram/gur gum mam17/ gla rtsi gnur zhing brgyad cing rngo ba'am/ sa la gzhibs 1 nas bdag nyid la byugs na/ de la tsan+dan nam/ ga bur ram/ gur gum 18mam / gla rtsi gnur ba'am brgyad pas de ltar dri 'pho 19bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang dri zhim po'ang na de nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar kho nar bdag gi 21don 91wa 1005

yod zhags pa'i snying po 'di la yang gang la la zhig gis 'phya zhing smod pa dang /snga ma ltar ji snyed bdag la sgyu 1)dang g.yos mchod pa (2 byed pa nga ride dag ni bcom ldan 'das dmu 4rgod kyi sems can de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur rol/ /'dod pas dka' bar 'dzin par brjod de phyi ma la'ang 5)ngo / /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de ru 96)tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab dang bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi dri dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po nyid du byed do/ /gang yang bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen ma'am/ de las gzhan pa'i kha cig don yod zhags pa'i snying po ched du byas nas dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la smyung (7bar gnas par 8byas te/lan bdun du don yod zhags pa'i snying po tshig tu mi brjod par yongs su (she kyibazlas na/ de la 7bcom ldan 'das mthong ba'i chos nyid la phan yon nyi shu tham pa so sor 'dod par bya'o/ /nyi shu po gang zhe na/ gang de'i lus la nad mi 'byung ba dang / las kyi dbang gis nad byung ba yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur rol/ /snum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i lus dkar bar yang 'gyur ro/ /skye bo mang po'i yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po sbubs su nub pa dang nor rnyed par yang 'gyur ro/ /nor yod pa yang rkun pos khyer 11bar mi nus so/ /mes mi 'tshig go/ / chu yis 12mi 'khyer 1 ro/ /rgyal po'i yid kyis kyang 'phrog par mi nus so/ /de'i las kyi mtha' rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la chu'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang char pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lan bdun du don yod zhags pa'i snying po chu'am thal ba la yongs 91wa 1006

su bsngags te/ phyogs dang mtshams dang steng dang 'og gi zhing la bcing ba byas na 3)nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mdangs za bas mdangs 'phrog par mi nus so/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ / dgra yis 'jigs pa 'byung dzon ba yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / mi yis 7 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyab par na ba'i 'jigs pa dang / /mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa drag po'ang ca'abyung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /me dang chu dang mtshon gyis 'chi ba'i dus 5byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /lhas kyang rgyun du nye bar srung 6)ba dang / skyob pa dang sbed par 97'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de ru du cibyams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms dang bral 99bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phan yon nyi shu po 'di dag so sor 'dod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang chos brgyad so sor 'thob 1 ste/brgyad po gang zhe na/ 'chi ba'i dus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge slong gi gzugs kyis zhal yang dag par ston par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar che'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba 11'khrul pa med do12/ /lag pa g.yob pa med do/ /bshang ba med do/ /gci ba med do/ /rlung gi rnam pa med do/ /shin tu legs par gnas shing dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kha 'og tu bltas nas tshe'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i dus su nyon mongs pa med 12par rab tu brjod par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang du smon lam btab pa de dang de ru 'iskye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyin re zhing dus gsum du lan gsum du bklag 15par bya'o/ /chang dang sha dang btsong gludang sgog skya 1 dang / bde byed la byin 91wa 1007

pa'i lhag ma khyad par du bsrung zhu bar 'dod pas de rnams spang bar bya'o/ /don yod zhags na pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sems can rnams la nus sam mi nus shes par byas la mnyan dugedu gzhug par bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis ser sna mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir phrag dog dang ser sna'i dri ma spangs pa ni byang chub sems dpa' yin no/ /sems can gyi don gyi ched ④du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun du yang 'gyur ro/ /shes rab ni byang chub tu brjod la sems dpa' ni thabs te/ de gnyis dag gis sems can gyi don nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te chos 'di rjes su zlos shing snying po de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdun du rjod tsho rapar byed pa ni 'khor bzhi po rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir dang / sdig pa byed pa gzhan rnams kyi yang phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ gang 'di dag pa'i sems can la khyod kyis bstan pa'i dus la bab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pa'i bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan mi 'dzums 6par gyur pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gson cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas 7pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo mang po la 2bde ba dang 'jig rten la rjes su brtse ba dang skye dgu'i 9tshogs chen po la phan pa dang bde ba dang rnam par thar 91—1008

oṃ bud+dha dharma 1)so bhā ya swā hā/ bklags tshogepas las thams cad 'grub pa yin no/ /dus gsum du bzlas na mtshams med pa lnga rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /a ga ru'i bdug spos dang /thal ba dang / chu dang / yungs kur du dadang seng lding gi phur bu la sogs pas mtshams ④bcing ngo / /rims nad thams cad la srung skud bcing bar tsho bya'o/ /nad thams cad la mar ram/ mar nag gam/ chu la yongs su bzlas te sbyin par bya'o/ /lus la yikhyab pa'i nad la mtshon chas gcad 97cing srung ci8)skud kyang bya'o / /lto na ba la tshwa chus nyams par byed pa'am/ 'jim bag ri'ogam/ chus kyang bya'o/ /mig gi nad la skud pa dkar po rna ba la bcing bar bya'o/ /so'i nad la ka char bī ra'i skoso shing gis so/ / mtshams bcing ba nyartal ni tshon 1 sna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du yongs su bzlas nas seng lding gi phur bu bzhi la bcings te phyogs bzhir gdab par byas na mtshams bobacings pa yin no/ /thams cad du srung 32skud dam/ chu'am thal bas bya'o/ /gza' tshathams cad la tshon sna lnga'i skud pas bya'o/ /rims thams cad la 1 skud pa dkar pos bya'o/ /sbrul dang / srin bu dang / ba spu byi rmo chib dang / lhog pa dang ske/ gre ba 'gags pa rnams la sbrang rtsi pi pi ling dang ldan pas bya'o/ /mig gi nad la dri zhim po'i chu'am/ rgya skyegs kyi chu'am/ sbrang rtsi'am/ shing mngar gyis bya'o/ /17rtsod pa'i dus thams cad du rtsod pa dang mi snyan 7par brjod pa la chu la 1yongs su bzlas te gdong bkru bar bya'o/ /yul gzhan gyi rgyal po'i 'tshe ba la yul 'khor du bum pa gang ba 2yang dag par bzhag nas gtsang mas gos gtsang ma gyon te mchod pa chen po byas shing bklags 2nyen zhi ba 91wa 1013

chen por 'gyur ro/ /de'i chus kyang gtor bar byas nas sems can thams cad bsrung tshob yin no/ /nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang / yams rnams zhi ba yin no/ /phyag rgya tsan+dan gyi thig le la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du yongs su bzlas na mtshams med pa thams cad zad par byed do/ /rtag tu bzlas na khyim bsrung 2ba'o/ /pad+ma'i sbyin sreg gi tsho sems can thams cad kyi bsrung baba'o/ /tsan+dan gyi sbyin sreg 5gis gza' 'chidang / 'byung po dang rgyu skar thams cad las ()skubasrung 8ba'o/ /rgyal ba dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang ske/ na gu li dang / dri'i na gu li dang /(9༷ dha ra ni chosadang / mi 'jigs pa'i lag pa dang / dbang po'i lag pa dang / dri'i pri yang ku dang / ta ka ra dang ske/ 'khor lo dang / 'khor lo chen po dang / rnam par gnon pa dang / so ma 11rā dzi dang / su nat+ta zhes bya ba ste/ de dag gang yang rung ba la lan 1nabargya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du yongs su bzlas nas nor bu lta bur byas nas mgo bo dang dpung pa la bcing bar bya'o/ /byis pa rnams kyi ni mgul du'o/ /bud med rnams kyi mdoms 1 su bcangs na rang nyid mchog tu skal ba chadang ldan par byed do/ /g.yang med pa nyams nas bu yang ster ro/ /nor bu 'di bcangs pas thams cad du bsrung 15ba byas pa yin no/ /dug dang mes mi tshugs so/ /dug gis byas pa yang 17skye bar mi 1 'gyur ro/ /nad byung ba yang 1 mi skye zhing myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gza' 19rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang sprin dang thog ni chus rengs 3 par byed do/ /ka ra bī 31ra'i lcug mas ni las thams cad byed do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po mchog tu grub pa 'dis ma bsgrubs 22par yang las 'di rnams byed do/ /de nas bsgrub dge31wa 1014

༄ga /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄༅bha /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pā sha hro da yaṃ ma hā yā na nā ma dhā ra tsā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros chen po sha ra dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang 91—1022

phyug snying rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu chen po thob pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi kha nas brjod pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'khor mang po'i dbus su smras pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bgyi ba da ltar bdag gis bshad par bgyi'o / /bdag gis sngags kyi tshig dang dgos pa thams cad ni grub par gyur cig /bdag 'jigs pa thams cad las srungs shig /tabya thā/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra / tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma ra ma ra/ mi ri mi ri/ mu ru mu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsi ri tsi ri 'i ri bi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ ma hā pad+ma hasta1/ ka la ka la / ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā shud dha satwa/ burgya budh+ya/ bo dha bo dha/bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ ka ṇa ka 2)kho/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇa ku ṇa/pa ra ma shud dha satwa/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hās+thā ma māstane/ tsa la tsa la/ sañca la sañca la/ bi tsa la bi tsa la/ e ṭa ṭa e ṭa ṭa/bha ra bha ra/ gi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru / e h+ye hi ma hā kā /ru ṇi ka /ma hā pa shu pa ti tsho be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra tsa ra tsa ra pa ra pa ra ba ra ba ra/ ma ra ma ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ha hā hi tī hu hū/oṃ ka ra brah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ na ra na ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ha ra ha ra/ rasmi sha ta sa ha sra pra ti maṇ+ḍi ta sha rī raṃ/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bhā sa bhā sa/ bhā ma bh+ra ma/ bha ga wan so ma/ ā dit+ya'i/ ya ma/ ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/91—1023

brah+man+d+ra / bā yu/ asna0)/ dha na da/ de ba/ ṛ ṣi ga ṇa (ges bh+yar tsi ta tsa ra ṇa(gu / su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ghu ru lhu ru/ sa nad ku mā ra/ru dra/ bā sa ba/ birgyu dha na da/ bā yu/ asdi/ ṛ ṣi/ nā ya ka /bi nā ④ ya ka ba hu pi bi dha be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ tha ra tha ra/ gha ra gha ra/ ya ra ya ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/pa ra pa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra dā ya ka /sa man+ta a wa lo ki ti/bi lo ki ti/ lo ke po shwa ra/ ma ho shwa ra/ tri bhu ba ne yishwa ra/ sarba gu ṇa sa ma a lo kṛ ta/ a wa lo ki te shwa ra/ mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/muñca muñca/ shī s+t+waṃ shrī s+t+waṃ/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang /'khrug pa thams cad dang / dug thams cad dang / nad thams cad las srungs shig /srungs shig /de bzhin du bsad pa dang / bcing ba dang /rdeg pa dang / spyo ba dang / rgyal po dang / me dang / chu dang / dug dang /mtshon las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇa ku ṇa / tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ yin dri ya/ ba la/ bo : ba/ /tsa tur ār+ya sa t+ya saṃ pra kā sha ku97 /ta pa ta pa/ ta ma ta ma/ da ma da ma/sa ma sa ma/ dha ma dha ma/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ma hā ta mo/ an dha kā ra bi dha ma na/ ṣaṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ka /ma la ma la/ mi li mi li/ mu lu mu lu/ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ ji khri khri ji/ ṭhā ṭhā zu mu / e ṇi ye tsam kṛ ta pa ri ka ra/ e h+ye hi 8rim hā kā 9ru ṇi 17/ /khri nyu1shwa ra/ma he 12tha ra/ ma hā bhū ta ga ṇa saṃ bhañja ka /ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru 91—1024

ku ru/ pa ra pa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ba ra ba ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ki ṭi ki ṭi/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma hā bi shud dha bi ṣa ya ni sti'i si na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka shwe ta yadz+nyā u pa r+pā ta/ rat+na 9(mu ku ṭa/ mā lā dha ra/ sarba dz+nyā shi ra si kṛ ta dza ṭā ma ku ṭa/ ma hā ad bhu ta/ ka ma la a lo kṛ ta ka ra ta la/ sgyu dzoṭa na/ sa mā dhi/ bi mok+ṣa/ a pra kuspya/ ba hu satwa san ta ti pa ri pā tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sarba kurma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho 0dha ka /sarba dz+nyā tshwa na pa ri pu ra ka /sarba byā dhi pa ri mo tsa ka /sarba satwa ā shā pa ri pū ra ka /sarba satwa sa mā shā sa na ka ra na mastu te swā hā/ a mo ghā 5ya swā hā/ a mo gha pā shā ya swā hā/ a dzi tā ya swā hā/ a pā rā dzi tā ya swā hā/ a mi bo tā bhā ya swā hā/ a mi tā bha su tā ya swā hā/ mā ra si (7 rgya pra marda nā ya swā hā/ a bha yā ya swā hā/ a bha ya pra dā ya swā hā/ dza yā ya swā hā/ bi dza yā ya swā hā/ dza ya bi dza yā ya swā hā/ ba ra dā ya swā hā/ ba ra pra dā ya swā hā/ a kā la mṛ 986 pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ i dañca me kurma ku 79༄ru na mastu te swā hā/ oṃ ra ṇa ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+ra rdza 1 sirdzu swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ dza ya swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥtri lokya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥhaḥrgyu phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs sngags 'di'i cho ga ni a mo gha pā sha'i gzungs bum pa la bzlas pas mi bgegs kyis brlams pa'am/ 'dre gdon gyis zin pa'am/ byad 'og tu chud pa'am/bud med byur ngad cing bu med pa'am/ bu mi 'tsho ba la sogs pa la phan par bya ba'i phyir cho ga bya na/ 'bab chu'i 'gram mam/ shing gcig pa'i drung ngam/lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ khang stong la sogs pa'i dbus nas dkyil 'khor gyis blang bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi la/ nub phyogs sam/91—1025

byang phyogs kyi sgo btod pa cig tshon rtsi dkar po sna gcig gis bris te/ dbus su yang pad ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa cig bris la/ gser dngul lam zangs kyi bum pa ma zhum pa/ mi 'jig pa'am/ kham pa'i bum pa sar pa so btang ba'i nag po dang ra ri med pa gcig spos chus bkang ste/ rin po che sna lnga/sman sna lnga/ 'bru sna lnga blugs la/ mgul ras dkar po sar pa kha tshar ma bcad pa dang / me tog gi phreng bas bcings te/ khar shug pa'am/ thang shing gi mgo lcogs bcug la me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa gcig pad ma'i steng du bzhag la/ gzungs klog pa nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi skur bsgyur te/ bum pa de yang rin chen rdzing bu bdud rtsi'i chus gang bar bsams la/ chu de'i nang nas pad ma dkar po cig byung bar bsams te/pad ma de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po yi ge dkar po bsams te/ yi ge de las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gyur par bsams la mchod pa dang / bstod pa byas te/ gang bsgrubs pa'i dngos po grub par gyur cig ces gsol ba btab pas/ a mo gha pā sha'i gzungs mang pos bum pa de la lan bcu gsum du tshig gzhan mi smra bar bzlas te/ bum pa de'i chus de'i spyi bo nas blugs na bgegs dang gdon la sogs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de la gos dang bcas par spyi bo nas blugs la/ blugs pa'i tshe yang gzungs klog pa dang / klog par bya ba gnyis yis kyang lus phyi nang gnyis dag pa dang / 'dre gdon las thar bar sems rtse gcig tu sems shing bklag go / gos gsher ba de yang yugs dor ba'i thabs su bor la/ gos dkar po sar pa gon te/ spos dang / me tog la sogs pas lus brgyan pa de nyid lan 91—1026

cig bklags pas lus bsrungs te bkra shis kyang bklag go/ /dkyil 'khor de'i kho ra khor yug tu 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyang so so'i ming smos te spyan drangs la mchod nas/ las gang bsgrub pa de grub 17par gyur cig ces smon lam btab nas / mchod pa rnam pa lnga pa gcig gis mchod la/ 'byung po phal rnams la yang gtor ma rgya cher sbyin no/ /bdag srung (2ba dang / mtshams bcad pa yang a mo gha pā sha'i gzungs de nyid kyis tshul bzhin du byas na/ de yang tshes brgyad la bya ba'i rigs so/ /cho ga 'dis bgegs kyis brlams pa la sogs pa gong du smos pa rnams las thar bar 'gyur ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ mi tha mal pa la byas na yang phyis bgegs dang / byad stems kyis mi tshugs/ nad 'go bas mi thebs / dpal che zhing bsams so cog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che sna lnga la gser byi ru/ mu tig /dung / shel/ sman lnga la/ sing ha/ byā sgri/gi ri kyini/ sa ha/ sa ha de ba/ 'bru sna lnga la/ nas so ba/ 'bras so ba/tilam/ gro/ mon sran/ ma sha'o/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā// //oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ /maṅga lo// //shu lha// //91—1027
